title: Senior UI/UX & Visual Designer
description:

You will work closely with clients, product teams, and engineering teams to ensure seamless and accessible user experience across all digital platforms.

title: Automatic Assembly, Set Up & Operate - 3rd Shift
description:
The TSUBAKI name is synonymous with excellence in quality, dependability and customer service. U.S. Tsubaki Automotive, LLC is an international tier-one supplier of high-speed chain drive systems to the automotive industry.

Automatic Assembly, Set Up & Operate is responsible for setting up and operating, changeovers, adjusting assembly line to assemble Automotive Timing Chain and Components, following established work standards. The machine operator using statistical quality control methods maintains the quality of all components and the timing chain. Changeovers and adjustments are exacting, but not difficult. Work to specifications, schedules, orders, and general instructions of the department group leader or supervisor, as defined in the work standards.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: The essential duties and responsibilities of this job are included but not limited to this job description – other tasks may be assigned and expected to be performed.

  • Perform preventive maintenance inspection before the start of each shift as outlined on the Preventive Maintenance Check Sheet. Apply oil or grease to specified areas. Confirm the operability of all detectors.
  • The ability to perform a more comprehensive PM on the machines including but not limited to oil changes.
  • Basic troubleshooting of chain assembly equipment to understand the alarm messages, identify what this issue is and how to correct the issue.
  • The assembly line consists of the following machines/operations: roller link assembly, chain assembly, riveting, pre-stressing, articulation checking, center distance measuring, automatic cutting, and endless operation, washing, final inspection, and packing.
  • Adhere to work standards. Responsible for maintaining production schedules, quality control records, chain assembly records, shipping charge numbers, and the traceability records for each charge of chain and referring any unusual problems to the departmental supervisor.
  • Prepare test samples for quality control per work standard. Record production and any other data required utilizing various forms as directed.
  • Utilize a machine-monitoring system to record downtime.
  • Detect faulty operation or defective material and report these and other unusual conditions to the group leader or supervisor.
  • Maintain work area and equipment in a clean and orderly condition and follow standard safety regulations.
  • Perform other similar and associated duties as required or directed.

title: Field Services Technician II
description:
At SPL, the work you do matters. Our teams provide trusted energy and environmental testing and measurement solutions that protect communities, support critical infrastructure, and safeguard the environment. With a nationwide footprint and opportunities for growth across multiple locations and disciplines, SPL is a place where you can build a career while making a real-world impact.


We’re searching for a motivated, detail-oriented Field Services Technician II to join our field sampling team in Plano, TX.


In this role, you’ll perform regulated environmental sampling, water and wastewater sample collection, environmental monitoring, field inspections, and specialized field operations, including independent execution of environmental sampling programs and operation of automated composite sampling equipment. This position also plays an important role in supporting environmental laboratory operations and requires flexibility to assist with laboratory workflows, sample receiving, sample preparation, and operational support as business needs require.


This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with backgrounds in environmental science, environmental services, wastewater operations, water treatment, utilities, industrial services, laboratory support, environmental compliance, field sampling, or technical field operations who enjoy hands-on outdoor work, operational variety, and cross-functional responsibilities.


What You'll Do

  • Perform regulated environmental sampling at municipal, industrial, and commercial sites
  • Collect and transport water, wastewater, groundwater, and other environmental samples
  • Deploy, retrieve, program, operate, and maintain composite sampling equipment
  • Load, unload, and transport samplers, coolers, and field equipment at client sites
  • Conduct field inspections, measurements, and environmental monitoring
  • Identify and resolve routine sampling or equipment issues
  • Maintain sample integrity, preservation, chain of custody, and holding times
  • Complete field logs, electronic records, and compliance documentation
  • Prepare and maintain sampling kits, equipment, coolers, and supplies
  • Support in-house sample receiving, verification, and preparation as needed
  • Communicate professionally with clients and escalate non-routine issues
  • Perform other duties as assigned

title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer (ID: 4028)
description:

  • Work with Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes (K8s), Ansible Tower, CI tools, and software artifact repositories.

  • Develop and maintain solutions using Go/Golang as a core development skill.
  • Support the infrastructure underpinning CI/CD tooling across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) applications on cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Provide L2 support for critical business applications and technical issues.
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, operating system, application, and network-related issues and drive incidents through to resolution.
  • Administer and maintain Linux-based environments, including operating-system-level configuration and administration.
  • Implement infrastructure automation using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including Ansible playbooks.
  • Support infrastructure alignment, standardization, and operational improvements across the development tooling environment.

  • Minimum 3 years of hands‑on Operations/Infrastructure Engineering experience.
  • Strong hands‑on foundation in cloud infrastructure, particularly Microsoft Azure.
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes (K8s).
  • Strong expertise in Go/Golang.
  • Hands‑on experience creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of DevOps and SecDevOps principles.
  • Experience with Ansible and Infrastructure as Code, including Ansible playbooks.
  • Experience with Ansible Tower is advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of Linux operating systems, particularly system administration and operational support.
  • Experience providing L2 support for critical business applications and production issues.
  • Experience installing, configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting COTS applications in cloud and/or on-premises environments.
  • Experience with infrastructure and application automation.
  • Experience troubleshooting network hardware and software‑related issues.
  • Experience managing incidents and implementing technical changes according to SLA requirements.
  • Experience with CI tooling and software artifact repositories is advantageous.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL or other relational databases is advantageous.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and related development tooling is advantageous.

You should possess the ability to:

  • Operate and maintain Azure and Kubernetes-based infrastructure supporting enterprise CI/CD platforms.
  • Develop automation and tooling using Go/Golang.
  • Design, implement, and maintain reliable CI/CD pipelines.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Ansible and IaC practices.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Linux environments at the operating-system level.

  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, application, network, and platform issues and perform root‑cause analysis.
  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot COTS applications across cloud and on‑premises environments.

  • Collaborate effectively with development, DevOps, infrastructure, and platform teams.

What we bring to the table:

  • The opportunity to work on a large-scale enterprise CI/CD and development tooling platform.
  • Exposure to a broad technology landscape including Azure, Kubernetes, Go, Ansible, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Nexus, Fortify, and other DevOps tooling.

title: English Teaching Fellow/University of Pennsylvania Boarding School Teaching Residency Master’s in Teaching Program for 2027-2028
description:
The Lawrenceville School, an independent boarding and day school located in central New Jersey, seeks dynamic individuals to join our community as a member of the Independent School Teaching Residency (ISTR) program, a two-year teaching fellowship offered in conjunction with the University of Pennsylvania Graduate School of Education (PennGSE), beginning in June 2027.


We are now accepting applications for our two-year teaching fellowship program for 2027-2028 in English.


ISTR Fellows join their departments at Lawrenceville as fully engaged members of the faculty, teaching their own classes from the start. Fellows will fulfill co-curricular responsibilities (in athletics, performing arts, or publications) and residential duties, including being a member of a House team, chaperoning student events, and advising a group of students in year two.


Fellows are paired with a mentor teacher in their discipline who offers support and coaching through regular classroom observations and ongoing conversations about life at Lawrenceville. Regular meetings with the cohort of eight fellows provide collegiality and a strong peer group of early career educators.


Teaching fellows are an integral part of a vibrant campus life. Our community lives, works, and eats together, all in enticing proximity to the variety of attractions in Philadelphia and New York.


Teaching fellows are required to live in school housing (basic utilities included). They are provided three meals per day in the school dining center and have access to athletic facilities.


If hired by Lawrenceville, fellows join their cohort at PennGSE, where they complete a rigorous two year course of study led by PennGSE professors and academic leaders from other boarding schools in pursuit of a Masters of Education from PennGSE. Throughout the year, fellows participate in regular distance learning sessions and gather in person four times–in June, October, January and April–on the UPenn campus in Philadelphia and at various host school locations around New England.


Upon completion of the two year fellowship, recent graduates have found desirable teaching and coaching opportunities at both boarding and day schools across the country (including Lawrenceville), as well as have gone on to pursue additional advanced degrees or consultant work.


The ideal candidate values hard work, learning and growth as an early career educator, and wants to collaborate to build community, connection and belonging for the students and faculty at Lawrenceville.


Essential Responsibilities


Teaching (two different preparations/courses)

  • In year one, two sections in Fall term and three sections in the Winter and Spring
  • In year two, four sections in Fall term and in either Winter or Spring, three in the other

Residential

  • Supervise a student dormitory as a member of a duty team one night a week from 6:00 - 11:30 pm.
  • Participate in Saturday programming as scheduled by the School.
  • Provide weekend chaperone coverage up to twice per term.
  • In addition, in year two, serve as an academic advisor to a group of six to eight students.
  • Live on campus with a cohort of other fellows and participate in the residential life of the School

Co-Curricular

  • Coach at least one season of interscholastic athletics
  • Lead/Co-lead one additional term of co-curricular activity (athletic, performing arts, community service, student publications, experiential learning)

Other duties as assigned

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer - SATCOM
description:
Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
The Skylark product line is focused on the rapid design, build, and test of cutting-edge active phased array antennas (AESA) for terrestrial and airborne applications. Current programs span high-power, large-scale ground terminals for missile defense to commercial airline and helicopter connectivity solutions.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Embedded Software Engineer with a strong background in developing embedded applications using Linux and Yocto. The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in embedded systems, device drivers, kernel modifications, and boot loaders, with a preference for experience on the Xilinx platform (though experience on other microcontrollers is also acceptable).
As a Cesium software team member, you will be responsible for software designs from concept through production, including product roadmaps, block diagrams, detailed design and coding, analysis, test, qualification, and in-orbit support. The ideal candidate will have development experience at nearly every level of the software stack, including microcontrollers, low-level drivers, board support packages (BSP), and user interfaces with an emphasis on applications and data management. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience in software testing and high-reliability qualification, as well as software engineering and software project management practices.
The successful candidate will present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and port embedded Linux applications, custom device drivers, and libraries.
  • Configure, modify, and integrate the Linux kernel and embedded boot loaders.
  • Work extensively with U-Boot, and Linux kernel configuration.
  • Maintain and support the Yocto build system in a CI/CD environment.
  • Package and deploy software images for various hardware platforms.
  • Create and manage Linux images tailored to specific embedded hardware.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure system integration and performance.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
  • Minimum of 5 years of industry experience in software development.
  • Experience in hands-on development and troubleshooting of software systems and hardware (such as motors, power distribution units, etc.).
  • Programming experience in C or C++.
  • Familiarity with software configuration management tools, defect tracking tools, and peer review.
  • Excellent understanding of multi-threaded applications and resource management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Strong hands-on experience with Embedded Linux and Yocto.
  • Familiarity with Xilinx platforms or other microcontroller-based systems.
  • Experience with boot loaders, kernel-level development, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple development tasks.
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.
CesiumAstro is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Staff Applications Hardware Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Ambiq is on a mission to enable intelligence everywhere — powering the AI edge revolution with the world's lowest-power semiconductor solutions.

Built on our proprietary sub- and near-threshold technology, our chips deliver multi-fold improvements in energy efficiency without costly process scaling. Since 2010, we've shipped over 300 million units to customers building smarter wearables, medical devices, IoT products, and AI-powered edge applications.

Our cross-functional teams span design, research, development, production, marketing, sales, and operations across Austin, Hsinchu, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Singapore. We move fast, tackle hard problems, and create space for people to grow through complex, meaningful work that shapes the future of technology.

We're looking for self-motivated, creative problem-solvers who are eager to push technological limits and make a real impact in energy efficiency.

At Ambiq, we live by five values: Innovate. Collaborate. Focus. Learn. Achieve.

If that's you, join us — the intelligence everywhere revolution starts here.

This role will be on-site 5 days a week in NW Austin.

Scope

As the Staff Applications Hardware Engineer at Ambiq, you will drive the development of both internal and customer facing evaluation hardware.

This role will work with our software development team, our design engineering team, and our field engineering team to satisfy internal and customer needs for low friction solutions to evaluate our SoC performance and power.

The successful candidate should have strong experience with PCB development for battery operated consumer electronics devices. Experience with wearable devices is a definite plus. The candidate must have experience with developing and debugging on ARM-based platforms and should have experience with low-power designs.

The person in this role will involve debugging device level issues on our SoCs, supporting our field engineers for customer issues with their components and boards, and supporting customer facing documentation such as Application Notes and Hardware Design Guidelines.

Responsibilities

  • PCB hardware architecture, design, development, and testing
  • Collaborate with internal engineering and validation teams to analyze and debug complex system level issues and develop solutions
  • Conduct customer hardware design reviews, help debug customer hardware issues, bridge the communication between field and engineering teams, and manage issue status tracking.
  • Assist with the design, debug, and testing of embedded microcontroller software drivers, algorithms, application code, board support packages, automated scripts, and design test cases to provide the required functionality to end customers
  • Develop manufacturing test procedures and hardware for board builds overseas
  • Create application notes, knowledgebase articles, and hardware design guidelines
  • Assist customers with the use of Ambiq SDK and hardware platforms

Qualifications

  • MS in ECE and 6+ years of experience or BS ECE with 8+ years of experience
  • Experience with hardware architecture design, component placement, layout, manufacturing test, system bring-up and testing.
  • Experience designing PCB schematics and layout using Altium Designer, Cadence, or similar PCB design software
  • Experience with MCU peripherals including SPI, I2C, UART, ADC, MIPI, USB, I2S and PDM..
  • Experience with controlled impedance and high-speed interface PCB layout
  • Experience working hands-on in the lab and using test equipment such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers
  • Excellent problem-solving skills dealing with complex system level issues related to HW/SW debug
  • Experience with at least one MCU IDE from ARM, Keil, IAR, Eclipse or other is a plus

Must be currently authorized to work in the United States for any employer. We do not sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas (now or in the future) for this role.

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
About Sycomp


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider, delivering complex technology solutions to enterprise customers worldwide. Headquartered in Silicon Valley, we support clients across more than 150 countries through our global integration centers, logistics networks, and engineering expertise.


Our teams operate at the intersection of IT infrastructure, supply chain, and services—enabling organizations to deploy and manage technology seamlessly across global environments. We are recognized for solving complex challenges and delivering reliable, scalable solutions that support critical operations.


At Sycomp, you will be part of a collaborative, globally distributed team where ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement are embedded in everything we do.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled and self-driven Data Center Engineer to join our Mumbai team, supporting critical infrastructure deployments for global enterprise customers. This is a hands-on, field-focused role where you will play a key part in delivering complex data center projects end-to-end—from initial rack integration through to full system commissioning and customer handover.


This position is ideal for engineers who thrive in dynamic, project-based environments and enjoy being on the ground delivering tangible outcomes. You will take ownership of installations, troubleshooting, and validation activities, ensuring that deployments meet both technical design standards and customer expectations. In addition to core delivery, you will also contribute to maintaining high operational standards, documentation accuracy, and quality control across projects.


At Sycomp, this role offers the opportunity to work on diverse, real-world deployment scenarios across different sites, gaining exposure to evolving data center technologies and best practices. You will be part of a collaborative global delivery network, where initiative, technical depth, and execution excellence are highly valued. With flexible working hours aligned to project needs and opportunities to support multi-site engagements, this role provides both stability and variety in equal measure.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end rack deployment including mounting, bolt-down, structured cabling (fiber and copper), power integration, and labeling
  • Execute installation, configuration, and commissioning of servers, routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure across OEMs such as Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Arista, HPE, and Dell
  • Coordinate with customers, OEM engineers, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution and acceptance testing
  • Perform fiber/copper termination, patching, OTDR testing, and performance validation to ensure network reliability
  • Validate LAN/WAN connectivity, redundancy, failover, and security configurations per design
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis during deployment and maintenance phases
  • Maintain detailed documentation including as-built diagrams, rack elevations, and test reports
  • Ensure all activities comply with safety, ESD, and data center operational standards
  • Support mentoring of field engineers to maintain installation quality and standards


Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience in data center infrastructure deployment, rack integration, and field implementation
  • Deep understanding of data center architecture, structured cabling systems, and hardware components
  • Experience working in multi-vendor environments and network infrastructure protocols
  • Strong stakeholder management and on-site coordination skills
  • Hands-on, results-driven mindset with focus on operational excellence
  • Certification: CCNA required; additional global certifications preferred
  • Willingness to travel for multi-site deployment projects (~10% travel as per business needs)


Why Join Sycomp?


Technology Means the World to Us

Technology connects people, enables business, fosters innovation, and helps organizations operate without boundaries. Every day, Sycomp’s diverse team delivers on the company’s mission to help customers and partners navigate the complexity of global IT—from cloud and data center computing to cyber security, networking, and integration and logistics across more than 150 countries.


If you thrive in a growth-minded and values-driven culture, Sycomp may be your next career adventure. At Sycomp, you will have the opportunity to work in a global setting, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and be part of a dynamic and growing organization.


Sycomp is known for its strong culture and commitment to employee growth. With a 93% company-wide retention rate, we foster an environment where people can make a meaningful impact, develop professionally, and build rewarding careers over the long term.


Learn more about Sycomp and our employee benefits at: https://sycomp.com/careers/

✨Join a group of passionate advocates on our mission to improve the lives of youth! Rite of Passage Team is hiring for a Regional Compliance Director at our San Pasqual Academy site in Escondido, CA✨

Required qualifications: Law degree.

Preffered qualification: Active bar membership in California and/or Nevada preferred

Pay: starting at $90,000 a year based on level of education and experience.

San Pasqual Academy is located on a beautiful 238 acres in rural San Pasqual Valley. SPA is equipped with all the amenities of a private high school, including classrooms, an auditorium, gym, and cafeteria. On grounds sports and activities include basketball, softball, and football. Our unique campus features residential staff and house parents serving as surrogate parents who mentor and tutor students, teach age-appropriate independent living skills, create opportunities to explore new interests, encourage participation in sports and recreation, assist in the exploration of career and job opportunities, and promote family living skills.

This job will require travel within CA and NV. Must be willing to travel.

This role will require close collaboration with both internal teams and external agencies to mitigate compliance vulnerabilities, provide technical assistance, and develop and implement corrective action plans as needed to maintain compliance with all relevant standards. This position is a key role on the Management team, ensuring success across all sites.

To be considered you should: Law degree or legal secretary background. Be able to pass a criminal background check, drug, physical, and TB test ~ Be able to pass a search of the child and adult abuse central registry

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

Apply today and Make a Difference in the Lives of Youth!

After 40 years of improving the lives of youth, we are looking for passionate advocates to continue the legacy of helping young people become successful adults. As a Regional Compliance Director, you will have the unique opportunity to create a positive, safe and supportive environment for the youth we serve while building a career rich in growth opportunities and self-fulfillment.

title: Lead Systems Engineer (MSP exp)
description:
Milestone IT is currently working with a well-established Managed Service Provider (MSP) to recruit an experienced Systems Engineer for a full-time position.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically strong Systems Engineer who enjoys working across complex infrastructure environments and wants to be part of a team that delivers high-quality solutions to a diverse range of clients.
You’ll be responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining and supporting enterprise infrastructure, with a particular focus on virtualisation, storage, backup and Microsoft technologies.

About the Role

As a Systems Engineer, you will work across a range of client environments, providing both project-based and operational support. You’ll be involved in maintaining highly available infrastructure, troubleshooting complex technical issues, implementing solutions and helping clients get the most from their technology investments.

This is a full-time role suited to an engineer who is comfortable working independently, taking ownership of technical issues and operating within an MSP environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, implement and support Microsoft-based infrastructure environments.
  • Manage and troubleshoot Hyper-V virtualisation and Failover Clustering.
  • Configure and support SAS and iSCSI SAN storage environments.
  • Deploy and maintain Dell and HPE enterprise server and infrastructure hardware.
  • Implement and support StarWind vSAN environments.
  • Configure and manage Veeam Service Provider products and backup solutions.
  • Support Microsoft Entra ID and associated Microsoft cloud services.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, storage and virtualisation issues.
  • Perform infrastructure upgrades, migrations and project implementations.
  • Monitor system performance, availability and capacity.
  • Maintain high standards around security, documentation, backup and disaster recovery.
  • Work closely with clients and internal technical teams to deliver reliable infrastructure solutions.
Must-Have Technical Skills

The successful candidate will have strong hands-on experience with:
  • Hyper-V Failover Clustering
  • SAS / iSCSI SANs
  • Dell and/or HPE enterprise hardware
  • StarWind vSAN
  • Veeam Service Provider products
  • Microsoft Entra ID
  • Microsoft Windows Server environments
  • Enterprise virtualisation and storage
  • Backup and disaster recovery technologies
  • Troubleshooting complex infrastructure environments
About You

You are a practical, technically capable Systems Engineer who enjoys solving problems and working with modern infrastructure technologies.

You'll ideally have:
  • Proven experience working as a Systems Engineer in an MSP or similar environment.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft server and infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience working with enterprise storage and virtualisation platforms.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and client environments.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • A proactive approach to identifying and resolving technical issues.
  • The ability to work independently while also contributing to a broader technical team.
  • A genuine interest in infrastructure and keeping your technical skills current.
Why Join?

This is a great opportunity to join an established MSP environment where you’ll work with enterprise-grade infrastructure and a broad range of technologies, rather than being limited to repetitive support tasks.
You'll have the opportunity to:
  • Work on complex infrastructure environments.
  • Get hands-on exposure to enterprise virtualisation, storage and backup technologies.
  • Be involved in infrastructure projects and implementations.
  • Develop your technical skills across a diverse client base.
  • Work alongside an experienced and technically focused team.
  • Build a long-term career within the MSP and infrastructure space.
Apply Now

If you're an experienced Systems Engineer with strong Hyper-V, storage, enterprise hardware and backup experience, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now or call Milestone IT on (03) 9670 6682 for a confidential discussion.

Title: GCP Data engineer

Location - Pune, Bengaluru, Mumbai

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and hands-on GCP Data Engineer to support the development and delivery of modern enterprise data and AI platforms on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

This role will work closely with Lead Data Engineers, Enterprise Architects, analytics teams, and AI/ML teams to build scalable, reliable, and AI-ready data pipelines and cloud-native data solutions that support enterprise analytics, intelligent automation, and digital transformation initiatives.

The ideal candidate should possess strong foundations in cloud data engineering, distributed data processing, and modern data platform development, along with a passion for building high-quality, scalable, and reusable data solutions in a fast-paced enterprise environment.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to work on large-scale data modernization, semantic data enablement, and next-generation AI data ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Cloud Data Engineering & Pipeline Development

  • Develop and maintain scalable batch and real-time data pipelines on GCP.
  • Build ingestion, transformation, and serving pipelines supporting enterprise analytics and AI use cases.
  • Assist in modernization of legacy data workflows into cloud-native architectures.
  • Develop reusable and maintainable data engineering components following established architectural standards.
  • Support implementation of event-driven and streaming-based data processing solutions.

2. Data Product Development

  • Contribute to development of reusable and domain-oriented data products.
  • Implement data transformation logic and standardized data models supporting downstream analytics and AI consumption.
  • Support implementation of:
  • Data quality validations
  • Schema management
  • Metadata enrichment
  • Data contracts
  • Reusable transformation frameworks
  • Ensure data pipelines are reliable, scalable, and production-ready.

3. GCP Platform Development

  • Work with GCP-native services including:
  • BigQuery
  • Dataflow
  • Dataproc
  • DBT
  • Pub/Sub
  • Cloud Storage
  • Cloud Composer (Airflow)
  • Cloud SQL
  • Develop ETL/ELT pipelines and optimize data processing workloads.
  • Support orchestration and scheduling of enterprise data workflows.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot pipeline performance, failures, and operational issues.

4. Semantic & Analytics Enablement

  • Support implementation of semantic models and business-friendly data structures for analytics and reporting.
  • Collaborate with analytics and BI teams to improve consistency and usability of enterprise data assets.
  • Assist in development of standardized metrics, dimensions, and reusable reporting datasets.
  • Contribute to metadata and data catalog integration initiatives.

5. AI/ML Data Enablement

  • Build and optimize AI-ready data pipelines supporting ML and GenAI initiatives.
  • Support feature engineering and data preparation workflows for AI/ML use cases.
  • Assist in integration with:
  • Vertex AI
  • BigQuery ML
  • Vector databases
  • GenAI frameworks
  • Contribute to implementation of semantic search and AI-assisted data interaction patterns.

6. Engineering Best Practices & Collaboration

  • Follow established coding standards, architecture guidelines, and DevOps practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and performance optimization activities.
  • Collaborate effectively with architects, lead engineers, analysts, and client stakeholders.
  • Contribute to engineering documentation, operational runbooks, and technical knowledge sharing.
  • Continuously learn and adopt modern cloud, data engineering, and AI platform technologies.

7. Governance, Monitoring & Operational Support

  • Support implementation of monitoring, logging, lineage, and observability frameworks.
  • Ensure adherence to enterprise security, governance, and compliance standards.
  • Assist in incident resolution, root cause analysis, and platform stability improvements.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for operational excellence and delivery quality.

Technical Expertise Required

Cloud Data Engineering

GCP, BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage

Data Processing

SQL, Python, PySpark, DBT

Cloud Composer (Airflow), Workflows

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 3–6 years of experience in data engineering and cloud-based data platform development.
  • Hands-on experience working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services.
  • Strong SQL and Python programming skills.
  • Experience developing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and distributed data processing workflows.
  • Understanding of modern data architecture concepts including data lakes, data warehouses, and streaming pipelines.
  • Exposure to analytics, AI/ML, or GenAI-enabled data ecosystems preferred.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in Agile and cross-functional delivery teams.

title: Senior Flight Dynamics Engineer
description:
Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are seeking a Senior Flight Dynamics Engineer to lead orbit design, trajectory analysis, and orbit determination analysis efforts across our spacecraft operations. You will own the flight dynamics function from early mission concept through launch, commissioning, and on-orbit operations. This role requires deep technical expertise, strong cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to build scalable tools and processes in a fast-paced startup environment.
You will play a critical role in shaping mission architecture, ensuring orbital safety and compliance, and enabling reliable spacecraft operations. You will work closely with the engineering team, program management to ensure the successful build and launch of our satellite. Element will be the largest, most powerful rideshare satellite in LEO. We’re launching eight of them in the next four years, starting with our first launch this year. Together, our small team will design, build, and iterate to reduce mass and cost while increasing performance, reliability, and manufacturability of a new generation of satellites. Let’s build!

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead orbit design, trade studies, and trajectory optimization for LEO/GEO/cislunar/deep space missions (as applicable).
  • Develop and maintain high-fidelity mission analysis models.
  • Perform launch window analysis, injection targeting, and dispersions analysis.
  • Define and validate ΔV budgets across all mission phases.
  • Support constellation design, station-keeping strategies, and end-of-life disposal planning.
  • Develop orbit determination strategies using tracking data (GNSS, radiometric, optical, etc.).
  • Support maneuver planning, targeting, and execution analysis.
  • Establish conjunction assessment and collision avoidance processes.
  • Support mission readiness reviews, launch campaigns, and on-orbit anomaly resolution.
  • Build, validate, and maintain flight dynamics tools and simulation environments.
  • Automate analysis workflows to scale with company growth.
  • Integrate tools with GNC, FSW, and mission operations pipelines.
  • Evaluate and implement industry-standard tools (e.g., GMAT, STK, ODTK, MONTE, custom Python/C++ frameworks).
  • Collaborate closely with GNC, propulsion, systems engineering, and mission operations teams.
  • Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to technical roadmaps and long-term mission strategy.
  • Interface with customers, partners, and regulatory agencies as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • B.S. in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Physics, or related field (M.S. or Ph.D. preferred).
  • 5 years of experience in flight dynamics, mission analysis, or astrodynamics.
  • Deep understanding of orbital mechanics and perturbation modeling, orbit determination and estimation techniques, maneuver design and optimization, and conjunction assessment and space traffic management
  • Experience supporting real spacecraft missions through launch and operations.
  • Strong programming skills (Python required; MATLAB, C++, or similar a plus).
  • Experience with industry-standard astrodynamics tools.
  • Ability to work independently in a high-ownership environment.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with small satellite or constellation missions.
  • Background in autonomous navigation or onboard orbit determination.
  • Familiarity with regulatory compliance (FCC, NOAA, ITU, Space-Track, etc.).
  • Experience building internal analysis frameworks from scratch.
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.
CesiumAstro is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

title: Vice President, Community Impact
description:
United Way of Dane County mobilizes the caring power of our community so all can thrive. From advancing health and education to strengthening livelihoods and local resilience, we connect people to possibility. Our mission is to unite the community to achieve measurable results that change lives. We collaborate with local nonprofits, individuals, families, people with lived experience, businesses, community leaders including policy makers, donors and volunteers to multiply impact and address complex issues no single person or organization can solve alone. As a local, autonomous member of a global network, we are a nonpartisan organization that works with leaders from all backgrounds to strengthen communities and expand opportunities for all.


We serve as a cornerstone in our community, bringing together people and resources to create lasting change. Together, we are The Power of Caring. Working for All.


Purpose:

The Community Impact team serves as United Way of Dane County’s knowledge hub for health and human services and family well-being in Dane County. Comprised of professionals from a range of disciplines, the team collaborates with organizations, community leaders and colleagues across the organization and community to advance collective impact, develop innovative, collaborative and equity-centered strategies that improve lives.


As an integral member of the executive leadership team and a direct report to the President and CEO, the Vice President of Community Impact serves as United Way of Dane County’s chief strategist for community impact. This position leads all aspects of the Community Impact department, including the collaborative development and management of community initiatives, budgeting, staff performance, volunteer engagement and partner relationships.


Provide strategic, energetic leadership by modeling equitable practices and advancing measurable results through partnerships, investments, data and research, connections to resources through 211, and public policy advocacy. Partner across the organization to strengthen giving, advocacy and volunteerism.


Lead the strategic investment of UWDC’s financial and human capital to achieve measurable community-wide change and improve outcomes. Use data and lived experience to strengthen credibility, effectiveness and impact. Bring the professional presence and depth of experience needed to credibly represent UWDC and its community partners locally, statewide and nationally. Build local alignment, coordination and shared measurement to accelerate United Way’s Plan For Community Well-Being.


Key Responsibilities


34% Executive Leadership Responsibilities:

  • Model and proactively demonstrate a commitment to equity and inclusion in all work.
  • Model and design equitable practices and systems-change approaches throughout the work.
  • Actively participate on the executive leadership team and help develop organizational goals and strategies.
  • Attract, retain and motivate staff who are committed to United Way’s Values and Behavior Standards.
  • Model and cultivate a culture of collaboration between departments and positions within the organization.
  • Cultivate productive relationships and partnerships that benefit the organization, particularly with nonprofit partner agencies, community leaders, volunteers, major donors and funders, government officials, senior staff and Board members.
  • Report and share relevant information with the Board, staff, partners and the community.
  • Partner with organizational leaders to design approaches and systems that align knowledge across departments, leverage impact and advance organizational goals.
  • Represent the organization as the primary community contact for community impact and recommend the appropriate role for United Way within community initiatives.


33% Strategy & Engagement:

  • Develop and advance strategies to achieve desired community impact and ensure the effective use of resources and approaches.
  • Ensure data on community needs and human services are regularly compiled, accessed and communicated to stakeholders.
  • Collaborate across departments to coordinate community impact priorities and strategies.
  • Advance community engagement and advocacy to address community issues through shared solutions and leveraged resources.
  • Oversee relationships with volunteers and donors, including compliance and reporting.
  • Develop and sustain management and operational plans using long-term goals, annual objectives and work plans as a framework.
  • Ensure continuity in volunteer leadership and support volunteer recruitment and recognition. Serve as lead staff liaison to Community Impact committees that report to the Board and ensure all departmental committees are effectively staffed.

33% Department Leadership:

  • Provide vision, leadership and team development across Community Impact.
  • Meet regularly with staff to discuss organizational context, plans and challenges; strengthen understanding of how each role connects to the mission; and seek and act on feedback.
  • Oversee plans to achieve team goals and coach staff in their execution.
  • Assign responsibilities with clear expectations, deadlines and available resources.
  • Continuously improve systems and processes and identify new opportunities for greater effectiveness.

title: HR Data Solutions Architect
description:
The HR Data Solutions Architect serves as the subject-matter authority on HR data and to lead the modeling and migration of the HR Warehouse and related sources to the enterprise Lakehouse. This role reports to the Senior Manager, Data Engineering and is responsible for defining how HR data is modeled, mapped, and governed as it moves to the enterprise Lakehouse — establishing trusted, well-structured HR data that supports reporting, analytics, and downstream business needs.

This role requires deep expertise in HR data and systems, data integration, and dimensional and domain-oriented data modeling. The HR Data Solutions Architect will partner with data engineering, data governance, and HR stakeholders to produce durable, business-aligned models that improve the consistency, quality, lineage, discoverability, and reuse of HR data across the enterprise.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the subject-matter expert for HR data domains — core HR, payroll, benefits, talent, time & attendance, and organizational structures — including their business rules, definitions, and lineage.

  • Design and govern conceptual, logical, and physical data models for HR data, and implement them across the Medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) using Delta Lake on Azure Databricks.

  • Lead source-to-target mapping from legacy HR systems and the existing HR Warehouse to the target Lakehouse, applying dimensional modeling to support HR reporting and analytics.

  • Identify and document the System of Record (SoR), Single Source of Truth (SSoT), and Single Version of Truth (SVoT) for HR entities, and govern the distinction between them across the Medallion architecture.

  • Provide architectural guidance on entity resolution and cross-system key management for HR identifiers (e.g., worker, position, and organization keys) spanning multiple source systems.

  • Partner with data engineers to migrate the HR Warehouse and associated integrations, mapping existing HR feeds and pipelines to Databricks-based ingestion patterns.

  • Support validation, reconciliation, and cutover between the legacy warehouse and the new platform.

  • Contribute to metadata and catalog practices (e.g., Unity Catalog), including lineage representation and business glossary definitions for HR data.

  • Champion data quality and ensure sensitive HR/PII data is modeled and handled in line with privacy, security, and compliance requirements.

  • Document data dictionaries, models, and source-to-target mappings to serve as authoritative references for HR data on the platform.

  • Mentor engineers and analysts on HR data modeling and migration best practices.

Education and/or Experience:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Human Resources Information Systems, or a related field.

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in data modeling, data architecture, or HR data/systems roles.

  • Deep experience with HR data and HR systems (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or comparable), including integrations.

  • Proven success designing data models across conceptual, logical, and physical layers.

  • Strong background in data integration — APIs, ETL/ELT, and middleware.

  • Proficiency in SQL and a solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts.

  • Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and data quality disciplines.

  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms; familiarity with Databricks or similar Lakehouse architectures is strongly preferred.

  • Ability to translate HR business requirements into sound, governed technical data structures.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Spark/PySpark, and Unity Catalog.

  • Familiarity with the broader Azure data ecosystem (Azure Data Factory, ADLS).

  • Experience migrating on-premises or legacy warehouses to a cloud Lakehouse.

  • Understanding of MDM and entity resolution to link key HR entities across data sources.

  • Knowledge of HR data privacy and compliance frameworks.

  • Experience mentoring analysts, data engineers, or other modelers on data modeling best practices.

  • Industry experience in legal or financial services a plus.

Other Skills and Abilities:

The following will also be required of the successful candidate:

  • Strong organizational skills

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Good judgment

  • Strong interpersonal communication skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Able to work harmoniously and effectively with others

title: NC Regional Natural Resources Team Leader
description:
SeamonWhiteside is seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial, and technically strong professional to serve as the North Carolina Regional Natural Resources Team Leader. This role will lead the growth, delivery, and quality of SW+ stormwater, stream restoration, floodplain management, and green infrastructure services across North Carolina, including watershed planning, stormwater control measures, drainage improvements, hydrologic and hydraulic modeling, FEMA flood studies, flood mitigation, stream stabilization and restoration, nature-based solutions, permitting, and related public and private sector infrastructure services.


The ideal candidate is a proven water resources leader with strong technical judgment, client relationship skills, business development experience, and the ability to mentor and grow a high-performing regional team. This position will be accountable for building market presence, developing client relationships, managing project delivery, supporting team development, and advancing SW+ standards, culture, and profitability within the North Carolina stormwater, stream restoration, floodplain management, and green infrastructure practice.


About Us


Since the company’s beginning in 1985, we’ve blended the disciplines of civil engineering and landscape architecture from concept to completion to create places of legacy and inspiration for our clients, community, and family. There is a big difference in how engineers and landscape architects visualize a project. At SW+ we approach every plan from both points of view, working together to create a successfully integrated venture. In our world, that’s a good thing.


With the goal of being the best design firm in the region, the SW+ leadership team continues to attract the brightest talent, each with a unique expertise in one of the many facets of land design. SW+ has a diverse portfolio at a variety of scales in both the public and private sector including mixed-use commercial developments, urban and suburban multifamily, healthcare, office, high end resort and parks and recreation projects.


With over 250+ employees, and offices in Mount Pleasant, Greenville, Summerville, Spartanburg, and Columbia, SC as well as Charlotte and Raleigh, Asheville, NC. SW+ inspires employees to stand behind its tagline, "Elevating the site design experience." Company culture is at the core of who we are. SW+ offers a mentorship program and other professional growth opportunities.


In addition, company sponsored events, such as golf tournaments, sports teams, and happy hours, along with philanthropic endeavors provide opportunities throughout the year to lift morale and strengthen bonds between coworkers.


Essential Job Functions

  • Lead and grow SW+ stormwater, stream restoration, floodplain management, and green infrastructure services across North Carolina, with emphasis on client service, technical excellence, quality control, team development, and profitable project delivery.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with municipal, county, state, institutional, and private sector clients, as well as strategic partners, regulatory agencies, and teaming firms.
  • Identify, pursue, and support new business opportunities, including proposals, scopes, fee development, interviews, and client presentations.
  • Serve as principal-in-charge, senior project manager, or technical advisor for stormwater, stream restoration, flood mitigation, and green infrastructure projects, as appropriate.
  • Oversee planning, design, permitting, bidding, and construction-phase services for stormwater control measures, drainage systems, watershed improvements, stream restoration and stabilization, floodplain modifications, flood mitigation projects, and nature-based infrastructure.
  • Lead or support hydrologic and hydraulic analyses, 1D and 2D modeling, watershed studies, floodplain mapping, scour assessments, stormwater retrofit evaluations, BMP design, and resilience-focused planning efforts.
  • Support green infrastructure and low-impact development strategies, including bioretention, bioswales, constructed wetlands, permeable pavement, regenerative stormwater conveyance, infiltration practices, and water quality retrofits.
  • Coordinate with SW+ civil engineering, landscape architecture, planning, surveying, and construction administration teams to deliver integrated site design and community resilience solutions.
  • Mentor project managers, engineers, designers, and emerging leaders; support recruiting, onboarding, training, career development, and performance feedback.
  • Promote consistent use of SW+ standards, tools, workflows, quality processes, and project management practices.
  • Monitor team workload, staffing needs, project financial performance, schedules, risk, regulatory requirements, and client satisfaction.
  • Represent SW+ in professional organizations, conferences, community engagement efforts, and industry events across North Carolina.

title: Afdelingsleder for Specialrådgivningen for børn
description:
Vi har sendt én af vores dygtige afdelingsledere videre i karrieren og søger derfor en ny leder til Specialrådgivningen – vores myndighedsafdeling for børn, unge og familier, hvor funktionsnedsættelse hos barnet eller den unge er en del af familiens hverdag.

Så har du lyst til at stå i spidsen for en fagligt stærk afdeling i Børn og Familie i Favrskov Kommune, og ønsker du fortsat at sikre det høje niveau, vi har i Specialrådgivningen, så er du måske vores nye afdelingsleder? Vi har fokus på at møde børn, unge og familier respektfuldt, og vi arbejder hver dag for at skabe gode udviklingsmuligheder og et godt hverdagsliv for børn og unge samtidig med, at vi sikrer, at familierne får den støtte og kompensation, de har behov for.

Du får en tæt samarbejdspartner i afdelingslederen for Familierådgivningen og Modtagelsen og bliver en del af et erfarent og velfungerende lederteam. Vi arbejder målrettet på tværs af afdelinger, står sammen og er optaget af at skabe ét samlet Børn og Familie.

Specialrådgivningen nyder anerkendelse blandt borgere, medarbejdere, ledere og politikere i hele organisationen. Afdelingen er kendt som en kompetent medspiller, som bidrager tværfagligt til at skabe trivsel for børn, unge og familier i Favrskov Kommune.

Du skal søge jobbet, hvis du kan se dig selv i følgende:
  • Du har naturlig autoritet, er robust og har en tydelig og anerkendende ledelsesstil
  • Du er uddannet socialrådgiver, jurist eller har anden relevant faglig baggrund
  • Du har ledererfaring, gerne fra det specialiserede børneområde, og meget gerne fra arbejdet med børn og unge med funktionsnedsættelser
  • Du brænder for personaleledelse og for at skabe resultater igennem andre
  • Du kan og vil samarbejde på tværs og være med til at styrke helhedstænkningen i organisationen
  • Du kan balancere mellem klare lovgivningsmæssige rammer, politiske mål, høje faglige krav og økonomi
  • Du kan skabe og fastholde motivation og gå forrest med begejstring på et fagområde, hvor sagerne ofte er komplekse og kræver høj faglighed.
Du bliver leder for 15 kompetente socialrådgivere og en fuldtids faglig koordinator, som alle ønsker sig en tydelig og faglig stærk leder. Du vil desuden blive ansvarlig for økonomien på det specialiserede børneområde sammen med chefen for Børn og Familie.

Yderligere oplysninger
Du kan læse mere om stillingens opgaver, vores forventninger til dine kvalifikationer, Favrskov Kommunes interne organisering og ansættelsesprocessen i job- og personprofilen her: Afdelingsleder for Specialrådgivningen for Børn | Favrskov.dk

Send en SMS til Charlotte Bøcher, chef for Børn og Familie, hvis du har lyst til en fortrolig snak om stillingen: 23 43 17 42, så bliver du ringet op.

Søg jobbet
Send din ansøgning til Favrskov Kommune senest fredag den 9. oktober 2026 via nedenstående link, hvor du finder alle ledige stillinger på

Favrskov Kommune kan kun modtage ansøgninger sendt elektronisk. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelsen, at den person, som vi ønsker at ansætte, ikke er straffet for forhold, som gør vedkommende uegnet til at bestride stillingen. Der vil derfor blive indhentet straffeattest på den kandidat, der tilbydes ansættelse.

title: Director, Patent Litigation Consulting (High-Tech IP)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Patent Litigation Consulting (High-Tech IP) based in India.

This is a senior leadership opportunity focused on guiding high-tech intellectual property consulting across complex patent litigation and licensing matters.
You will lead and develop distributed teams of technical consultants and IP specialists while overseeing multiple high-value engagements simultaneously.
The role combines people leadership, program delivery, technical direction, client management, and operational excellence.
You will help shape rigorous work products such as claim charts, source code analyses, reverse engineering studies, patent portfolio assessments, and expert report support.
Your technical expertise will be applied across areas such as telecommunications, semiconductors, AI/ML, cloud, software, consumer technology, and medical devices.
You will work closely with legal teams, executives, expert witnesses, and other senior stakeholders, translating complex technical findings into clear strategic insights.
This is an opportunity to influence practice standards, develop technical talent, and contribute to high-stakes matters within a global, remote-first environment.

Accountabilities

  • Lead, manage, and develop technical consultants and IP experts, including distributed contributors across multiple locations, with responsibility for hiring, performance management, coaching, career development, and retention.
  • Own delivery across a portfolio of concurrent patent litigation, licensing, and IP consulting engagements, including scoping, planning, budgeting, staffing, milestones, utilization, risk management, and on-time delivery.
  • Serve as the senior delivery owner for high-value and time-sensitive matters, proactively identifying dependencies and escalating risks with practical solutions.
  • Establish and maintain high-quality standards for technical work, including review protocols, documentation, peer review, defensibility checks, and consistent methodologies.
  • Build repeatable playbooks, templates, training programs, and operational processes that improve delivery efficiency and reduce reliance on individual expertise.
  • Champion the adoption of AI-enabled tools and help shape technology, workflows, and knowledge-management practices used by technical teams.
  • Manage senior client relationships by leading status discussions, resolving escalations, advising on technical approaches, and communicating findings to legal, executive, financial, and other non-technical audiences.
  • Direct and quality-control technical analyses involving claim charts, source code review, reverse engineering, technical due diligence, patent portfolio analysis, damages-supporting work, and expert report preparation.
  • Develop technical narratives that connect rigorous analysis with litigation strategy and support expert witnesses through technical briefing, analysis direction, and preparation of supporting exhibits.
  • Support account expansion by identifying follow-on opportunities within existing client relationships and collaborating with business development teams, while keeping delivery leadership as the primary focus.
  • Represent the practice at industry events, panels, and professional education programs while remaining current on relevant technology, intellectual property, and litigation trends.
  • Partner with functions including legal, finance, product, and people operations to improve cross-functional processes, operating standards, and organizational effectiveness.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline; an advanced degree, MBA, or JD is a plus.
    • 10+ years of combined experience in technical consulting, IP strategy, patent litigation support, licensing, patent law, or related fields, including senior client-facing delivery leadership.
    • At least 5 years of direct people-management experience with responsibility for hiring, performance reviews, coaching, development, and team growth.
    • Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent programs or projects, including budgeting, resource allocation, utilization, dependencies, and risk management.
    • Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one high-tech domain, such as telecommunications and wireless, semiconductors and hardware, AI/ML and cloud, software and platforms, or consumer, automotive, and medical technologies.
    • Familiarity with patent litigation and IP workflows, including infringement and invalidity analysis, claim charts, source code review, expert reports, IPR and post-grant proceedings, patent licensing, patent monetization, SEPs, FRAND commitments, and trade secret matters.
    • Strong analytical capabilities and sufficient technical depth to direct and quality-control work involving source code, data analysis, and AI-assisted analytical tools.
    • Strong program and project management capabilities, with experience using structured operating rhythms, project tracking platforms, utilization reporting, capacity planning, and leadership reporting.
    • Proven ability to lead distributed or cross-time-zone teams and allocate shared technical resources effectively.
    • Excellent client-management and stakeholder-engagement skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical specialists, executives, attorneys, judges, juries, and other non-technical audiences.
    • Exceptional technical writing and presentation skills for reports, whitepapers, expert materials, and legal documentation.
    • A track record of building processes, standards, methodologies, or internal tools that improve team performance and delivery quality.
    • Prior experience in IP litigation consulting, expert services, technical analysis, digital forensics, law firm IP practices, in-house IP or licensing, patent prosecution, or patent monetization is highly valued.

title: Data Engineer
description:
As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be responsible or designing and developing data processing and data persistence software components for solutions which handle data at scale. Working in agile teams, Senior Data Engineers provide strong development leadership and take responsibility for significant technical components of data systems. You will work within a multi-skilled agile team to design and develop large-scale data processing software to meet user needs in demanding production environments.

Your responsibilities will include working to develop data processing software primarily for deployment in Big Data technologies. The role encompasses the full software lifecycle including design, code, test and defect resolution. Working with Architects and Lead Engineers to ensure the software supports non-functional needs. Collaborating with colleagues to resolve implementation challenges and ensure code quality and maintainability remains high. Leads by example in code quality. Working with operations teams to ensure operational readiness. Advising customers and managers on the estimated effort and technical implications of user stories and user journeys. Coaching and mentoring team members

It is a fast-paced environment, so it is important for you to make sound, reasoned decisions. You will do this whilst learning about new technologies and approaches, with talented colleagues that will help you to develop and grow. You will support your colleagues and more junior colleagues, providing direction support as you solve challenging problems together.

MINIMUM (ESSENTIAL) REQUIREMENTS:

• Strong software development experience in one of Java, Scala, or Python

• Software development experience with data-processing platforms from vendors such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks.

• Experience of developing substantial components for large-scale data processing solutions and deploying into a production environment

• Proficient in SQL and SQL extensions for analytical queries

• Solid understanding of ETL/ELT data processing pipelines and design patterns

• Aware of key features and pitfalls of distributed data processing frameworks, data stores and data serialisation formats

• Able to write quality, testable code and has experience of automated testing

• Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment techniques

DESIRABLE:

• Experience of data pipeline development

• Experience of Docker and Kubernetes

• Experience of performance tuning

• Experience of data visualisation and complex data transformations

• Experience with steaming and event-processing architectures including technologies such as Kafka and change-data-capture (CDC) products

• Expertise in continuous improvement and sharing input on data best practice

title: ESP Warehouse Operator
description:
SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

The purpose of this job is to accurately and safely inspect, receive, store, and distribute material, tools, equipment, and products within the company warehouse as well as picking, packing and scanning orders for customer pickup and delivery, in order to increase operational efficiency, company profitability and customer satisfaction. The Warehouse Operator I will master one of the primary areas of the particular Warehouse: Receiving, Shipping, Yard or Inspection.


SPECIFIC DUTIES, ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:

  • Read customer orders, work orders, shipping orders, or requisitions to determine items to be moved, gathered, or distributed and/or shipped.
  • Move materials and items from receiving or storage areas to shipping or to other designated areas.
  • Open bales, crates, and other containers.
  • Sort and place materials or items in proper locations according to predetermined sequence such as size, type, style, color, or product code.
  • Assemble customer orders from stock and place orders on pallets, shelves or directly onto company/customer trucks or relocate orders to a holding area or shipping department.
  • Mark materials with identifying information using appropriate method.
  • Record amounts of materials or items received or distributed. Complete internal forms and documents or reports as instructed.
  • Perform stock transfers and inventory counts.
  • Inspect incoming parts, following QMS procedure and documenting all results
  • Responsible for the proper care and maintenance of company equipment assigned to the warehouse area.
  • Ensure the protection of company property and all other assets.
  • Ensure warehouse areas are clean, accessible, and safe for traffic.
  • Comply with and ensure department compliance with Company health, safety and environmental policies.
  • Comply with all applicable U.S. export control and security regulations.
  • Other duties as required.

title: Production Worker III – Dairy Processing
description:
Production Worker III – Dairy Processing

Company: HireNow Staffing (Contract-to-Hire Partner)
Location: Bellevue, WA | Onsite
Employment Type: Contractor (Pay-As-You-Go) | 90-Day Temp-to-Perm
Pay: Up to $30.00/hr. without a Pasteurizer's License | Up to $34.00/hr. with a Pasteurizer's License

HireNow Snapshot

HireNow Staffing is recruiting an experienced Production Worker III for an onsite dairy production operation in Bellevue, Washington. This is a hands-on processing position for someone who already has experience operating pasteurization or dairy processing equipment and understands the importance of food safety, sanitation, accurate batching, and consistent production.

This position begins as a contractor assignment with the opportunity to convert to permanent employment after approximately 90 days. Candidates hired permanently must join the onsite union.

HireNow Package

Available Shifts — Candidates will work one of the following:

  • Swing: Monday–Friday | 2:00 PM–10:30 PM
  • Grave: Sunday–Thursday | 10:00 PM–6:30 AM
  • Candidates must also be flexible to work overtime when production needs require it.

Compensation:

  • Without Pasteurizer's License: Up to $30.00/hour
  • With Pasteurizer's License: Up to $34.00/hour

What You'll Be Doing

You'll closely monitor dairy production processes while following established SOPs for batching and processing. Responsibilities include operating and cleaning processing equipment, monitoring product specifications, maintaining accurate production documentation, and helping the operation maximize quality and throughput while minimizing downtime.

You will monitor fats, total solids, allergens, and other critical processing measurements, perform CIP and manual equipment cleaning, and analyze process and equipment performance information to identify problems and improve production.

You'll also communicate with production teams, other departments, and management when issues could affect efficiency, food safety, or product quality.

All work must comply with applicable Federal and State requirements, company policies, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), food-safety requirements, safe-work practices, and 5S standards.

Required Qualifications

Candidates must have:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • With a Pasteurizer's License: At least 6–12 months of experience operating pasteurization or dairy processing equipment.
  • Without a Pasteurizer's License: At least 12 months of experience operating pasteurization or dairy processing equipment.
  • Previous pallet jack and forklift experience.
  • Ability to accurately follow recipes, measurements, SOPs, and processing instructions.
  • Basic math skills, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
  • Ability to stand and walk for nearly the entire workday.
  • Ability to lift and move objects weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to food safety and workplace safety.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Flexibility to work overtime when required.

HireNow Checklist — Who We're Recruiting

The strongest candidate is not simply a general production or warehouse worker. We are specifically looking for someone with direct experience operating dairy processing or pasteurization equipment.

Before applying, candidates should be able to answer yes to the following:

I have at least 12 months of dairy processing/pasteurization equipment experience, or 6–12 months with a Pasteurizer's License.
I have experience with pallet jacks and forklifts.
I can safely lift up to 50 lbs. and remain on my feet throughout my shift.
I understand the importance of sanitation, GMPs, food safety, and accurate production documentation.
I can work either the assigned swing or grave shift and accommodate overtime when required.
I understand this is an onsite 90-day temp-to-perm opportunity and that permanent employees must join the onsite union.

HireNow Standout Candidates

Candidates will stand out if they bring a current Pasteurizer's License, strong dairy manufacturing experience, familiarity with CIP sanitation systems, and demonstrated experience troubleshooting processing equipment or analyzing production-performance data.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can explain what dairy equipment they have operated, what products/processes they supported, and how they maintained food safety and sanitation standards.

HireNow Disqualifiers

This opportunity will not be a match for candidates whose experience is limited to general warehouse, packaging, assembly, or production work without hands-on dairy processing or pasteurization equipment experience.

Candidates who cannot meet the assigned shift, overtime, physical requirements, or eventual union requirement should not apply.

HireNow Staffing Disclaimer

HireNow Staffing is acting as a contract-to-hire staffing partner for this opportunity. Candidate information will be handled professionally and shared as appropriate during the recruitment process. Job duties, schedules, and operational requirements may evolve based on business needs.

Please apply only if your background meets the core experience requirements, particularly the required dairy processing/pasteurization equipment experience.

HireNow Staffing
Your Journey. Our Priority.
