title: Project Manager – Electricity Networks - Build & Lead Projects
description:
Project Manager - Electricity Networks - Build & Lead Projects

Vehicle Included

UGL's Utilities Operations & Maintenance business is growing rapidly across Victoria, and we're looking for an experienced Project Manager to help drive the next phase of that growth.

This is more than a delivery role.

You'll take ownership of electricity distribution and transmission projects from tender through to close-out while working directly with major network clients including Powercor, AusNet and emerging opportunities with United Energy.

Why this role

  • Join a growing Victorian business with significant expansion plans and a strong pipeline of work.
  • Take ownership of projects from pricing and planning through to delivery and financial close-out.
  • Work directly with some of Australia's largest electricity network providers.
  • Be trusted to make decisions and execute with autonomy.
  • Help shape how projects are delivered as the business continues to grow.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities.
  • Work alongside experienced operational, engineering and field delivery teams who are passionate about what they do.

About the role

You'll lead a portfolio of electricity network projects across Victoria, responsible for the complete project lifecycle, from tender support, planning, workforce management, cost control, client engagement and project delivery.

This role would suit a Project Manager who has successfully delivered electricity network projects through the full project lifecycle and is looking for greater ownership, autonomy and scope.

Initially, you'll work across a mix of distribution network projects while supporting the growth of our United Energy portfolio and broader Victorian operations. As the business expands, you'll have the opportunity to help build and lead larger delivery teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead electricity distribution and transmission projects through the full project lifecycle, from tendering and planning through to delivery, close-out and client handover.

  • Manage project performance across safety, commercial, quality and delivery outcomes, including budgets, forecasting, risk management, variations and compliance.

  • Coordinate project resources to achieve successful outcomes, including internal delivery teams, 4supervisors, field crews, subcontractors and suppliers.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and key stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, trusted partnerships and high levels of customer satisfaction.

  • Support business growth and continuous improvement initiatives through tendering, pricing, operational improvements and leadership of project teams.

What we offer

  • Hybrid work environment when possible.
  • Access our OneRewards Discount Program.
  • Discounted Medibank health insurance.
  • Participate in our Wellness Program with AIA Vitality.
  • Benefit from 16 weeks of paid primary parental leave.
  • Complimentary salary continuance insurance.
  • Shape your career with an Individual Development Plan.

About you

You've managed power network, electricity distribution, transmission or utilities infrastructure projects and understand what it takes to get work delivered safely, efficiently and commercially.

You're a practical, straight-talking Project Manager who enjoys owning outcomes and building strong relationships with clients and crews alike. You're comfortable managing competing priorities, making decisions and keeping projects moving forward.

  • Experience in a similar Project Manager position within electricity distribution, transmission, utilities or power network environments.

  • Strong commercial acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting, variations and project costs.

  • Experience managing subcontractors, field crews and project stakeholders.

  • A solid understanding of project planning, scheduling, risk and delivery management.

  • The ability to confidently communicate with clients and build trusted relationships and travel to electricity depots around Victoria.

About Us

UGL is a respected of end-to-end engineering, construction, operation and maintenance services within various sectors including rail, transport, communications, oil and gas, power, renewables, resources, water and defence. We partner with some of the world’s largest blue-chip companies, government agencies, private enterprises, and public institutions. As a member of the CIMIC Group of companies, we value diversity in our team’s backgrounds, ideas, work styles.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and strongly encourage applications from people with disabilities, Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander people, mature aged workers and individuals from culturally diverse backgrounds.

Please note that relevant screening checks will be conducted as part of the recruitment process. These may include a national criminal history check and for you to complete a pre-employment medical.

title: Accordion India - Lead Data Engineer
description:
Company overview

Accordion is a global financial consulting and technology firm helping CFOs and their teams drive value creation. Rooted in private equity rigor and powered by data, analytics, and AI, we partner with companies across industries to turn insight into impact.


Accordion works at the intersection of Private Equity sponsors and portfolio companies’ management teams across every stage of the investment lifecycle. We provide hands-on, execution-oriented support, driving value through the office of the CFO by building data and analytics capabilities and identifying and implementing strategic work, rooted in data, analytics and AI.


Accordion is headquartered in New York City with 10 offices worldwide, including the India office

based out of Hyderabad. Join us and make your mark on our company.


Data & Analytics (Accordion | Data & Analytics)

Accordion's Data & Analytics (D&A) practice in India delivers cutting-edge, intelligent solutions to a global clientele, leveraging a blend of domain knowledge, sophisticated technology tools, and deep analytics capabilities to tackle complex business challenges.


We partner with Private Equity clients and their Portfolio Companies across diverse sectors, including Retail, CPG, Healthcare, Media & Entertainment, Technology, and Logistics.


D&A team members deliver data and analytical solutions designed to streamline reporting capabilities and enhance business insights across vast and complex data sets ranging from Sales, Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Customer Strategies, and more.


Working at Accordion in India means joining 800+ analytics, data science, finance, and technology experts in a high-growth, agile, and entrepreneurial environment to transform how portfolio companies drive value. It also means making your mark on Accordion’s future—by embracing a culture rooted in collaboration and a firm-wide commitment to building something great, together.


Join us and experience a better way to work!


Location: Hyderabad, Telangana


Role Overview:

The Lead Data Engineer at Accordion is responsible for architecting and maintaining modern, scalable data platforms that power analytics, AI, and decision-making across client organizations. This role demands deep expertise in cloud-native architectures including data lakes, lakehouses, and enterprise data warehouses, to deliver robust, cost-optimized solutions addressing both current and future client needs.


The Lead Data Engineer will take an AI-first approach to every engagement, leveraging AI tools to

accelerate delivery, enhance productivity, and build data infrastructure that is architected to be AI ready from the ground up. A successful candidate will possess strong business acumen, cloud

platform expertise, and the ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders to

drive end-to-end solution delivery.


What You will do:

  • Partner with client stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate them into data architecture requirements and actionable solution roadmaps.
  • Lead the design of cloud-native data platform architectures, including data lakes, lakehouses (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg), and modern data warehouses, recommending the right technology stack per engagement.
  • Collaborate with business and technology teams to define KPIs, data models, and metrics frameworks aligned with client goals.
  • Partner with Project Managers to develop and execute delivery plans ensuring high-quality output within agreed timelines.
  • Evaluate and lead the implementation of modern data integration patterns: streaming pipelines, ELT/ETL orchestration, and real-time data processing.
  • Design and lead the implementation of data infrastructure that is AI-ready by design: ensuring proper governance, lineage, and accessibility patterns that enable downstream AI and analytics consumption.
  • Responsibly integrate/leverage AI tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cortex, Genie, or similar) to accelerate pipeline development, code reviews, documentation, and solution delivery.
  • Design, build and deploy MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to expose data platform capabilities as tools consumable by AI agents and LLM-powered workflows.
  • Conduct technical design reviews, architecture assessments, training and knowledge transfer sessions for junior engineers.
  • Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies, cloud platforms, AI tooling, and data ecosystem innovations to deliver forward-thinking solutions to clients.


Ideally, you have:

  • An undergraduate degree (B.E/B.Tech.) from a tier-1 or tier-2 institution.
  • 6–9 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data platform development, or cloud data architecture.

  • Hands-on experience with at least two of: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or AWS Redshift.
  • Experience designing data lake and lakehouse architectures using open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg) on cloud storage (ADLS, S3, GCS).
  • Proficiency in cloud-native orchestration tools: Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, dbt, Apache Airflow, or equivalent.

  • Hands-on experience owning end-to-end DevOps practices, including designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines, to ensure robust, scalable, and repeatable deployment of data solutions across environments.
  • Experience with streaming platforms (Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, AWS Kinesis) is a strong plus.
  • Working knowledge of BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative, drive innovation, and lead technical discussions with senior stakeholders.
  • An analytical, AI-first, automation-forward problem-solving mindset.


Why Explore a Career at Accordion:

A Culture of Impact & Excellence

  • A culture of merit & recognition: Thrive in a meritocratic, high-growth environment with semi-annual performance and promotion cycles.
  • Multi - dimensional exposure: Navigate complex, high stakes workstreams across diverse industries and domains. At Accordion, you will engage with varied intellectual challenges that keep your perspective sharp, and your curiosity fuelled.
  • Entrepreneurial environment: Exercise the intellectual freedom to make definitive decisions and the autonomy to own their outcomes. We reward initiative, encouraging you to expand your influence and assume larger responsibilities.
  • Collaborative vitality: Experience a non-bureaucratic, high-energy culture alongside high-calibre peers. Our environment is designed to challenge your thinking and accelerate your growth through shared expertise and collective ambition.


Our Commitment to Your Well-being

  • We believe that our collective success is rooted in the personal well-being and growth of our people. We have curated a suite of benefits designed to support you and your family’s health, celebrate your milestones, and empower your professional journey.
  • Comprehensive health & security: We provide fully covered Health and Group Term Life Insurance for you, with health insurance coverage extending to your immediate family.
  • Care on your terms: Access expert medical guidance through on-site health camps or our integrated tele-health services. This ecosystem includes free professional consultations alongside discounted healthcare services including dental and vision care.
  • Integrated family support: We support working parents with a fully sponsored, premium on-site Day Care facility.
  • Empowering leave structures: Our robust leave policy is an intentional commitment to work-life integration, featuring dedicated maternity and parental support designed to help new parents through life’s major transitions.
  • A culture of recognition: We believe every breakthrough deserves an audience. Through our dedicated rewards platform, we pause to celebrate both your professional triumphs and your most meaningful personal milestones.
  • Architecting your growth: Thrive in a positive & transparent environment designed for the continuous evolution of your craft. We provide the infrastructure - through learning programs and engagement initiatives - to bridge the gap between your personal aspirations and professional mastery.

title: Principal Supplier Quality Engineer
description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

Halter's component suppliers are predominantly based across Asia. The components they produce have to be right before they ever reach our contract manufacturers. When something is wrong, we need someone on the ground who can get to the root cause fast, push through to a real fix, and prevent it from happening again.

The Supplier Quality Principal is Halter's senior technical authority embedded in Asia. You'll lead highly technical supplier audits, own complex quality problem-solving at our suppliers, and work directly with both suppliers and Halter's design teams to ensure that what comes off a supplier's production line meets the standard we set. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, covering a portfolio of suppliers across the region and acting as the technical bridge between our Asia supply base and the Halter team in Auckland.

This is not a compliance role. Ticking audit checkboxes and filing reports is not what this job is about. The best person for this role is someone who goes deep: who can walk a production line and immediately identify what's controlling quality and what isn't, who can sit with a supplier's engineers and work through a failure mode from first principles, and who knows the difference between a corrective action that actually solves a problem and one that just looks good on paper.

You'll report to the Head of Supplier Quality and work closely with Halter's hardware design and operations teams. When there's a quality issue in Asia that needs solving, you're the person we call.

You'll be measured on the technical quality of audits, the speed and effectiveness of issue resolution at suppliers, and your ability to build supplier capability over time.

What You'll Do

Technical Supplier Auditing

  • Lead technically rigorous audits of Halter's component suppliers across Asia, going well beyond system compliance to assess process control, measurement capability, and the reliability of how suppliers actually build and inspect parts.

  • Identify the real drivers of quality performance at a supplier, not just the documented procedures, and develop clear, prioritised findings that distinguish between critical risks and cosmetic gaps.

  • Conduct pre-qualification audits of new suppliers, assessing their technical capability and readiness to meet Halter's design and quality requirements before commitments are made.

  • Run periodic surveillance audits to verify that corrective actions have been implemented effectively and that quality performance is being sustained.

  • Develop and continuously improve Halter's audit methodology and supplier assessment criteria, ensuring audits capture what actually matters for component quality.

Technical Problem Solving

  • Own the resolution of complex quality issues at suppliers, using first-principles analysis to identify root cause and drive effective corrective actions rather than superficial fixes.

  • When a production failure or OQC rejection occurs, lead rapid on-site analysis with supplier engineers and Halter's design team to understand the failure mode, assess risk to in-flight inventory, and define the fastest path to resolution.

  • Work with suppliers to improve their process controls, measurement systems, and inspection methods so that quality issues are caught and corrected at source, not downstream.

  • Coach supplier engineering teams to develop their own capability for root cause analysis and corrective action, building their ability to self-solve rather than depend on Halter for every issue.

  • Escalate issues clearly and early when resolution is taking too long, a supplier is not engaging in good faith, or a quality risk to production is emerging.

Quality Assurance Specifications

  • Implement and maintain Halter's quality assurance specifications at suppliers, ensuring specifications are understood, accepted, and consistently applied across the production process.

  • Work with Halter's hardware design team and the Head of Supplier Quality to refine QA specifications where field experience, audit findings, or supplier feedback reveals gaps or ambiguity.

  • Ensure that when designs evolve, updated specifications are communicated to suppliers, implemented correctly, and re-validated before affected parts re-enter supply.

  • Challenge specifications that are unclear, unmeasurable, or misaligned with what suppliers can realistically control, bringing engineering and operations teams to a better standard.

Part Approval and Ongoing Compliance

  • Support supplier-side part approval activities, ensuring new and revised components are formally validated against Halter's specifications before production release.

  • Maintain a clear picture of approval status and open quality issues across the suppliers in your portfolio, tracking corrective actions to closure and flagging risks to supply continuity.

  • Collaborate with the Head of Contract Manufacturing Quality when parts that pass supplier OQC fail IQC at our contract manufacturers, working to determine whether root cause sits with the supplier process, the OQC criteria, or the incoming inspection.

Supplier Development

  • Build genuine working relationships with quality and engineering counterparts at key suppliers, creating the trust and technical credibility that allows hard conversations to happen fast.

  • Identify where suppliers have systemic capability gaps and develop structured improvement plans that address root cause, not symptoms.

  • Share Halter's standards, expectations, and technical knowledge with suppliers in a way that builds their capability over time rather than creating dependency.

What You Bring

  • 15 or more years of experience in supplier quality or manufacturing quality for complex electromechanical hardware, with a proven track record of solving technically difficult quality problems at suppliers.

  • Deep manufacturing and process engineering knowledge. You understand how parts are made, what drives process variation, and how to identify whether a supplier's process is actually in control.

  • Exceptional audit capability. You conduct audits that go beneath the surface, uncover the real quality risks, and produce findings that drive meaningful improvement.

  • Strong first-principles thinking. When you see a quality failure, you work back to the actual root cause, not the nearest plausible explanation.

  • Experience with QA specification development and the ability to assess whether a specification is clear, measurable, and correctly implemented at a supplier.

  • High proficiency in both English and Mandarin (written, verbal, and reading). You can work directly with Chinese engineers and leadership without translation.

  • Comfortable operating autonomously across a portfolio of suppliers. You manage your own priorities, escalate the right things at the right time, and don't need close supervision to stay effective.

  • Firm, fair, and direct with suppliers. You hold a high standard, push back on inadequate corrective actions, and maintain a relationship that is professional and productive even when conversations are hard.

  • Willing to travel regularly across APAC. A significant portion of your time will be on-site at suppliers.

  • A Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline is preferred.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

title: Especialista Agronômico - Campinas/SP
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Especialista Agronômico - Campinas/SP based in Brazil.

This is a full-time, fully remote opportunity focused on agronomic research, innovation, and product development.
You will lead initiatives to develop and validate technologies that improve plant nutrition, agricultural productivity, and sustainability.
The role covers the full product development cycle, from technical concept and experimental design through agronomic validation and launch support.
You will collaborate with researchers, consultants, universities, and internal R&D, marketing, commercial, and market development teams.
Your work will translate scientific research and field data into actionable insights, technical positioning, and new product opportunities.
The position combines scientific expertise, project leadership, data analysis, and strategic stakeholder management in a global environment.
It is an ideal opportunity for an agronomist passionate about innovation who wants to contribute to the future of sustainable agriculture.

Accountabilities

  • Lead agronomic research, innovation, and product development initiatives focused on plant nutrition technologies, including fertilizers, biostimulants, and solutions designed to improve productivity and agricultural sustainability.
  • Manage the full product development cycle, from technical concept and feasibility assessment through experimental validation, agronomic performance evaluation, and launch support.
  • Design and implement agronomic research programs, defining experimental protocols, selecting and managing research partners, monitoring field trials, and ensuring the quality and reliability of generated data.
  • Manage research and development projects from experiment installation and execution through statistical analysis, technical reporting, and communication of key findings to local and global R&D teams.
  • Lead innovation and new product development projects, validating agronomic performance and supporting the expansion and optimization of the product portfolio.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with professors, researchers, consultants, and leading research institutions in soil fertility, plant nutrition, and plant physiology.

    • Experience with biostimulants, biological products, and technologies focused on mitigating agricultural stresses is a plus.
    • Knowledge of regulatory processes for the registration and launch of new agricultural products is desirable.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
About Vista Equity Partners
Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista’s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations — reinforcing India’s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem.
Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio — enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams.
About Amtech
Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics — empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise.
With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can:

Purpose

Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations.

Growth

Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista’s global network — accelerating both technical and managerial career paths.

Culture

Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision.

Innovation

Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business.


Role Description

Amtech LLC is seeking a Lead Data Engineer to own the architecture, scalability, and technical direction of ACDP (Amtech Cloud Data Platform) - the data warehouses, pipelines, tenant data stores, and feature stores that power analytics, personalization, and AI agent initiatives across the company. This role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership: setting standards, mentoring engineers, and partnering with architecture and product stakeholders to shape the platform's roadmap.

The Lead Data Engineer will play a central role in building the data foundation behind Amtech's AI Agents initiative — the tenant registries, tenant data warehouses, analytics/monitoring, and event pipelines that feed the Amtech Agent Hub and the broader Amtech AI Cloud. This includes helping stand up the data layer that supports agent use cases and expanding platform capabilities beyond traditional analytics into next-generation, agent-driven intelligence.

This role is also central to Amtech's intentional hybrid AI strategy, which routes each use case to the right tier based on risk, data sensitivity, latency, and IP protection. The Lead Data Engineer will build and govern the data layer underneath all three tiers — the stateless Cloud AI acceleration layer, the Hybrid AI zone where cloud LLM reasoning is combined with on-prem data via a Data Agent, and the deterministic On-Prem/Private AI control layer for margin- and production-critical logic — ensuring the org, not the model, controls where sensitive data flows.

Job Description

  • Own end-to-end architecture for ACDP: data warehouses, tenant data stores, lakes, and feature stores supporting analytics, ML, and AI agent use cases.
  • Design and build the tenant registry and tenant data warehouse layer that underpins multi-tenant AI Agent workloads.
  • Build and govern the Data Agent layer that supplies on-prem/customer-controlled data to cloud LLM reasoning in the Hybrid AI zone, with staged, explainable data outputs and human review checkpoints.
  • Define data classification and routing rules that determine which data can flow to Cloud AI, which requires the Hybrid AI path, and which must remain fully on-prem/deterministic — protecting customer IP and production-critical logic.
  • Set engineering standards for ETL/ELT design, orchestration, and data quality across the team.
  • Lead design and code reviews; mentor data engineers and act as technical escalation point.
  • Drive automation and reliability of pipelines, including SLAs, observability, and incident response.
  • Own data security, access control, lineage, and governance compliance at the platform level, across cloud, hybrid, and on-prem tiers.
  • Partner with data scientists and analysts to ensure platform data is ML-ready and supports predictive modeling.
  • Build and maintain the data/event pipelines connecting ERP source systems (e.g., EnCore) to the EnCore Agent Hub, supporting secure read/write and event-and-trigger flows.
  • Guide GenAI/LLM data enablement, including embeddings, vector database design, and RAG pipeline architecture, in support of Amtech AI Cloud agent orchestration.
  • Represent data engineering in cross-functional architecture (ARB) and platform roadmap discussions.
  • Optimize pipelines for low-latency access; establish partitioning, caching, and indexing strategies as team standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering or software development, including 3+ years in a technical lead or architect capacity.
  • Deep expertise in data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery).
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Scala.
  • Proven experience with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, AWS Glue).
  • Hands-on ownership of cloud platforms at scale (AWS, Azure, or GCP), plus familiarity with on-prem/private deployment models.
  • Proficiency with big data frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink) and streaming tools (Kafka, Kinesis).
  • Expert-level SQL and NoSQL databases; familiarity with time-series or graph databases is a plus.
  • Experience setting data validation, governance, and observability standards (e.g., Great Expectations, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers or leading a technical team.
  • Experience designing multi-tenant data architectures (tenant registries, tenant-scoped data stores/warehouses) is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of data sensitivity/risk classification and hybrid cloud/on-prem routing for AI workloads is a strong plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced training in Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture, or Industrial Data Systems.
  • Experience with ERP, MES, or manufacturing data environments.
  • Familiarity with IoT/OT data pipelines, including machine telemetry and SCADA signals.
  • Applied experience with GenAI tools such as LangChain, vector databases, and RAG pipelines in production.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration platforms, MCP-style tool routing, or event-driven agent architectures.
  • Experience building or governing hybrid AI architectures balancing cloud acceleration with on-prem/private control layers.

    Why Join Amtech

    At Amtech, you will drive meaningful financial impact in a growing enterprise software organization while benefiting from Vista’s world-class ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented peers, leverage cross-portfolio learning programs, and help shape the future of Amtech’s financial operations and systems. Build your career with Amtech — backed by the strength, scale, and innovation culture of Vista.

title: HIM Technician
description:
Job Summary:

The Health Information Management (HIM) Technician supports the integrity, accuracy, and confidentiality of patient health records. This role is responsible for managing medical records throughout their lifecycle, including record completion, document imaging, data quality review, release of information, and compliance with regulatory standards. The HIM Technician plays a critical role in ensuring timely, accurate, and secure health information to support patient care, billing, legal, and quality needs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Retrieve, scan, index, and file medical records in electronic health record (EHR) systems
  • Ensure adherence to HIPAA and organizational privacy and security policies
  • Respond to requests for medical records from authorized parties (patients, providers, insurance companies, etc.)
  • Perform data entry and quality checks in EHR systems
  • Assist with documentation and processing of ROI requests, including verifying authorizations
  • Track, manage, and reconcile patient charts and documentation
  • Support audits, compliance reviews, and accreditation activities
  • Maintain record retention and destruction schedules according to policy
  • Collaborate with clinical and administrative staff to resolve documentation issues
  • Answer incoming phone calls, assist callers, and route inquiries appropriately
  • Open, sort, and distribute incoming mail related to HIM operations
  • Receive, log, track, and process release of information (ROI) requests in accordance with policies and timelines
  • Maintain accurate logs and tracking systems for all incoming and outgoing record requests
  • Respond to requests for medical records from authorized parties (patients, providers, insurance companies, attorneys, etc.)
  • Assist with department projects as needed
  • Other duties as assigned.

Professional Requirements:

  • Proficiency with EHR systems and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Team collaboration skills
  • Completes and maintains all required education and/or training requirements.
  • Complies with HIPAA regulations and always maintains patient confidentiality.
  • Follows and maintains all lawful safety, health requirements, and regulations, and follow protocols for required protective equipment (PPE).
  • Promptly reports safety issues, job-related injury, or illness, near misses, etc. in SafetyZone.
  • Follows Hillsboro Health Standards of Behavior.

title: Senior Principal, Compliance (Infosec & TBA Compliance)
description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

InfoSec & TBA Compliance팀은 안정적이고 신뢰할 수 있는 서비스 운영을 위해 전기통신사업법 및 관련 법령 준수 체계를 구축하고, 서비스 안전성 확보와 통신재난 대응 역량 강화를 주도하는 조직입니다.

Director, TBA Compliance & Information Security Governance는 전기통신사업법(TBA) 및 관련 정보보호 규제에 대한 준수 체계를 총괄하며, 서비스 안정성·보안성 확보를 위한 전략 및 운영 프레임워크를 수립하는 역할입니다. 경영진, 서비스 오너, 보안 조직 및 대외 규제기관과 긴밀하게 협력하여 규제 변화에 선제적으로 대응하고, 컴플라이언스 및 보안 리스크 관리 체계를 지속적으로 고도화하는 데 핵심적인 역할을 수행합니다.

업무 내용

  • 전기통신사업법(TBA) 및 관련 정보보호 규제에 대한 전사 컴플라이언스 전략 및 거버넌스 체계 수립
  • 서비스 안전성 확보 의무와 보안 요구사항에 대한 컴플라이언스 모니터링 프로그램 구축 및 운영 총괄
  • 통신재난관리기본계획 및 서비스 연속성 관련 규제 준수 여부에 대한 감독 및 평가 체계 운영
  • 주요 규제 및 보안 리스크를 식별·평가하고, 비즈니스 및 기술 조직과 협력하여 개선 전략 수립
  • 컴플라이언스 현황 및 주요 리스크를 경영진에게 보고하고 의사결정을 지원
  • 규제기관 대응, 감사 대응 및 주요 대외 점검 활동 리드
  • 데이터 기반 분석과 증적 검토를 통해 통제의 효과성을 검증하고 개선 과제 도출
  • 정보보호 및 컴플라이언스 조직의 역량 강화와 모범 사례(Best Practice) 정착 주도
  • 관련 법령 및 규제 변화에 대한 모니터링을 통해 정책 및 프로세스의 지속적인 개선 추진

자격 요건

  • 정보보호, 컴플라이언스, IT 감사 또는 리스크 관리 분야에서 12년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분
  • 전기통신사업법, 방송통신발전기본법, 정보통신망법, 통신비밀보호법 등 관련 규제에 대한 깊은 이해와 실무 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 클라우드 환경, 대규모 분산 시스템, 네트워크, 데이터베이스 및 보안 아키텍처에 대한 높은 수준의 기술적 이해를 갖추신 분
  • 정보보호 및 규제 준수 프로그램을 설계하고 조직 차원에서 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 다양한 조직 및 경영진 수준의 이해관계자와 효과적으로 소통하고 영향력을 발휘할 수 있는 리더십 역량을 보유하신 분
  • 복잡한 리스크를 분석하고 전략적 해결방안을 제시할 수 있는 뛰어난 문제 해결 능력을 갖추신 분
  • 경영진 보고서 작성 및 Executive-level 프레젠테이션 경험을 보유하신 분

우대 사항

  • 인터넷 플랫폼, 통신사업자, 대규모 온라인 서비스 기업에서 정보보호 컴플라이언스 또는 IT 감사 조직을 리드한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 클라우드 기반 서비스 환경(AWS, Azure, GCP)에서 정보보호 거버넌스 및 리스크 관리 체계를 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 국내외 규제기관 대응, ISMS-P 인증, 내부·외부 감사 대응을 주도한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 글로벌 정보보호 프레임워크(NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 등)에 대한 이해와 적용 경험이 있으신 분
  • 보안 및 IT 리스크 관리 관련 전문 자격증(CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, ISMS-P 심사원 등)을 보유하신 분
  • 조직 구축 및 인력 리더십 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 영어를 활용한 문서 작성 및 글로벌 이해관계자와의 협업이 가능하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Fullstack
description:
Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead the design and development of user-facing applications that power CesiumAstro’s mission-critical platforms. This role will translate complex requirements into elegant, functional, and scalable UIs, working closely with backend, DevOps, and machine learning teams to deliver robust, high-performance systems.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and maintain user-facing features for CesiumAstro’s web-based dashboards and applications.
  • Collaborate with backend, DevOps, and machine learning engineers to integrate complex data and workflows into intuitive frontends.
  • Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate user needs into functional UI solutions.
  • Contribute to reusable component libraries to ensure consistent aesthetics and behavior across applications.
  • Participate in QA, testing, and release cycles to ensure high-quality, reliable software.
  • Provide technical leadership in frontend development, mentoring team members and influencing design decisions.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
  • 5 years of professional experience building web application frontends.
  • Proven track record of leading or independently delivering frontend features in production systems.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Deep experience with modern frontend frameworks, particularly Vue.js, and tools such as Axios.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate design and technical choices.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience developing tools that visualize and communicate complex quantitative information.
  • Backend development experience, ideally with Python APIs.
  • Familiarity with DevOps and deploying web applications using infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform).
  • Experience integrating complex APIs (e.g., Elasticsearch).
  • Previous experience in small, fast-moving teams or early-stage environments.
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.
CesiumAstro is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

title: Lead Software Engineer - AI & Agentic Systems
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

What's in it for you:
This role offers the opportunity to build real enterprise AI solutions while working at the leading edge of how software development is changing.

You will apply modern AI coding tools and agentic development practices to real product delivery, not just experimentation. You will help determine what works, where the risks are, how quality should be maintained, and how these practices can scale in an enterprise environment.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Deliver AI solutions that address real employee and enterprise needs
  • Work hands-on with agents, integrations, orchestration patterns, and emerging AI technologies
  • Apply coding assistants and agentic coding practices to production-oriented software delivery
  • Build reusable components and technical patterns based on real delivery work
  • Help shape scalable, enterprise-ready AI delivery practices that make future AI solutions faster, safer, and more consistent to build

What you will do:

As Lead Software Engineer – AI & Agentic Systems, you will:

  • Design, build, test, deploy, and support AI-enabled solutions for real enterprise use cases
  • Translate product needs, business requirements, and technical concepts into working software that delivers measurable value
  • Design and integrate models, agents, tools, workflows, APIs, enterprise systems, cloud services, and user experiences into reliable AI-enabled applications
  • Apply emerging AI patterns such as agents, tool-calling, MCP, A2A, agent frameworks, and context engineering where they create practical value
  • Design cloud-based solutions with attention to scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational support
  • Move AI capabilities from concept, prototype, or pilot into production-ready solutions
  • Use coding assistants and agentic coding practices as part of the development and delivery process
  • Establish and share reusable components, agent capabilities, and engineering patterns that improve the speed, quality, reliability, and consistency of future AI delivery
  • Provide technical leadership to other developers by guiding design decisions, reviewing implementation approaches, mentoring on best practices, and helping establish engineering standards

What you will bring:

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent work experience
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including experience in a senior, lead, or highly independent developer role
  • Strong programming experience in one or more modern application development languages such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C#, or Java
  • Experience designing, building, testing, deploying, and supporting production software
  • Experience building backend services, APIs, integrations, or full-stack application features
  • Experience designing and building cloud-based applications on at least one major cloud platform such as Azure, GCP, or AWS
  • Experience providing technical leadership through design guidance, code review, mentoring, or establishing engineering standards
  • Experience applying coding assistants or agentic coding practices in structured software delivery workflows

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building AI-enabled applications, including agents, tool-calling workflows, orchestration layers, or multi-agent systems
  • Experience integrating models, tools, data sources, APIs, and user workflows into reliable application experiences
  • Familiarity with emerging AI patterns such as MCP, A2A, agent frameworks, or context engineering approaches
  • Experience working across multiple cloud platforms

$156,528.33 - $199,300.00

Salary

No

title: Principal Safety Case Engineer
description:
About us

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

The role

We are looking for a Principal Safety Case Engineer to own the architecture, strategy and integrity of Wayve’s safety cases for our first products. This role sits independently from Engineering and Product and reports into Safety Management & Assurance, providing senior expert safety oversight while working closely with the teams responsible for designing, developing, validating and releasing the product.

You will act as the architect of the safety case: defining the top-level claims, argumentation structure, evidence strategy and assurance approach that connect product intent, system behaviour, AI performance, engineering controls, validation and operational deployment into a coherent safety argument. You will provide independent challenge and advice, while enabling Engineering and Product teams to own and deliver the safety evidence required for their systems.

What You’ll Be Doing

Safety Case Strategy & Architecture

  • Own the safety case strategy and architecture for Wayve’s robotaxi and OEM ADAS products.
  • Define top-level safety claims, argumentation, evidence structures, and traceability from safety requirements through validation and deployment decisions.
  • Develop safety arguments appropriate for AI-enabled autonomous driving, incorporating functional safety, SOTIF, AI safety, cybersecurity, validation, operational safety, and post-deployment monitoring.
  • Evolve reusable safety case approaches as Wayve’s products, vehicle platforms, and evidence base mature.

Product & Engineering Integration

  • Partner with Product, Systems Engineering, AI/ML, Validation, Vehicle Engineering, Software, Hardware, and Operational Safety to define safety requirements and evidence expectations.
  • Identify gaps, assumptions, and weaknesses in the safety argument early and drive resolution with accountable teams.
  • Ensure product requirements, architecture, validation plans, and release criteria remain aligned with the safety case.
  • Support technical and programme leaders in making proportionate, evidence-based safety decisions.

Independent Safety Assurance

  • Provide independent technical challenge of safety cases and supporting evidence.
  • Assess whether safety arguments are coherent, complete, evidence-backed, and sufficient to support release or deployment.
  • Highlight material gaps, uncertainties, dependencies, residual risks, and safety red lines.
  • Provide clear recommendations to safety governance forums and senior leadership.

Safety Leadership

  • Build a common understanding of safety case principles across Wayve.
  • Coach engineering and product leaders on structured safety argumentation, evidence quality, and traceability.
  • Represent the safety case perspective in internal governance, customer, and technical discussions.
  • Contribute to Wayve’s broader safety strategy and assurance capability.

About You

Essential Experience

  • Deep experience developing or owning safety cases for complex safety-critical systems, ideally in autonomous vehicles, ADAS, robotics, aerospace, defence, or another software-intensive domain.
  • Strong systems engineering background spanning requirements, architecture, verification, validation, and safety assurance.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical evidence into structured safety claims and arguments.
  • Strong understanding of autonomous driving and AI/ML safety, including model performance, data, uncertainty, and limitations of conventional verification approaches.
  • Experience partnering with AI/ML, engineering, systems, and product teams on safety-critical products.
  • Strong knowledge of relevant standards, including ISO 26262, ISO 21448, ISO/PAS 8800, and ISO 3450x.
  • Excellent technical communication and stakeholder management skills.

Desirable

  • Safety case experience with L2+/L3 ADAS or L4 ADS products.
  • Experience with GSN or equivalent structured assurance methods.
  • Safety evidence experience for end-to-end or foundation-model-based autonomous driving.
  • Experience working with OEMs, regulators, assessors, or independent safety reviewers.
  • Familiarity with operational and post-deployment safety monitoring.

What we’re looking for

  • You are an architect and systems thinker who can move comfortably between top-level safety strategy and detailed technical evidence.
  • You are pragmatic and able to distinguish between what is essential to the safety argument and what is merely desirable.
  • You are intellectually rigorous, curious and comfortable challenging assumptions, including established industry practice where it does not adequately address AI-enabled autonomous driving.
  • You can work independently of Engineering and Product without becoming detached from them: your role is to provide credible challenge, direction and oversight while helping teams succeed.
  • You are comfortable operating with uncertainty and can make clear recommendations based on the strength of the available evidence.
  • You are open to challenge and willing to change your position when better evidence emerges.
  • You can clearly articulate where you believe a safety red line exists, why it matters, and what evidence or mitigation would be required to move it.

Success in this role

title: VP of Software
description:
Mission

TAR’s mission is to power intelligence for the world. We are building the world’s first off-grid power plant for data centers powered by renewable technologies.

We firmly believe AI should be built in the US for the benefit of all people. For that, power must be fast, clean and scalable. We are singularly focused on delivering GW-scale power faster than anyone has ever done, by rethinking every layer of the stack.

We vertically integrate to solve every bottleneck, from racking systems to power electronics to dispatch algorithms to on-site construction.

Leave your mark on the future of civilization-scale energy infrastructure.

Company

TAR is both a hardware and software company, we are building out massive, critical, physical infrastructure. TAR is working directly with one of the largest compute providers to scale and deploy 5GWs by 2028.

We operate on…

  • High ownership. High Agency. Own project end-to-end. Great people don’t need to be managed.

  • Speed. We achieve great things on incredible timelines. We push ourselves to go faster.

  • First principles. No ego. No hierarchy. Challenge every assumption.

  • Passion. Solving the energy problem is one of the largest challenges that faces the world now and in the future.

About the role

TAR develops, builds, and operates fully islanded solar and storage campuses that deliver firm power to AI data centers, and runs them as a growing fleet. That business generates a wide software surface: energy and plant data, fleet telemetry, tooling for construction and operations, and the customer-facing systems that sit on top of them. As VP of Software, you own all of it outside robotics, spanning the core platform, data, cloud infrastructure, and internal and customer-facing tooling. You take the software organization from where it stands today to what a fleet of GW-scale campuses demands, set the architecture the rest of the team builds on, and partner with the autonomy team on the interfaces to robotics without owning onboard autonomy. This is a leadership-team role for an engineer with 10+ years of experience, including 5+ years leading software organizations, based at our San Francisco engineering office.

Responsibilities

  • Own the software strategy and technical roadmap for TAR's core platform, data, and business-critical systems, aligning engineering priorities with the company's energy-infrastructure mission and business goals.

  • Build and lead the software engineering organization, hiring and developing individual contributors and engineering managers as scope grows, as a group distinct from the autonomy and robotics software team.

  • Set system architecture across platform, data, cloud infrastructure, and internal and customer-facing tooling, keeping systems secure, reliable, and built to scale with the business.

  • Drive the software development lifecycle end to end across all non-robotics systems, from roadmap and prioritization through release, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner with the autonomy team on the interfaces between company platforms and robotics systems, including data pipelines, fleet telemetry, and reporting, without owning onboard autonomy software.

  • Serve as the senior software voice on the leadership team, shaping investment decisions, roadmap trade-offs, and technology strategy alongside engineering, product, and executive leadership.

  • Represent software to customers, partners, and investors when technical credibility in platform and data systems is what earns trust.

  • Establish the engineering standards, security practices, and reliability processes the broader software organization builds on.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role at the Director, Head of, or VP level building and running a software organization.

  • Direct, hands-on experience managing a software engineering team, including hiring, structuring, and developing both individual contributors and managers.

  • Demonstrated ownership of platform, data, or infrastructure software for an operationally intensive business, taking systems from early development through production scale.

  • Deep expertise in platform architecture, data systems, or cloud infrastructure, with the judgment to set technical direction others build on.

  • Track record of building and scaling a software organization from zero to one while setting technical direction and engineering process.

  • Strong communication skills, comfortable representing software and platform decisions to executive leadership, customers, and investors.

Nice to have

  • Experience building software for energy, utilities, or other industrial infrastructure operators.

  • Experience partnering with hardware or robotics teams on data integration, such as telemetry or fleet data pipelines.

  • Background at a high-growth, venture-backed infrastructure or industrial technology company, such as Anduril, Palantir, or SpaceX.

Salary and Benefits

  • Up to $15K relocation bonus

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • $1K monthly stipend for meals

title: Senior Product Manager - Runtime Platform
description:

Our Runtime Platform segment's mission is to make it simple for the builders at N26 to use our cloud infrastructure to build on top of, protect our customers, and adhere to the highest regulatory standards, which can power N26 to reach the next 10 million customers.

The Runtime Platform segment at N26 consists of 3 engineering groups that define the tooling and interactions for the foundational cloud, connectivity and infrastructure for the bank. We are looking for a data-driven, technically savvy, Senior Product Manager to help build the Runtime Platform of the future bank and help deliver key growth and operational metrics.

In this role, you will:

  • Deliver a world class Runtime Platform, fully compliant and user-centric.
  • Help build the strategy for the evolution of N26’s Runtime Platform product, its interactions with the rest of the organisation, its global rollout and the decision to build vs buy.
  • Deeply understand the needs of the segment customers - teams developing the products and services built on top of the Runtime Platform, understand how it enables their success, and identify clear product improvements.
  • Help us understand where there are inefficiencies in the way that we do things and create solutions to enable our product, engineering, and design teams to make the biggest impact.
  • Be the glue of the team. Clearly communicate the product vision and ensure alignment between product, engineering, design and cross-functional groups (e.g. Bank, Legal, Compliance, Product teams, commercial departments).
  • Be a decision maker. Possess complex decision making skills rooted in analytics, user feedback, and business goals. Set clear goals, priorities, and manage stakeholder expectations.

What you need to be successful:

  • You have experience building internal tools and working with developers as your users.
  • Proven track record of building scalable and efficient products in a mature environment.
  • Strong technical understanding and exposure to the latest emerging trends in the Cloud Computing domain.
  • Deep understanding of the product life cycle and how the right infrastructure products and tooling enable other teams.
  • Strong analytical thinking and the ability to use data and customer insights to inform decisions and inspire new thinking.
  • Extensive experience working with agile methodologies, leading cross-functional teams of engineers.

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

title: Animal Training and Behavior Lead
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Annenberg PetSpace, located in Playa Vista, is a unique community space featuring pet adoptions, a humane education program, and a leadership institute for animal science and welfare advancement. Annenberg PetSpace focuses on the bond between people and their pets, as well as the origins and community impact of that relationship.


The Animal Behavior & Training Lead plays an integral role in achieving this mission by supporting animals throughout their entire PetSpace journey—from intake and acclimation through adoption and post-adoption support.


Working as part of the Behavior & Training team, this position provides professional dog training, behavior assessment, behavior modification, enrichment, staff coaching, adoption support, and post-adoption services. The Animal Behavior & Training Lead helps prepare animals for successful placement while building the skills and confidence of Animal Care staff and adopters.


The position works closely with the Behavior & Training Coordinator and Animal Operations team to maintain consistent, humane, evidence-based training and behavior practices throughout PetSpace.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

The following is representative of the major duties and responsibilities of the position. Additional duties may be assigned based on organizational needs.


Animal Behavior, Training & Behavior Modification

· Conduct behavioral assessments and ongoing evaluations of dogs to identify strengths, challenges, stress signals, and training needs.

· Develop and implement individualized training and behavior modification plans using positive reinforcement, learning theory, and evidence-based behavior modification methods.

· Provide daily training and behavior support to dogs throughout their stay at PetSpace.

· Prepare dogs for successful adoption by developing skills including loose-leash walking, recall, impulse control, appropriate greetings, door manners, handling, enrichment, and engagement with handlers.

· Work with dogs experiencing fear, anxiety, reactivity, frustration, overarousal, and other behavioral challenges.

· Apply appropriate behavior modification techniques to improve emotional responses, coping skills, and functional behaviors.

· Monitor changes in behavior and modify training plans as needed.

· Recognize and respond appropriately to changes in canine body language, emotional state, and arousal level.

· Provide enrichment and decompression strategies to support animal welfare and reduce stress.


Dog-to-Dog Introductions & Playgroups

· Lead and oversee dog-to-dog introductions and meet-and-greets, ensuring appropriate safety protocols and professional behavioral assessment are followed.

· Evaluate canine body language, social behavior, play styles, and compatibility during dog-to-dog interactions.

· Lead and facilitate appropriate playgroups, including evaluating dogs for participation and monitoring interactions throughout the session.

· Determine when interactions should continue, be modified, or discontinued based on behavioral observations.

· Train staff in appropriate techniques for safely conducting dog-to-dog introductions and managing group interactions.

· Participate and lead tandem walks, pack walks, offsite activities, and other real-world behavioral assessments.


Animal Care Training & Staff Development

· Lead and provide Animal Care staff training on canine body language, handling, enrichment, training techniques, behavior modification, and safety.

· Support the development and implementation of PetSpace's handler color-level program and assist with assessing handler skills.

· Provide clear and consistent instruction regarding individual dogs' training plans, handling needs, equipment, and safety considerations.

· Model appropriate handling, training, and behavior modification techniques for Animal Care staff, volunteers, and other team members.

· Promote consistency in training language, methods, equipment, and behavioral expectations across departments.

· Coach staff in recognizing changes in canine behavior and making appropriate handling decisions.

· Assist in developing and maintaining training protocols, procedures, assessment tools, and educational materials.

Foster, Adoption & Pet Retention

· Provide fosters, adopters and potential adopters with accurate and practical information regarding individual dogs' behavior, training, and ongoing needs.

· Provide post-adoption training and behavior support through consultations, phone/video calls, email resources, and educational programming.

· Assist in identifying and addressing behavioral challenges that may place an adoption at risk.

· Support PetSpace's goal of increasing successful adoptions and improving long-term pet retention.

Documentation & Communication

· Maintain accurate and timely training, behavior, and assessment records within PetSpace's electronic record-keeping system.

· Document behavioral observations, training progress, recommendations, behavior modification plans, and changes in individual training plans.

· Communicate professionally and effectively with Animal Care, Adoptions, veterinary staff, leadership, volunteers, adopters, and other team members.

· Clearly communicate behavioral concerns, training recommendations, and safety considerations to appropriate team members.

· Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when discussing animal behavior and adopter information.

Teamwork & Professional Development

· Work collaboratively with the Behavior & Training Coordinator and other PetSpace departments to ensure consistent standards of animal care, training, and behavior management.

· Assist with developing and maintaining PetSpace's organization-wide training and behavior standards.

· Continue professional development and maintain current knowledge of canine behavior, learning theory, humane training, and behavior modification practices.

· Represent Wallis Annenberg PetSpace professionally and positively at all times.

· Assist with animal care, adoptions, and foster department duties as needed.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Introduction:

We at Entiovi Technologies provide digital transformation using new-age intelligent technologies for more than 9 years. We have clients located primarily in the US and Europe that are served by our Dedicated teams. This job is part of our expansion in India.


Location: Remote


About the role

The Data Engineer in our AI & Data team will be responsible for designing and building the data structures and pipelines our AI Engineers rely on across Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, and Lakebase (our managed Postgres / OLTP layer). The primary mission of this role is to enable the AI Engineering team translating the needs of machine-learning and computer-vision workflows into reliable, well-modelled, and cost-effective data foundations.

Tasks include setting up new data pipelines and transformations, ingesting structured and unstructured data into the data lake and warehouse, monitoring the performance and cost-effectiveness of existing data jobs, and docking machine-learning processes into the existing data landscape. The Data Engineer works hand in hand with AI Engineers and is the go-to person for making trusted data available for models, products, and analytics.


Main Responsibilities

  • As part of the AI & Data team, design and build the data structures, schemas, and models that AI Engineers depend on for training, feature engineering, and inference.
  • Develop and orchestrate scalable data pipelines on Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake) and load curated, analytics-ready data into Snowflake.
  • Own data ingestion, transformation (ELT/ETL), and storage across the Azure cloud (e.g. ADLS, Data Factory, Event Hubs / Synapse), including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data such as text, images, and video.

title: Data Engineer
description:
