title: DevOps data engineer
description:
Ben jij een gedreven DevOps data engineer met passie voor business intelligence? Dan is deze vacature wat voor jou. Draag bij aan de veiligheid van onze samenleving door innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen voor de politie!

Specificaties vacature

LFNP Functie:

bedrijfsvoeringspecialist B

Organisatieonderdeel:

Politiedienstencentrum

Contractvorm:

Formatief

Vakgebied(en):

Bedrijfsvoering Spec.

Schaal:

Schaal 10

De LFNP-functie bedrijfsvoeringspecialist B, gewaardeerd in schaal 10Bbp is van toepassing.Bekijk de volledige LFNP-functiebeschrijving voor bedrijfsvoeringspecialist B (deze link is alleen benaderbaar vanuit een politieomgeving).

Als DevOps data engineer bij het onderdeel Business Intelligence van de politie speel je een cruciale rol in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van geavanceerde softwareoplossingen. Je werkt samen met een multidisciplinair team van devops engineers, IT-experts en operationele professionals. Zo draag jij er met onze ICT-oplossingen aan bij dat de Nederlandse politie tot de beste politiekorpsen ter wereld hoort.

Waar ga je werken?

Het Productiehuis is een organisatieonderdeel binnen de Dienst IV van de politie waarin 120 DevOps-teams volgens de Agile/Scrum-methode werken. In het Productiehuis zijn zeven Productielijnen ingericht, die weer zijn onderverdeeld in specifieke politiedomeinen. Jij gaat aan de slag in de productielijn Business Intelligence. De productielijn maakt producten die voorzien in de informatiebehoefte van de politie. Deze producten worden dagelijks gebruikt door alle politieagenten op straat, in de auto, de meldkamer en het Real Time Intelligence Center om snel alle informatie over een situatie op te vragen. Het is van groot belang dat deze informatie correct, snel, veilig en gemakkelijk te gebruiken is

Jij gaat binnen onze productielijn werken in het Cluster Data. Hier zijn meerdere DevOps-teams actief voor de politie en diverse ketenpartners. De teams beheren en ontwikkelen applicaties en diensten om alle beschikbare informatie uit interne, nationale en internationale gegevensbronnen te ontsluiten. Deze dataproducten worden continue gebruikt door collega’s binnen de politie en ketenpartners buiten de politie. Het is van groot belang dat deze informatie correct, snel, veilig en gemakkelijk te vinden is. Jij als Java ontwikkelaar bent altijd bezig de software net dat beetje beter te maken en de CI/CD continu te optimaliseren. Een voordeel van werken bij de politie is dat er verschillende ondersteunende teams zijn die de clusters helpen bij het optimaliseren van kwalitatieve en veilige softwareontwikkeling, deployment en operations.

We werken hybride waarvan minimaal 1 dag op kantoor in Zwolle en volgens de Scrum-methodiek. Verder is het goed om te weten dat er ook een beroep op je gedaan kan worden voor een piketdienst. Daarbij kan het voorkomen dat je buiten kantoortijd wordt opgeroepen. Het werk van de politie gaat immers 24/7 door.

Jij bent een DevOps data engineer met backend-specialisatie. Heb je interesse in softwareontwikkeling in de breedste zin van het woord en ben je iemand die zich graag verder wil ontwikkelen? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Je bent nieuwsgierig van aard en constant op zoek naar mogelijkheden om nieuwe technologieën te benutten. Een vooruitstrevende aanpak is het resultaat. Je stelt jezelf regelmatig de vraag: hoe kan dit nóg beter? Het is voor jou een uitdaging om hierover na te denken en je deelt graag je creatieve ideeën. Bovendien ben je een echte teamspeler en pas je je gemakkelijk aan wanneer de situatie daarom vraagt. Je hebt ruime ervaring in het werken in teamverband en je bent je bewust van jouw rol in het team en hoe jij kan bijdragen in het groeien van het team als geheel.

Verder heb je:

  • hbo (bachelor) werk- en denkniveau*; bij voorkeur in de richting vanInformatica, Software/Data Engineering of een gerelateerd vakgebied;
  • aangevuld met werkervaring als data engineer of software developer in een Agile en DevOps omgeving;
  • kennis van of ervaring met:
    • Java, Python en het ontwerpen, bouwen en beheren van data pipelines;
    • containers zoals Kubernetes en Openshift;
    • Spark, Springboot, Airflow, SQL, XML, JSON, REST en CICD software zoals Gitlab Pipelines en ArgoCD;
    • tools als: Jira, Confluence, Git en van BI (data modellering, ETL en data infrastructuur);
    • Linux en met relationele databases zoals PostgreSQL en Oracle;
  • bij voorkeur afiniteit met (Big)Data.

Wat wij bieden

De standplaats is Zwolle. Er is ruimte voor 1 fte. Het betreft een functie voor 36 uur per week.

De functie is opengesteld voor medewerkers werkzaam bij de politie met een vaste aanstelling, voor medewerkers die tijdelijk bij de politie werken en minimaal één jaar in dienst zijn, én voor politievrijwilligers. Bij meerdere geschikte kandidaten heeft een beroepsmedewerker voorrang op een politievrijwilliger. Eventuele preferente kandidaten binnen de politie worden eerst geplaatst. Medewerkers die bij de matching tijdens de overgang naar een LFNP-functie of door een eerdere reorganisatie bij plaatsing in een functie met een lagere schaal terecht zijn gekomen hebben een voorrangspositie.

Het betreft de LFNP-functie bedrijfsvoeringspecialist B, gewaardeerd in schaal 10 Bbp. Bij aanstelling accepteer je de rechtspositie die bij de functie hoort.

Bel of mail met John Muntendam, clustermanager (06 - 29 37 97 03,john.muntendam@politie.nl ) als je meer informatie over de functie wilt. Voor vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure bel of mail je met Bas Feskens, IT-recruiter (06 - 39 01 36 49,bas.feskens@politie.nl ).

13 september 2026

Wat verder belangrijk is

  • Een betrouwbaarheids- en omgevingsonderzoek maakt deel uit van de selectieprocedure;
  • Goed politiewerk heeft verschillende inzichten nodig. Met welke unieke blik kom jij ons versterken?

Je hebt een diploma op hbo (bachelor)-niveau of je bent daaraan gelijkgesteld via EVC. Of je toont op een van de volgende manieren aan dat je hbo (bachelor)werk- en denkniveau hebt:

  • Je bent aangesteld op een functie op het gevraagde werk- en denkniveau.
  • Je hebt een functie op het gevraagde werk- en denkniveau minimaal twee jaar formeel waargenomen.
  • Je bent minimaal 2 jaar tijdelijk tewerkgesteld op een functie op het gevraagde werk- en denkniveau.
  • Je hebt een formele beoordeling waaruit blijkt dat je een functie op het gevraagde werk- en denkniveau minimaal 2 jaar uitgeoefend hebt.
  • Je hebt een verklaring van de eenheidsleiding waaruit blijkt dat je over het gevraagde werk- en denkniveau beschikt, conform de beleidsregel Cognitieve Capaciteitentest en Assessment.

Dit moet je met een aanstellings-, waarnemings- of tewerkstellingsbesluit dan wel een beoordeling of verklaring schriftelijk aantonen.

Of je hebt van een andere werkgever een erkende functieomschrijving of een formeel vastgestelde vacaturetekst of een ander formeel bewijsstuk waarmee je aantoont dat je minimaal twee jaar werkervaring hebt op het gevraagde niveau. Het bewijsstuk heeft aantoonbaar betrekking op een functie die je daadwerkelijk hebt uitgevoerd en moet herleidbaar zijn tot jouw persoon. Denk aan een werkgeversverklaring waarin het werk- en denkniveau staat opgenomen of een uittreksel uit het HR-systeem waarop je functie en het dienstverband zichtbaar zijn.

title: Associate Director, Programmatic
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Director, Programmatic based in the United States.

This is a senior, hands-on media leadership role responsible for shaping programmatic and direct media strategy across a diverse portfolio of clients.
You will oversee planning, activation, optimization, measurement, and partner strategy across channels including CTV, display, audio, native, OLV, DOOH, and emerging formats.
The role combines strategic thinking with deep platform expertise, requiring you to move comfortably between client advisory, media planning, and campaign troubleshooting.
You will collaborate with creative, analytics, growth, and client teams to connect media investment with meaningful business outcomes.
A major part of the opportunity is identifying new partners, technologies, automation, and AI applications that can improve campaign performance and operational efficiency.
You will also mentor junior talent, contribute to new business opportunities, and help advance the organization's programmatic capabilities and thought leadership.
The environment is fast-moving, entrepreneurial, collaborative, and designed for people who enjoy testing ideas and continuously improving how media works.

Accountabilities

  • Define and own programmatic and direct media strategies across a portfolio of clients, covering CTV, OLV, display, native, audio, DOOH, high-impact, and emerging formats.
  • Lead campaign strategy and activation across DSPs such as The Trade Desk, DV360, StackAdapt, and other relevant platforms, maintaining hands-on oversight of setup, pacing, optimization, QA, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop buying and audience strategies across open exchange, private marketplace (PMP), Preferred Deals, Programmatic Guaranteed, and direct insertion order opportunities.
  • Own media planning and performance best practices spanning forecasting, budgeting, reach and frequency, learning agendas, optimization, reporting, and analysis.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with publishers, platforms, and media partners, including leading RFPs, evaluating opportunities, and negotiating direct and programmatic partnerships.
  • Identify and test emerging partners, formats, technologies, automation solutions, and AI applications that can improve campaign strategy, activation, workflows, and performance.
  • Partner with client, creative, growth, and analytics stakeholders to connect media strategy and measurement with broader business objectives.
  • Translate complex media strategies, marketplace developments, and performance data into clear recommendations and actionable business implications for clients.
  • Serve as a trusted, client-facing advisor by anticipating needs, presenting recommendations, and helping clients make informed media investment decisions.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to team development, new business pitches, thought leadership, POVs, presentations, and content.
  • Continuously improve processes and capabilities while helping evolve programmatic and direct media best practices.

    • Requirements

    • 6+ years of experience developing and activating programmatic media strategies, ideally within an agency environment.
    • Strong hands-on experience with DSPs such as The Trade Desk, DV360, and StackAdapt, including campaign setup, optimization, QA, troubleshooting, and performance management.
    • Broad experience across CTV, OLV, display, and other programmatic channels, with knowledge of PMP, Preferred Deals, Programmatic Guaranteed, and direct publisher buying.
    • Strong understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, publishers, data providers, and verification partners.
    • Experience developing sophisticated audience strategies using first-party data, contextual targeting, modeled audiences, and other targeting approaches.
    • Strong media planning, measurement, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn performance insights into strategic recommendations.
    • Proven client-facing experience and the ability to communicate complex media concepts clearly to diverse audiences while building trusted relationships.
    • Experience developing publisher and media partner relationships, evaluating opportunities, and supporting new business pitches.
    • Relevant platform certifications are a plus.
    • Strategic, data-driven, and commercially minded, with a strong focus on delivering results and exceeding client expectations.
    • Comfortable balancing high-level strategy with hands-on execution and remaining close to media platforms and campaign performance.
    • Entrepreneurial, proactive, curious, and adaptable, with an interest in improving processes and exploring new technologies.
    • Strong interest in AI and automation and a willingness to incorporate emerging tools into media strategy and execution.
    • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

      • Benefits

      • Base salary range of $113,000–$140,000, commensurate with experience and location.
      • Performance-based bonus opportunity of up to 7%.
      • Full medical, dental, and vision benefits.
      • Generous retirement program.
      • Thoughtful parental leave and return-to-work program.
      • Flexible time off and paid holidays.
      • Quarterly company Recharge Days.
      • Holiday closure in December.
      • Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities.
      • Commitment to transparent diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices.
      • Flexible remote work environment for U.S.-based employees.
      • Inclusive and supportive culture that encourages people from diverse and underrepresented backgrounds to grow and succeed.

title: Mid-level Project Manager
description:

A prestigious financial services firm is seeking a Mid-level Project Manager or Project Manager / Business Analyst with 2-5 years of experience, to join them a rolling 12 month contract.

With a background in financial services, you're comfortable with financial concepts & products and have strong skills around planning, prioritisation and stakeholder management.

With a reputation for being a fantastic place to work, truly valuing their employees and with an excellent culture, they are an excellent name to have on your CV!

Hit the Apply for this job button to find out more!

You are:

You're a driven & switched-on Project Manager or BA/PM, ideally with 2-5 years of experience and looking for a role that will take you to the next level.

They are a successful firm in financial services and are known to hire the best of the best.

With awesome CBD offices, they have a hybrid WFH/office model and flexible hours.

They have fantastic staff retention & are a great place to grow your career even as a contractor, with a big emphasis on promotion.

  • Background in financial services
  • Understanding of financial products & concepts ideal ie equities/derivatives/fixed income
  • Driven, excellent communication skills and hands-on
  • Oversee all changes for treasury
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills

If this sounds like you, apply now or contact Erinn Brukmann on 0422 154 366.

title: Middle School Science Curriculum Writer Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Middle School Science Curriculum Writer Consultant based in United States.

This is a 12-month, remote consulting opportunity for an experienced science educator and curriculum designer.
You will create rigorous, engaging, and culturally responsive middle school science curricula from the ground up.
The scope includes full-course design, lesson planning, instructional materials, labs, projects, homework, and assessments.
Your work will help shape high-quality learning experiences across life, Earth, physical, and related sciences.
You will collaborate closely with academic leaders, instructional coaches, and fellow curriculum specialists.
The role combines subject-matter expertise, instructional design, inquiry-based learning, and data-informed iteration.
It offers flexible scheduling, meaningful educational impact, and the opportunity to contribute to an ambitious academic mission.

Accountabilities

  • Design comprehensive middle school science courses, including scope and sequence, unit plans, and daily lesson plans across areas such as life, Earth, physical sciences, and biology.
  • Develop high-quality student-facing instructional materials, including lessons, problem sets, laboratory activities, projects, real-world applications, and course-aligned homework.
  • Create formative and summative assessments with clear success criteria that measure both scientific knowledge and the ability to apply skills.
  • Ensure all curriculum materials align with applicable New York State standards, academic expectations, and desired student outcomes.
  • Embed inquiry-based learning, conceptual understanding, analytical thinking, scientific reasoning, and problem-solving throughout the curriculum.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders, instructional coaches, and other curriculum writers to maintain coherence across subjects, courses, and grade levels.
  • Gather and incorporate feedback from educators and student performance data to continuously refine and strengthen curriculum materials.
  • Manage project deliverables and deadlines in partnership with the designated project lead while maintaining a consistently high standard of instructional quality.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree required; a Master’s degree is preferred.
    • At least 3 years of experience designing and/or teaching high-quality secondary or middle school science instruction.
    • Demonstrated experience developing rigorous, engaging, standards-aligned curriculum and instructional materials.
    • Strong knowledge of science content and effective middle school instructional practices.
    • Experience designing lessons, units, assessments, labs, projects, and other student-centered learning experiences.
    • Ability to develop curriculum that promotes inquiry, conceptual understanding, analytical thinking, and real-world application.
    • Experience using educator feedback and student performance data to evaluate and improve instructional materials.
    • Strong written communication, organization, collaboration, and project-management skills, with the ability to work independently in a flexible consulting environment.
    • A growth-oriented, collaborative mindset and a strong commitment to educational excellence, equity, and student success.
    • Permanent authorization to work in the United States is required.

      • Benefits

      • 12-month, project-based consulting engagement with an immediate start.
      • Fully remote work, with collaboration conducted remotely or in person when project needs require it.
      • Flexible work schedule, with deliverables and deadlines agreed upon with the project lead.
      • Compensation of $15,000–$25,000 per project unit, depending on experience and project scope.
      • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on middle school science education and student outcomes.
      • Collaboration with academic leaders, instructional coaches, and experienced curriculum professionals.
      • Purpose-driven environment focused on high academic achievement, equity, growth, and lifelong learning.
      • This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement; consultants are responsible for their own taxes and are not eligible for employee benefit plans.

title: IT - IT Technician II
description:
The IT Technician II provides advanced technical support and troubleshooting for library technology systems across multiple branches, in all continental US time zones. title: Solutions Engineer
description:
About the role

You are the person who makes our robot make sense to someone seeing it for the first time.

That means running live demos at our office, on customer floors, and on the show floor at trade events — setting the robot up, driving it through a task list that maps to what the customer actually cares about, and answering the hard technical questions in the room. When something goes wrong mid-demo, and it will, you are the one who keeps talking, diagnoses it in real time, and gets the robot back on task.

Between demos, you work with our sales team to scope pilots, respond to technical questions in deals, and bring what you hear from customers back to engineering. You will be one of the few people who sees the full arc from first handshake to deployed robot.

This is a hands-on hardware job. You will be lifting crates, running cable, and debugging on a concrete floor as often as you are in a conference room.

What you'll do

  • Run technical demos for prospects, partners, and press — at our facility, at customer sites, and at industry events

  • Own demo readiness: robot setup, calibration, task scripting, teardown, shipping, and field repair

  • Build and maintain a demo library that shows our capabilities against real customer use cases

  • Join sales calls as the technical voice — answer questions on payload, reach, cycle time, safety, integration, and deployment

  • Scope and support pilot deployments: define success criteria, configure the robot, train customer operators

  • Staff booths at trade shows, including multi-day events with long hours on your feet

  • Feed structured customer feedback to product and engineering — what people ask for, what breaks, what confuses them

  • Write the technical collateral sales needs: demo scripts, spec one-pagers, integration FAQs

What we're looking for

Required

  • 1–5 years of hands-on experience with physical robots — industry, research lab, or a serious competition team (FRC, RoboCup, Robomaster, ROS-based projects, university robotics lab, etc.)

  • Degree in robotics, automation, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or CS — or equivalent hands-on track record

  • Proficient in Python — you can script a demo sequence, automate a repetitive setup step, parse logs, and pull data off the robot without waiting on an engineer

  • Comfort with ROS/ROS 2, teleoperation, and reading logs to diagnose a problem under time pressure

  • You can explain a technical system to a non-technical buyer without either dumbing it down or losing them

  • Genuine composure in front of an audience — you have presented, demoed, or competed with people watching, and something went wrong, and you handled it

  • Willing to travel roughly 30% and to do the unglamorous parts: crates, cables, hotel ballrooms, 6am load-ins

  • Legally authorized to work in the US

description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

What's in it for you:

Lead the energy and infrastructure projects redefining how buildings perform.

Ideal for experienced project developers, engineers, construction and design-build leaders, building automation and controls specialists, energy and sustainability professionals, and technical consultants ready to lead complex infrastructure, energy, and mission-critical projects.

If you enjoy leading multidisciplinary teams, solving hard problems, developing innovative solutions, and translating technical concepts for audiences at every level of an organization, this role offers the chance to make a significant impact while accelerating your own growth.

The facilities our customers depend on are changing faster than at any point in a generation — driven by electrification, decarbonization, surging demand for data and compute, on-site generation and storage, and the shift toward intelligent, grid-interactive operations. As a Senior Energy Services Project Developer, you sit at the center of that change.

This role serves as the leader and integrator of the project development process—bringing together customer objectives, engineering expertise, financial analysis, design, estimating, construction planning, performance requirements, and innovative technologies into complete solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.

Working closely with Sales, Energy Engineers, Design-Build Specialists, Measurement & Verification Engineers, Operations teams, contractors, and customer stakeholders, you will lead the development of complex energy, infrastructure, and facility modernization projects from opportunity qualification through contract execution.

Successful Senior Project Developers understand how building systems, operational requirements, financial objectives, project execution strategies, emerging technologies, and customer outcomes work together to create successful projects.

If you enjoy leading multidisciplinary teams, solving complex challenges, developing innovative solutions, and translating technical concepts to diverse audiences, this role offers an opportunity to make a significant impact while accelerating your own growth.

Where You’ll Make an Impact

Our Energy Services business is built on decades of HVAC and controls leadership — and it’s expanding into the vertical markets shaping the next decade of the built environment. In this role, you’ll help develop projects across:

  • Electrification & Decarbonization — heat pumps, hydronic modernization, and net-zero pathways for aging building stock.
  • Core HVAC & Building Automation — the Trane and multi-vendor systems and controls that remain the backbone of every high-performing facility.
  • Renewable Energy & On-Site Generation — solar, combined heat and power, and distributed energy resources that lower both cost and carbon.
  • Energy Storage & Grid-Interactive Buildings — battery storage, load flexibility, and demand management that turn buildings into grid assets.
  • Intelligent & AI-Enabled Buildings — analytics, digital services, and AI-driven optimization that keep performance improving long after project handoff.
  • Mission-Critical & Data Centers — thermal management, high-density and liquid cooling, resilience, and efficiency for the facilities powering AI and the digital economy.

Why Join Trane?

At Trane, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Work on projects that improve schools, universities, hospitals, government facilities, industrial sites, and commercial buildings.
  • Lead complex infrastructure and facility modernization programs that create lasting customer impact.
  • Develop solutions that improve building performance, operational efficiency, sustainability, resilience, and occupant experience.
  • Collaborate with experts in engineering, controls, construction, analytics, digital services, energy, and emerging technologies.
  • Gain exposure to electrification, decarbonization, intelligent buildings, energy storage, resilience planning, and advanced building technologies.
  • Influence major customer investment decisions through solution development and project leadership.
  • Join a company recognized for innovation, sustainability, building technology, and energy services leadership.
  • Build a career path that can lead to Executive Project Developer, Team Leader, Preconstruction Leader, Business Leader, or broader Energy Services leadership roles.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?

Successful Senior Project Developers are natural project leaders who enjoy bringing people, information, and ideas together to solve problems. They can coordinate multidisciplinary teams, manage competing priorities, evaluate technical and financial tradeoffs, and communicate solutions clearly to stakeholders at every level of an organization. They understand how customer goals, building systems, project execution, operations, technology, and financial considerations work together to create successful outcomes — and they’re curious, collaborative, and always looking for a better way to deliver value.

What You'll Do - Key Responsibilities

Lead Project Development

Lead complex energy, infrastructure, and facility modernization opportunities from qualification through contract execution. Coordinate project development activities across engineering, design-build, estimating, operations, M&V, sales, and customer stakeholders while maintaining project schedules, priorities, deliverables, quality, and momentum.

Develop Integrated Solutions

Partner with technical experts to develop solutions that align with customer objectives and project requirements. Solutions may include HVAC modernization, building automation and controls, energy efficiency improvements, facility renewal, deferred maintenance reduction, electrification, sustainability initiatives, resilience improvements, intelligent building technologies, renewable energy solutions, and other emerging technologies.

Drive Customer Alignment

Work alongside sales teams and customer stakeholders to understand operational challenges, facility needs, financial objectives, and desired outcomes. Facilitate workshops, presentations, and planning discussions while helping stakeholders understand solution benefits, implementation requirements, risks, and expected results.

Evaluate Business & Financial Viability

Develop business cases, lifecycle cost analyses, project valuations, and funding strategies that support customer investment decisions. Help customers evaluate value beyond energy savings, including operational performance, reliability, risk reduction, asset renewal, sustainability goals, occupant experience, and organizational priorities.

Ensure Constructability & Project Feasibility

Collaborate with designers, contractors, estimators, and operations teams to ensure solutions are practical and executable. Evaluate project phasing, constructability, implementation challenges, subcontractor approaches, risk factors, and execution strategies to improve project outcomes and reduce delivery risk.

Advance Innovation & Digital Solutions

Leverage analytics, digital tools, building performance insights, and emerging technologies to strengthen project development and customer outcomes. Support Trane's innovation strategy through the application of intelligent buildings, advanced analytics, AI-enabled tools, resilience solutions, and next-generation infrastructure technologies.

What You'll Bring

Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Energy Management, Business, Construction Management, Finance, Economics, or related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in engineering, energy services, construction, facilities management, building automation, controls, consulting, project management, infrastructure development, capital projects, or similar fields.
  • Strong project leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Business and financial aptitude with the ability to evaluate project value and customer outcomes.

Preferred:

Experience with facility modernization, capital improvement programs, performance contracting (ESPC), design-build delivery, infrastructure planning, estimating, contractor coordination, HVAC systems, controls, mission-critical/data center facilities, renewable energy, or sustainability initiatives. Certifications such as CEM, PMP, PE, DBIA, or LEED AP are valued but not required.

title: HSM Managed Services Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a HSM Managed Services Engineer based in United States.

The HSM Managed Services Engineer will provide day-to-day operational administration and technical support for a critical enterprise Hardware Security Module environment.
You will help maintain a highly available, secure, resilient, and auditable cryptographic infrastructure supporting mission-critical operations.
The role covers HSM monitoring, partition lifecycle management, key management, high availability, disaster recovery, and security controls.
You will work primarily remotely, with limited travel to customer facilities when on-site support is required.
The position requires strong hands-on experience managing HSM environments and the ability to troubleshoot complex operational issues.
You will also contribute to incident response, documentation, SLA reporting, knowledge transfer, and customer personnel training.
This is an opportunity to play a direct role in protecting sensitive cryptographic infrastructure within a demanding enterprise environment.

Accountabilities

  • Provide remote and on-site administration, troubleshooting, monitoring, and operational support for enterprise HSM environments.
  • Continuously monitor appliance health, availability, performance, capacity, partition status, and key-operation failures, maintaining a target availability of at least 99.9% per calendar month.
  • Provision, configure, modify, monitor, and securely decommission HSM partitions across dedicated, shared, multi-tenant, and application-specific environments.
  • Maintain role-based access controls, privileged-access controls, partition isolation, and secure administrative practices.
  • Integrate HSM logging and audit events with enterprise SIEM capabilities to support security monitoring, compliance, and auditability.
  • Support high-availability configurations, failover procedures, backup and recovery processes, and disaster recovery capabilities.
  • Execute enterprise cryptographic key lifecycle activities, including key generation, rotation, backup, recovery, archival, and secure destruction.
  • Participate in documented and witnessed key ceremonies using M-of-N quorum authentication, dual control, and split-knowledge principles.
  • Participate in annual disaster recovery exercises and document recovery results, findings, and corrective actions.
  • Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, configuration documentation, and partition-management records.
  • Support incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, service-level reporting, and ongoing operational improvements.
  • Provide knowledge transfer and hands-on training to customer personnel to strengthen operational capabilities and ensure continuity.

    • Requirements

    • Demonstrated hands-on experience operating and supporting HSM managed-service or enterprise HSM environments.
    • Experience with remote HSM administration, troubleshooting, monitoring, and operational maintenance.
    • Proven experience managing the complete HSM partition lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, modification, monitoring, and secure decommissioning.
    • Strong understanding of SIEM and security logging integrations for HSM environments.
    • Experience supporting HSM high availability, failover, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes.
    • Practical knowledge of enterprise cryptographic key lifecycle operations, including generation, rotation, backup, recovery, archival, and destruction.
    • Experience participating in secure key ceremonies involving M-of-N quorum authentication, dual control, and split knowledge.
    • At least two previous managed HSM engagements demonstrating your responsibilities and the service levels sustained.
    • Experience with Thales Luna or equivalent enterprise HSM technologies is strongly preferred.
    • OEM HSM administration training or certification is a plus.
    • Experience working in federal or Department of Veterans Affairs environments is preferred.
    • FedRAMP or cloud-based HSM experience is advantageous where applicable.
    • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and incident-resolution skills.
    • Ability to work independently in a primarily remote environment while maintaining effective communication with customers and technical stakeholders.
    • Willingness and ability to travel on a limited basis to customer facilities when required.

      • Benefits

      • Primarily remote work environment with limited travel requirements.
      • Opportunity to support a highly available, secure, and mission-critical enterprise HSM environment.
      • Meaningful technical responsibility within a growing organization focused on transformation and customer mission success.
      • Collaborative environment where employees are encouraged to contribute ideas and influence how services are delivered.
      • Opportunities for professional development, knowledge sharing, and hands-on technical growth.
      • Supportive culture emphasizing respect, collaboration, empowerment, and employee contributions.
      • Exposure to enterprise cryptographic infrastructure, federal technology environments, SIEM integration, and disaster recovery operations.
      • Compensation and additional benefits are subject to the applicable employment package and location.

title: Workforce Planner
description:
Kia ora!

Are you someone who enjoys solving complex problems, finding patterns in data, and turning information into practical plans? Do you like working with people as much as you enjoy working with numbers?

We’re looking for Workforce Planners to join our team with permanent and 12-month fixed-term opportunities across our Air and Ground operations.

There are 3 x Workforce Planner opportunities: one permanent and one 12-month fixed-term position supporting our Pilot and Cabin Crew workforces, and a second 12-month fixed-term position supporting our Ground operations across Airports and Engineering & Maintenance.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in ensuring we have the right people, with the right capability, in the right place, at the right time to support a large and complex airline operation.

Depending on the role, you could be supporting workforce planning across our Air operation, planning for our Pilot and Cabin Crew workforces, or our Ground operation, supporting our Airport and Engineering & Maintenance workforces.

In either environment, you’ll work closely with operational leaders and stakeholders to develop workforce and leave plans that balance operational demand, resilience, cost efficiency, contractual obligations and regulatory requirements. Your work will directly influence how we plan, make decisions and prepare our workforce for future operational needs.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and maintain accurate workforce and leave plans across medium and long-term planning horizons, from approximately 6 months to 5 years ahead.
  • Analyse workforce demand, labour capacity, leave requirements, operational risks and performance trends.
  • Balance operational requirements, labour costs, contractual obligations and regulatory requirements to develop effective workforce plans.
  • Monitor workforce plans and provide reporting, insights, options and recommendations to support informed business decisions.
  • Identify workforce constraints, risks and opportunities, and recommend practical solutions to support operational readiness.
  • Use data, modelling and structured problem-solving to shape decisions, influence outcomes and create clarity where there are competing priorities or ambiguity.
  • Build strong relationships with operational leaders and key stakeholders to understand business priorities, constructively challenge where needed and translate requirements into workable plans.
  • Identify and lead improvements in workforce-planning processes, tools, systems and ways of working.
  • Maintain accurate workforce-planning data and systems to support reporting, compliance and decision-making.
  • Champion safety, security and compliance in everything you do.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

title: Databricks Data Engineer
description:
About the job

Job Title: Data Engineer/RSA (Databricks Focused)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: W2 Contract (No C2C and H1B candidates)


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer/ RSA with 10–12+ years of experience to act as the primary technical bridge between our data platforms and enterprise clients. This is a high-velocity role for an architect who thrives in ambiguity and can seamlessly manage multiple concurrent client engagements.


Unlike traditional architecture roles, you will be embedded directly within client delivery teams to lead the architecture, design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise Databricks Lakehouse platforms. You will translate complex business requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions while providing technical leadership, architectural guidance, and engineering best practices.


Required Experience

  • 10–12+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Solution Architecture.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks Lakehouse Platform.
  • Experience leading enterprise-scale cloud data platform implementations.
  • Strong client-facing experience working directly with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring engineering teams and leading technical design discussions.


Key Responsibilities

● Lead technical priorities across multiple enterprise client engagements simultaneously, balancing rapid delivery with scalable architecture and long-term platform strategy.

● Architect and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) for data engineering workflows, ensuring robust version control, automated testing, and seamless deployment of Databricks assets.

● Serve as the primary technical advisor within client delivery teams, translating business challenges into scalable, production-ready data solutions while mentoring engineering teams and driving architectural decisions.

● Architect, build, and optimize enterprise-scale Databricks Lakehouse platforms using Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), supporting multiple business domains and large-scale production workloads.

● Own the full development lifecycle, from technical design and ETL/ELT pipeline construction (Databricks Workflows, SQL Warehouses, Spark) to deployment, monitoring, and production support.

● Implement governed Lakehouse patterns using Unity Catalog, RBAC/ABAC, lineage, and compliance controls while balancing security with development agility.

● Design distributed integration patterns across cloud-native services (AWS / Azure / GCP) and enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, Kafka/Kinesis streams).

● Lead architecture reviews, mentor engineering teams, establish platform best practices, and drive cloud cost optimization across storage, compute, and enterprise data platforms.


Technical Qualifications

● Strong hands-on experience with Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables (DLT), Photon Engine, and Lakehouse Federation.

● Demonstrated experience implementing CI/CD pipelines for data platforms.

● Proficiency with Terraform and version control workflows.

● Proficiency in Spark (PySpark & Scala), complex query tuning, performance optimization, and pipeline automation (Airflow, dbt).

● Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS / Azure / GCP), containerization (Docker), and building/debugging data-connected applications (FastAPI, Flask, Node.js).

● Experience with real-time streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, Auto Loader).


Interview & Placement Process

Our hiring process is designed for speed and precision, matching your unique skill set with fast-moving, high-impact client projects. The typical timeline is one to a few weeks, depending on current project allocations.

1. Initial Screening: A quick background and qualification screening with the CloudTech Innovations team.

2. Client Introduction: A brief introductory phone call with the client to align on high-level goals.

3. Technical Deep-Dive: A one-round technical interview held by our Implementation Partner. This is where we analyze your depth of knowledge and technical versatility. Based on this assessment, we match your core strengths with the specific end-client requirements best suited to your profile.

Note on Flexibility: If you are a strong candidate but not the right fit for the specific project discussed, we pivot to match you with other open end-client projects that utilize your skills.

4. Final Interview: A final discussion with the end client to confirm project fit. There may be multiple rounds based on project needs and client requirements.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The Adaptive Builder: You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar codebases or project structures and immediately adding value. You do not just support projects; you drive them.

The High-Pace Operator: You thrive in an environment where speed-to-market is critical. You balance the need for quick wins with long-term architectural stability.

The Client Partner: You possess the interpersonal skills to act as a technical advisor to stakeholders, managing expectations, translating technical trade-offs into business value, and maintaining trust across multiple concurrent workstreams.

Ownership Mindset: You take complete pride in the quality of your code, the stability of your deployments, and the measurable success of your clients.

Certifications: Certifications in Databricks, AWS/GCP/Azure Solution Architecture, or TOGAF are a plus.

title: Sr. Marketing Design Lead (Start up Healthtech)
description:

You’ll also develop design systems, manage external creative partners, and maintain a consistently high visual standard across channels.
Working closely with marketing, sales, customer success, product marketing, and external partners, you’ll help turn complex healthcare concepts into compelling creative.

  • Build organized asset libraries, naming conventions, templates, and production processes that improve efficiency and reduce duplicated work.
  • Take creative briefs from concept through final delivery, presenting options with clear rationale and refining work based on feedback.

  • Manage multiple concurrent projects, prioritize competing demands, communicate progress, and identify risks or blockers early.

    • Requirements

    • Demonstrated experience designing for technology, SaaS, B2B, or similarly complex business environments.
    • Strong portfolio covering social media, web, advertising, email, sales collateral, event materials, signage, and other print applications.
    • Advanced proficiency with Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
    • Working knowledge of design systems, components, libraries, and scalable brand standards.
    • Experience preparing print-ready production files with accurate bleeds, color specifications, file formats, and vendor requirements.
    • Strong practical experience using AI tools for creative ideation, variation, retouching, layout, and other design workflows.
    • Ability to turn individual AI techniques into repeatable systems, templates, instructions, and workflows that can be adopted by non-designers.
    • Exceptional visual judgment, with a strong eye for typography, hierarchy, composition, layout, and brand consistency.
    • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain, defend, and adapt design decisions.
    • Experience sourcing, briefing, coordinating, and managing freelance designers, agencies, and other creative specialists.
    • Ability to work independently, manage priorities across multiple projects, and maintain high-quality execution in a fast-paced startup environment.
    • Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or another regulated industry is a strong advantage.
    • Familiarity with Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review processes and their impact on creative development is preferred.
    • Motion design or short-form video experience using tools such as After Effects, Runway, or similar platforms is a plus.
    • Experience collaborating with web developers and engineers, including familiarity with Figma Dev Mode and design-to-development workflows, is beneficial.
    • Experience contributing to or developing brand systems, rather than simply executing within established guidelines, is valued.
    • Experience creating AI workflows for other users, including agent instructions, prompt libraries, or reusable templates, is a strong plus.

Assist members with all consumer lending needs by explaining loan terms, conditions, and requirements, and collaborate with the Consumer Lending Department on loan products requiring specialized underwriting.

로켓배송을 통해 미래 물류의 혁신을 이끌어 온 종합물류서비스 기업으로서 CLS는 로켓배송의 노하우, 인프라, 네트워크 등을 연계하여 물류 혁신을 통한 더 나은 고객감동을 만들어 나갈 것입니다.

직무 소개

Quickflex Account Management팀은 로켓와우부터 로켓 프레시 등 로켓 배송의 90% 이상에 해당하는 배달을 담당하는 운송 파트너사를 운영하고 관리하고 있습니다. 다양한 영업점들과 함께 더 나은 배송 서비스를 위해 운영 방향성과 실행계획을 수립하고 있습니다.

업무 내용

  • PDD(Promise Delivery Date) 달성을 위해 운송 파트너사 운영 및 관리
  • 일/주/월 단위 배송 관제
  • 노선별 배송 상황 모니터링 및 긴급 공백 대응
  • 운영 리포트 작성 및 본사/현지 공유
  • Quickflex Operation을 위한 운영 방향성 및 실행계획 수립
  • 계약된 운송사 Account Management
  • 배송 서비스 및 프로세스 관리
  • 이슈 수집 및 개선안 제안

자격 요건

  • 최소 2년 이상의 물류 운영 또는 영업관리 또는 배송 관제 업무 경험이 있으신 분
  • OA 활용이 가능하신 분 (Excel, Google Sheet, ERP 등)
  • 스케줄 근무가 가능하신 분 (주말 포함 주5일 근무, 야간 근무 필수)
  • 빠르게 변화하는 환경에 대응 가능한 유연한 영업 역량을 가지신 분
  • 다수의 우선순위를 동시에 관리할 수 있는 업무 관리 능력을 가지신 분

우대 사항

  • 중국어(대만) 또는 영어 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분
  • 높은 커뮤니케이션 역량을 보유하신 분
  • 물류관련 자격증을 소지하신 분
  • 문제를 구조적으로 분석하고 솔루션을 도출하는 능력을 가지신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupangls.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

Please complete the attached Internal Transfer Request Form and submit.

title: PEER SPECIALIST - SENIOR HOUSING
description:
The Lord’s Place is a dynamic, passion-driven social impact organization in Palm Beach County providing innovative, compassionate, and effective services to homeless men, women, and children in our community. We are an organization committed to building a varied workplace welcoming people of all backgrounds. We have consistently ranked nationally as a Best Nonprofit to Work For and as a Best Place to Work in Florida.


What makes us one of the best places to work, besides having mission-focused employees who live our core values?

  • Generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, and holidays.
  • Maternity/Paternity Leave
  • 401k with employer match
  • Exceptional benefits including health, dental, vision, life, short and long-term disability, supplemental insurances.
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Flexible work environment
  • And much, much more!

We are seeking a Peer Specialists to join our Bill’s Place team. Bill’s Place is a supportive housing facility serving senior men who have experienced homelessness. The Peer Specialist will provide services directly to individuals in the program and work closely with Client Advocates. Hours will vary for program activities. This role allows for flexible work schedules, subject to campus needs.


The Peer Specialist utilize their lived experiences and demonstrate an ability to use their personal narrative in the service of assisting others. The Peer Specialist assist in the utilization of appropriate community resources, engagement, and development of wellness and recovery skills and provides information, support, assistance, and advocacy. The Peer Specialist is uniquely poised to provide collaborative and person-centered support services from a peer perspective.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develops effective working relationships with agencies, organizations, and community members to respond and advocate for men experiencing homelessness.
  • Assists in a variety of support activities including peer support groups, peer recovery, and psycho-educational groups outcomes for client.
  • Collaboratively works with peers in the development of a strength-based wellness and recovery plan to overcome barriers to good mental health.
  • Develops effective working relationships with agencies, organizations, and community members to respond and advocate for men from a peer perspective.
  • Communicates effectively, represents and promotes the consumer perspective within mental health, homelessness, reentry, and other relevant systems.
  • Attends and participates in special events, conferences, and workshops and trainings within the community.
  • Focuses on and is sensitive to client satisfaction with the services received and general satisfaction with services provided.
  • Attends and participates in supervision and multidisciplinary meetings.
  • Provides transportation in company vehicle throughout Palm Beach County.
  • Documents all activities as required.
  • Collaborates with the Advancement Department as it applies to gifts-in-kind and sharing client stories to aid the department with necessary information to share the impact of The Lord’s Place with our community.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned by the Director of Senior Housing or client advocates according to business needs.

title: Medior Data Engineer
description:
De Centrale Commissie Mensgebonden Onderzoek (CCMO) is een commissie ingesteld op basis van de Wet Medisch- wetenschappelijk Onderzoek met mensen (WMO). De CCMO valt onder het Ministerie VWS. Naast de WMO voert de CCMO de Embryowet uit.

De CCMO waarborgt de bescherming van onderzoekdeelnemers betrokken bij medisch- wetenschappelijk onderzoek, middels toetsing aan de daarvoor gestelde wettelijke bepalingen en met inachtneming van het belang van de voortgang van de medische wetenschap. De CCMO zelf beoordeelt medisch-wetenschappelijk onderzoek bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van somatische celtherapie en gentherapie. Zij fungeert ook als Bevoegde Instantie voor geneesmiddelenonderzoek, als toezichthouder van de erkende medisch-ethische toetsingscommissies (METC’s) en zij treedt op als beroepsinstantie.

De CCMO beoogt om met de inzet van een Agile DevOps team onder leiding van een eigen CCMO productowner, een senior data architect en een medior data engineer een centraal dataplatform in Microsoft Azure, gebaseerd op Databricks, Delta Lake en Power BI te realiseren. Dit platform vervangt de huidige versnipperde en grotendeels handmatige manier van rapporteren en biedt op termijn ondersteuning aan de kernprocessen Sturen & Verantwoorden, Beoordelen en Onderzoeken. Dit datateam wordt verder ondersteund door onze cloud platform en securityteams.

Opdrachtomschrijving

De CCMO is een groeiende organisatie met een ambitieus strategisch businessplan wat resulteert in een strategische IV/IT-behoefte. Medewerkers en stakeholders van de CCMO worden ondersteund bij de uitvoering van de medisch-ethische toetsing door gebruiksvriendelijke en digitaal weerbare IT-systemen en een duurzame informatievoorziening. We werken hierbij vanuit een Cloud-first en Cloud-native IT-strategie. De CCMO start met de realisatie van een centraal dataplatform in Microsoft Azure, gebaseerd op Microsoft Fabric en/of Azure Databricks, Delta Lake en Power BI. Dit platform vervangt de huidige versnipperde en grotendeels handmatige manier van rapporteren en biedt op termijn ondersteuning aan de kernprocessen Sturen & Verantwoorden, Beoordelen en Onderzoeken. Fase 1 richt zich op het inrichten van het platformfundament en het beschikbaar stellen van betrouwbare, uniforme data voor rapportages en dashboards ten behoeve van Sturen & Verantwoorden. De CCMO is op zoek naar een Medior Data Engineer om samen met het CCMO-datateam dit dataplatform in te richten, datasets te bouwen en te beheren. In deze opdracht is alle ruimte voor jou als Medior Data Engineer om vanaf de start een zichtbare bijdrage te leveren aan het opzetten van een nieuw dataplatform. Zo draag je bij aan onze belangrijke maatschappelijke missie: de bescherming van deelnemers betrokken bij medisch-wetenschappelijk onderzoek en het stimuleren van de voortgang van de medische wetenschap.

Als Medior Data Engineer draag je bij aan het opzetten en doorontwikkelen van het centrale dataplatform van de CCMO in Microsoft Azure. Je werkt in nauwe samenwerking met de Platform Owner, Data Architect en de functioneel en technisch beheerders. Je vertaalt databronnen en informatiebehoeften naar betrouwbare datapijplijnen, datasets en rapportageproducten.

Als Medior Data Engineer bouw en onderhoud je datapijplijnen waarmee gegevens uit databases, applicaties en API’s worden ontsloten, verwerkt en beschikbaar gesteld voor rapportages en dashboards. Je werkt binnen de vastgestelde platformarchitectuur en lagenstructuur. Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van herbruikbare ingest- en transformatielogica met Python, SQL en waar nodig PySpark. Je werkt met moderne Azure-dataplatformtechnologieën zoals Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Delta Lake en Apache Airflow. Van kandidaten wordt niet verwacht dat zij al specialist zijn in al deze technologieën. Wel wordt verwacht dat zij beschikken over een goede basis in Microsoft Azure en aantoonbaar in staat zijn zich nieuwe technologieën snel eigen te maken. Je draagt onder andere bij aan het ontsluiten van gegevens uit SQL-databases, applicaties en REST API’s, het bouwen en onderhouden van ingest- en transformatiepijplijnen, het aansluiten van datasets op Power BI en andere rapportageoplossingen en het veilig en beheersbaar verwerken van gegevens binnen de Azure-omgeving.

Waarom CCMO?

Bij de CCMO werk je mee aan de opbouw van een nieuw dataplatform vanaf de fundamenten. Dit biedt jou de kans om vanaf dag één een rol te spelen in de architectuur, bouw en doorontwikkeling van een modern, cloud-native dataplatform dat de organisatie helpt bij het nemen van

datagedreven beslissingen. Om succesvol te zijn in deze rol is het belangrijk dat je zelfstandig en proactief werkt, structuur aanbrengt in een omgeving die nog in opbouw is, en initiatief neemt. We waarderen een hands-onmentaliteit, sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met het navigeren door de opbouw Van een dataplatform.

Benodigdheden voor aanbieding VWS:

  • 2. Ingevuld Nederlands aanbieddocument met daarin een motivatie gericht op de aanvraag. Aanbieddocument max 1-1,5 pagina's lang zijn.
  • 3. CV AVG-proof: Géén foto. Géén persoonsgegevens zoals (mail)adres, telefoonnummer, geboortedatum, nationaliteit of LinkedIn. Géén leveranciersgegevens

Kandidaat beschikt over minimaal HBO werk- en denkniveau.

Kandidaat heeft minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring met data-engineering, en/of data-analyse-engineering en/of het ontwikkelen en beheren van dataplatformen.

Kandidaat beschikt minimaal over de Microsoft certificaten Fabric Data Engineer Associate en Azure Fundamentals.

Mate waarin de kandidaat aantoonbare ervaring heeft met Microsoft Azure en verschillende Azure-dataplatformtechnologieën zoals Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Delta Lake of Apache Airflow.

Mate waarin de kandidaat aantoonbare ervaring heeft met Python en SQL en met het bouwen, onderhoud van data pipelines

Mate waarin kandidaat aantoonbare ervaring heeft met API- en database- ingestie, gelaagde data-architecturen, datakwaliteit, monitoring en foutafhandeling

Mate waarin kandidaat beschikt over de gevraagde competenties en vaardigheden (toetsbaar in CV, motivatie en/of mogelijk gesprek).

Uurtarief: (laagste tarief / aangeboden tarief ) * maximale prijsscore.

title: Director of Engineering, Product
description:
About Airtasker

Airtasker is Australia's leading platform connecting people who need work done with skilled people who want to do it, from furniture assembly to full home renovations. We are a Sydney-based team building a platform that has facilitated millions of tasks and helped hundreds of thousands of Taskers grow their businesses.

About the role

Two things are happening at Airtasker at once. We are rebuilding the core of the platform, and we are changing how engineering works. This role leads the second one for product engineering.

You shape how the work gets done: how our Engineering Managers lead teams whose members each coordinate a fleet of agents, how engineers plan and review work they no longer type, and how much of our support and bug fixing we hand to agents outright. Your peer Directors lead our tooling and architecture, and you help steer that work from the CTO Leadership Team.

We are well on our way to being an AI-native engineering organisation. We work spec-first, directing autonomous systems that author code and curating the context that makes them effective, and that is how a growing share of the group works today.

The Evidence

On the eight-level agentic maturity scale we use internally, we currently place ourselves at five to six. We are equally honest about where we have stalled. The remaining bottleneck is not model capability, it is us: how we plan, how we hand work to agents, and how much of our systems knowledge still lives only in people's heads.

The Group

Three teams covering acquisition, activation and retention. Around 21 people, five direct reports (three Engineering Managers and two senior engineers), split between Sydney and Hanoi. The teams are full-stack and own their verticals end to end, across backend, web and mobile.

This group is more than half of everyone who writes code at Airtasker. A small number of people carrying a large share of the company's output, which is roughly the point: we would rather have a leader who knows every engineer by name than another layer of management.

You will report to the CTO and sit on the CTO Leadership Team alongside the Director who leads our core marketplace platform, the Director who leads our operational teams across SRE and Data Platform, and the Director who leads decision science. Platform and architecture investment is decided at that table, which is where you make the case for what your teams need.

What you'll do

  • Work out what engineering management looks like in an agentic team. Coordinating work across people matters less now, and the quality of intent, context and review matters more. You would do that alongside three Engineering Managers who know our teams and our customers well, and feed what you learn back into how we grow and hire engineering leaders. There is no settled playbook for this anywhere yet, which is what makes it the largest part of the role and the hardest.

  • Change how engineers work with agents. We want one engineer directing a vertical slice end to end, running agents in parallel, with review happening at the plan rather than only at the diff. Getting there means new habits, and habits do not change because a director announced a new process.

  • Take support and bug fixing off humans. We think a large share of our triage and fixing can be handed to coding agents. Nobody here has proved it yet. You would lead that from hypothesis to production.

  • Partner with our product and design leaders on how we scope and sequence work. Agentic delivery breaks when intent is vague, and no amount of tooling fixes that upstream.

  • Bring rigour to how we measure engineering performance. Know where speed is converting into instability and review load rather than into shipped value, and show it with data. Self-reported productivity is not evidence, and we would like a leader who already knows why.

  • Question our metrics. We currently target 60 merged PRs per engineer per month and 90% of code generated by AI. Both are useful and both are gameable.

  • Represent product engineering on the CTO Leadership Team, and help set company technical direction.

  • Hire, and lift the bar through interviewing, guidance and mentorship.

What Hands-On Means Here

You are expected to be fluent enough with a coding agent to reason about our code, our architecture and our systems, and to build enough domain knowledge to join the on-call rotation alongside the other Directors. Shipping code into production is not part of the role, though nobody will stop you if that is what you enjoy.

  • You break work down into agent-executable units yourself, with clear constraints and acceptance criteria.

  • You can read a diff properly, and you recognise a well-framed piece of work because you have framed one yourself.

  • You treat being hands-on as the thing that earns you permission to change how everyone else works.

What a Good First Year Looks Like

In twelve months we would expect:

  • Our Engineering Managers running teams in a way that would have looked unrecognisable a year earlier.

  • Most non-trivial work planned, reviewed and merged through agent workflows, with our change failure rate holding.

  • A meaningful share of inbound bugs resolved without a human writing the fix.

If you got two of those three, we would consider it a good year.

What you'll bring

We care much more about what you have done than how long you have been doing it, so tell us about specific things you have built, fixed or changed rather than years of scope.

Must have

  • You have led a multi-team engineering group and grown engineering managers within it, and you can point to managers who got better while working for you.

  • You have taken an engineering organisation through a change that people resisted, and you can describe what you did about the resistance rather than what you announced.

  • You are hands-on with AI coding tools such as Claude Code across the full lifecycle. You think spec-first, and when agent output goes wrong you fix the upstream artefact rather than patching the symptom.

  • Strong engineering and architecture fundamentals, and the credibility to guide technical decisions without taking them over.

  • Based in Sydney, and able to be in the office around twice a week.

Nice to have

  • You have a point of view on how to run an engineering organisation well. We would welcome you challenging our thinking here.

  • You treat developer experience as a product, and can give us an example of using metrics to find hidden friction in the inner loop and what you changed to remove it.

  • Deep care for the product and commercial context, and a habit of coaching rather than directing.

  • Marketplaces or two-sided platforms.

  • Scaling delivery through better leverage rather than more headcount.

  • Working with teams split across time zones.

How We Hire

Four conversations and one short piece of written work. We aim to get you from application to decision in about two weeks, and we will tell you where you stand within two days of each stage.

  1. A conversation with our Talent Acquisition team. Motivation, the shape of the role, location and money, so nothing is a surprise later.

  2. A short written exercise. We send you a real Airtasker problem, lightly redacted, and ask for one to two pages: what you think is going on, and what you would do about it. Two pages is the limit, and telling us what you would do next with more time is part of the answer.

  3. A 90 minute conversation about what you wrote, with our CTO, an Engineering Director and one of our product leaders. We will dig into your reasoning, and part way through we will hand you something new and think about it together.

  4. A technical judgement conversation with two of our senior engineers, who would report to you. No coding, no whiteboard.

  5. A leadership and values conversation with our CTO and a People Partner.

Our People Experience:

Our people team at Airtasker are dedicated to designing an industry leading people experience. This means creating an environment where you are empowered to do your best work and realise the full potential of your skills.

Thriving

  • Hybrid working - when it comes to working, there’s no “one size fits all” approach, with Airtasker you choose the environment that helps you do your best work.

  • Airtime - welcome to no Slack and meeting-free Fridays! Airtime is designed so we regularly have dedicated focus time for work and personal growth.

  • Recharge days - each quarter we have a company-wide Recharge Day, equivalent to 4 additional days of leave per year. It’s a day for everyone when the world can wait and self-care takes centre stage.

  • Wellbeing support - our Employee Assistance Program provides confidential access for our people to GPs, dieticians, counselling and mental health specialists, providing essential support whenever needed.

  • Airpowerment Fund - we provide a $200 allowance to spend on anything that supports your health & wellbeing.


Rewarding

  • Airtasker credits - it’s a great feeling to get things done. Even greater when you get $1000 worth of credits every year to help you check off your to-do list and connect with our community of Taskers.

  • Fair and equitable pay - this is a core commitment to our people. Every year we review industry data to ensure our compensation framework supports everyone to be recognised for the full value of their skills.

  • Tenure leave - To celebrate our people’s commitment to Airtasker, we offer tenure leave starting from your 3rd anniversary with the company. This begins with 3 extra days of leave per year, gradually increasing to a maximum of 5 days per year.


Belonging

  • DAREtasker - join our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion committee! Every month we meet to create meaningful and impactful programs of work that embrace belonging at Airtasker.

  • Celebration swap - not everyone celebrates the same things. That’s why, at Airtasker, you can swap national, state or territory public holidays for the ones that matter to you.


Growing

  • Learning and development - learning at Airtasker is on the job, guided by managers, enhanced by peers and led by ourselves. We deliver learning programs and budget allowances to invest in your growth.

  • 360 performance reviews - feedback is a gift. Every year we run 360 reviews across the business to recognise achievements and promote personal growth.

  • Volunteer leave - Our team members can take a day each year to lend a helping hand and support a cause they are passionate about.


Celebrating

  • Awards - and the winners are… our go-getters! Whether it’s our peer-nominated quarterly Values Awards or our periodic Go-Getter Spirit Award, we love celebrating our people and spreading good energy.

  • Vibe committee - good vibes only! Our Vibe Committee delivers events that hit the sweet spot of bringing us all together to enjoy each other’s company whether you’re local or remote.

  • Birthday leave - All of our people get an extra day of leave during their birthday week to take time away from work to celebrate.


At Airtasker we believe in culture add - that each person is different and has their own background, learnings and unique experiences that can add to the Airtasker cultural tapestry. We pride ourselves on our inclusive culture, and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

To all recruitment agencies and talent suppliers: Airtasker does not accept unsolicited resumes. Airtasker is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job postings or directly to our managers. If you are on our supplier list and have terms in place, ensure you work alongside our internal TA team and do not send resumes directly to managers.

title: AI & Data Architect
description:
AI & Data Architect
Melbourne
200k-240k + Super + Bonus

Company overview
A fast-growing fintech in the invoice payments space, helping businesses get paid faster and manage cash flow without taking on debt. It's a senior, high-trust environment: this role sits on par with the leadership team and has real influence over how the business's data and systems are built. Backed by strong investment in tooling, a social culture, and the kind of scope that rarely comes up twice.

Role and responsibilities
You'll own the data and systems architecture end to end. That means the canonical data model (entities, relationships, schemas, semantics), the contracts between systems, and the standards for lineage, quality and freshness. One trusted definition per concept, enforced across the business.
On the systems side, you'll own the landscape itself: which system is master for which data, how everything connects, and the integration patterns, event standards and identity design that hold it together. You'll make the build versus buy calls, lead technical evaluation of vendors, and surface the trade-offs for sign-off. You'll also design the access layer that lets AI agents work with the estate, including MCP servers and tool contracts, and direct the developers building against your architecture.

Key technical skills
  • 10+ years in software or systems engineering, with real experience designing production systems end to end
  • Strong dimensional modelling and warehouse design experience, ideally in Redshift
  • A track record of defining data contracts, lineage and quality standards that held up in production
  • Experience designing integration architecture and event or API standards across transactional systems
  • Strong AWS experience and working knowledge of Terraform
  • Hands-on with ETL and data pipelines, PostgreSQL, and at least one production application framework (Ruby on Rails a plus)
  • Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM inside an integrated system estate
  • Working knowledge of how AI agents access data: MCP servers, tool contracts, agent access layers
  • Financial services or another regulated, risk-sensitive background is a bonus, as is DDD and data governance experience
Location and package
Melbourne CBD. Hybrid, Tuesday to Thursday in office, WFH Monday and Friday (3 days in office)
