title: News Desk Producer, CNN
description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN.

To see what it’s like to work at CNN, follow @WBDLife on Instagram and X!

Your New Role...

CNN is seeking a News Desk Producer to work at the nerve center of the Washington newsroom. The ideal candidate is someone who embraces the challenge of multi-tasking in a fast-paced news environment.

You will be responsible for coordinating and managing live signals for DC events and other incoming feeds while providing timely updates to the shows and digital managers and maintaining communications with them.

In your role, you will help coordinate pool coverage of events for the network.

You will work closely with field operations managers to launch crews to cover news stories in the DC area and maintain contact with photojournalists and producers in the field in order to relay editorial information to the newsroom and the network as stories develop. You will be responsible for ensuring that visual elements and related editorial information are quickly shared with the network including fresh video shot in the field by CNN photojournalists and social media video related to developing stories.

You will work with DC reporting teams to cut newsworthy video elements for digital platforms.

Another responsibility of your job will be to help the newsgathering operation by making calls to DC area officials when necessary, including police and fire departments.

This role demands sharp editorial judgment, rapid decision‑making, and the ability to pivot instantly as priorities shift in a high‑pressure, high‑volume environment.

Your Role Accountabilities…

  • Coordinate feeds for DC bureau ensuring all participants are informed about logistics

  • Work with satellites and feeds to ensure elements are routed and recorded

  • Communicate with shows and other desks regarding incoming events and feeds

  • Coordinate pool coverage and dissemination

  • Edit newsworthy video elements for digital platforms

  • Work with field production managers to coordinate on assignments for photojournalists and launch crews on breaking news or developing stories

  • Ensure new video and other visual elements are shared with the network along with related editorial information

  • Assist newsgathering by making calls to DC area officials

  • Monitor other news outlets and flag any important editorial that CNN needs to chase

Qualifications & Experience…

  • 3-5 years of progressively complex related experience.

  • Strong editorial acumen and ability to interpret

  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced news environment 24 hours/ 365 days a year

  • College degree or equivalent industry experience

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, skill set, experience, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of Warner Bros. Discovery’s total compensation package for employees. Pay Range: $51,170.00 - $95,030.00 salary per year. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and sick time and vacation.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer

title: Environmental Test Technician (2nd Shift)
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Enterprise Test Capabilities (ETC) develops, operates, and scales the shared physical test infrastructure, technical expertise, and execution systems required to validate Anduril's products across the company. The team provides specialized testing that is capital-intensive, technically complex, safety-critical, or broadly reusable across multiple programs, spanning environmental testing (thermal, vibration, shock, HALT, TVAC), battery testing (cell/module/pack characterization, abuse testing, BMS validation), propulsion testing (engine test cells, thrust/torque measurement, fuel/feed systems), aerodynamic testing (wind tunnel operations, flow visualization, force/moment measurement), and structural testing. We partner with product test teams from early development through qualification and sustainment to identify technical risk, select appropriate test methods, execute testing safely, and generate trusted engineering evidence. The test operations team within ETC owns the lab facilities, equipment fleet, calibration program, and operational support team that keeps this diverse test enterprise running.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking an Environmental Test Technician to join our rapidly growing environmental test team in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role, you will be responsible for executing a wide variety of climactic and environmental tests on the full spectrum of products developed at Anduril. The ideal candidate brings hands-on test and measurement equipment experience, strong troubleshooting instincts across multiple equipment types, and takes genuine pride in equipment performance and uptime.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Execute a variety of environmental tests including, but not limited to, thermal, dynamic, corrosion, and ingress tests.
  • Program test controllers such as WATLOW F4s, and F4Ts.
  • Execute dynamic tests using electrodynamic shaker table control software.
  • Set up data acquisition systems for environmental tests
  • Maintain lab spaces to a high level of organization and professionalism.
  • Promote lab safety training and processes, fostering an environment and culture to promote safety as the number one priority
  • Promote proper maintenance of capital equipment including environmental chambers, electrodynamic shakers, and data acquisition equipment.
  • Advance environmental testing training materials and keep technical documentation updated.
  • Travel to test sites and remote labs as needed

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of professional experience in a engineering technician capacity or similar
  • Familiarity with Jira or other agile development software
  • Experience with running environmental test equipment
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, demanding, flexible team environment
  • Eligible to obtain / maintain a U.S. Security Clearance
  • Familiarity with environmental test standards (MIL-STD-810, DO-160)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Familiarity with NI Data acquisition system setup and collection, as well as running LabVIEW and Flexlogger software.
  • Familiarity with VR software including VibrationVIEW and ObserVIEW for executing and processing dynamic tests.
  • Demonstrated sense of drive and ability to work in cross-functional teams effectively
US Salary Range
$37—$49 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

title: Facilities Technician
description:
Facilities Technician

Department: Facilities

Location: San Carlos

Shift: Monday–Friday, Day Shift

About 1X

We’re building humanoid robots that work in any space humans exist with the mission to create an abundance of labor. Simple, but it’s not.

To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, software, hardware, manufacturing and operations at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe. If you’re inspired by this, you’ll thrive here. We’ve been at this since 2014 and we’re at the point where the hard problems are behind us and the hard work is in front of us.

NEO is our flagship - a general purpose robot designed to move, learn, and operate in the real world alongside real people. We’re not demoing it, we're shipping it. We’re excited to meet you, if this excites you.

If you’ve spent your career working on problems that matter and want to see them actually reach the world - this is that moment. We’re scaling, we’re hiring with intention, and we need people who want to build something that will genuinely change how humans spend their time safely creating abundance for all.

About the Team

The Facilities team keeps 1X’s San Carlos site running so the people building NEO never have to think twice about their space. From equipment uptime to safety compliance, we’re the quiet infrastructure that lets engineering, manufacturing, and operations move fast without disruption. As we scale and ship, this team makes sure the physical world underneath the mission never becomes the bottleneck.

Your Charter

Own the day to day upkeep, safety and functionality of 1X’s San Carlos facility, including equipment, systems and workspace, so every team building and shipping NEO has a safe, reliable and fully operational environment to work in every day.

Key Outcomes

  • Performing routine repairs and preventive maintenance across plumbing, carpentry and basic electrical, including changing ballasts and light fixtures

  • Completing minor plumbing, carpentry and electrical work such as fixing leaks, patching drywall or repairing fixtures

  • Conducting facility walkthroughs and safety inspections to catch issues before they become bigger problems

  • Logging completed work and tracking parts and supplies used

  • Coordinating with outside vendors or contractors when a repair falls outside scope

  • Keeping the facility clean, organized and running smoothly day to day

Key Competencies

  • Hands on with plumbing, carpentry and basic electrical work, including things like changing ballasts, switches and fixtures

  • Takes ownership of the space and doesn’t wait to be told something needs fixing

  • Stays calm and moves quickly when something breaks and people are counting on a fast fix

  • Knows when to bring in a licensed electrician or specialty contractor rather than going outside their scope

  • Detail oriented with a strong safety mindset

  • Comfortable working independently and juggling multiple open issues at once

Minimum Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in facilities maintenance or a related trade, with hands-on plumbing and carpentry work

  • Comfortable performing basic electrical tasks safely (e.g., replacing ballasts, light fixtures, switches, outlets)

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform physical tasks (climbing ladders, standing/walking for extended periods)

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working in a manufacturing, lab, or industrial environment

  • Forklift or scissor lift certification

  • Experience with a CMMS (computerized maintenance management system) or ticketing tool

  • Broader HVAC or mechanical systems exposure beyond core MEP tasks

What does a successful 1X Team Member look like

Team members at 1X who thrive here are builders. They move fast, own their work completely, and treat time like it’s the one thing you can’t get back - because it is. They say what they mean, finish what they start, and hold themselves to a standard before anyone has to ask. We push each other to be better, and we do it with honesty and respect.

Compensation Range

$35.00/hr - $40.00/hr

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Generous paid time off, company holidays, and parental leave

  • 401(k) plan with company match (100% on the first 3% of contributions, 50% on the next 2%)

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) options

  • Commuter benefits (transit and parking)

  • Short-term and long-term disability, and life insurance

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health, financial, and personal support

  • Onsite snacks and catered lunches

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Funding Specialist Lead - West Region
description:
Statement of the Position:

Coordinates with the Division Funding Director, Funding Manager, Funding Supervisor, Branch Manager, Rehabilitation Technology Supplier (RTS), and other office support personnel to ensure all operational procedures are completed in accordance with company policy and within expected time frames. Responsible for the thorough review of orders to ensure accuracy and providing education to Funding Specialists when errors are identified.

Company Description:

At all levels, working at National Seating & Mobility provides the opportunity to directly impact our client’s lives by giving them self-reliance and independence. Our teams are comprised of passionate individuals, dedicated to providing the best care to each client. We focus on abilities by leveraging technology and creating mobility solutions that are as unique as our client’s needs.

Working at National Seating & Mobility is an opportunity to build a meaningful career, while leaving a lasting impact on the lives of those we serve. Located in more than 40 states, we strive for diversity and offer an array of benefits including 401k, company paid Long Term Disability, and tuition reimbursement.

Duties and Responsibilities / Essential Functions:

1. Develops and maintains working knowledge of current durable medical equipment and policies and procedures held by National Seating & Mobility as well as all applicable insurance guidelines regarding eligibility for coverage and reimbursement.

2. Ensures compliance with National Seating & Mobility policies and procedures.

3. Manages transaction cycle time (TCT) from Coding and Pricing Complete to Documentation Complete, making certain that all necessary steps are taken in the appropriate order ensuring timeliness of process and quality of funding approval.

4. Supports the Funding Specialist position due to PTO, LOA, FMLA, open positions and any other need as identified by the Division Funding Director, Funding Manager or Funding Supervisor.

a. Communicates regularly and professionally with Referral sources, Physicians, Therapists, RTSs, and Clients to secure documentation as required by payer.

b. Meets quality documentation follow-up attempt frequency and quality per policy following the escalation process. When necessary, attempts are to be made more often and as directed by the Funding Manager or Funding Supervisor.

c. Requests, gathers, and reviews documentation for funding package and deferrals, including but not limited to: proper prescriptions, Letters of Medical Necessity (LMN), RTS evaluation information, price lists, forms (AOB, ABN, rent or purchase letter).

d. Thorough review of all documentation received ensuring payer guidelines are met must be completed prior to satisfying the document in the work order. When documentation is not complete or accurate, immediate contact with the Referral source, Physician, Therapist, RTS, and/or Client to discuss and educate is required.

e. Gathers and verifies insurance coverage information and communicates benefits and coverage information to client.

f. Maintains communication with client throughout the process when applicable, including notifying them of and collecting financial responsibility or guiding them through the hardship process, where allowed.

g. Responsible for relationship management and funding related communication with Referral sources, Physicians, Therapists, RTSs, Clients and other internal and external customers.

h. Follows the document collection Escalation Policy and communicates with all necessary parties per the guidelines.

i. Communicates changes and escalations in the process and collects needed information from branch personnel, Referral sources, Physicians, Therapists, RTSs, and Clients.

j. Coordinates with other funding areas and responsible for completing all tasks that need a Funding Action Required. This includes, but is not limited to, all communication with Referral sources, Physicians, Therapists, RTSs, and Clients.

k. Investigates and requests update of payer documentation requirements in the UPD.

l. Ability to investigate issues and solve problems and concerns regarding any aspect of the Funding process.

m. Completes other Funding tasks, as needed, including Coding and Pricing, Submissions, Authorization collection, PPQA and Delivery Verifications

5. Provides direction, instructions, and guidance to staff to achieve goals based on management direction.

6. Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new assignments. Assists in documenting any best practices with clinicians for properly documentation procurement and identifies and coordinates any training opportunities, opportunities for improvements and UPD discrepancies or updates.

7. Facilitates problem solving and collaborations.

8. Motivates and inspires team members.

9. Recognizes and celebrates team and team member accomplishments and exceptional performance.

10. Assists in resolving customer complaints and concerns.

11. Assists in fielding billing and payer concerns and correspondence.

12. Supports the Division Funding Director, Funding Manager or Funding Supervisor in performance monitoring and evaluation process.

13. Communicates team status, task accomplishment and direction to management.

14. Performs routine auditing to assist in identifying coaching opportunities; Ensures the performance of staff is of a high standard.

15. Occasionally may assist with new business acquisitions, branches that have temporary needs for processing.

16. Performs other related duties and special assignments as requested.

Work Environment:

This position primarily operates in a work from home environment. The work from home policy and requirements must be adhered to. Occasionally, this job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is regularly required to sit; use hands repetitively to operate standard office equipment. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms.

Required Education, Experience & Competencies:

• Has minimum of 3 years of experience related to Durable Medical Equipment and/or Complex Rehab Technology required, preferred experience in all aspects of a Funding Specialist’s position including how to process both Repairs and Non-Repairs.

• Has extensive knowledge of the process and insurance guidelines to secure funding for Durable Medical Equipment and/or Complex Rehab Technology including comprehensive knowledge of insurance verification for DME.

• Experience with applications such as Mobility Advisor or data management systems required.

• Proven record of excellent people skills including good communication and inter-personal skills. Strong leadership skills.

• Strong Team Player.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Customer service driven.

• Excellent computer and technology skills including good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, Outlook and Power Point; Experience with Excel to include spreadsheets and formulas and outlook email is required.

• Ability to be a strong role model for high performance and productivity.

• Ability to manage and develop others remotely.

• Ability to read, analyze and interpret general business reports, technical procedures, work instructions, and governmental regulations.

• Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and develop training materials.

• Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from a variety of staff.

• Basic understanding of and willingness to learn and adopt professional and industry standards.

title: Backend Software Engineer
description:

Na anderhalf jaar bouwen aan onze tool in Nederland helpen we inmiddels meer dan 120.000 treinreizigers per maand en verwerken we ruim 700.000 treinritten per maand. Nu is het moment daar om uit te breiden naar Europa. Vooraf zoeken we een Backend Software Engineer die ons helpt dit mogelijk te maken. Waar Nederland één van de meest punctuele spoornetwerken van Europa heeft, liggen in de omliggende landen enorme kansen. Alleen al in Duitsland is de markt voor treinvertragingen ongeveer 50 keer zo groot als in Nederland. Dit is een founding engineering-rol binnen ons kleine team dat werkt aan de Europese uitbreiding. Je werkt direct samen met de oprichters aan het vertalen van lokale spoorrichtlijnen en processen naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen voor reizigers in heel Europa.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Nieuwe markten lanceren: bouw aan kernonderdelen voor nieuwe Europese landen, zoals eligibility checks, claimformulieren, ticket parsing, browserautomatisering, partner-API’s en monitoringssystemen.
  • Van inzicht naar code: doe onderzoek naar land-specifieke regels en processen in het spoorverkeer en vertaal je bevindingen direct naar werkende oplossingen.
  • Eindverantwoordelijk: onderzoek, bouw, deploy en onderhoud backend-features van begin tot eind.
  • Snel en slim werken: werk nauw samen met de Engineering Lead, ship snel, leer en verbeter continu.
  • Vooruit bouwen: jouw technische keuzes vormen de basis voor hoe we in de toekomst door heel Europa kunnen opschalen.

Succes in je eerste 12 maanden

  • Na 3 maanden: lever een eerste MVP op waarmee we automatisch kunnen bepalen of een vertraging recht geeft op compensatie, en help bij het opzetten van de backendbasis voor onze Europese uitbreiding.
  • Na 6 maanden: breid de pipeline uit met automatische claimverwerking, verbeter het importproces van ritgegevens voor partners en verhoog de nauwkeurigheid van de eligibility checker.
  • Na 12 maanden: MVP tot een schaalbaar systeem door externe componenten te vervangen met eigen algoritmes. Gebruik deze basis om de uitrol naar meerdere Europese markten te leiden.

Wie jij bent

  • Backend developer met 2–4+ jaar ervaring, die zich comfortabel voelt om features end-to-end te bouwen.
  • Ervaren met PHP (Laravel), MySQL/PostgreSQL, Redis, RESTful API’s en Node.js (Puppeteer/Playwright). Mocht je een andere stack goed beheersen komen we ook graag met je in gesprek.
  • Handig met databases, API’s, background jobs, automatisering/scraping en B2B-integraties.
  • Startup-mentaliteit: praktisch, zelfstandig en gericht op impact boven perfectie.
  • Nieuwsgierig naar rail- & traveltech en gemotiveerd om complexe, echte processen te automatiseren.
  • Vloeiend in Engels; Duits, Frans of Spaans is een pluspunt.

Waarom bij ons werken

  • Impact vanaf dag één: je speelt een sleutelrol in de bouw van Trein-vertraging.nl’s nieuwe Europese platform.
  • Samenwerken in Amsterdam: hybride werken (4 dagen op kantoor, 1 dag thuis).
  • Groeimogelijkheden: je stapt in aan het begin van onze internationale groei.
  • Kleine, ambitieuze cultuur: directe lijnen, geen bureaucratie, veel leren, veel doen. Flexibele werktijden – je bepaalt zelf je ritme, zolang het past binnen het team.
  • We werken 4 dagen op kantoor, met de mogelijkheid om 1 dag thuis te werken.

We zijn er niet voor iedereen

  • Dit is een rol met impact, waar betrokkenheid telt. Soms zal je even een stap extra zetten – niet omdat het moet, maar omdat je écht geeft om wat je bouwt.
  • Als je het leuk vindt om te werken in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vaststaat, waar je meebepaalt wat we bouwen én hoe – dan ga je je hier thuis voelen.
  • Als je liever wacht op perfecte specificaties of houdt van eindeloze meetings, dan waarschijnlijk niet.

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:

About the role

The Cyber Security Engineer is responsible for implementing, optimising, and monitoring cyber security operations to safeguard NHVR’s IT infrastructure, architecture, and systems.

Working within clearly defined security frameworks and NHVR’s Cyber Security Roadmap, the Cyber Security Engineer applies technical expertise and data-driven processes to identify, mitigate, and monitor risks in a dynamic cyber threat landscape.

Key responsibilities of this role are:

  • Safeguard NHVR’s critical assets, systems, and data from evolving cyber threats by implementing measures outlined in the Cyber Security Roadmap and relevant frameworks.
  • Leverage IT Service Management (ITSM) tools, such as ServiceNow, to document, track, and resolve cyber incidents, adhering to ITIL principles.
  • Perform assessments of systems and processes to identify potential vulnerabilities and recommend corrective actions to reduce risks.
  • Manage technical security controls, including email security gateways, firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems, endpoint protection solutions, and SIEM platforms.
  • Investigate and respond to potential security threats, coordinating with the SOC and relevant teams to mitigate risks to NHVR’s operations.
  • Conduct security reviews of digital initiatives before implementation, ensuring these comply with aligned frameworks (such as Essential Eight, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST).
  • Support and contribute to penetration testing, phishing simulations, and IT security assessments to ensure operational resilience.
  • Maintain and optimise incident response playbooks and ensure processes remain aligned with best practices to enable efficient and consistent responses.

Join our Technology Operations and Cyber Security unit tasked with ensuring the delivery, operation, and security of reliable and scalable digital services across NHVR.

This role may be required to participate in an on-call roster in accordance with the NHVR EA and operational requirements.

To learn more, the position description can be found on the NHVR Careers site - https://careers.nhvr.gov.au/jobs/search


About You

To be successful in this role you will have demonstrated experience in technical cyber security operations, including supporting a Security Operations Centre and managing SIEM tools.

You will be proficient in maintaining ITSM processes (e.g., ServiceNow) and tracking service performance to improve operational outcomes.

You will have:

  • Familiarity with the secure administration of cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure, AWS) and IT infrastructure (e.g., Windows/Linux servers, firewalls, VPNs, and DLP tools).
  • Hands-on experience in implementing security technologies from well-known vendors.
  • Working knowledge of framework alignment principles (e.g., Essential Eight, ISO/IEC 27001, ITIL) to ensure NHVR’s tools and processes adopt globally recognised security standards.
  • Skilled in risk and vulnerability management processes to identify and remediate operational-level risks.


Why join us?

The National Heavy Vehicle Regulator (NHVR) commenced operations in 2013 as the national entity responsible for regulating all vehicles in Australia over 4.5 tonnes gross vehicle mass. The NHVR minimises the compliance burden on the heavy vehicle transport industry, reduces duplication and inconsistences across state and territory borders, and ultimately for the heavy vehicle business with government in Australia.

We are headquartered in Brisbane and employ more than 1000 people across the ACT, New South Wales, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania and Victoria.

title: Substation Foreman
description:
Forbes Bros. Group of Companies delivers transmission, distribution, substation, and related power infrastructure projects across Canada and the United States.

Our work spans field construction, project delivery, operations, and corporate support in an environment where safety, execution, and reliability matter.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Foreman is an entry-level supervisory role responsible for leading small field crews on utility substation construction projects. Typically overseeing 6–10 craft workers, Foremen play a key role in maintaining daily productivity, ensuring safety compliance, and supporting quality execution across substation civil, structural, and electrical installation scopes.

This role is ideal for experienced tradespeople who are transitioning into leadership and are ready to take accountability for day-to-day field performance, crew coordination, and basic site communication with General Foremen or Superintendents.

Work includes substation construction activities such as civil foundations, grounding systems, structural steel installation, conduit systems, and electrical equipment support work.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Daily Crew Leadership & Field Execution

  • Direct the activities of a small crew in accordance with work plans and daily task assignments
  • Ensure job tasks are clearly understood, scheduled, and executed safely and efficiently
  • Coordinate tools, materials, and equipment needed for daily work
  • Respond to field issues and escalate as required to maintain momentum and site alignment

Safety Leadership & Compliance

  • Conduct daily tailboard talks and field-level hazard assessments
  • Ensure all safety protocols are followed, including PPE usage, permitting, and safe work practices
  • Participate in incident reporting, safety observations, and corrective action implementation
  • Lead by example in promoting a positive safety culture within the crew

Quality Assurance & Task Readiness

  • Ensure that work is completed according to specifications, drawings, and client requirements
  • Support installation checklists, material verification, and photo documentation as required
  • Ensure work aligns with substation construction standards, grounding requirements, and equipment installation specifications
  • Identify non-conforming work and communicate issues to supervision for timely resolution
  • Assist in preparing work areas for inspections or client walkdowns

Time, Tools & Productivity Tracking

  • Track crew time and material usage; submit accurate daily reports to General Foreman or Superintendent
  • Monitor task durations and assist with identifying delays or inefficiencies
  • Maintain basic equipment care and ensure materials are stored and used appropriately

Communication, Team Coordination & Leadership

  • Serve as the main point of contact for assigned crew

  • Participate in coordination meetings and deliver instructions clearly to crew members
  • Support new or junior crew members with task understanding and site integration

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience in utility construction or related trade work
  • Proven technical competency in utility construction, preferably with substation construction (civil, structural, or electrical yard installation experience)

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer based in India.

This is a senior QA engineering role focused on building reliable, scalable quality systems for modern AI-powered enterprise platforms.
You will design automated testing strategies across web applications, APIs, microservices, graph databases, and cloud environments.
The role goes beyond traditional testing, requiring thoughtful approaches to probabilistic AI/ML and agentic workflows where quality must be evaluated contextually.
You will help establish automated quality gates, ephemeral test environments, regression frameworks, and measurable test reliability standards.
Working closely with engineering, data science, and platform teams, you will drive quality earlier in the development lifecycle and help identify root causes quickly.
You will also contribute to testing graph analytics, model behavior, data pipelines, and AI-generated outputs with a strong focus on reliability, fairness, and explainability.
This is an opportunity to shape QA practices for sophisticated technologies while having meaningful ownership in a collaborative, remote-friendly engineering environment.

Accountabilities

  • Build and maintain end-to-end, component, API, and contract test suites using modern browser automation frameworks, with parallel execution, trace-based debugging, and reliable automation practices.
  • Establish test coverage according to the test pyramid, prioritizing API and contract testing while using UI automation for critical end-user journeys.
  • Integrate automated quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, including parallelized execution, risk-based test selection, and automated release criteria.
  • Provision ephemeral, containerized test environments using infrastructure-as-code and generate appropriate synthetic or masked test data for automated runs.
  • Monitor test reliability through metrics such as flake rates, runtime, and stability SLAs, while proactively fixing or quarantining unreliable tests.
  • Use AI-assisted testing tools for test generation, coverage analysis, and locator resilience while applying sound engineering judgment to validate their effectiveness.
  • Work alongside developers during feature development to embed testing early and collaborate on issue triage and root-cause analysis.
  • Design automated validation for graph databases, including schema integrity, relationships, query behavior, ingestion, transformation, deduplication, and referential accuracy.
  • Build regression testing for graph analytics such as pathfinding, centrality, community detection, and link analysis.
  • Develop evaluation frameworks for AI/ML models covering accuracy, drift, bias, fairness, explainability, and other requirements relevant to regulated environments.
  • Create automated test suites for agentic workflows, validating tool calls, multi-step orchestration, context management, failure recovery, and guardrail enforcement.
  • Develop assertion strategies for non-deterministic outputs using approaches such as golden datasets, semantic similarity scoring, and LLM-based evaluation.
  • Establish prompt and model regression testing to identify unexpected behavioral changes before production releases.
  • Partner with data science teams to validate feature pipelines and consistency between model training and serving environments.
  • Recommend improvements to development, testing, and deployment processes and support application onboarding into standardized build and release practices.
  • Document, track, communicate, and escalate quality issues while maintaining strong standards for product reliability and release readiness.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.
    • Extensive hands-on experience designing, developing, and executing automated tests for web applications and services using Python and modern browser automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, or equivalent.
    • Strong Python scripting skills and experience building maintainable, scalable test automation architectures using Page Object Model or comparable design patterns.
    • Solid experience testing REST APIs and web services using tools such as Postman, Swagger, or similar technologies.
    • Working knowledge of graph databases such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, JanusGraph, or equivalent, including the ability to write and validate graph queries.
    • Understanding of testing AI/ML-powered functionality and the ability to develop appropriate assertions for probabilistic and non-deterministic systems.
    • Experience with SQL and additional scripting technologies such as Unix shell, Ruby, or similar.
    • Practical experience with continuous integration and pipeline-based delivery using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or comparable tools.
    • Experience identifying opportunities for process improvement and translating them into practical engineering solutions.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a disciplined approach to debugging and root-cause analysis.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, data science, and platform teams.
    • Familiarity with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or comparable orchestration technologies is advantageous.
    • Knowledge of LLM evaluation practices, including golden datasets, rubric-based scoring, hallucination and jailbreak testing, or red-team approaches, is a plus.
    • Experience with graph analytics technologies such as Neo4j GDS, Apache Spark GraphX, or NetworkX is desirable.
    • Familiarity with observability-driven testing, synthetic monitoring, canary analysis, traces, logs, and metrics is beneficial.
    • Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, microservices, cloud deployment, and service orchestration is advantageous.
    • Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP APIs and JIRA for issue tracking is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Comprehensive health and wellness plans.
      • Paid time off and company holidays.
      • Flexible and remote-friendly working opportunities.
      • Maternity and paternity leave.
      • Opportunity to work with advanced AI/ML, graph analytics, and agentic technologies.
      • Meaningful ownership in shaping modern QA and automated testing practices.
      • Collaborative environment with opportunities to work across engineering, data science, and platform teams.
      • Exposure to enterprise-grade cloud, microservices, CI/CD, and infrastructure technologies.
      • Inclusive workplace committed to diversity, equal opportunity, and professional development.

title: Presales & Training Consultant
description:

Reporting to the National Manager Technical Service, this Auckland-based role offers a unique mix of customer engagement, technical consulting and training delivery. You'll support customers and business partners throughout New Zealand, partner with sales and service teams to design solutions, deliver training and help organisations maximise the value of Canon's technology and services.

As this is a national support role, regular travel throughout New Zealand is anticipated along with some opportunities to travel to Australia for product training, updates and events.

Scope of the role includes:

  • Provide pre-sales technical consulting and solution expertise to sales teams and customers
  • Deliver product demonstrations, solution presentations and workflow consulting
  • Design and scope customer solutions, including site assessments and implementation planning
  • Deliver customer, partner and employee training across New Zealand
  • Develop training materials, guides and supporting documentation
  • Support post-sales solution adoption and ongoing customer success
  • Build strong relationships with customers, business partners and internal stakeholders
  • Assist with complex projects, solution delivery and risk management activities
  • Maintain expertise across Canon hardware, software and workflow technologies
  • Identify opportunities to expand customer utilisation of Canon products and services


About you | Mōu

You're someone who enjoys combining technical expertise with customer interaction. You can simplify complex concepts, build credibility with stakeholders and confidently present solutions, whether you're running a product demonstration, delivering training or consulting on a customer's workflow needs. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy partnering with sales teams, customers and technical specialists to achieve the best outcome. Organised, adaptable and proactive, you're comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining a strong focus on customer experience.

Most importantly, you're passionate about technology, continuous learning and helping customers realise value from the solutions they invest in.

Key skills and experience include:

  • Proven experience with print, document management or workflow solutions
  • Strong understanding of colour management, workflow software and print technologies
  • Experience with industry RIP platforms such as Fiery or PRISMA
  • Advanced presentation, facilitation and training delivery skills

At Canon, you'll be joining a business known for its strong customer relationships, innovative technology and collaborative culture. You'll have the opportunity to learn, grow and contribute to meaningful customer outcomes while building your career with a respected global brand.

We believe in the power of an inclusive and diverse workforce. We trust you will bring your authentic self to work and we will focus on making sure that together, we make a strong contribution to the broader community in which we operate. Where possible, flexible working arrangements are the norm, as we know a better work-life balance can improve your motivation, performance, and productivity.

As an equal opportunity employer focused on strengthening our inclusive culture, all applicants will be considered and we welcome applications from people of all ages, cultures including Māori and Pasifika peoples, abilities, religious beliefs, national origin, sexual orientation and gender identities. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Canon Group and the country where you work.

title: Foreclosure Specialist II- First Legal Team
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Foreclosure Specialist II – First Legal Team based in the United States.

This role supports the management and resolution of foreclosure matters across a complex, nationwide mortgage servicing portfolio.
You will work closely with attorneys, governmental agencies, investors, insurers, and internal business teams to keep foreclosure activities accurate, compliant, and on schedule.
The position requires strong knowledge of foreclosure regulations, mortgage documentation, servicing requirements, and judicial and non-judicial processes.
You will play an important role in identifying issues, mitigating risk, and ensuring appropriate actions are taken within established authority.
The environment is fast-paced and highly deadline-driven, requiring sound judgment, organization, and exceptional attention to detail.
You will also provide reporting, coordinate with outside counsel, and help ensure portfolio activity aligns with applicable federal, state, agency, and investor requirements.
This is an opportunity to build deeper expertise in mortgage servicing while contributing to processes that directly support homeowners, clients, and investors.

Accountabilities

  • Work with governmental agencies, special servicing clients, private-label clients, and investors to resolve foreclosure issues, mitigate risk, and minimize potential losses beyond delegated authority.
  • Provide timely status updates and reporting to management while ensuring foreclosure activities comply with applicable agency, investor, and insurer requirements.
  • Support internal business units by responding to questions and providing guidance on foreclosure loans within established authority.
  • Manage communications with foreclosure attorneys through LoanSphere and monitor the activity of multiple outside counsel accounts.
  • Ensure foreclosure portfolios receive prompt and appropriate maintenance, follow-up, and required actions.
  • Monitor attorney firms to ensure required notices and letters are issued in accordance with applicable servicing handbooks.
  • Maintain current knowledge of federal and state regulations, agency requirements, investor and insurer timelines, and documentation standards governing judicial and non-judicial foreclosures.
  • Accurately calculate foreclosure sale bids and provide bidding instructions to attorney firms for nationwide foreclosure sales.
  • Apply established procedures, standards, and techniques while exercising sound judgment and maintaining accuracy in accordance with company and federal compliance requirements.
  • Execute policies and procedures under management direction and recommend improvements or changes when operational needs or regulatory developments warrant them.
  • Review and interpret mortgage and legal documentation, applying relevant terms and conditions to day-to-day foreclosure processes.
  • Represent the organization professionally when participating in legal proceedings or other formal interactions, as required.
  • Perform additional duties and support other foreclosure-related activities as assigned.

    • Requirements

    • High school diploma or equivalent required; some college education or an equivalent combination of relevant experience, knowledge, and skills is preferred.
    • At least 2 years of foreclosure, mortgage default, or closely related mortgage servicing experience, with direct foreclosure experience preferred.
    • Working knowledge of mortgage banking and regulations including RESPA, FDCPA, GLBA, OCC, CFPB, SCRA, and applicable federal and state foreclosure and bankruptcy requirements.
    • Familiarity with mortgage loan documentation, foreclosure processing best practices, default and foreclosure laws, and applicable FNMA, FHLMC, FHA, and VA guidelines.
    • Experience monitoring multiple accounts handled by outside counsel and coordinating attorney activity.
    • Strong ability to understand legal terminology, contractual conditions, and regulatory requirements and translate them into accurate operational actions.
    • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
    • Advanced organizational and multitasking skills, combined with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
    • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while taking direction effectively from senior paralegals, attorneys, and management.
    • Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, particularly when working in high-volume, multifaceted, and time-sensitive environments.
    • Proficiency with personal computers, internet-based research, Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, and Access, as well as MSP and LoanSphere.
    • Ability to prioritize workload and maintain productivity in a fast-paced remote work environment, including occasional early, late, weekend, or overtime hours when business needs require.
    • Previous title work experience is preferred.
    • Trial and deposition training or experience is beneficial.
    • Notary Public commission is beneficial but not required.
    • Must be able to work from a quiet, private home environment with reliable high-speed internet, including minimum network speeds of 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload.

      • Benefits

      • Hourly compensation range of $17.88–$26.73, with actual pay determined by qualifications, skills, experience, and other relevant factors.
      • Optional medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.
      • Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave.

title: Privatrådgivere
description:
Djurslands Bank åbner en ny filial med særligt fokus på Aarhus Ø, målrettet de mange spændende og økonomisk stærke kunder, der bor og bosætter sig her. Vi er i fuld gang med at udvide og skabe de helt rigtige og indbydende rammer på Nørreport i Aarhus i forbindelse med vores nuværende Aarhus filial. Vi har også ansat din leder, som starter hos os til juli, og som er klar til at byde dig velkommen på holdet.

**
Vil du være med til at starte vores nye filial?

Kunderådgiver for en spændende kundegruppe**
I jobbet som kunderådgiver i Djurslands Banks nye filial, får du mulighed for at opbygge en kundeportefølje fra bunden bestående af en yderst spændende kundegruppe.

Dine kommende kunder befinder sig typisk i en livsfase, hvor børnene er flyttet hjemmefra - eller snart flytter hjemmefra - og de har solgt eller har planer om at sælge huset. Nu ønsker de et mere fleksibelt og bynært liv i en lejlighed med alle Aarhus’ kulturelle og gastronomiske tilbud udenfor døren. De har måske allerede bosat sig på Aarhus Ø eller er på vej til at gøre det.

Vi forventer, at det er kunder med en solid økonomi, stærke forventninger til personlig rådgivning – og et stort fokus på boligfinansiering, investering og fremtidssikring.

Medarbejder i en stærk lokalbank med vækstambitioner
Du tilbydes en stilling, hvor du kan tage selvstændige beslutninger, og hvor du får rig mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og personligt. Ligesom du får stor indflydelse på både opbygning og sammensætning af din kundeportefølje, så den passer til netop dig. Endelig er det en unik mulighed for at være med til at skabe noget nyt og påvirke de aktiviteter og samarbejder, vi igangsætter i opstartsfasen.

I banken lægger vi vægt på ordentlighed, menneskelige værdier, trivsel og arbejdsglæde. Vi er et bundsolidt pengeinstitut med gode nøgletal, en høj kundetilfredshed, en god indtjening og vækst af nye kunder.

Her er frie rammer og korte beslutningsveje, og som lokalbank i Østjylland er alle kolleger og interne ”livliner” funderet i det østjyske – tæt på dig og dine kunder.

Vi har stor erfaring i etablering af nye filialer. Så du kan forvente, at der er styr på hele praktikken omkring opstarten – herunder at vi har et marketing-team i særklasse, som støtter op med aktiviteter, der giver gode kundeemner at arbejde med.

Du kommer også til at få et tæt kollegialt fællesskab med alle de dygtige kolleger, som arbejder i huset i forvejen i vores eksisterende Aarhus filial. De vil også hjælpe dig og teamet i gang med de nye systemer og processer.

Hvem er du?
Vi forventer, at du er fagligt velfunderet som privatrådgiver, og måske du allerede har erfaring med rådgivning af formuende kunder, hvor du sætter en høj standard for dine møder.

Hvis du herudover kan nikke ja til følgende, er det måske dig, vi søger:

  • Du motiveres af arbejdet med at tiltrække nye kunder
  • Du matcher de modne kunder
  • Du har en særlig interesse for finansiering af lejligheder
  • Du synes, det er sjovt at komme ud i nærmiljøet og møde kunderne på en anderledes måde
  • Du kan bedst lide at opnå gode resultater sammen med dit team

Vi ved, at ingen matcher alt – hvis du kan se dig selv som en relationsskabende rådgiver for netop denne målgruppe af privatkunder, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Interesseret?
Så skynd dig at sende et motiveret CV snarest muligt – vi behandler det naturligvis i fortrolighed.

Du er også velkommen til at kontakte områdedirektør Peter Bredal på mobil 2916 3117, hvis du er nysgerrig på at høre mere, før du søger.

Vi inviterer til samtaler løbende og besætter stillingerne i takt med, at vi finder de rette kandidater.

title: Head of Hardware (Robotics)
description:
Mission

TAR’s mission is to power intelligence for the world. We are building the world’s first off-grid power plant for data centers powered by renewable technologies.

We firmly believe AI should be built in the US for the benefit of all people. For that, power must be fast, clean and scalable. We are singularly focused on delivering GW-scale power faster than anyone has ever done, by rethinking every layer of the stack.

We vertically integrate to solve every bottleneck, from racking systems to power electronics to dispatch algorithms to on-site construction.

Leave your mark on the future of civilization-scale energy infrastructure.

Company

TAR is both a hardware and software company, we are building out massive, critical, physical infrastructure. TAR is working directly with one of the largest compute providers to scale and deploy 5GWs by 2028.

We operate on…

  • High ownership. High Agency. Own project end-to-end. Great people don’t need to be managed.

  • Speed. We achieve great things on incredible timelines. We push ourselves to go faster.

  • First principles. No ego. No hierarchy. Challenge every assumption.

  • Passion. Solving the energy problem is one of the largest challenges that faces the world now and in the future.

About the role

TAR builds fully islanded solar and storage campuses that deliver clean, firm power directly to AI data centers, with no grid connection and no gas. At GW scale the binding constraint is no longer equipment, it is how fast a crew can put steel in the ground, so TAR builds its own racking system and the robots that install it, and each campus gets faster and cheaper to build than the last. As Head of Hardware, you own the robotics hardware organization: the mechanical, electrical, and systems engineering behind machines that drive piles, set racking, and move earth across the West Texas desert. You take these robots from low-volume prototype builds to reliable, higher-volume production, and you hire and lead the team that designs, builds, and field-hardens them. This is a senior role with a seat on the leadership team, based at our San Francisco robotics facility, with regular field time at our West Texas site.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the hardware strategy and technical roadmap for TAR's construction robots, aligning engineering priorities with the campaign to build GW-scale power campuses on a hard schedule.

  • Build and lead the hardware engineering organization across mechanical, electrical, and systems, hiring, structuring, and mentoring the team as the robot fleet and its scope grow.

  • Drive hardware from low-volume prototype builds to reliable, higher-volume production, partnering with manufacturing and supply chain to hit cost and quality targets without giving up field reliability.

  • Own system architecture decisions across mechanical, electrical, controls, and sensor integration, making design choices that hold up under dust, heat, and vibration in the field.

  • Manage BOM complexity and supplier relationships, driving real cost reduction while protecting the performance and durability the mission requires.

  • Serve as the senior hardware voice on the leadership team, shaping investment decisions, roadmap trade-offs, and deployment timing alongside engineering, product, and executive leadership.

  • Represent hardware externally with customers, partners, and investors when technical credibility is what earns trust.

  • Establish field-feedback and continuous-improvement loops so lessons from deployed robots feed directly back into design.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of hardware engineering experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role (Director, Head of, or VP level) at a robotics or complex electromechanical systems company.

  • Demonstrated success taking a hardware product from low-volume prototype to higher-volume production, including work with contract manufacturers or Tier-1 suppliers.

  • Deep expertise across mechatronics, mechanical engineering, motion control, and ruggedized system design for field or industrial environments.

  • Experience managing complex BOMs and driving cost down without giving up reliability.

  • Track record building and leading multidisciplinary hardware teams across mechanical, electrical, and controls disciplines.

  • Strong communicator, comfortable representing hardware decisions to executive leadership, customers, and investors.

Nice to have

  • Experience in energy, industrial automation, or field robotics rather than consumer robotics, at companies such as Anduril, Built Robotics, or Tesla.

  • Familiarity with regulatory or certification requirements relevant to industrial or field hardware.

  • Background at a high-growth, venture-backed hardware startup.

title: Scientist, RD&Q Raw Materials
description:
Job Description:

Scientist, RD&Q Raw Materials

The Scientist, RD&Q Raw Materials creates and maintains raw material specifications and its business process to support global gum, mint and fruity confections products.

The role safeguards the ongoing integrity of raw material specifications as key foundations for product creation and traceability, while supporting associated systems, data and process improvements.

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor's degree in food science, Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry or a related scientific discipline.

  • Minimum of 6 years' experience creating, reviewing or maintaining raw material, ingredient, product or quality specifications in a food, consumer goods or similarly regulated environment. Experience in gum, mint and fruity confections preferred.

  • Knowledge of SAP data management and experience working with specification, product lifecycle or related information systems.

  • Experience supporting system testing, implementation, data conversion or ERP transformation is preferred.

  • Strong understanding of raw material risk assessment, specification change control, product traceability and data integrity principles.

  • Meticulous attention to detail, with the ability to manage detailed technical information accurately and consistently.

  • Proven success learning quickly new information systems and the technical language and terminology used in R&D and Supply.

  • Strong written communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to provide timely, accurate and succinct updates.

Raw material specification creation and maintenance

​

Systems and process support

  • Support testing and implementation of raw material and recipe-related system enhancements, including assistance with conversion between ERP systems.

  • Follow standard processes consistently and recommend improvements where opportunities are identified.

  • Owns the global raw material specifications business process

title: Clinical Trial Coordinator
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a growing medical device company developing innovative technology to transform the treatment of mitral valve disease. Our team is advancing a transcatheter mitral valve replacement through pivotal clinical development, with a shared commitment to bringing safe, effective, and innovative technology to patients.


THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a Clinical Coordinator to provide critical coordination and operational support across our Clinical Operations team. This is a highly collaborative role that touches many aspects of clinical trial execution—from site documentation and clinical data to payments, device logistics, meetings, and training.

The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities while ensuring clinical trial activities remain accurate, timely, and audit-ready.

  • Provide cross-functional support and coverage across the Clinical Operations team as priorities and workloads shift.

title: Senior DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer

Join a global Infrastructure Engineering team responsible for the cloud foundation and developer platform powering a rapidly growing AI-focused business.
You’ll take hands-on ownership of production infrastructure across GCP, AWS, and Azure, with a strong emphasis on reliability, security, and scalability.
The role combines cloud operations, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, CI/CD, developer tooling, networking, and automation.
You’ll turn complex operational challenges and manual processes into resilient, repeatable, and automated solutions.
Working closely with application and security teams, you’ll help engineers ship faster while maintaining high standards for operational excellence.
You’ll also contribute to incident response, root-cause remediation, cloud optimization, and initiatives that improve developer productivity.
This is a remote role in Brazil, with working hours generally overlapping with U.S. Pacific Time and participation in a shared global on-call rotation.

Accountabilities

  • Own and continuously improve production cloud infrastructure across GCP, AWS, and Azure, focusing on reliability, scalability, performance, capacity, observability, and cost efficiency.

You will lead vulnerability management from discovery and prioritization through remediation, reporting, and continuous improvement.
The role combines hands-on security engineering with strategic influence across software development and infrastructure teams.
You will strengthen operating system images, open-source dependencies, and the broader software supply chain against emerging threats.
You will also embed security validation directly into CI/CD workflows through automation, testing, and modern security tooling.

  • Secure the software supply chain: Harden base operating system images and strengthen the security of open-source software, dependencies, package managers, and other components of the software supply chain.
  • Embed security into development: Integrate SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, automated validation, and other security controls into CI/CD pipelines to identify and address vulnerabilities earlier in the development lifecycle.
  • Evaluate security technologies: Research, assess, adopt, and develop security tools and approaches, including solutions such as Google Assured OSS and comparable technologies.
  • Establish secure-development practices: Define practical secure-coding standards and provide engineering teams with guidance, training, mentorship, and resources to improve security adoption.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst based in Canada.

This role sits within a high-impact analytics function responsible for ensuring financial accuracy across complex payment and money-movement operations. You will independently own reconciliation and reporting workstreams spanning card networks, banks, processors, and internal transaction and ledger data. The position combines advanced SQL, financial analysis, automation, and stakeholder management to turn complex datasets into reliable business intelligence. You will investigate discrepancies, strengthen controls, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce financial risk. Working closely with Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Data teams, you will influence priorities and technical roadmaps. The environment is fast-paced, highly analytical, and focused on accuracy, accountability, and measurable impact.

Accountabilities

  • Independently design, develop, deploy, and maintain end-to-end reconciliation and reporting solutions, including matching logic, exception queues, break dashboards, settlement summaries, and standardized accounting outputs.
  • Own daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliation activities across card networks, banking partners, processors, and internal transaction and ledger systems, taking discrepancies from detection through root-cause analysis, resolution, and control enhancement.
  • Define and implement meaningful domain metrics such as match rates, break aging, resolution times, funding compliance, and reporting SLAs, ensuring stakeholders understand and use them effectively.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on settlement, funding, transaction lifecycles, money movement, data models, and reconciliation technologies.
  • Develop and document automated SQL-based reporting, navigating unfamiliar datasets independently to answer complex questions about financial flows.
  • Partner with Data Engineering or work independently to design, build, validate, troubleshoot, and maintain datasets and pipelines supporting reconciliation and reporting.
  • Identify control weaknesses, revenue leakage, manual processes, and upstream data-quality issues, then drive automation and process improvements to address them.

title: Product Owner
description:
Imagine a future where you enable analytics and portfolio models to become a key competitive advantage in energy trading.

Why join?

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Join us in this role where you’ll be Product Owner for the Analytics & Portfolio Models team in Digital Technology, where you'll own and shape a growing product area enabling quantitative models, analytics capabilities, and development platforms for traders, analysts, and quants across Ørsted's trading organisation. Working at the intersection of trading, analytics, and technology, you'll help turn analytical and portfolio models into products and capabilities that support decision-making, optimise trading performance, and enable the next generation of analytics and quantitative tools.

Welcome to Analytics & Portfolio Models You’ll be part of Analytics & Portfolio Models team where you, together with your colleagues, will build the development platform that helps traders, analysts, and quants make better decisions, create business value, and increase transparency in model outcomes. The area combines commercial understanding, modern technology, and DevOps capabilities for commodity trading.

We are newly established team and expected to grow as part of an ambitious strategy to strengthen analytics and quantitative capabilities across Ørsted's trading organisation. In this role, you'll work closely with stakeholders across Trading, Analytics, Portfolio Models, and Digital Technology while collaborating with software product teams in Denmark, Poland, and Malaysia.

You’ll play an important role in:

  • driving the evolution of analytics and modelling platforms and infrastructure that accelerate analytics, AI adoption, portfolio optimisation, and decision-making across Ørsted's trading business
  • driving the products for fast and frictionless analytics, model development, and experimentation through self-service capabilities, development environments, automated onboarding, and modern engineering tool
  • shaping the product roadmap by balancing innovation and speed with cybersecurity, governance, and operational resilience
  • ensuring seamless access to data and digital capabilities through close collaboration with the Trading Data Products organisation, architects, and development teams across Commercial Digital Technology
  • driving product scalability and adoption by continuously improving user experience, performance, reliability, and transparency across analytics and portfolio modelling ecosystems
  • enabling the next generation of AI-powered ways of working by providing foundations for experimentation, model development, agentic software engineering, and responsible adoption of AI technologies.

To succeed in the role, you:

  • are an experienced Product Owner or similar product leader with a track record of defining product vision, prioritising roadmaps, and driving adoption of digital products
  • have experience in or a strong interest in energy trading, commodity trading, banking, or financial markets
  • have experience working with analytics capabilities, quantitative models, analytics platforms, or similar business-critical solutions
  • are great at adapting to different stakeholder groups in trading and IT
  • have sufficient technical understanding to engage with engineers, architects, and data specialists
  • understand the importance of governance and cybersecurity while recognising the need for speed and flexibility in a trading environment
  • have experience with shaping product strategy and turning opportunities into tangible business outcomes.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us
Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

Imagine a future with Ørsted

Join a global leader in renewable energy

Ørsted is a global leader in offshore wind and is one of the largest renewable energy companies in the world. With us, you’ll play your part in creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. As a leading green energy company, we leverage the curiosity and passion of our people to innovate and develop new technologies or bring existing technologies to scale, collaborating with governments, suppliers, and our industry partners to make renewable energy solutions a reality. At Ørsted, we work together with openness and respect and seek fresh perspectives to solve any task at hand: big or small.

About Ørsted

  • We provide countries, companies, and communities with sustainable, reliable, and cost-competitive energy solutions, including offshore and onshore wind, solar PV, and energy storage.

Our cross-functional teams span design, research, development, production, marketing, sales, and operations across Austin, Hsinchu, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Singapore. We move fast, tackle hard problems, and create space for people to grow through complex, meaningful work that shapes the future of technology.

We're looking for self-motivated, creative problem-solvers who are eager to push technological limits and make a real impact in energy efficiency.

At Ambiq, we live by five values: Innovate. Collaborate. Focus. Learn. Achieve.

If that's you, join us — the intelligence everywhere revolution starts here.

Scope

As the Staff Applications Software Engineer at Ambiq, you will be responsible for supporting Ambiq’s Apollo and Atomiq families of SoCs.

This role will work with our hardware and software development teams, field engineering team, and customers to develop software, including example applications for Ambiq and customer evaluation hardware, device drivers, HAL updates, and Zephyr enablement. In addition, the Software Engineer will debug device level software issues, support field engineering with customer issues, and help create customer-facing documentation such as application notes and software design guidelines.

The successful candidate should have a strong understanding of embedded development on Cortex-M MCUs, bare-metal and real-time operating systems, and be familiar with debugging the same. They must possess strong written and oral communication skills.

The person in this role will be responsible for supporting Ambiq’s field engineering team and customers, coordinating with the global team to make improvements and fix customer issues, and extending Ambiq's offerings with new software examples, application notes, and software design guidelines.

Responsibilities

  • Design, debug, porting, and analysis of embedded microcontroller software drivers, algorithms, application code, board support packages, automated scripts, and design test cases to provide the required functionality to end customers.
  • Collaborate with internal development teams to analyze and debug complex system level issues and develop software solutions.
  • Create application notes, knowledgebase articles, and software design guidelines.
  • Assist customers with the use of the Ambiq SDKs and hardware platforms.
  • Collaborate with hardware engineering in the architecture and design of hardware evaluation platforms, provide software for test and debug of hardware evaluation platforms.
  • Develop custom software functions and applications to facilitate microcontroller performance analysis and silicon issue debug.
  • Bridge the communication between field and engineering teams for field issues and manage issue status tracking.

Qualifications

  • MS in ECE or Computer Science and 6+ years of experience or BS in ECE/CS with 8+ years of experience.
  • Experience developing embedded MCU code in C required.
  • Experience with embedded systems in real-time environments.
  • Experience with Zephyr is a plus.
  • Experience with at least one MCU IDE from ARM, Keil, IAR, SEGGER, or other.
  • Familiarity with MCU peripherals including SPI, I2C, UART, ADC, USB, I2S and PDM. MIPI and USB are a plus.
  • Experience with Bluetooth and Bluetooth Low Energy.
  • Experience with short-range technologies including Zigbee and Thread are a plus.
  • Experience working hands-on in the lab.
  • Familiarity with source code control systems (git) required.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills dealing with complex system level issues related to HW/SW debug.
  • Experience in embedded security and cryptographic algorithms is a plus.
  • Experience with embedded graphics and display technologies is a plus.
  • Experience with scripting languages required, and python experience is specifically desirable.
  • Experience leveraging modern AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., Cursor, Codex, or similar) is desirable.
