title: Site Reliability Engineer, Vehicle Software
description:
About us

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

Site Reliability Engineer - Vehicle Software

The role

As a Site Reliability Engineer at Wayve, you will work across the full reliability stack for our vehicle software: observability, incident management, operator tooling, and the automation that lets engineering and operations teams detect, triage, and resolve issues faster. You will work closely with software engineers, field engineers, and operations, debugging real systems, improving real processes, and having direct impact on how our vehicles perform in production.

Wayve is scaling its autonomous vehicle programs with partners, and you will help shape the SRE approach for vehicle-centric systems as that happens. This is not a role where reliability sits on top of the real work, it is central to it.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and improve tooling, automation, observability, and incident-management processes for vehicle software reliability.
  • Work closely with field engineers, software teams, and operations to diagnose reliability issues and improve system performance.
  • Own hands-on debugging across Linux, low-level systems, logs, metrics, traces, and vehicle and production data.
  • Develop reliability improvements that reduce manual intervention and make issue detection, triage, and recovery faster.
  • Support vehicle-centric operations, including safety-operator tools and the reliability needs of our customer and partner programs.

About you

Essential skills

  • You will write production-quality code every day in Python, C++, or Rust. This is a software engineering role as much as a reliability role, and coding is central to the work.
  • Comfortable debugging at the Linux and systems level, reading logs, tracing failures, and finding root cause in complex environments.
  • Experience with CI/CD, containerization, networking, distributed systems, databases, and observability and incident-management tooling, including DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Splunk, or Humio.
  • Experience diagnosing complex production or operational systems, not just escalating, but seeing problems through to resolution.
  • The communication skills to work effectively across engineering, operations, and field teams, and the judgment to know when to bring others in.
  • Based in Sunnyvale and able to be onsite at least three days a week to work alongside the field teams you will support.

Desirable skills

  • Experience with autonomous vehicles, robotics, embedded systems, or safety-critical environments. We know this is rare, and it is not a barrier to applying.
  • Experience with large-scale telemetry or high-volume data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with vehicle-centric or on-device software systems.

This is a full-time role based in our office in Sunnyvale. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home. The reasonably estimated salary for this role ranges from $209,700 to $266,800, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

Wayve is committed to creating an inclusive interview experience. If you require any accommodations or adjustments to participate fully in our interview process, please let us know.

We understand that everyone has a unique set of skills and experiences and that not everyone will meet all of the requirements listed above. If you’re passionate about self-driving cars and think you have what it takes to make a positive impact on the world, we encourage you to apply.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For US candidates only, please visit E-Verify Notice and Participation and Right to Work

However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: 2nd Shift Feed Mixer
description:
Job Title: Feed Mixer

Hours/Week: 40 hours per week with more hours required as needed

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Job Objective

The Feed Mixer Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining equipment to mix and prepare feed and related products for livestock, ensuring proper ingredient blending, monitoring machinery, and adhering to safety and quality standards. This position will perform tasks related to feed production including quality control, ingredient and feed processing, manufacturing and load out, ingredient receiving and storage, equipment maintenance, and general housekeeping.


The incumbent will be expected to assist other locations and departments as assigned by management. Will communicate availability regularly and assist with projects as needed.


Incumbent maintains efficiency in a manner that will optimize the cooperative’s market share and savings, improve the cooperative’s efficiency, help achieve the cooperative’s mission and goals, and result in outstanding customer service.


This position will maintain a positive attitude that promotes teamwork within the location, as well as within the cooperative and upholds a favorable image of Five Star Cooperative at all times.


Job Summary and Primary Duties

  • Organizes daily schedule of required local mix to expedite custom mixing and grinding
  • Operates machinery used in the feed mixing and production process
  • Dumps bags or presses buttons on control panel to transfer individual ingredients from separate bins to batch scale hopper until specified weight of each ingredient is obtained. Weighs additives like minerals and vitamins and dumps them into the hopper. Starts machine to mix ingredients, and starts elevator conveyors to transfer feed to storage tank
  • Maintains quality of mixes above standards set by Five Star and the local mixing program
  • Accounts for each mix or other service provided by writing job, sales, or transfer tickets to ensure accurate inventory control
  • Reports inventory items which should be placed on order
  • Prepare and file department records as needed
  • Cleans and lubricates equipment, maintains equipment on a regular schedule to avoid breakdowns and anticipates and plans for major overhauls requiring shutdowns
  • Observes equipment operations for malfunctions
  • Collects samples of ingredients and/or finished product for laboratory testing
  • Understands and ensures compliance with all transportation, environmental, and feed production regulations and policies
  • Adhere to all laws and company policies associated with safety, health and environmental practices. Take immediate and appropriate actions to remedy hazards as they are identified. Help provide solutions to safety, health and environmental challenges.
  • Works directly with customers, developing excellent customer relations
  • Enforce and abide by all cooperative policies
  • Enforce and uphold the cooperative’s credit policy
  • Good communication with all employees and customers
  • Other duties as assigned

Company overview

Accordion is a global financial consulting and technology firm helping CFOs and their teams drive value creation. Rooted in private equity rigor and powered by data, analytics, and AI, we partner with companies across industries to turn insight into impact.

Working at Accordion in India means joining 800+ analytics, data science, finance, and technology experts in a high-growth, agile, and entrepreneurial environment to transform how portfolio companies drive value. It also means making your mark on Accordion’s future—by embracing a culture rooted in collaboration and a firm-wide commitment to building something great, together.


Join us and experience a better way to work!


Location: Hyderabad, Telangana


Role Overview:

The Senior Data Engineer at Accordion is responsible for designing and developing robust, scalable

data platforms that power analytics and AI-driven decision-making across client organizations. This

role requires hands-on expertise in cloud-native data architecture, modern warehousing, and pipeline development, with the ability to independently lead workstreams and mentor junior engineers.


The Senior Data Engineer will take an AI-first approach to every engagement — leveraging AI

development tools to accelerate delivery, building data infrastructure that is AI-ready by design, and contributing to MCP (Model Context Protocol) server builds that expose data capabilities to AI agents and LLM-powered workflows.



What You will do:

  • Partner with client stakeholders to understand business requirements and contribute to designing cloud-native data platform architectures that meet current and future needs.
  • Implement modern data integration patterns: ELT/ETL orchestration, streaming pipelines, and real-time data processing.
  • Implement data solutions on technology-agnostic, cloud modern data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, and Redshift.
  • Build data infrastructure that is AI-ready by design – ensuring proper governance, lineage, and accessibility patterns that enable downstream AI and analytics consumption.
  • Contribute to the build and deployment of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to expose data platform capabilities as tools consumable by AI agents and LLM-powered workflows, where applicable.
  • Integrate/leverage AI tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) responsibly to accelerate pipeline development, code reviews, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with multiple stakeholders to define KPIs, data models, and metrics frameworks aligned with client goals.
  • Partner with Project Managers to develop and execute project plans within agreed schedules and timelines.
  • Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and mentor junior engineers.
  • Stay current on emerging cloud platforms, data tools, and AI ecosystem developments.


Ideally, you have:

  • An undergraduate degree (B.E/B.Tech.) from a tier-1 or tier-2 institution.
  • 3–6 years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or cloud data platform development.
  • Strong SQL proficiency — query optimization, complex transformations, and data modeling across relational and columnar databases.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, or AWS Redshift.
  • Experience with cloud-native orchestration tools: Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, dbt, or Apache Airflow.
  • Familiarity with data lake and lakehouse architecture using open table formats (Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg) on cloud storage (ADLS, S3, GCS).
  • Experience with streaming platforms (Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, AWS Kinesis) is a strong plus.
  • Hands-on experience owning end-to-end DevOps practices, including designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines, to ensure robust, scalable, and repeatable deployment of data solutions across environments.
  • Working knowledge of BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) is a strong plus.
  • Awareness of AI-ready data design principles – governance, and accessibility for AI consumption.
  • A strong habit of responsibly using AI tools to improve delivery speed and code quality.
  • Proven ability to take initiative, drive innovation, and communicate effectively with stakeholders.

Our Commitment to Your Well-being

title: Senior Forretningsudvikler til boligfinansiering og realkredit
description:
Motiveres du af at forstå komplekse sammenhænge og omsætte forretningsbehov til gennemarbejdede løsninger i tæt samarbejde med udviklere, arkitekter og specialister?

Så er du måske vores nye Senior Forretningsudvikler.

Du bliver en del af et specialiseret udviklingsteam, som udvikler og vedligeholder de regler, beregninger og API'er, der udgør fundamentet for bankens boligfinansierings- og realkreditløsninger. Teamets løsninger anvendes på tværs af banken og er afgørende for, at både kunder og rådgivere møder korrekte, effektive og sammenhængende finansieringsløsninger.

Om rollen

Du får en central rolle i udviklingen af bankens finansieringsplatforme. Du arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem finansielle produkter, forretningsregler, data og teknologi, hvor din opgave er at analysere, kvalificere og udfordre krav samt bidrage til løsninger, der skaber værdi på tværs af finansieringsområdet.

Stillingen adskiller sig fra mange klassiske forretningsudviklerroller. Du kommer ikke til at bruge størstedelen af din tid på brugerinterviews, workshops eller bred behovsafdækning. Til gengæld bliver du en vigtig faglig sparringspartner i udviklingen af de centrale komponenter, som de kunde- og rådgivervendte løsninger bygger på.

Du bliver en del af et mindre team med korte beslutningsveje, hvor du får stor indflydelse på både analyser, løsninger og prioriteringer.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

  • Analysere komplekse boligfinansierings- og realkreditprodukter samt de regler, beregninger og data, der understøtter dem.
  • Omsætte forretningsbehov til konkrete krav, løsningsbeskrivelser og dokumentation i tæt samarbejde med udviklere, arkitekter og andre specialister.
  • Udfordre krav og løsningsforslag gennem faglige analyser, så løsningerne er gennemarbejdede og skaber reel værdi.
  • Drive afklaringer på tværs af teams og sikre sammenhæng mellem systemer, data, processer og integrationer.
  • Bidrage til udvikling og vedligeholdelse af API'er, beregninger, forretningsregler og de centrale komponenter i finansieringsplatformen.
  • Planlægge, gennemføre og validere test, analysere fejl og bidrage til løbende forbedringer og modernisering af bankens finansieringsløsninger.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med forretningsudvikling, analyse eller specialistarbejde i et komplekst forretnings- eller IT-miljø.

Vi ser helst, at du har branchekendskab og erfaring med realkredit og boligfinansiering, da forståelsen for området er med til at gøre, at du kan skabe gode resultater i rollen. Din tekniske og økonomiske forståelse kan også hjælpe med at sikre gode resultater i jobbet.

Du arbejder analytisk og detaljeorienteret, samtidig med at du bevarer overblikket.

Du trives i et samarbejdsorienteret miljø, hvor du bidrager engageret med din faglige indsigt. Du finder gerne løsninger sammen med mennesker med forskellige fagligheder, er åben for andres perspektiver og udfordrer eksisterende løsninger. Samtidig arbejder du selvstændigt, tager ansvar for at føre dine og teamets opgaver og afklaringer fremad og har lyst til at opbygge en dyb forståelse for boligfinansiering, realkredit og de forretningsregler, der understøtter området.

Vi forventer, at du har en videregående uddannelse på kandidatniveau inden for forretningsudvikling, IT, økonomi, finansiering eller et beslægtet område, alternativt har du opnået tilsvarende akademiske færdigheder gennem erfaring.

Du har en solid forståelse for de nyeste teknologiske trends og værktøjer inden for IT-udvikling og formår at omsætte denne viden til forretningsmæssig værdi.

Du har erfaring med at bruge AI-værktøjer som fx Copilot eller lignende i dit arbejde eller studie. Du er tryg ved at bruge AI til at løse opgaver, f.eks. til at strukturere, skrive eller analysere og kan forholde dig kritisk til outputtet.

Du er nysgerrig på at udvikle dine kompetencer yderligere og har lyst til at arbejde mere systematisk med AI i din hverdag.

Dit nye team

Du bliver en del af et specialiseret udviklingsteam bestående af to forretningsudviklere og fire IT-udviklere, som arbejder tæt sammen om at udvikle og vedligeholde centrale løsninger inden for boligfinansiering.

Hverdagen er præget af godt humør, samarbejde og et fælles mål om at skabe et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi trives og skaber resultater sammen. Vi hjælper hinanden, deler viden på tværs og har plads til både faglig sparring og en uformel tone i hverdagen.

Stillingen er placeret i Glaskuben på Kalvebod Brygge i København, hvor du får din daglige gang blandt næsten 1000 kolleger.

Rekrutteringsproces og næste skridt

Send din motiverede ansøgning senest den 11. september 2026. Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende og kan lukke opslaget før fristens udløb, så søg gerne hurtigst muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Anja Orth tlf. 29861929, Leder i Ejendomsdata- og finansiering.

Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge. Hos os er der plads til forskellige perspektiver og personligheder, og vi tror på, at forskellighed bidrager til både samarbejdet og løsningerne.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Healthcare Data Scientist (Medicare/Medicaid) based in Australia.

This role offers the opportunity to apply advanced data science and AI to some of the most complex challenges in healthcare program integrity.
You will analyze large-scale Medicare and Medicaid claims data to uncover patterns associated with fraud, waste, and abuse.
The position combines statistical modeling, machine learning, generative AI, and agent-based technologies to create innovative analytical solutions.
You will work with modern tools including LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented pipelines.
Your insights will support better decision-making, operational efficiency, and stronger outcomes across healthcare programs.
The environment is collaborative and mission-driven, with opportunities to translate sophisticated technical work into clear recommendations for diverse audiences.
This is an ideal opportunity for a curious, hands-on data scientist who wants to make meaningful impact through healthcare analytics and emerging AI technologies.

Accountabilities

  • Analyze Medicare and Medicaid claims data using statistical methods, machine learning, and advanced analytical techniques to identify trends, anomalies, and potential fraud, waste, and abuse.
  • Develop generative AI-powered solutions and agent-based systems to strengthen fraud detection, investigate complex patterns, and improve business processes.
  • Build predictive, anomaly detection, and other analytical models that improve program integrity, operational efficiency, and actionable insights.
  • Identify opportunities to apply large-scale CMS data with modern AI and machine learning approaches, including LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation pipelines.
  • Apply sound data science practices including feature engineering, attribute selection, threshold setting, model validation, and train/test methodologies.

Je komt terecht bij een data-gedreven zorgtech scale-up uit Utrecht die de zorg structureel slimmer maakt door het fundament opnieuw te ontwerpen: grote delen van zorgprocessen digitaal, veilig en schaalbaar organiseren. Daardoor hebben zorgprofessionals minder werkdruk, is er meer grip op zorgprocessen en worden patiënten beter ondersteund. Jouw werk is tastbaar en maatschappelijk relevant, en dat geeft voldoening.

Het product is live en telt al 10.000 gebruikers, dus je krijgt directe feedback en ziet je impact meteen. Je stapt in terwijl het platform klaargemaakt wordt voor forse groei, dus je maakt de belangrijke keuzes mee en leert in korte tijd enorm veel. Daar zit ook de echte uitdaging: hoe houd je zorgdata veilig en correct terwijl je van tienduizenden naar honderdduizenden gebruikers schaalt? Dat los je op vanuit sterke computer science-fundamenten!

Cultureel is dit een plek voor engineers. Techniek is hier de core business, en er is veel ruimte voor ownership, voor experimenteren met nieuwe tech en voor het inbrengen van ideeën: bijvoorbeeld het veilig en succesvol implementeren van GenAI in een gereguleerde omgeving.

Het team is serieus en sterk, en zoekt er iemand bij met energie en een ondernemende scale-up-instelling: laten we dit samen gewoon fixen. Technisch management luistert, beslissingen worden inhoudelijk genomen en kwaliteit staat voorop. Je werkt met de stabiliteit en funding van een volwassen organisatie en de snelheid en autonomie van een scale-up, dus je hebt de rust om het goed te doen en de ruimte om snel te bewegen.

Jouw rol: Senior Backend Engineer Utrecht

Als Senior Backend Engineer Utrecht bouw je aan het hart van een cloud-native platform waar grote hoeveelheden real-time data doorheen stromen. Je ontwerpt en ontwikkelt schaalbare services en API's, werkt met event-driven architectuur en neemt ownership over performance, betrouwbaarheid en security. In deze you build it, you run it-omgeving draag je end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid voor software die continu beschikbaar moet zijn, van architectuur en implementatie tot CI/CD, infrastructuur, monitoring en livegang.

De huidige stack draait op C#, .NET en Azure, maar men ziet dit als een tool en niet als een doel. Daarom staan ze absoluut open voor solide software engineers met een achtergrond in bijvoorbeeld Java, Kotlin of Typescript en die openstaan om zich deze stack eigen te maken (en in de wereld van AI, gaat dit natuurlijk nog sneller!). Het gaat hier namelijk om dat je vanuit de fundamenten redeneert en ownership pakt over het platform als geheel.

Groeimogelijkheden

Je groeit hier op twee assen tegelijk. Technisch verdiep je je in schaalbaarheid, betrouwbaarheid en security, en je helpt het platform volwassen worden richting fors meer gebruikers. Tegelijk groei je als engineer: je zet standaarden neer, deelt kennis en tilt het niveau om je heen omhoog. Omdat je vroeg instapt terwijl het platform opschaalt, werk je met een schone basis en blijf je jarenlang uitgedaagd naarmate het platform groeit.

Wat wordt er gevraagd?

  • 6+ jaar ervaring als Backend Engineer
  • Sterke basis in C# .NET, Java, Kotlin, Typescript en bereid om met C# te werken
  • Ervaring met Cloud, Event-Driven- en schaalbare systemen zijn grote pre’s
  • Oprechte interesse in AI en idealiter al ermee aan het experimenteren
  • Een ondernemende, energieke scale-up-instelling en oprechte betrokkenheid bij de maatschappelijke impact van het product
  • Een BSc or MSc in Computer Science of vergelijkbaar
  • Nederlandssprekend (belangrijk vanwege de zorgcontext en stakeholders)

Wat wordt er geboden?

  • Hybride werken: 1 tot 2 kantoordagen per week in Utrecht
  • Elke 6 maanden een inflatiecorrectie
  • Pensioenregeling, 50% betaald door de werkgever
  • 25 vakantiedagen op basis van 36 uur
  • Reiskosten- en thuiswerkvergoeding
  • Laptop naar keuze (MacBook mogelijk)
  • Eerst een jaarcontract, daarna een vast contract

Wil jij een live zorgplatform mee opschalen naar honderdduizenden gebruikers, en daarin snel groeien als engineer?

title: Clinical Supervisor - Children's Advantage
description:
SUMMARY: The Clinical Supervisor provides clinical, administrative, and programmatic oversight for all children's behavioral health services delivered by the agency. This position is responsible for the full scope of the children's office: direct supervision of clinical staff, program quality and fidelity, compliance with multiple county board contracts and funder requirements, and coordination of the agency's school-based, court-involved, and detention/jail assessment services.


A defining responsibility of this position is building clinical capacity in areas where children's behavioral health staff are commonly underprepared: recognizing, diagnosing, and treating co-occurring mental health and substance use disorders (dual diagnosis) in youth, and identifying and addressing family-level needs, including parental and household substance use. The Clinical Supervisor is expected to function as the in-house expert in these areas — reviewing staff assessments for missed or misattributed substance use presentations, coaching clinicians who have little or no alcohol and drug training, and ensuring that treatment plans reflect an integrated, family-inclusive approach rather than mental health treatment alone.

The position carries a limited direct service caseload and functions as the senior clinical authority for the children's program.


SUPERVISOR: Director of Behavioral Health or Designee


SUPERVISES: Therapists, case managers, QMHS/CPST staff, school-based clinicians, interns and licensure candidates


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Clinical Supervision and Staff Development

  • Provide individual and group clinical supervision to therapists, case managers, and paraprofessional staff in accordance with state licensure board rules and agency policy.
  • Provide board-approved supervision toward independent licensure for licensure candidates (e.g., LSW, LPC) and document supervision hours per licensing board requirements.
  • Review and approve diagnostic assessments, treatment plans, discharge summaries, and level-of-care determinations.
  • Conduct chart reviews and case consultation to assess clinical quality and model fidelity.
  • Assess staff competency, identify training gaps, and deliver or arrange ongoing clinical training, with particular attention to staff who lack alcohol and drug assessment and treatment skills.
  • Complete performance evaluations, coach staff on performance concerns, and participate in hiring, onboarding, corrective action, and separation decisions.
  • Maintain a supervision schedule that meets contractual, licensure, and accreditation minimums, with documentation available for audit.

Dual Diagnosis: Co-Occurring Mental Health and Substance Use Disorders

  • Serve as the agency's primary clinical resource on adolescent substance use, recognizing that most children's behavioral health staff have limited training in diagnosing and treating these conditions.
  • Build and sustain staff competency through structured training, case consultation, shadowing, and skills coaching in substance use screening, assessment, diagnosis, and treatment.
  • Ensure universal substance use screening is completed and correctly interpreted, using validated adolescent tools (e.g., CRAFFT, GAIN-SS, S2BI) rather than informal or self-report-only inquiry.
  • Review diagnostic assessments for missed, minimized, or misattributed substance use, including symptoms mistakenly attributed solely to mood, anxiety, trauma, or behavioral disorders.
  • Apply and teach ASAM criteria for adolescents; oversee level-of-care determinations and referrals to withdrawal management, IOP, residential, or recovery support services.
  • Ensure treatment planning addresses mental health and substance use concurrently and in an integrated manner, rather than sequentially or in isolation.
  • Oversee use of evidence-based co-occurring interventions (e.g., Motivational Interviewing, A-CRA, Seeking Safety, adolescent CBT for substance use) and monitor fidelity.
  • Ensure staff understand and apply 42 CFR Part 2 requirements, adolescent consent rules for substance use treatment, and the confidentiality distinctions between mental health and substance use records.

Family Assessment and Family Needs Identification

  • Ensure clinical staff assess the family system, not only the identified child, including parental/caregiver substance use, parental mental health, domestic violence, housing instability, food insecurity, and caregiver capacity.
  • Train and coach staff to recognize and appropriately respond to caregiver substance use, including referral, safety planning, and mandated reporting obligations where child safety is implicated.
  • Ensure family needs identified during assessment translate into concrete treatment plan objectives, referrals, and coordination , not narrative observations without follow-through.
  • Oversee family engagement strategies and monitor family participation rates in treatment.
  • Coordinate with children services, kinship caregivers, and adult treatment providers when the treatment needs of a caregiver directly affect the youth's clinical course.

Program Oversight — Children's Office

  • Oversee all aspects of daily operations of the children's behavioral health office, including scheduling, caseload assignment, access and intake flow, productivity, and service capacity.
  • Monitor referral response times, wait lists, no-show/engagement rates, and length of stay; implement corrective strategies where targets are not met.
  • Ensure services are delivered across the continuum, including diagnostic assessment, individual/family/group therapy, CPST/case management, crisis intervention, and psychiatric coordination.
  • Coordinate with psychiatry/prescriber staff on medication management, high-risk cases, and complex care planning.

Contract, Board, and Funder Compliance

  • Serve as clinical point of contact for multiple county board contracts (e.g., Portage County Mental Health and Recovery Board), ensuring services delivered match the scope, population, deliverables, and outcome expectations of each contract.
  • Track and report contract-specific utilization, outcomes, and deliverables; prepare data and narrative for board reports, contract renewals, and funder site visits.
  • Maintain working knowledge of the differing requirements across contracting boards and ensure staff apply the correct requirements to the correct funding stream.
  • Support grant and levy-funded program implementation, reporting, and renewal processes.
  • Coordinate with billing/revenue cycle staff to ensure documentation supports Medicaid, managed care, and board-funded claims; address denials and audit findings related to clinical documentation.
  • Participate in state certification, accreditation (e.g., COA, HRSA, Ohiomas), and payer audits, including preparation, on-site response, and plan-of-correction implementation.

School-Based and Community Treatment Services

  • Oversee school-based behavioral health programming, including staff placement, service delivery models, and school-year/summer coverage planning.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with district administrators, principals, school counselors, and special education staff; participate in MOU development and renewal.
  • Ensure clinical practice in schools complies with FERPA, HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, IDEA, and consent/release requirements, and that information sharing is properly authorized.
  • Support staff participation in IEP, 504, MTSS/PBIS, and school-based team meetings as clinically indicated.
  • Ensure school-based staff are equipped to identify and respond to student substance use rather than routing all concerns to discipline.
  • Monitor school-based service data for contract and grant reporting.

Court, Juvenile Justice, and Detention/Jail Assessments

  • Oversee the agency's assessment services for youth involved with juvenile court, probation, detention, and, where applicable, young adults in county jail settings.
  • Ensure timely completion of court-ordered assessments, substance use assessments, and disposition-related clinical recommendations.
  • Review assessment reports for clinical soundness, defensibility, and compliance with court timelines and formatting requirements, with particular scrutiny of co-occurring findings and level-of-care recommendations.
  • Maintain working relationships with juvenile court judges, magistrates, probation officers, detention staff, prosecutors, defense counsel, guardians ad litem, and children services caseworkers.
  • Provide or coordinate expert clinical testimony as needed.
  • Ensure staff conducting facility-based assessments are trained in facility security protocols, safety procedures, and the confidentiality limits specific to court-ordered evaluations.
  • Coordinate reentry and step-down planning for youth transitioning from detention or residential placement into community services, including linkage to substance use treatment and recovery supports.

Quality Assurance, Risk, and Compliance

  • Lead clinical quality improvement activities, including outcome measurement, fidelity monitoring, and performance improvement projects.
  • Oversee incident reporting, critical incident review, and follow-up for the children's program, including suspected abuse/neglect reporting obligations.
  • Oversee risk assessment protocols for suicidality, self-harm, aggression, overdose risk, and safety planning; ensure staff competency in risk assessment and documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, mandated reporting laws, client rights, and agency policy.
  • Maintain and update clinical policies, procedures, forms, and workflows for the children's office.
  • Ensure timely, accurate documentation in the electronic health record by all supervised staff.

Direct Service

  • Carry a reduced direct service caseload as assigned, which may include complex, high-acuity, or co-occurring cases requiring senior-level clinical skill.
  • Provide crisis response and clinical coverage during staff absences or surge demand.

Collaboration and Community Representation

  • Represent the agency at county board meetings, family and children first councils, juvenile justice work groups, school partnership meetings, and community coalitions.
  • Collaborate with children services agencies, adult substance use treatment providers, primary care, residential providers, and other community partners on shared cases and system-level initiatives.
  • Participate in agency leadership meetings and contribute to strategic planning, program development, and budget input for the children's office.
  • Other duties as assigned.

The Duties and Responsibilities above represent the most significant duties of this position, but do not exclude other assignments that would be within the qualification and responsibility levels of this position.

title: Senior Communication Systems Engineer
description:

At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. In this position, you will help develop space architecture concepts, sub-system design, payload design, requirements development, analysis and decomposition, high-level software and hardware system architecture design, concept of operations (CONOPS) development, and risk assessment. You will coordinate activities across multidiscipline engineering teams, raise issues at the program level, and help drive complex programs to success.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Excellent written and verbal technical communication skills.

    open-ended projects

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Sr. Data Engineer

Exp: 6-10 Years

Location: Chennai


Position Overview:


The Senior Data Engineer is responsible for delivering scalable data pipelines, ETL processes, data warehouse solutions, and BI reporting tools across Azure and AWS cloud platforms. This role serves as a key technical contributor, ensuring seamless data integration, high data quality, and secure access while collaborating with stakeholders to translate business needs into efficient, cloud-optimized data solutions.


Key Responsibilities:


  1. Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes including database scripts, stored procedures, triggers, functions, Azure Data Factory pipelines, AWS Glue jobs, and other back-end processes to ensure efficient data extraction, transformation, loading, and seamless system integration across Azure and AWS cloud environments.
  2. Own the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise BI and reporting solutions including metrics, reports, analyses, and dashboards using tools like Amazon QuickSight and Microsoft Azure BI solutions to drive key business decisions; implement robust user access controls and data security measures across cloud environments.
  3. Assist with tabular and multi-dimensional modelling in addition to the development and maintenance of the Enterprise Data Warehouse leveraging both AWS and Azure cloud data warehouse solutions.
  4. Coordinate with management and end-users to evaluate business needs, anticipate opportunities for improvement in cross-cloud analytics solutions, identify alternate approaches that leverage the strengths and cost-optimization benefits of both AWS and Azure platforms, and present recommendations for approval and implementation.
  5. Develop and execute comprehensive system and unit testing across Azure and AWS environments, identify and fix defects, and validate results to ensure quality and compatibility between cloud platforms.


Skills & Qualifications


Must-Have:


  • 6 -10 years of experience in data engineering and reporting required.
  • A bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is required, with a focus in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline.
  • Strong proven track record of developing and testing database scripts, stored procedures, triggers, functions, SSIS Packages, AWS, Azure cloud services and other back-end processes to support system integration.
  • Experience using BI/Analytics/Statistical tools like Power BI, Tableau, SSRS, SSAS, and Excel.
  • Strong SQL skills, business intelligence tool expertise, AWS Cloud services, and report development skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services including Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Dataflow, Logic Apps, Azure Synapse Analytics, Function Apps, and Key Vaults for building and orchestrating data pipelines, serverless integrations, and secure secrets management.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services including S3, Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, Redshift, Athena, SNS, SQS, EventBridge, Event Bus, SageMaker, IAM, Secrets Manager, Bedrock, CloudWatch, and Lake Formation for building scalable data engineering solutions, event-driven architectures, ML workflows, and governance of data lakes.
  • Understanding of configuration, deployment, and database servers.
  • Strong writing and verbal communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a functional team environment.


Preferred:

  • Domain expertise in Automotive industry.
  • Certification in AWS or Azure services.

title: Motion Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Motion Designer based in Brazil.

As a Motion Designer, you will turn complex agricultural technology concepts into engaging, easy-to-follow video experiences.
You will create tutorials, reels, social content, and educational materials that help users adopt digital tools with confidence.
Your work will transform field-tested training content and long-form recordings into scalable video formats.
You’ll combine editing, motion graphics, dynamic captions, transitions, and strong visual storytelling to keep content clear and engaging.
The role offers the opportunity to work closely with product and field adoption teams in a fast-moving AgTech environment.
You’ll have significant autonomy to execute creative briefs while maintaining consistency across the visual identity and messaging.
This is a fully remote opportunity with room to grow alongside an innovative and expanding technology-driven business.

Accountabilities

  • Edit tutorials, reels, short clips, and educational content based on established scripts and creative briefs, incorporating motion graphics, dynamic captions, transitions, and appropriate pacing.
  • Transform webinars, training sessions, onboarding recordings, and other long-form materials into full-length videos, highlights, and short-form content.
  • Edit footage captured in agricultural fields, events, and industry conferences, delivering polished content within short turnaround times.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to maintain consistency in visual identity, tone, messaging, and production quality across different video formats.
  • Organize and maintain project files, media assets, templates, and reusable production resources to improve efficiency and support recurring content creation.
  • Monitor existing video materials as the digital platform evolves, identifying outdated tutorials and proactively recommending updates.
  • Partner with field adoption teams to identify recurring user questions and topics that could be addressed through explainer and educational videos.
  • Contribute creative and production insights that improve the effectiveness, scalability, and accessibility of video-based learning content.

    • Requirements

    • Demonstrable professional experience in motion design and video editing, particularly for social media, educational, tutorial, or onboarding content, with a portfolio or showreel required.
    • Strong command of CapCut and proficiency with at least one professional editing tool, such as Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects.
    • Strong understanding of pacing, composition, transitions, motion graphics, and visual storytelling for short-form formats such as Reels and TikTok-style videos.
    • Experience working with gimbal-recorded footage and field recordings; familiarity with Insta360 or similar equipment is a plus.
    • Ability to work independently from established scripts and briefs, exercising creative judgment without requiring constant supervision.
    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines within a high-volume monthly editorial calendar.
    • Advanced English proficiency is required for effective collaboration and content production.
    • Advanced Spanish proficiency is considered a plus.
    • Basic graphic design knowledge using tools such as Figma, Canva, or similar platforms is desirable.
    • General knowledge of agriculture or a strong interest in AgTech, as well as experience producing tutorial or onboarding videos, will be considered an advantage.

      • Fully remote work from Brazil.
      • Opportunity to work in a fast-growing AgTech environment focused on digital innovation.
      • Collaborative and supportive team culture.
      • Opportunities for professional development, learning, and career growth.
      • Opportunity to create content with direct impact on user education, onboarding, and technology adoption.

title: Project Coordinator, Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO)
company: The Royal Australasian College of Surgeons
description:
About the role
In this role, you will support the delivery of projects and program initiatives across the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) portfolio. You will help coordinate activities, track milestones and dependencies, maintain project documentation and prepare reporting and governance materials. You will also work with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, helping to coordinate meetings, workshops and consultations and ensuring actions, decisions and follow-up activities are clearly captured and progressed.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Coordinate day-to-day project activities, including actions, milestones, deliverables, risks and dependencies.
  • Maintain project plans, schedules, risk and issue logs, status reports and other project documentation.
  • Prepare clear and accurate project reporting, dashboards and governance papers.
  • Coordinate inputs to governance meetings and track actions and decisions through to completion.
  • Support stakeholder meetings, workshops and consultations, including preparing presentations, briefings and summaries.
  • Support project and program reporting, including tracking progress and identifying issues or gaps that need attention.
  • Take responsibility for specific work packages or areas of project delivery as required.
  • Contribute to improving project coordination practices, tools and ways of working.

This is a great opportunity to join an EPMO at an early stage and gain broad experience across project delivery, governance and stakeholder engagement while supporting strategic programs that are shaping the future of RACS.

This position is Full Time, 12-month maximum term parental leave replacement from October 2026 to October 2027. Location is flexible; however, Melbourne is preferred.

About the team
The EPMO is responsible for overseeing and supporting RACS's portfolio of projects and strategic initiatives. The team works with project managers, project leads, portfolio and functional teams, managers and staff across RACS, as well as committees, working groups, external consultants, delivery partners, Society Partners and health jurisdictions. The EPMO provides a consistent approach to project governance, reporting and delivery. The team helps projects stay aligned with organisational priorities, provides visibility of progress and risks, and supports teams to work through delivery challenges. As the EPMO is newly established, this role will have the opportunity to contribute to how the team works and how project coordination practices develop over time.

About you
You will be organised, reliable and comfortable working across several projects and priorities at once. You will take pride in producing accurate work and keeping information clear and up to date.

You will bring:

  • Experience in a project coordination or project support role, ideally in a complex or regulated environment.
  • A sound understanding of project management approaches such as PRINCE2, PMBOK or Agile.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • High attention to detail, with the ability to maintain clear and structured project documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear and concise reports, presentations and other materials.
  • You will also be proactive and willing to take responsibility for getting things done.
  • You will be able to work independently while staying closely connected with project leads and the broader EPMO team, and you will be comfortable building effective working relationships with people across different areas of the organisation.

Experience supporting large-scale transformation or strategy implementation programs, or exposure to governance forums and committee environments, would be advantageous.

If you are looking for a role where you can contribute to important projects, work with a broad range of stakeholders and develop your project delivery skills, we would like to hear from you.

For a copy of the full position description, please contact careers@surgeons.org.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Crimson Global Academy (CGA) is a world-class online school delivering live, real-time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures.

The Role

Our engineering team builds the systems that make a global virtual school actually work: the student and parent app and backend (CGA Home), internal sales and marketing tools, school operations infrastructure, and the public website.

Our engineers sit close to the product, close to the people using it, and close to the impact. We're looking for a senior engineer who's genuinely excited by the difference good software makes to a child's education, and who's ready to help us raise the bar on what we ship and how we ship it.

You'll work at a senior level across our backend and infrastructure, contribute to architectural decisions, and help shape the technical direction and engineering culture of the team.

What you'll do

  • Design and build CGA's products in the cloud, backend, infrastructure, and frontend where needed

  • Take ownership of hard technical problems end to end, from framing through to shipping, monitoring, and iterating

  • Test-drive your development so that once your work is done, it doesn't go backwards

  • Contribute to architectural decisions and help shape CGA's technical direction

  • Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders: give honest estimates, communicate clearly, and ship when you said you would

  • Follow and improve our CI/CD, testing, and deployment practice so the team ships faster and more safely

  • Monitor product health and respond when something needs attention

  • Mentor your colleagues, lift quality across the team, and model the standards we hold each other to

What we're looking for

Essential

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Strong full-stack instincts with deep backend and infrastructure experience at a senior level

  • Fluency (or close to it) in our stack: HTML5/CSS, React, TypeScript, Node, Postgres, Docker, AWS, Terraform

  • A track record of shipping software you and your team are proud of in a strong CI/CD environment

  • Clear, honest communication and a team-first instinct, you back your teammates and deliver what you've committed to

  • Genuine interest in growing into technical leadership over time

  • Personal commitment to CGA's standards: unlocking potential together, rethinking and rebuilding, and raising the bar to compound impact

Highly regarded

  • Experience building education or other consumer-facing products with a global user base

  • Experience mentoring or guiding more junior engineers

  • Comfort running production systems across multiple regions and time zones

Why CGA

Every family that chooses CGA is trusting us with something irreplaceable. Engineering owns the platforms that make CGA possible: the code you ship reaches students and families around the world, every day. If you want senior-level work with real impact, on a team that holds itself to a high bar, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Product Manager, Agent Development - Financial Services
description:
About us

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such as SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

About the Financial Services team

  • Our financial services customers span systemically important banks, neobanks committed to building more delightful banking software (1 in 3 of the world's leading banks use Sierra!), insurers that provide protection for life’s most challenging moments, vertically integrated ecosystems like Rocket Companies, and more. The decisions we make impact millions of end customers and billions of dollars in economic activity.

  • Our financial services team partners closely with these organizations to set their AI strategies and build modern tools that carefully handle moments when a person’s private anxiety meets an institution’s procedural muscle - the instant before a family learns whether they are pre-approved for a mortgage; the claustrophobic half hour after someone notices a fraudulent charge; the frustrating experience of losing a card and needing to order a new one.

  • Sierra’s Financial Services team is transforming the customer experience and building technology that makes the industry more accessible, human, and affordable for everyone.

What you'll do

  • Build enterprise-grade AI agents: As an Agent PM at Sierra, you will be responsible for partnering directly with our engineers and customers to build and ship AI agents that handle thousands of customer conversations a day.

  • Engage with customers: In the role, you will engage with all levels of our customers’ businesses:

    • Discover and assess their requirements.

    • Prepare and present demonstrations of Sierra’s agent.

    • Address and overcome technical challenges in the business process by working with technical counterparts.

    • Develop and improve Sierra virtual agents to fit and anticipate our customers’ needs and business processes.

    • Become trusted advisors and drive strategic technical strategies for our customers.

  • Shape the product roadmap: Work with Sierra’s engineering and product development teams to scope and implement new features essential to the success of your customers.

What you'll bring

  • 5-10+ years experience in product development of highly technical products.

  • Past experience in Product Management or other similar product development roles at or above the level of Senior Product Manager.

  • Experience in financial services, such as banking, fintech, lending, payments, insurance, mortgages, or wealth management.

  • A track record of taking products from ambiguous customer problems through launch and meaningful scale.

  • Strong technical fluency and the ability to reason about APIs, data flows, system architecture, AI systems, integrations, and failure modes.

  • Exceptional product judgment, including the ability to balance customer needs, speed, reliability, risk, and long-term platform leverage.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers and communicating effectively with both executives and deeply technical teams.

  • A builder mindset: you prototype, investigate, and work hands-on rather than relying solely on process.

  • Clear, structured communication, with the ability to explain complex technical and AI concepts to diverse audiences and create alignment in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

  • Degree in a technical or related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Even better...

  • AI-related experience (experience with product development for AI agents a plus).

  • Some coding experience with React, Typescript, and Go.

  • MBA or equivalent professional experience (while this is a product management role, you will have the opportunity to lean into broader business roles).

  • Past roles that interface with end customers to influence software development.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

title: Senior Manager, Data Platform Engineering

What you’ll need:

  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional engineering initiatives from planning through production, with strong delivery discipline, dependency management, risk mitigation, accountability, and a demonstrated track record of improving predictability.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience working with healthcare data, including claims, eligibility, clinical, provider, or other healthcare datasets.

Pay & Perks:

🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, and Employee Assistance Program

📈 401K retirement plan with company match; flexible spending and health savings account

🏝️ Flexible Time Off + Company Holidays

👶 Up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

🐶 Pet insurance

The salary range for this position is $175,000 to $195,000 annually; as part of a total benefits package which includes health insurance, 401k and bonus. In accordance with state applicable laws, Cohere is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including but not limited to qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and internal alignment.

Interview Process*:

  2. Meet your Hiring Manager!

  4. Behavioral Interview(s)

*Subject to change

About Cohere Health:

Cohere Health is a fast-growing clinical intelligence company that’s improving lives at scale by promoting the best patient-specific care options, using cutting-edge AI combined with deep clinical expertise. title: Offer Trader - Served Sports
description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations to marketing to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Trader to join our growing Sports Trading team at Superbet. Within Served Sports, our team covers Tennis, Table Tennis, Water Polo, Handball, and Badminton, and this role is geared primarily towards Tennis, so a strong interest in the ATP, WTA, ITF, and Grand Slam circuits is a big plus. You will play an integral role in enhancing our betting product by analyzing served sports events, setting up offers, monitoring market trends, and managing risk.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has a strong passion for Tennis specifically, along with a good general understanding of served sports such as table tennis, water polo, handball, and Badminton
  • Is familiar with the ATP, WTA, ITF and Grand Slam calendars, rankings and scoring formats
  • Has previous experience in a Trading role - considered a bonus
  • Has excellent communication skills at an Advanced English level
  • Is flexible and easy to adapt
  • Proves an eye for detail
  • Has strong prioritisation skills with the ability to manage a high volume of tasks
  • Has a passion for sports/sports betting
  • Is willing to work shifts and weekends

What you’ll be doing:

  • Follow local and international Tennis tournaments and events, along with Table Tennis, Water Polo, Handball and Badminton competitions
  • Analyze and provide insights on players, teams and tournaments, with particular depth on Tennis
  • Monitor the risk of the served sports offer
  • Contribute to the development of the company’s overall sports product
  • Add events in the back office using both manual and automated betting tools and set up betting offers
  • Observe market movements and provide recommendations
  • Control prices using a full trading system
  • Monitor customers and bet limits
  • Monitor and report customer activity
  • Communicate performance with managers, providing strategic direction where applicable
  • Follow international and local Tennis, Table Tennis, Water Polo, Handball and Badminton events and competitions
  • Perform odds adding for special bets
  • Follow all data changes in rules and competitions worldwide
  • Follow players’ rankings and transfers, updating the internal databases
  • Check and assign templates for competitions and events
  • Check and assign feeds on competitions and events
  • Monitor the betting ticker for any ticket delays and promptly report any potential issues to the product support team
  • Resolve odds issues either independently or in consultation with senior/offer team members
  • Report wrong odds imported from providers
  • Evaluate the impact of wrong odds on internal offers and communicate with relevant teams to provide the best user experience
  • Prepare and submit incident reports to relevant teams in the event of potential complaints to regulatory bodies generated by wrong odds
  • Provide feedback and request improvements from the provider’s services

About Super

With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

title: Risikoanalytiker til Markedsrisiko
description:
Er du interesseret i risiko, finansielle instrumenter og markeder, og kan du gøre det komplekse forståeligt? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Vi søger en økonom med højt engagement, som kan bygge bro mellem finansielle risici og den forretningsmæssige virkelighed. Du skal have lyst til at opbygge relationer, skabe dialog og sætte risiko tydeligt på landkortet på tværs af koncernen. Sammen med dine kolleger bliver du en central rolle, der formidler bankens syn på risiko til vores interessenter. Du kan omsætte komplekse krav til konkrete løsninger og fungere som bindeled mellem IT og forretning. Du er vant til at arbejde med data, og det er en naturlig del af din opgaveløsning.

Om jobbet

I stillingen som risikoanalytiker til Markedsrisiko vil du være med til at løfte afdelingens ansvar i forhold til udvikling og vedligeholdelse af risikoopgørelser, regulatoriske kapitalopgørelser samt rapportering.

Gennem dit arbejde får du en bred indsigt i bankens finansielle produkter og opgørelsesmetoder. Den viden bringer du i spil i tværgående projekter og opgaver, hvor du får mulighed for at bidrage til fremtidens risikoopgørelser – særligt inden for kapitalområdet, hvor vi står over for væsentlige ændringer.

Du får en central rolle, og vi forventer, at du deler din faglige viden og tager initiativ til at føre opgaver videre. Samtidig bidrager du til, at risiko får endnu større synlighed og betydning i koncernen.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger og samarbejdspartnere på tværs af banken, hvor du er med til at udbrede kendskabet til risikoarbejdet og sikre, at bankens risikostyring er stærk og lever op til gældende lovgivning. Din rolle indebærer både faste og udviklingsorienterede opgaver, hvor du får mulighed for at bringe din viden i spil i dialogen med ledelse, forretningsområder og projekter.

Dit primære fokus vil være inden for fagområdet modpartsrisiko. Samtidig arbejder vi på tværs af afdelingen, så du får mulighed for også at arbejde med markeds- og likviditetsrisiko.

Afdelingen

Du bliver en del af afdelingen Markedsrisiko, som har base i Silkeborg og et team på Kalvebod Brygge i København. Afdelingen består af 20 dygtige og engagerede kolleger med høj faglighed og ansvar for konceptuelle opgørelsesprincipper og regulatoriske krav inden for kapitalmarkedsområdet – herunder markeds-, modparts- og likviditetsrisiko. Vi arbejder tværfagligt og bredt med risikostyring, og du får rig mulighed for at udvikle dig og bidrage på tværs af vores tre hovedområder. Kulturen er præget af humor, tillid og hjælpsomhed – og vi tror på, at faglige udfordringer trives bedst i et uformelt og godt fællesskab.

Din profil

  • Du har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for økonomi, finans, matematik eller lignende (fx cand.merc. eller cand.oecon.).
  • Du har interesse for finansielle markeder og produkter
  • Du kan arbejde i spændingsfeltet mellem IT og forretning
  • Du er en dygtig formidler – både skriftligt og mundtligt
  • Du arbejder struktureret og trives med at have flere bolde i luften
  • Du er åben, nysgerrig, initiativrig og samarbejdsorienteret
  • Du bidrager til det gode arbejdsmiljø

Vi lægger vægt på at finde den helt rigtige kandidat og er derfor fleksible med, om dit primære arbejdssted hedder Silkeborg eller København.

Ansøgning

Vi oplever mangfoldighed som en fordel i vores opgaveløsning og i vores fællesskab. Derfor opfordrer vi alle til at søge.

Lead HR Business Partner Karin Elmedal Hansen vil tage sig af din ansøgning.

Stillingen er tidsbegrænset til 2 år, men med forventet mulighed for fastansættelse.

Ansøgningsfristen er 15. september 2026, og vi indkalder til samtaler løbende.

Hør mere om jobbet

Hvis du er interesseret i jobbet, eller har spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os.
