description:
Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

In this position, you will be responsible for low-level and high-level software in CesiumAstro’s products through all phases of the development process. Key projects will include satellite flight software as well as mission data and operations systems for space missions. CesiumAstro’s goal is to create an out-of-the-box hardware and software experience which enhances our customers’ ability to rapidly integrate our products into their systems.
As a CesiumAstro software team member, you will be responsible for software designs from concept through production, including product roadmaps, block diagrams, detailed design and coding, analysis, test, qualification, and in-orbit support. The ideal candidate will have development experience at nearly every level of the software stack, including microcontrollers, low-level drivers, board support packages (BSP), and user interfaces with an emphasis on applications and data management. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience in software testing and high-reliability qualification, as well as software engineering and software project management practices.
The successful candidate will present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • As a technical leader, design and implement software to build and integrate mission systems including satellites, ground stations, and mission operations centers.
  • Architect, design, develop, code, test, debug, and document space system software.
  • Act as a subject matter expert, providing expertise on space software systems throughout CesiumAstro.
  • Review code and system designs.
  • Analyze code for efficiency, stability, and scalability.
  • Integrate and validate new product designs.
  • Provide expert guidance to direct product design.
  • Support software quality assurance and optimize I/O performance.
  • Provide post-production/in-orbit customer support.
  • Interface with hardware design and development engineers.
  • Mentor junior team members.
  • Assess third-party and open-source software.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
  • Minimum of 8 years of industry experience in software development with a Bachelor’s degree, or a minimum of 7 years with a Masters.
  • Experience in developing multiple flight software systems
  • Experience in hands-on development and troubleshooting of software systems and hardware (such as motors, power distribution units, etc.).
  • Programming experience in C or C++.
  • Experience in interfacing a variety of open-source software to create an integrated system.
  • Familiarity with software configuration management tools, defect tracking tools, and peer review.
  • Excellent understanding of multi-threaded applications and resource management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with products for aerospace applications.
  • Experience with satellite operations or mission data systems, including COSMOS.
  • Experience with NASA's cFS flight software framework.
  • Adequate knowledge of reading electronics schematics and component data sheets.
  • Experience with ARM processors and fully-featured microcontrollers.
  • Experience in design and development of a Software Development Kit (SDK).

title: Lead Pricing & Taxation Specialist
description:
Bliv den faglige motor bag prisfastsættelse og afgiftsområdet i Jyske Finans

Vil du have en central specialistrolle med stor faglig indflydelse på, hvordan vi arbejder med prisfastsættelse og afgiftsforhold i en af Danmarks største leasingforretninger?

Hos Jyske Finans får du mulighed for at sætte retning på to forretningskritiske områder. Du omsætter analyser, markedsindsigt og specialistviden til beslutninger, der har direkte betydning for vores lønsomhed, risikostyring og kundeoplevelse. Samtidig bliver du den naturlige sparringspartner for både kolleger, ledelse og samarbejdspartnere inden for Pricing & Taxation.

Om rollen

Rollen er for dig, der motiveres af at have et tydeligt fagligt ansvar og mulighed for at sætte retning inden for dit specialistområde. Du får stor indflydelse på beslutninger, processer og metoder i en forretning, hvor Pricing & Taxation spiller en central rolle.

Som Lead Pricing & Taxation Specialist får du det faglige ansvar for to centrale områder i Jyske Finans: prisfastsættelse og afgiftsforhold.

Du bliver den person, organisationen går til, når der skal træffes beslutninger om restværdier, service- og dækaftaler eller afgiftsmæssige forhold. Samtidig spiller du en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at vores metoder, processer og beslutningsgrundlag understøtter en sund og robust leasingforretning.

Hverdagen veksler mellem analyse, faglig sparring og udvikling. Du omsætter markedsindsigt og data til konkrete anbefalinger, bidrager til udviklingen af vores prismodeller og arbejdsgange og sikrer en professionel håndtering af afgiftsområdet, herunder dialogen med Motorstyrelsen.

Dine primære ansvarsområder bliver:

  • Prisfastsættelse af restværdier samt service- og dækaftaler
  • Afgiftsberegning og faglig kvalitetssikring
  • Udvikling og forankring af metoder og processer
  • Faglig sparring til kolleger, ledelse og forretningen
  • Dialog med Motorstyrelsen og øvrige relevante samarbejdspartnere

Din profil

Du trives med at være specialist og motiveres af at skabe et solidt fagligt grundlag for forretningens beslutninger. Du kan dykke ned i komplekse problemstillinger, men formår samtidig at omsætte analyser, data og regler til løsninger, som skaber værdi i praksis.

Du arbejder struktureret og fokuserer på både detaljerne og den større forretningsmæssige sammenhæng. Samtidig motiveres du af at tage ansvar for et fagområde og bidrage med sparring, når beslutninger kræver både faglig indsigt og forretningsforståelse.

Rollen indebærer mange samarbejdsflader, og du trives derfor i dialogen med både kolleger, ledelse og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Du formår at formidle komplekse problemstillinger klart og omsætte din viden til anbefalinger, som andre kan handle på.

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med ét eller flere af følgende områder:

  • Prisfastsættelse og kommercielle vurderinger
  • Afgiftsberegning og regulatoriske forhold
  • Leasing, automotive eller beslægtede brancher
  • Service- og dækaftaler eller lignende porteføljeforretninger

Om afdelingen og Jyske Finans

Du bliver en del af Supply Chain, et team på 12 specialister, hvor høj faglighed, sparring og korte beslutningsveje præger hverdagen.

Stillingen refererer til Director, Supply Chain, og du får et tæt samarbejde med både forretningen, tekniske specialister, interne støttefunktioner, eksterne samarbejdspartnere og ledelsen.

Jyske Finans er et datterselskab i Jyske Bank-koncernen og beskæftiger ca. 170 medarbejdere. Vi er et af landets største og mest erfarne selskaber inden for låne- og leasingfinansiering af biler og materiel til erhvervslivet.

Vores domicil ligger i Silkeborg, og vi har kontorer i Aalborg og Roskilde. Kulturen er uformel og præget af høj faglighed, korte beslutningsveje og en klar ambition om at skabe resultater sammen.

Ansøgning og proces

I Jyske Bank koncernen mener vi, at diversitet skaber bedre beslutninger og relationer samt et mere varieret arbejdsmiljø. Vi arbejder aktivt for inklusion og lige muligheder og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge.

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV og en kort motivation for, hvorfor netop denne rolle tiltaler dig.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 15. september 2026. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Senior HR Business Partner Anni Bech Kristoffersen varetager rekrutteringen, og har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Director, Supply Chain, Kristoffer Mortensen for en uforpligtende dialog.

title: Quality Food Safety Specialist
description:
SUMMARY

The Quality Food Safety Specialist supports food safety, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance across all facilities. This role conducts environmental and product testing, verifies food safety programs, supports audits, and partners closely with Production and Quality teams to ensure all products meet high standards for safety, quality, and consistency. This position also plays a key role in training, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the company’s SQF, HACCP, and GMP programs.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES

Food Safety & Quality Verification

  • Monitor, verify, and validate HACCP, SQF, and GMP programs to ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, and internal standards.
  • Review, maintain, and verify production, sanitation, allergen, temperature, receiving, and environmental monitoring records.
  • Conduct environmental, bacteriological, chemical, and physical testing of raw materials, packaging, in-process samples, and finished products.
  • Complete daily product release logs and ensure finished goods meet safety and quality specifications.
  • Prepare and submit samples to external labs as needed.
  • Lead, support, and trend results for the environmental monitoring program and other verification/validation programs.

Documentation & Recordkeeping

  • Ensure all food safety and quality records are complete, accurate, reviewed, and properly stored.
  • Prepare reports, maintain data logs, and assist in SOP, SSOP, and process documentation updates.
  • Assist with product investigations, customer complaints, and corrective action follow-up.

Training & Internal Support

  • Assist with training for GMPs, HACCP basics, chemical safety, and food safety requirements.
  • Assist with developing training materials aligned with regulatory, customer, and internal standards.
  • Serve as a resource to cross-functional teams, providing timely guidance and support for quality-related questions or issues.

Audits & Compliance

title: Data engineer
description:
Dit en meer ga je doen

Als Data Engineer ontwikkel en beheer je datakoppelingen voor het onderwijs. Je werkt binnen het Business Intelligence Competency Center van het ROC van Amsterdam - Flevoland. Het team bestaat uit 14 collega’s. Samen maken jullie data veilig, betrouwbaar en tijdig beschikbaar.

Veel bestaande koppelingen draaien op C# en Azure Functions. Je onderhoudt deze oplossingen en bouwt nieuwe data-integraties en datapipelines. Daarbij ontsluit en verwerk je gegevens uit verschillende applicaties. Je onderzoekt storingen en verbetert prestaties, beveiliging en monitoring. Zo blijven systemen, processen en rapportages goed werken.

Je draagt ook bij aan de vernieuwing van het dataplatform. De verwerking verhuist stap voor stap verder naar Azure. Je onderzoekt waar Azure Data Factory en Microsoft Fabric waarde toevoegen. Daarbij stem je werkzaamheden en technische keuzes af met collega’s. Je legt oplossingen vast en deelt kennis binnen het team.

Dit verwachten we van jou

Je kunt bestaande oplossingen doorgronden en gericht verbeteren. Bij problemen onderzoek je de oorzaak en werk je aan een blijvende oplossing. Ervaring met samenwerken binnen een technisch team is een pre. Dat geldt ook voor bewust gebruik van Microsoft Copilot bij ontwikkeling, documentatie en tests. Je controleert uitkomsten altijd zelf en behandelt gegevens en broncode zorgvuldig.

Daarnaast vragen wij:

  • aantoonbare werkervaring met C# en Azure Functions;
  • hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur binnen ICT;
  • ervaring met SQL, datamodellering en data-integratie;
  • ervaring met ETL- of ELT-processen;
  • ervaring met Git, CI/CD of DevOps.

Meer dan alleen goede voorwaarden

De werkwereld om je heen verandert continu. Daarom zetten wij vol in op je ontwikkeling. Trainingen, opleidingen, workshops… wat jij nodig hebt, maken wij mogelijk. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op doorgroeikansen en prima arbeidsvoorwaarden.

  • Een salaris in schaal 10 (cao mbo) van maximaal€ 5.495 brutoper maand bij een fulltime dienstverband
  • Pensioenregeling via ABP, 8% vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%
  • Reiskostenvergoeding en demogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van bijvoorbeeld een fietsplan
  • Werkgeversbijdrage in de (aanvullende) ziektekostenverzekering
  • Ruime vakantieregeling
  • Middelen om jouw werk goed te doen (afhankelijk van jouw functie bijvoorbeeld een kwalitatieve laptop, BYOD-telefoonregeling en een vergoeding voor thuiswerken).
  • Toegang totonze digitale leeromgeving RocWISE om je verder te ontwikkelen.

Wil je weten wat we nog meer bieden? Bekijk dan het volledige overzicht van onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Hier ga je werken

De wereld rondom onderwijs en ICT is continu in ontwikkeling. Werken voor een grote onderwijsorganisatie, zoals het ROC van Amsterdam – Flevoland, betekent dan ook veel dynamiek waarbij het onderwijs en de student centraal staan. De dienst OI&I speelt een belangrijke rol in de digitale transformatie van het onderwijs en de organisatie. De leer- en werkomgeving is flexibel en ondersteunt gepersonaliseerd leren. We bieden moderne en digitale voorzieningen voor onze studenten, leerlingen en medewerkers, adviseren de organisatie en zorgen dat het werkt.
Om het onderwijs goed te kunnen ondersteunen omvat de dienst OI&I diverse afdelingen, te weten; Onderwijsinnovatie & Samenwerking, Onderwijslogistiek & Ondersteuning, Business Intelligence Competency Center, ICT Services, ICT Infrastructuur,Projectenbureau en een stafafdeling (architecten, informatiemanagers, Information Security Manager en secretariaat).

Over het ROC van Amsterdam - Flevoland

Het ROC van Amsterdam - Flevoland verzorgt middelbaar beroepsonderwijs op vier niveaus binnen veertien onderwijsdomeinen. Het ROC van Amsterdam biedt ruim 300 verschillende opleidingen aan en het ROC van Flevoland zo’n 130 opleidingen. Het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs wordt op de verschillende mbo-colleges gegeven. Het ROC van Amsterdam - Flevoland heeft bij elkaar twaalf mbo-colleges in Amsterdam, Amstelveen, Hoofddorp, Hilversum, Almere en Lelystad. Het roc biedt onderwijs aan 36.000 mbo-studenten, 3.300 leerlingen in het voortgezet onderwijs en 6.500 deelnemers aan overige educatie (waaronder inburgering en volwassenen). Bij het roc werken in totaal ca. 4.000 medewerkers.

Het ROC van Amsterdam – Flevoland is een onderwijsorganisatie waar ruim 180 nationaliteiten iedere dag welkom zijn en samen leren, ook van elkaars verschillende achtergronden. Voor iedereen geldt hetzelfde respect en elke collega draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van leerlingen en studenten voor de inclusieve Nederlandse samenleving.

Om goed onderwijs te geven is het onderwijs op de mbo-colleges kleinschalig georganiseerd; een student heeft voornamelijk te maken met de afdeling waar zijn of haar opleiding onderdeel van is. Het ROC van Amsterdam – Flevoland kenmerkt zich door kwalitatief hoogwaardig onderwijs met veel aandacht voor de student. We streven elke dag naar het allerbeste onderwijs. Iedereen is welkom en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van studenten. We leren van elkaars achtergronden, gaan mee met de ontwikkelingen in de maatschappij en vernieuwen waar nodig. Dit doen we in een sfeer van vertrouwen en op elkaar kunnen bouwen. Van prettig en respectvol met elkaar samenwerken. Kijken waar het beter kan en dat vervolgens ook doen. Want ook dat hoort bij een organisatie die overal de beroepspraktijk ademt.

title: Construction Process Optimization Engineer
description:
Mission

TAR’s mission is to power intelligence for the world. We are building the world’s first off-grid power plant for data centers powered by renewable technologies.

We firmly believe AI should be built in the US for the benefit of all people. For that, power must be fast, clean and scalable. We are singularly focused on delivering GW-scale power faster than anyone has ever done, by rethinking every layer of the stack.

We vertically integrate to solve every bottleneck, from racking systems to power electronics to dispatch algorithms to on-site construction.

Leave your mark on the future of civilization-scale energy infrastructure.

Company

TAR is both a hardware and software company, we are building out massive, critical, physical infrastructure. TAR is working directly with one of the largest compute providers to scale and deploy 5GWs by 2028.

We operate on…

  • High ownership. High Agency. Own project end-to-end. Great people don’t need to be managed.

  • Speed. We achieve great things on incredible timelines. We push ourselves to go faster.

  • First principles. No ego. No hierarchy. Challenge every assumption.

  • Passion. Solving the energy problem is one of the largest challenges that faces the world now and in the future.

About the role

TAR builds fully islanded solar and storage campuses that power AI data centers, and at GW scale the binding constraint is field labor: how fast crews can install a campus. As Construction Process Optimization Engineer, you own installation productivity on the ground, embedded with our EPC and their crews through the build of our first campus. The problem has two halves: the install itself, which covers pile driving, racking assembly, module mounting, and BESS and electrical placement, and the logistics around it, which covers delivery sequencing, laydown yards, staging, kitting, and the QA that keeps rework near zero. Much of the work is empirical: try a method, measure it, keep it or kill it, then turn what wins into the standard playbook every future campus starts with on day one. This is a senior, field-heavy role: you will spend extensive time living at our West Texas site during construction campaigns, with Austin as your home base.

Responsibilities

  • Run structured time-and-motion studies across every major installation activity (piles, racking, module install, DC collection, BESS placement) and build TAR's productivity baseline: cycle times, crew-hours per activity, and MW per week.

  • Identify the true bottlenecks and quantify what each one costs in schedule and dollars, so the team acts on the constraints that matter.

  • Design and run field experiments on crew size, sequencing, staging, and method, then measure results and standardize the winners into repeatable work.

  • Solve the recurring physical problems (panel laydown, material handling, work-front congestion) with methods that hold up at scale, not one-off fixes.

  • Build the material logistics system from scratch: delivery cadence, laydown plans, kitting, and staging distances, so crews are never waiting on material at the work front.

  • Stand up the QA/QC process around installation that catches issues before they turn into rework.

  • Codify everything into standard work (playbooks, productivity targets, training material) and train EPC crews on TAR-specific methods, including robot-assisted survey and layout, partnering with our robotics team as more automation reaches the field.

  • Feed constructability findings back into engineering and procurement so the next campus is designed to build faster than the first.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in process or industrial engineering, construction execution, or capital projects, with substantial time in the field rather than behind a desk.

  • Hands-on construction project experience on the EPC side, the owner's side, or in construction-focused consulting, with a feel for how field work actually flows and what makes an improvement stick and repeat at scale.

  • A measurement-first toolkit: time studies, takt and line-of-balance, lean methods, work sampling, and bottleneck analysis, plus the data skills to back it up (Excel required; Python or SQL a plus).

  • Comfort spending extended stretches at a remote West Texas site and the temperament to earn credibility with field crews.

  • A builder's bias: you would rather run the experiment this week than write the memo about it.

Nice to have

  • Utility-scale solar or BESS construction experience.

  • Background in oil and gas, petrochemical, or manufacturing operations, or in operations and manufacturing consulting (shop-floor productivity, capital projects, ops transformation); the systems-and-measurement mindset matters more than the industry.

  • Experience with construction robotics, survey automation, or GPS/RTK layout tools.

  • Texas PE license or OSHA 30.

  • Spanish proficiency.

Salary and Benefits

  • Up to $15K relocation bonus

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • $1K monthly stipend for meals

title: Market Data Lead
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Market Data Lead based in India.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity to build and own the market data function supporting the next phase of a global financial technology platform’s Traditional Finance expansion. You will define the market data strategy, source and negotiate critical exchange and vendor relationships, and oversee the integration of real-time, reference, and historical data. Working across product, engineering, legal, compliance, and finance, you will establish the data foundation required to launch and scale new financial products and markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on technical and commercial leadership. You will also build and mentor a growing team while establishing strong governance, data-quality, licensing, and operational standards. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced market data professional who thrives in fast-moving, global, build-from-zero environments.

Accountabilities

  • Market Data Strategy: Define and own the market data strategy and roadmap, identifying, evaluating, and prioritizing exchange and vendor data required for expanding financial products and markets.
  • Sourcing & Commercial Management: Lead sourcing and negotiations with exchanges, consolidators, and market data vendors, managing licensing agreements, renewals, vendor relationships, and overall data expenditure.
  • Data Integration: Partner closely with engineering to manage end-to-end feed onboarding, normalization, symbology, reference data, corporate actions, and distribution across trading and client-facing platforms.
  • Data Governance: Establish robust governance across the market data lifecycle, including entitlements, data quality, lineage, usage controls, and compliance with exchange policies and audit requirements.
  • Licensing & Compliance: Collaborate with product, legal, and compliance teams to assess licensing and redistribution requirements as products, regions, and asset classes expand.
  • Market Intelligence: Maintain a current view of market data providers, sources, pricing models, partnership opportunities, and industry developments to ensure a competitive and cost-efficient data ecosystem.
  • Team Leadership: Build, develop, and mentor a small market data team while establishing effective operating rhythms with product and engineering stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership: Serve as the internal subject-matter expert on market data and market structure, translating exchange and vendor conventions into practical guidance for technology and product teams.

    • Requirements

    • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
    • Professional Experience: 6–10 years of experience in market data or trading technology within a global brokerage, exchange, fintech, or market data provider, with demonstrated experience building or scaling market data capabilities.
    • Market Data Expertise: Deep understanding of exchange feeds, vendor products, licensing and redistribution models, entitlements, exchange audits, and compliance processes.
    • TradFi Experience: Hands-on experience sourcing and integrating market data across one or more traditional asset classes, such as equities, derivatives, commodities, fixed income, FX, or indices, and across multiple regions.
    • Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of feed protocols, data normalization, symbology standards, corporate actions, reference data, and time-series distribution.
    • Commercial Skills: Strong negotiation and vendor-management capabilities, including experience managing market data budgets and commercial relationships.
    • Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across product, engineering, legal, compliance, and finance.
    • Leadership: Experience building teams, mentoring talent, and establishing operational processes in a fast-paced environment.
    • Execution: Comfortable working in a high-velocity, build-from-zero environment with significant autonomy and ownership.
    • Preferred Technical Skills: SQL or Python proficiency and familiarity with common market data feed protocols and data architectures.
    • Preferred Experience: Experience establishing a market data function for a brokerage entering new asset classes or markets; broad knowledge of APAC, U.S., and European market data landscapes; and familiarity with market data and trading products.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive salary and comprehensive company benefits.
      • Fully remote work-from-home arrangement, subject to business and team requirements.
      • Opportunity to shape the market data infrastructure supporting the expansion of a global financial technology ecosystem.
      • Collaboration with highly experienced, international teams across technology, product, finance, legal, and compliance.
      • High-autonomy environment with fast-paced, technically challenging projects.
      • Flat, results-driven organizational culture with opportunities to take ownership and make a visible impact.
      • Career growth and continuous learning opportunities.
      • Exposure to global financial markets, market data ecosystems, and emerging financial technology.

title: Business Analyst
description:
At ASIC, you can be the change that ensures a fair, strong and efficient financial system for the benefit of all Australians. Contribute to delivering on ASIC's purpose, vision, and strategic priorities to help maintain the integrity of the financial system and protect consumers from harm.

ASIC's Business Analysis team is currently seeking Business Analysts to join their high-performing team to contribute to a wide range of technology projects within ASIC.

  • Sydney and Melbourne locations
  • 24 month fixed term role
  • Salary from $136,204 to $149,295 (depending on experience) + 15.4 % superannuation
  • Applications will close at 11:59pm AEST, Sunday 6 September 2026

The team

The Digital, Data & Technology (DD&T) Portfolio Office delivers a broad suite of services in portfolio management, project delivery, business planning, and governance to support ASIC's strategic priorities. We work in close partnership with ASIC's Digital, Data & Technology group and the newly established RegistryConnect (RC) program to ensure projects are aligned with both strategic direction and operational needs.

The role

The Business Analyst role within ASIC is responsible for leading and delivering a broad range of analysis activities critical to the successful completion of projects. This includes, but is not limited to, the elicitation and analysis of both high-level and detailed business requirements (functional and non-functional), requirements management, enterprise analysis, solution assessment and validation, ensuring alignment with business needs and project objectives.

More specifically, you will:

  • Collaborate with business subject matter experts and IT teams to analyse business requirements, identifying and articulating the underlying business needs through stakeholder workshops and targeted discussions.
  • Elicit, document and manage business, functional and non-functional requirements in formats that are clear, structured and accessible to a broad range of stakeholders, including business, executive, design, development and testing teams.
  • Design user interfaces in alignment with User-Centred Design (UCD) principles, ensuring solutions meet industry standards and Australian Government accessibility and usability guidelines.
  • Develop and maintain process maps, including current state (as-is) analysis and future state (to-be) design, to support process improvement and transformation initiatives.
  • Define integration patterns and develop detailed integration specifications across technology platforms, as well as technical requirements for infrastructure services where required.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and system implementation activities, including the preparation of test artefacts, user documentation, and training materials to facilitate successful adoption.

About you

The ideal candidate for the Business Analyst role at ASIC is a highly analytical and adaptable professional with strong experience in both Agile delivery and traditional business analysis practices. They will demonstrate the ability to elicit, analyse and manage complex business and technical requirements, working closely with stakeholders at all levels to translate business needs into clear, actionable outcomes. A strong communicator and collaborator, the ideal candidate will also demonstrate a proven ability to build effective relationships with SMEs, senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, while guiding other analysts. They will be customer-focused, self-driven and committed to delivering outcomes aligned with ASIC's objectives and values.

In addition, you will have:

  • Tertiary qualifications in Information Technology or a related discipline.
  • Strong knowledge of IT Systems Development Lifecycles (SDLC) and Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Demonstrated expertise in eliciting, documenting and managing business and technical requirements.
  • Solid capability in process modelling (including BPMN), data analysis and data modelling techniques.
  • Advanced enterprise analysis skills, with a proven ability to resolve complex problems within dynamic and evolving business environments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging effectively and deliver to diverse audiences, both verbally and in writing.

Click ‘apply' to start your application. Applications will close at 11:59pm AEST, Sunday 6 September 2026.

About ASIC

ASIC's remit is one of the broadest of regulators across the world. ASIC regulates corporations, markets, financial services and consumer credit and monitors and promotes market integrity and consumer protection in the Australian financial system. Through our enforcement work, we hold to account those who contravene the law, working to achieve strong outcomes that address the greatest consumer and investor harms.

ASIC is an equal opportunity employer seeking people who want to make a difference. ASIC is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace where the very best talent in Australia chooses to work. Applications from people of all ages, cultural backgrounds, abilities, LGBTIQ+ identity, and people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent are encouraged to apply.

We offer a range of employee benefits including:

  • Attractive superannuation
  • Additional leave entitlements
  • 50/50 hybrid work-from home model
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Assistance for study and professional development

Click here to view ASIC's salary and benefits guide.

To read more about ASIC, you can visit our website or review our Corporate Plan.

To work with us, you need to be an Australian citizen and be prepared to complete an ASIC Suitability and Baseline Assessment.

title: Senior Product Engineer (AI, Full-Stack)
description:
About AZX

Our mission is to accelerate positive impact in critical industries through AI transformation. We specialize in physics-informed ML and enterprise AI solutions that directly address climate and sustainability challenges.

We’re growing quickly and already work with category-leaders in real estate (CBRE), energy (LevelTen Energy), logistics (Flexe) and utilities.

We’re a public benefit corporation, founded in 2024, and have been profitable from inception.

We work on challenges in clean energy, decarbonization, climate risk, energy systems, and global economics. We’re building our company for long-term success and aim to create the ultimate place to work for those passionate about AI and making a positive impact.

About This Role:

We are seeking a Product Engineer that owns the demo's we build for clients from the schema to the pixel, the deployment and the observability. You'll work across the chat surface and agent workspaces, the app builder alongside the platform team, and the shared component and design system, plus the agent-facing developer experience — since our platform's users are coding agents as much as humans. Enterprise readiness is a feature here, not an afterthought: accessibility, localization, and audit trails get demoed, not promised. You'll build on the backend team's services and the runtime team's infrastructure, so overlap down the stack is expected.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the chat surface and agent workspaces — streaming protocol on both client and server, message/run persistence, tool-call and approval UX, and citation rendering.

  • Partner with the platform team on the app builder: the fixed app template and toolchain it generates against, the preview sandbox seam, and the generation/repair loop UX.

  • Maintain the component and design system across chat, workspaces, and the app builder, keeping all three visually and behaviorally consistent.

  • Build the agent-facing developer experience — CLI, deploy tooling, manifests — treating coding agents as first-class platform users alongside humans.

  • Own the full stack behind your own features: TypeScript front end, Node/FastAPI backend-for-frontend, Postgres schema, deployment, and on-call.

  • Ship enterprise readiness as a first-class feature — accessibility, localization, and audit trails — demoed working, not described as roadmap.

  • Work down the stack when it matters: read backend service traces and runtime/Kubernetes logs to debug across the seam between product, backend, and platform teams.

Core Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of deep, production experience with React/TypeScript — streaming UIs, high-frequency updates, virtualization, and real state management, with informed, hands-on opinions about React 19.

  • Hands-on experience with a streaming protocol end to end (SSE or WebSocket) — chunk boundaries, reconnection semantics, abort propagation — including having personally debugged a raw byte stream.

  • True full-stack ownership: you've shipped the backend half of your own front ends (Node/Fastify or Python/FastAPI), handling auth, idempotency, pagination, race conditions, and migrations.

  • Product taste backed by enterprise experience — accessibility you can defend to a screen-reader user, thoughtful empty/error states, and localization that goes beyond a strings file.

  • An AI-native working style: daily use of AI coding tools, driven by specs rather than vibes, with concrete examples of where you overrode a tool's output.

  • A strong sense of ownership — instrumentation, evals on AI-dependent behavior, cost awareness, and on-call are part of "done," not a later phase.

  • Practical depth in some of our core stack — TypeScript (strict), React 19, TanStack Query, Vite, Node/Fastify or Python/FastAPI, Postgres/Redis, and SSE/WebSocket streaming — with a track record of researching into unfamiliar parts of it.

  • Familiarity with the surrounding toolchain: zod-validated wire contracts, sandboxed iframes/CSP/postMessage, Playwright/Vitest, WCAG 2.2 AA, i18n frameworks, and OIDC/OAuth2 session mechanics

  • Bachelor's Degree; Master's is a plus

Why AZX!

  • Be part of a fast-growing, profitable, mission-driven company with industry-leading clients tackling the massive opportunity of AI transformation in critical industries.

  • Competitive early-stage startup compensation (based on capabilities, experience, and location)

  • Bonus eligibility

  • Health insurance with meaningful coverage for dependents

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Equity

  • Fully remote culture with a cluster of teammates in Seattle

Additional Information:

  • Must be able to travel 2x/year for company summits

  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

  • We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.

  • Please only apply to a maximum of 2 roles at a time, any applicants who apply to more then 2 roles within a 6 month period will automatically be disqualified

Next Steps:

title: Senior II Data Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior II Data Engineer based in India.

This is a senior data engineering role focused on building the analytical foundation for enterprise Finance transformation.
You will serve as a key technical expert within an enterprise data engineering, analytics, and intelligence function.
The role centers on Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI), including data loads, semantic models, KPIs, dashboards, and data architecture.
You will partner closely with Finance leaders across Accounting, Revenue Operations, and Business Finance to integrate systems and improve data accessibility.
Your work will enable operational intelligence, enterprise reporting, and scalable self-service analytics across critical business processes.
You will also translate complex technical roadmaps into practical solutions for business stakeholders and guide Finance system evolution.
The environment values curiosity, initiative, collaboration, technical excellence, and the ability to solve complex problems in a flexible global organization.

Accountabilities

  • Partner with Finance leadership across Accounting, Customer Revenue Operations, and Business Finance to architect system migration and integration initiatives within Oracle Cloud.
  • Configure and manage Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) data loads, semantic models, KPIs, and dashboards to transform Finance data into actionable operational intelligence.
  • Build, maintain, and improve enterprise data structures that support reliable reporting and self-service analytics.
  • Develop and maintain an enterprise data catalog, helping Finance users understand, discover, and effectively use available data.
  • Serve as a primary technical expert and consultant for Finance system process changes, data requirements, and technology roadmaps.
  • Translate Finance business processes and data lifecycles into scalable data architecture and analytical solutions.
  • Support cloud ERP transformation initiatives and ensure data integrations align with business and technical requirements.
  • Create enterprise-level reports and analytical outputs using tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Work with relational databases and develop complex SQL queries to support data analysis, validation, reporting, and troubleshooting.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders to identify opportunities for improving data quality, accessibility, and operational efficiency.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts, architectural decisions, and roadmaps clearly to non-technical Finance stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify and resolve complex data and systems challenges while adapting to evolving business requirements and technology priorities.

    • Requirements

    • 6+ years of hands-on experience working with Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI), with strong expertise in its data loads, dashboards, semantic models, and analytical capabilities.
    • Strong understanding of Finance business processes and data lifecycles, particularly across Accounting, Customer Revenue Operations, and Business Finance.
    • Proven experience with data architecture and cloud ERP transformation initiatives involving platforms such as Oracle Cloud, Workday, Salesforce, or similar enterprise systems.
    • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Oracle FDI environments for business reporting and operational analytics.
    • Strong relational database management experience, particularly with Oracle or comparable RDBMS platforms.
    • Advanced SQL skills for data analysis, troubleshooting, validation, transformation, and reporting.
    • Experience developing enterprise reports and dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or comparable business intelligence tools.
    • Strong functional understanding of ERP Finance modules, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Revenue, as well as their underlying data structures.
    • Strong understanding of data architecture, integration concepts, reporting frameworks, and enterprise data management.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
    • Ability to explain complex technical roadmaps, data concepts, and system changes to Finance and other business stakeholders.
    • Proactive, curious, and self-motivated approach, with a strong ability to take ownership and solve complex problems independently.
    • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and work effectively in a flexible, collaborative, global environment.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on building scalable, sustainable solutions.

      • Benefits

      • Remote work opportunity based in India, with flexible working options.
      • Flexible approach to how and where work is delivered, with the opportunity to discuss individual requirements during the recruitment process.
      • Opportunities to work on large-scale cloud ERP and Finance transformation initiatives.
      • Exposure to Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence, enterprise data architecture, business intelligence, and advanced analytics.
      • Collaboration with Finance, technology, and business teams across a global organization.
      • Opportunities for professional growth, learning, and career development.
      • Benefits designed to support health, financial well-being, family needs, and personal time.
      • A collaborative and inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives, curiosity, innovation, and meaningful impact.
      • Opportunity to contribute to data-driven solutions supporting global business operations and digital transformation.

title: Program Manager Analyst
description:
Position Title: Program Manager Analyst

Reports to: Operations Manager

Location: Fort Bragg, NC

Work Schedule: Full-Time, Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt


Position Summary: Aldevra is currently seeking a qualified Program Manager Analyst to support the United States Army Reserve (USAR) in Fort Bragg, NC. We are looking for someone who brings a positive attitude, strong attention to detail, clear communication, and a willingness to jump in where needed. The right person will also connect with Aldevra’s core values of SOAR: Strong Integrity and Ethics, Outstanding Teamwork, Accountability-Driven, and Relentless Pursuit of Quality.


This position is contingent upon contract award.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Use information systems and automation tools—including ATAAPS, DCPDS, DCPS, FMS-Web, GFEBS, PROBE, and TAPDB-R—to complete assigned tasks, safeguard PII, and ensure submissions comply with applicable policies and templates.
  • Analyze Force Management structure changes and provide monthly reports on impacts to personnel, workforce shaping, training, recruiting and retention, and performance management.
  • Research and analyze human capital needs, including performance management, benefits, training, and leader development, and provide monthly findings and recommendations to support human capital planning.
  • Provide updates to portions of the document based on changes, called segment updates, seven days of the requested update.
  • Document, track, and analyze personnel information to assist CPMO in human resource planning, such as succession planning and workforce development.
  • Update and maintain data in existing Microsoft Access databases and Microsoft Excel spreadsheets to ensure that all personnel information, education, and training reports are current and accurate.
  • Serve as the quota manager for Civilian Education System (CES) training for the Army Reserve.
  • Provide a monthly report which analyzes civilian education quota utilization, training needs assessments, competency gaps, and the effectiveness of civilian training programs and civilian leader development programs.
  • Provide segment updates to this report within seven days of the requested update.
  • Consolidate FY training program accomplishments upon completion of the current FY training program and analyze data to provide training quota recommendations for the following fiscal year to Director and/or designee(s)
  • Analyze current internal and external focus areas, surveys, and initiatives, such as the Talent Management Framework and Employee Engagement and provide a report which recommends mitigation strategies and courses of action to ensure that requirements are met with the resources at hand.
  • Provide segment updates to this report within three days of the requested update.
  • Research CES-related topics and use findings to draft or update policy for Government approval, including onboarding, mentorship, career development, training needs, proficiency assessments, and HR liaison opportunities.
  • Provide monthly report of findings within the first five working days of each month.
  • Perform budget analysis which considers the current command structure but also analyzes what budgetary impact there will be with the implementation of future changes to the command structure.
  • Provide an analysis of the budget implications of standardization of civilian personnel classification and organizational design across the footprint.
  • Perform an analysis of civilian personnel pay execution trends and propose solutions to build requirements and maximize civilian personnel pay execution in accordance with the command’s current hiring strategy and future changes to the command structure.
  • Perform budget analysis on non-civilian pay execution trends and propose solutions to effectively manage program execution.
  • Provide segment updates to these reports within seven days of the requested update.
  • Perform an analysis of civilian personnel pay execution under specified Management Decision Packages (MDEPs) / Program Evaluation Groups (PEGs) to provide expenditures and trends, and to identify potential excesses and/or shortfalls in the programs, MDEPs, and/or Operating Budgets.
  • Provide segment updates to these reports within seven days of the requested update. These segment updates usually occur on a bi-monthly basis but can occur as often as weekly.
  • Provide a forecast of future manpower, training, and budget requirements based on current and future changes to manpower and budgets on a quarterly basis.
  • Serve as the Site Content Administrator for the Army Reserve CPMO SharePoint Page.
  • Provide training to personnel within CPMO on how to use the CPMO SharePoint page, how to update information, and troubleshoot issues that users have using the SharePoint page.
  • Grant and manage the CPMO SharePoint page access and permissions.
  • Review information on the CPMO SharePoint page and ensure Information Security (no PII) is maintained, that content is current, and accurate information is maintained.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Aldevra was founded in 2009 by current President & CEO Rodney Marshall, a U.S. Marine Corps veteran and minority entrepreneur. The company began by selling foodservice equipment to the federal government and later expanded to include medical equipment and professional services, helping to meet a broader range of customer needs. Today, Aldevra is recognized as a top foodservice equipment dealer in the U.S., specializing in federal government sales while also growing its commercial and e-commerce customer base. Its professional services division provides federal agencies with healthcare professionals, construction and facilities managers and technicians, and administrative support. Learn more about us at aldevra.com.

title: Project Finance Lead
description:
Mission

TAR’s mission is to power intelligence for the world. We are building the world’s first off-grid power plant for data centers powered by renewable technologies.

We firmly believe AI should be built in the US for the benefit of all people. For that, power must be fast, clean and scalable. We are singularly focused on delivering GW-scale power faster than anyone has ever done, by rethinking every layer of the stack.

We vertically integrate to solve every bottleneck, from racking systems to power electronics to dispatch algorithms to on-site construction.

Leave your mark on the future of civilization-scale energy infrastructure.

Company

TAR is both a hardware and software company, we are building out massive, critical, physical infrastructure. TAR is working directly with one of the largest compute providers to scale and deploy 5GWs by 2028.

We operate on…

  • High ownership. High Agency. Own project end-to-end. Great people don’t need to be managed.

  • Speed. We achieve great things on incredible timelines. We push ourselves to go faster.

  • First principles. No ego. No hierarchy. Challenge every assumption.

  • Passion. Solving the energy problem is one of the largest challenges that faces the world now and in the future.

About the role

TAR develops, builds, owns, and operates fully islanded solar and storage campuses that deliver firm power to AI data centers, with no utility interconnection and no gas generation. Financing that infrastructure is what turns projects in the ground into a repeatable business: each campus sits in its own project SPV and carries a mix of construction and term debt, tax equity, ITC transfer, and equipment financing that has to be structured, negotiated, and closed on aggressive timelines. As Project Finance Lead, you own financing execution end to end. You take live transactions from term sheet through diligence, documentation, and close, build and defend the models behind them, and drive the counsel, advisors, and counterparties that get deals done. This is a high-ownership individual contributor seat for someone who has run significant workstreams on live transactions, based on-site in New York, San Francisco, or Austin.

Responsibilities

  • Lead financing execution across construction and term debt, tax equity and ITC transfer transactions, and equipment financing, driving term sheet negotiations and managing lender and counsel relationships through documentation and close.

  • Structure and document offtake and credit support arrangements, including PPAs, guarantees, and other instruments, and account for how each affects debt sizing, covenant mechanics, and lender underwriting.

  • Build and own the models behind live deals: debt sizing, DSCR waterfalls, tax equity and transferability economics, restricted payment mechanics, levered and unlevered returns, and multi-scenario sensitivities, serving as the team's primary check on model integrity.

  • Manage external counsel, financial advisors, and counterparty working groups, tracking open legal and commercial issues, flagging risks to senior leadership, and pushing resolutions forward on deal timelines.

  • Design and stress-test capital structures across HoldCo, OpCo, and project SPV arrangements, including cross-collateralization, cross-default, and intercreditor mechanics, and work with legal to translate structural decisions into documentation.

  • Analyze and negotiate equity-linked and warrant structures, including warrant agreements and co-invest instruments issued alongside strategic offtake or partnership arrangements.

  • Own investor and lender materials, from investment memos and lender presentations to internal approval packages, and codify deal learnings into the frameworks and playbooks that keep execution consistent as the pipeline grows.

  • Partner across development, power systems, procurement, legal, and policy to gather inputs, pressure-test commercial assumptions, and ground financing structures in operational reality, translating capital markets concepts for non-finance stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • 2-6 years in investment banking, private equity, project finance, or another transaction-focused finance role at a bank, fund, or infrastructure sponsor.

  • Demonstrated experience owning significant workstreams on live transactions, from diligence through close.

  • Deep financial modeling capability: able to independently build, audit, and pressure-test project finance models with complex capital structures.

  • Proven ability to manage external advisors and counterparty workstreams while driving transactions forward on timeline.

  • Excellent written communication: you can independently draft clear, concise investment memos, term sheets, and board-level materials.

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to power, renewables, energy storage, data centers, or other capital-intensive real asset sectors, on the debt or equity side.

  • Strong working knowledge of credit agreement mechanics, covenant structures, and project finance documentation.

  • Familiarity with tax equity, ITC transferability, and other clean energy incentive structures.

  • Experience with offtake agreements, guarantees, or other credit support structures and their impact on financing economics and lender underwriting.

  • Understanding of SPV structuring, multi-lender intercreditor arrangements, and cross-collateralization mechanics.

Salary and Benefits

  • Up to $15K relocation bonus

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • $1K monthly stipend for meals

title: Service Technician - Air Products
description:

Our dedicated team of over 300 sales representatives and certified service technicians allows us to bring unparalleled quality and service to our industry. MES supports its customers with innovative digital commerce solutions and a nationwide warehousing system with three strategically located hubs that carry thousands of products representing the best brands on the market.


Additional Information:

MES is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law.


MES hires only those authorized to work in the United States. Any offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of pre-employment screening.


Job Description:

Municipal Emergency Services, Inc. (MES) is looking for a full-time Service Technician (Air Products - SCBA). Our Service Technician (Air Products – SCBA) is responsible for inspecting, maintaining, repairing, and testing the Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus used by firefighting personnel who work in environments with limited oxygen supply or hazardous atmospheres. Their main responsibility is ensuring that SCBA equipment is in optimal condition and ready for use during emergencies. The ideal candidate will conduct periodic service calls at Fire Departments, conducting preventative maintenance services on 3M/Scott Safety SCBA (Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus) and SCBA-related equipment.


Territory:

The territory encompasses the counties within central Texas. (Example - Travis, Bastrop, Lee, Fayette, Burleson, Brazos, Hays, Comal, Kendall, Keer, Gillespie, Llano, Burnet, Manson, Milam, San Saba, Caldwell, Lampasas). The ideal candidate should reside within central Texas.


Travel:

There will be some travel involved approximately 25-30% of time.


Essential Job Functions: Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Equipment Inspection: Perform routine inspections and functional checks of 3M/Scott Safety SCBA and SCBA-related equipment to verify their readiness and compliance with safety regulations and standards.
  • Maintenance and Repairs: Conduct maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on 3M/Scott Safety SCBA and SCBA-related equipment, replacing worn or damaged components to ensure proper functionality.
  • Testing: Conduct tests on Scott/3M SCBA units, such as pressure tests, airflow tests, and leak tests, to verify that they meet or exceed manufacturer specifications and industry standards.
  • Documentation: Maintain detailed records of all inspection, maintenance, and repair activities, including equipment condition, parts replaced, and testing results.
  • Calibration: Calibrate and adjust SCBA equipment to ensure accurate readings and safe operation.
  • Training: Train end-users and other personnel on the proper use, care, and maintenance of SCBA equipment.
  • Inventory Management: Manage spare parts and replacement components inventory, ensuring adequate stock for repairs and maintenance.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Stay current with safety regulations and industry standards for SCBA equipment and ensure that all equipment meets Scott/3M standards.
  • Customer Service: Interact with customers and end-users, addressing their concerns and assisting with equipment-related issues.

title: AEP Data Engineer-GCP Specialist
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer with expertise in Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to develop, integrate, and manage scalable data pipelines that enable trusted customer data across enterprise digital ecosystems. This role is responsible for implementing data ingestion frameworks, supporting enterprise integrations, and ensuring high-quality, reliable data is available for customer experience, analytics, and activation use cases.

Working closely with Data Architects, Solution Architects, Platform Engineers, and business stakeholders, the Data Engineer will translate architectural designs into robust technical implementations while maintaining data quality, scalability, and operational efficiency across Adobe Experience Platform and cloud-based data environments.


Core Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain scalable data ingestion and integration pipelines that enable efficient movement of enterprise data into Adobe Experience Platform (AEP).
  • Implement data engineering solutions that support customer data management, analytics, and digital experience initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Data Architects to translate enterprise data models and architectural designs into production-ready data solutions.
  • Design, develop, and optimize data transformation processes that ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across multiple source systems.
  • Build and maintain integrations between Adobe Experience Platform, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and enterprise applications using modern integration patterns and APIs.
  • Support data validation, cleansing, reconciliation, and monitoring activities to ensure trusted and accurate data across the platform.
  • Optimize data processing performance, scalability, and operational reliability by leveraging native GCP services and engineering best practices.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot data integration issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable resolutions.
  • Implement data governance, security, and compliance requirements throughout the data engineering lifecycle.
  • Support deployment automation, version control, and CI/CD practices to enable efficient and reliable solution delivery.
  • Monitor data pipelines and platform health, proactively identifying opportunities to improve performance, resilience, and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain technical documentation for data flows, integration designs, deployment processes, and operational procedures.
  • Stay current with Adobe Experience Platform and Google Cloud Platform capabilities, recommending engineering improvements that enhance scalability and business value.


Mandatory Skills

  • Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)
  • Data Engineering
  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Data Integration
  • Data Pipeline Development


Good-to-Have Skills

  • XDM Schema Understanding
  • API Integration
  • BigQuery
  • Cloud Storage
  • CI/CD & DevOps Practices


Experience

8+ years of experience in data engineering, including hands-on implementation of scalable data integration and processing solutions. Demonstrated experience with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), enterprise data pipelines, and cloud-native data engineering practices is essential. Experience with API-based integrations, BigQuery, cloud storage services, CI/CD, and modern deployment methodologies will be considered an advantage.


Educational Qualification

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.


Preferred Certifications

title: Speech Pathologist
description:
Speech Pathologist | Perth | Paediatric OR Adult Caseload — Your Choice Full-time or part-time | New grads and experienced SPs welcome

Mediix is partnering with a well-established multidisciplinary private practice in Perth to appoint a Speech Pathologist to their growing team. What makes this role a little different: you choose the caseload that suits you. Whether your interest sits with paediatrics, adults, or a mix of both, the practice will build the role around your clinical strengths and areas you want to grow into.

The team is a genuinely collegial mix of Speech Pathologists, Occupational Therapists, Psychologists and allied health support staff, working out of a modern, well-resourced clinic.

About the role

You'll shape your own caseload from the practice's referral base — and it's a broad one. Depending on your preference, that might look like:

  • Paediatrics — early language delay, ASD, articulation, fluency, AAC, school-age literacy
  • Adults — acquired communication disorders, voice, fluency, cognitive-communication, and dysphagia
  • Mixed — a genuine blend across ages, if that's the variety you're after

Day to day, you will:

  • Complete comprehensive assessments and develop individualised, evidence-based treatment plans
  • Deliver 1:1 intervention, with group sessions where clinically indicated
  • Collaborate closely with the in-house multidisciplinary team on shared clients
  • Partner with families, carers, educators and support workers
  • Maintain clinical documentation and complete NDIS, Medicare and DVA reporting as required
  • Contribute to team case reviews, in-house PD and clinical discussion

What we offer

  • Above-award remuneration, negotiable on experience
  • Generous PD budget, paid study leave and internal case-review sessions
  • Structured supervision — genuine mentoring for new grads, and peer support for senior clinicians
  • A caseload built around your clinical interests, not handed to you
  • Admin, billing and NDIS claims support so your day stays clinical
  • Flexible hours — 0.6–1.0 FTE, compressed weeks and school-hours arrangements all considered
  • Modern, purpose-built clinic with a full assessment and therapy resource library
  • Employee Assistance Program and a supportive, low-turnover team culture

About you

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Speech Pathology
  • Speech Pathology Australia (CPSP) eligible or certified
  • New graduates with strong placement experience are warmly encouraged to apply — structured new-grad support is in place
  • Experienced SPs looking for a stable, well-run practice equally welcome
  • Strong clinical reasoning, documentation and interpersonal skills
  • Current WA driver's licence and reliable vehicle
  • WWCC and NDIS Worker Screening (or willingness to obtain)

For a confidential discussion, please contact - ania@mediix.com.au.

title: Flex stilling som køkkenmedarbejder på Botilbuddet Sedenhuse
description:
Har du lyst til et fleksibelt job i køkkenet, hvor hverdagen giver mening, og du gør en konkret forskel for borgere med særlige behov? På Botilbuddet Sedenhuse søger vi en køkkenmedarbejder til en flex-stilling, der elsker god mad, struktur i hverdagen og et varmt fællesskab. Du bliver en vigtig del af dagligdagen for både borgere og kolleger – og ja, vi går op i både smag, trivsel og et smil i hverdagen.

Om Botilbuddet Sedenhuse
Botilbuddet Sedenhuse - her arbejder vi alle for at skabe et trygt, udviklende og inkluderende miljø for borgerne med særlige behov. Vi har fokus på rehabilitering, selvstændighed og helhedsorienteret støtte, og vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af faggrupper. Her er respekt, ordentlighed og stabilitet ikke bare fine ord, men noget vi øver os i hver dag.

Vi lægger stor vægt på samarbejde, faglig udvikling og et godt psykisk arbejdsmiljø med plads til både faglighed og humor. Du bliver en del af et team, der tror på social inklusion, åbenhed og tillid – og hvor vi hjælper hinanden, når tempoet stiger.

Det får du hos os
Hos os får du en hverdag, hvor fleksibilitet og trivsel går hånd i hånd med kvalitet og struktur. Vi ved, at et godt arbejdsliv kræver både støtte, udvikling og plads til at være sig selv – også på de travle dage. Du får mulighed for at bruge dine kompetencer i køkkenet på en måde, der giver mening for både dig, kollegaerne og borgerne.

  • Arbejdstider og mulighed for at tilrettelægge dit arbejde, så det passer både os og dig
  • Grundig introduktion og oplæring, så du bliver tryg i opgaverne
  • Løbende kompetenceudvikling og faglig sparring med kolleger og ledelse
  • Nærværende og støttende ledelse med fokus på tillid, dialog og feedback
  • Et stærkt og inkluderende arbejdsfællesskab med høj social kapital og plads til humor
Hvad du kommer til at lave
Som køkkenmedarbejder i flex-stilling bliver du en central del af det daglige måltidsflow – fra planlægning til servering. Du er med til at sikre, at mad og måltider fungerer godt både praktisk og socialt for borgerne, og du samarbejder tæt med det pædagogiske- og køkken personale. Du får en hverdag med faste rutiner, men også plads til gode ideér, forbedringer og nytænkning.

  • Tilberede og anrette mad i køkkenet på Botilbuddet Sedenhuse
  • Sørge for god hygiejne, orden og struktur i køkkenet og tilstødende områder
  • Hjælpe med planlægning af måltider og tilberedning, opvask m.m.
  • Samarbejde med kolleger om borgernes behov og særlige hensyn i forbindelse med måltider
  • Deltage i daglig dialog og sparring om, hvordan vi kan gøre hverdagen bedre for borgerne og vores arbejdsmiljø
  • Bidrage til en positiv og rolig stemning omkring mad og måltider
Hvem vi håber du er
Vi leder efter dig, der har lyst til at være en stabil del af hverdagen i køkkenet og som trives med både mennesker og mad. Du behøver ikke være gourmet-kok, men du skal have styr på basale køkkenrutiner, kunne arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en del af fællesskabet. Det vigtigste for os er din motivation, din ansvarsfølelse og din måde at møde andre mennesker på.

  • Du har erfaring fra køkken, kantine, café eller lignende
  • Du har kendskab til grundlæggende køkkenhygiejne og arbejdsmiljø
  • Du er mødestabil, struktureret og kan skabe ro og overblik i køkkenet
  • Du trives i et miljø med borgere med særlige behov og møder alle med respekt
  • Du kan samarbejde med forskellige faggrupper og kommunikerer klart og venligt
  • Du er nysgerrig på at lære nyt og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med os
  • Du skal kunne arbejde effektivt 12 timer pr. uge
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen aflønnes efter gældende overenskomst. Det forventede lønniveau oplyses inden en eventuel samtale og afhænger af erfaring og kvalifikationer.

Vil du vide mere?
Er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Sussi Hartvig Grundvig Qvist på 61 20 78 59.

Sådan sender du din ansøgning
Hvis du kan se dig selv som køkkenmedarbejder på Botilbuddet Sedenhuse og har lyst til et job med mening, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Send din ansøgning og dit CV elektronisk via vores online rekrutteringssystem, og vedhæft gerne relevante dokumenter, der viser din erfaring fra køkkenarbejde. Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende, og indkalder til samtaler, efterhånden som vi modtager spændende profiler.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:

We believe that new (data) technology and techniques will help us in better serving our customers. Therefore we invest in a cloud based Intelligence Infrastructure with a Data lake at its core. In the Data lake you get the freedom to develop and test your data streams, publication sets, models, based on streams of data that arrive automatically. Both linear and logistic models and the more complex neural networks can be applied, as long as these models can be brought into production and deliver added value to the customer. Role

title: Lead Environmental Construction Specialist 2
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Environmental Construction Specialist 2 based in United States.

This is a field-focused environmental compliance role supporting major construction projects and permitted worksites.
You will help ensure construction activities remain aligned with environmental permits, regulatory requirements, and project commitments.
The role involves working directly with site managers, contractors, inspectors, clients, and regulatory stakeholders.
You will oversee environmental inspections, erosion and sediment controls, waterbody and wetland crossings, restoration, waste management, and spill prevention activities.
Your expertise will help identify risks early, resolve compliance issues, and maintain strong environmental performance throughout construction.
The position offers the opportunity to contribute to diverse projects while providing technical guidance, training, and regulatory support.
The primary assignment is expected to be near Point Pleasant, West Virginia, with potential long-term field assignments depending on project and client needs.

Accountabilities

  • Monitor construction activities along pipeline rights-of-way, access roads, staging areas, and other permitted workspaces to verify compliance with environmental requirements.
  • Ensure construction activities remain consistent with environmental permits, mitigation measures, approved plans, environmental procedures, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Conduct and document routine environmental inspections covering erosion and sediment controls, waterbody and wetland crossings, topsoil segregation, vegetation clearing, revegetation, waste handling, spill prevention, and restoration.
  • Confirm that construction remains within approved rights-of-way, environmental buffers, access routes, and other designated boundaries.

  • Work with contractors and subcontractors to resolve deficiencies and verify timely completion and closeout of environmental action items.
  • Maintain accurate daily reports, inspection records, photographs, permit documentation, agency correspondence, training records, and environmental tracking logs.
  • Support environmental orientation and awareness training for site personnel, contractors, and other project stakeholders.
  • Participate in pre-job meetings, construction planning sessions, environmental reviews, and coordination meetings with project teams and clients.
  • Provide concise daily and weekly reporting on environmental performance, outstanding issues, emerging trends, and upcoming compliance requirements.
  • Monitor and support applications for environmental permits, including air, water, and waste permits.
  • Assist with the development and review of compliance plans designed to address identified environmental issues.
  • Provide technical guidance and training to project personnel regarding environmental regulations, permitting requirements, and compliance procedures.
  • Support project teams with environmental permitting, compliance matters, risk identification, and regulatory interpretation.
  • Stay current with environmental regulations, regulatory developments, and industry best practices while promoting a proactive culture focused on protecting people, the public, property, and the environment.

    • 15+ years of professional experience in environmental permitting and compliance, including substantial hands-on field experience with environmental compliance activities.
    • Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local environmental regulations, including requirements associated with the Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act, and RCRA.

    • Ability to independently assess situations, think creatively and analytically, and make timely, sound decisions in dynamic construction settings.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate requirements, findings, corrective actions, and recommendations clearly.
    • Strong presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide guidance and training to employees, contractors, and project stakeholders.
