title: Software Developer, Intermediate
description:
Salary Range: $90,000.00 To $100,000.00 Annually

Cellula is looking to add an Intermediate Software Developer to its Engineering team to support product development and project delivery.

Cellula Robotics Ltd. is a world-leading marine technology company focused on changing the paradigm of subsea survey, science and security through modular, long range, autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) systems. Our company is growing and is transitioning from building mostly one-of-a-kind prototypes to completing the development of our four core products and will be delivering multiples of those products to our customers. Our products are configured for each client to deliver required capabilities to the end-user. We are committed to producing sustainable solutions for the defense, mineral exploration, and energy sectors driven by innovation and industry knowledge. We’re looking for enthusiastic and energetic people to join us in this growth and transition.

At Cellula we believe in collaboration, innovation, adaptability and reliability. These values are woven through all our products and how we do business. Our products are designed to be solutions to the challenges and capability needs of our clients, which often requires developing new capabilities and subsystems unique to a particular application. These systems are designed, built, and tested in-house by a skilled team of engineers, technicians, and support staff. People are at the heart of our business, and we pride ourselves on having a team-based workplace and building partnerships to solve the most difficult challenges in ocean technology. We believe in learning and innovating by doing. We send staff along with our products into the field to learn from our clients which informs our innovation.

As an Intermediate Software Developer, you’ll leave your mark across Cellula’s products and leverage your experience to take ownership over the software development of a system. You’ll get to see your work becomes widely used across multiple units and different products which are delivered to clients all over the world. You’ll be a force sustaining a positive team culture while contributing your experience and skills to mentor junior engineers in their design efforts. You’ll take part in a product or system’s design, development, testing, and support. You’ll get to participate in sea trials, attend system deliveries to clients, and see how the systems you designed are operated in the field. The ideal candidate has experience in subsea technology such as AUVs, acoustics, ROVs, or similar systems, or has experience in adjacent industries like robotics or other low volume high mix engineering where systems have undergone the transition from prototype to product.

As a company, we offer team members a chance to grow professionally. Our office is a casual, collaborative environment where you will be able to learn about our state-of-the-art systems from technical experts. We’re excited for you to contribute your experience and make a positive impact on how we grow. In addition, we offer flexible work hours, benefits, and competitive compensation. This position is primarily an on-site position with some limited flexibility for remote work.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Define requirements and specification for software functionality and behaviors.
  • Design software architecture, algorithms, and user and device interfaces to support autonomous operations and mission execution
  • Analyze software performance, reliability, and scalability through testing and simulation.
  • Develop, integrate, and manage software for in-water autonomous operation, mission planning, and human machine interaction
  • Define and conduct software testing, including unit testing, integration testing, and validation against simulated and real-world scenarios.
  • Provide technical support for software applications, including bug fixes, feature enhancements, and operator training.
  • Software configuration management and quality management.
  • Assist in overall vehicle system integration, troubleshooting, and testing.
  • Provide technical support through all phases of a project.
  • Create documentation and training material and provide training to Cellula team members and clients.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Degree in related field
  • Minimum 3 years working experience in a relevant or related field.
  • Working experience developing software for hardware applications.
  • Proficient with Real-time Linux, ROS, C++, and Python.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Software configuration management experience.
  • Analytical, thorough, resourceful, and detail oriented.
  • Team and customer service focused.
  • Self-motivated, hardworking, flexible.
  • Experience in the subsea industry or with subsea devices.
  • Experience operating and piloting unmanned underwater vehicles.
  • LUA programming experience.
  • Cybersecurity experience.
  • Registered P.Eng. with EGBC.
  • ISO9001 quality control.

Reports to: Software Engineering Manager

At InMobi Advertising, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how billions of users connect with content, commerce, and brands worldwide. To learn more, visit www.inmobi.com


Role Overview

We are hiring a Tech Lead / SDE IV to anchor and grow our Data Engineering capability within our Demand-Side Platform (DSP). This is a high-impact, technically hands-on leadership role at the intersection of real-time data infrastructure, programmatic advertising, and scalable backend systems. You will own the design and delivery of pipelines that power bidding intelligence, audience targeting, campaign analytics, and attribution — processing billions of bid-stream events daily. Alongside your data engineering mandate, you will architect and contribute to backend microservices that sit at the core of our DSP stack, including integrations with SSPs, ad exchanges, and identity resolution platforms. You will mentor a team of engineers, drive technical direction, and collaborate closely with product, ML, and growth functions to turn data into a true competitive advantage.


Key Responsibilities:

Data Stack:

▸ Design and own end-to-end data pipelines — batch and real-time — handling bid requests, win/loss events, impression logs, click streams, and conversion signals at scale.

▸ Build and maintain our data lakehouse architecture (ingestion → storage → serving layer) optimized for low-latency DSP analytics and ML feature generation.

▸ Define standards for data quality, lineage, observability, and SLA adherence across all data products.

▸ Own and evolve our StarRocks deployment for real-time analytical queries — schema design, ingestion patterns, and query optimisation for DSP reporting workloads.

▸ Drive FinOps discipline across the data platform — track compute and storage costs, enforce resource quotas, identify optimisation opportunities, and report on unit economics.

▸ Establish and lead Data Governance practices: metadata management, data cataloguing, access control policies, PII classification, and data retention standards compliant with GDPR and CCPA.


Backend Microservices:

▸ Contribute to and review the design of backend services that power DSP functionality — bid shading, pacing, budget management, and reporting APIs.

▸ Architect data contracts and event schemas between microservices, ensuring consistency across the bid request lifecycle.

▸ Champion best practices in API design, service reliability (SLOs, circuit breakers, retries), and observability (distributed tracing, structured logging, metrics).

▸ Collaborate with the bidder team on low-latency data reads (Aerospike, Cassandra, or similar) for real-time targeting signal lookups.


Technical Leadership

▸ Lead architecture reviews, set engineering standards, and drive adoption of best practices across the data and backend engineering teams.

▸ Mentor SDE II/III engineers through code reviews, design sessions, and pair programming; grow the next generation of technical leaders.

▸ Partner with ML engineers on the full model lifecycle — feature engineering pipelines, offline training data generation, experiment tracking, and model serving infrastructure.

▸ Translate complex business requirements (campaign KPIs, ROAS, viewability, brand safety) into robust technical designs.

▸ Own the technical roadmap for data infrastructure — capacity planning, migration strategies, and build vs. buy decisions.


Required Skills & Qualifications


Experience & Education

▸ 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years focused on data engineering or large-scale data systems.

▸ Prior experience in ad-tech, programmatic advertising, or real-time bidding (RTB) environments strongly preferred.

▸ Experience in ML engineering — feature engineering, building offline training pipelines, or collaborating closely on model productionisation — is preferred.

▸ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.


Data Engineering (Core)

▸ Deep expertise in distributed stream processing frameworks — Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, or Apache Spark Structured Streaming.

▸ Strong command of SQL and experience optimizing complex analytical queries at petabyte scale.

▸ Hands-on experience with real-time analytical databases, particularly StarRocks; familiarity with Snowflake or ClickHouse is a plus.

▸ Proficiency with workflow orchestration tools: Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

▸ Solid understanding of data modelling — dimensional modelling, OBT patterns, and eventdriven schemas relevant to ad impression and attribution data.

▸ Familiarity with open table formats: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.


Backend & Systems

▸ Proficiency in Python (primary) and/or Java/Scala for building production-grade services and data processing jobs.

▸ Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and/or gRPC-based microservices.

▸ Working knowledge of low-latency data stores (Aerospike, Cassandra) used for real-time lookups in the bidding path.

▸ Comfortable with containerised deployments on Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or similar).

title: Real Property Analyst
description:
Position Title: Real Property Analyst

Reports to: Operations Manager

Location: Fort Bragg, NC

Work Schedule: Full-Time, Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt


Position Summary: Aldevra is currently seeking a qualified Real Property Analyst to support the United States Army Reserve (USAR) in Fort Bragg, NC. We are looking for someone who brings a positive attitude, strong attention to detail, clear communication, and a willingness to jump in where needed. The right person will also connect with Aldevra’s core values of SOAR: Strong Integrity and Ethics, Outstanding Teamwork, Accountability-Driven, and Relentless Pursuit of Quality.


This position is contingent upon contract award.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Support a distributed, forward deployed Real Property execution model in which contractor personnel are embedded at designated Readiness Divisions (RDs), the 9th Mission Support Command (MSC), and Army Reserve Funded Installations (ARFIs).
  • Embedded personnel shall provide daily technical execution support to local Realty staff while reporting strategically to the USARC G-3/5/7 Engineers Directorate, which serves as the Accountable Organization for Army Reserve real property.
  • Shall coordinate daily activities with local DPW Realty staff and shall submit standardized monthly reports directly to the USARC G-3/5/7 Engineers Directorate to ensure the Accountable Organization maintains visibility of real property execution across all supported locations.
  • Work directly with Realty staff at the local Directorate of Public Works (DPW) to execute day-to-day real property transactions. This includes updating the General Fund Enterprise Business System (GFEBS) with acquisitions, disposals, and capital improvements.
  • Plan and execute physical inventories of real property assets within their assigned installation/region footprint in accordance with (IAW) Army Regulation (AR) 405-45.
  • Identify "found on site" assets, research historical documentation (such as as-builts and transfer memos), and prepare DD Form 1354s for capitalization.
  • Submit a Monthly Status Report (MSR) directly to the USARC G3/5/7 Engineers Directorate Real Property Branch.
  • Prepare "Health Check" briefings for USARC leadership regarding the real property status of their assigned Readiness Division (RD)/Army Reserve Functional Installation (ARFI).
  • Execute USARC’s phased remediation model to address identified InSITE discrepancies.
  • Support remediation of approximately 625 critical issues across 191 sites, prioritizing assets per USARC direction (>$1M or as directed). Phase 1 shall address administrative fixes (UIC mismatches, FAC/CATCODE corrections, historic status, disposal status) primarily via desktop actions. Phase 2 shall address substantive fixes requiring multi-step validation and on-site measurements to correct quantity errors (square footage/acreage) and verify sustainment and operational status.
  • Provide a monthly InSITE Progress Report included in the MSR. Surge Support and Special Missions (Fly-Away Capability) The Contractor shall maintain a fly-away Mobile Support Team capability to provide surge support, audits, and urgent inventories at locations outside assigned duty stations upon direction of the COR.
  • Reconcile the Universe of Transactions (UoT), resolve Unmatched Transactions (UMTs), and correct Intermediate Document (IDOC) failures between GFEBS and HQIIS (Headquarters Installation Information System), and shall provide weekly exception logs and corrective action plans to the COR.
  • Provide support for HQDA and USARC Real Property-related taskers, G-4 Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) sample testing, and Army audit submissions. This includes assisting in the retrieval and preparation of documentation to address instances of non-submittal or constraints in obtaining required paperwork.
  • All other duties as assigned.

About Us

Aldevra was founded in 2009 by current President & CEO Rodney Marshall, a U.S. Marine Corps veteran and minority entrepreneur. The company began by selling foodservice equipment to the federal government and later expanded to include medical equipment and professional services, helping to meet a broader range of customer needs. Today, Aldevra is recognized as a top foodservice equipment dealer in the U.S., specializing in federal government sales while also growing its commercial and e-commerce customer base. Its professional services division provides federal agencies with healthcare professionals, construction and facilities managers and technicians, and administrative support. Whether it's equipment or staffing, Aldevra is committed to delivering high-quality products and timely service at the best value.


Recent accolades include:

  • Great Place to Work®
  • 2026 Military Friendly® Employer Gold designation
  • 2025 HIRE Vets Medallion Award
  • VETS Indexes 5-Star Employer for 2026 Employer Awards
  • Department of Defense Military Spouse Employment Partnership Small Business Partner
  • Army Partnership for Your Success (PaYS) Partner #911
  • Foodservice Equipment & Supplies magazine 2026 Distribution Giants list
  • Foodservice Equipment Reports 2025 Top Dealer
  • RATIONAL 2025 Premium Partner Award
  • ENERGY STAR® Partner

Learn more about us at aldevra.com.

title: Mathematics  Fellow/University of Pennsylvania Boarding School Teaching Residency Master’s in Teaching Program for 2027-2028
description:
The Lawrenceville School, an independent boarding and day school located in central New Jersey, seeks dynamic individuals to join our community as a member of the Independent School Teaching Residency (ISTR) program, a two-year teaching fellowship offered in conjunction with the University of Pennsylvania Graduate School of Education (PennGSE), beginning in June 2027.


Candidates must be able to teach a range of courses from Algebra 1 and geometry through multivariable calculus and statistics.

ISTR Fellows join their departments at Lawrenceville as fully engaged members of the faculty, teaching their own classes from the start. Fellows will fulfill co-curricular responsibilities (in athletics, performing arts, or publications) and residential duties, including being a member of a House team, chaperoning student events, and advising a group of students in year two.


Fellows are paired with a mentor teacher in their discipline who offers support and coaching through regular classroom observations and ongoing conversations about life at Lawrenceville. Regular meetings with the cohort of eight fellows provide collegiality and a strong peer group of early career educators.


Teaching fellows are an integral part of a vibrant campus life. Our community lives, works, and eats together, all in enticing proximity to the variety of attractions in Philadelphia and New York.


Teaching fellows are required to live in school housing (basic utilities included). They are provided three meals per day in the school dining center and have access to athletic facilities.


If hired by Lawrenceville, fellows join their cohort at PennGSE, where they complete a rigorous two year course of study led by PennGSE professors and academic leaders from other boarding schools in pursuit of a Masters of Education from PennGSE. Throughout the year, fellows participate in regular distance learning sessions and gather in person four times–in June, October, January and April–on the UPenn campus in Philadelphia and at various host school locations around New England.


Upon completion of the two year fellowship, recent graduates have found desirable teaching and coaching opportunities at both boarding and day schools across the country (including Lawrenceville), as well as have gone on to pursue additional advanced degrees or consultant work.


The ideal candidate values hard work, learning and growth as an early career educator, and wants to collaborate to build community, connection and belonging for the students and faculty at Lawrenceville.


Essential Responsibilities

Teaching (two different preparations/courses)

  • In year one, two sections in Fall term and three sections in the Winter and Spring
  • In year two, four sections in Fall term and in either Winter or Spring, three in the other

Residential

  • Supervise a student dormitory as a member of a duty team one night a week from 6:00 - 11:30 pm.
  • Participate in Saturday programming as scheduled by the School.
  • Provide weekend chaperone coverage up to twice per term.
  • In addition, in year two, serve as an academic advisor to a group of six to eight students.
  • Live on campus with a cohort of other fellows and participate in the residential life of the School

Co-Curricular

  • Coach at least one season of interscholastic athletics
  • Lead/Co-lead one additional term of co-curricular activity (athletic, performing arts, community service, student publications, experiential learning)

Other duties as assigned

title: Analyst - Commercial Property
description:
Our team.
In Commercial Banking (Property), we prioritize meeting client needs, serving businesses with commercial debt limits of up to $100 million for property investment and development, construction services and real estate agents.

Our clients are exceptional businesses, and our experienced banking professionals excel in providing property financing solutions, transactional banking, risk management, and international trade support.

We are seeking an Analyst to join our Commercial Banking Property team in Adelaide. As an Analyst, you will play a key role in assessing commercial property and construction lending opportunities by preparing high-quality credit submissions, undertaking detailed financial analysis and providing well-reasoned recommendations to support lending decisions.

Working closely with Relationship Executives, Risk and Product Partners, you will analyse client financial performance, assess transaction risks and opportunities, and help structure lending solutions across a diverse portfolio of property investors and developers.   • Maintain high standards of data quality, compliance and reporting in line with policy, risk and governance expectations
  • Partner closely with Relationship Executives, providing market research, client insights and analytical support to drive effective deal origination and structuring

About you

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • Strong financial analysis skills, with sound attention to detail

title: Senior Data Engineer [T500-28803]
description:

CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the centre of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.


What CIBC India Offers:

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

  • We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
  • Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide.
  • We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.


What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):

The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and supporting scalable data pipelines, data products, and integration solutions that enable reliable analytics, reporting, risk management, and business decision-making. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Databricks as a must-have capability, including development of ETL pipelines, data processing using Spark/PySpark, and implementation of modern data lakehouse patterns. The incumbent translates business requirements into robust technical solutions, leveraging Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and modern data engineering practices. Considerable judgement and autonomy are exercised in day-to-day tasks, including ingestion, transformation, storage, data quality validation, performance tuning, troubleshooting and delivery of trusted data products.

At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.


How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):

Data Engineering and Databricks Development:

  • Design, develop, test, and support scalable data pipelines using Azure Databricks, Spark/PySpark, SQL, OpenSharing (Delta Sharing) and related cloud data services.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows that ingest, transform, validate, and publish data for analytics, reporting, and downstream applications.


Data Platform Implementation:

  • Participate in technical design, development, integration, and implementation of modern data solutions across cloud, data lake, warehouse, and enterprise data platforms.


Data Quality, Reliability, and Technical Skills:

  • Work closely with business, technology, and data partners to understand data requirements, source system impacts, and downstream consumption needs.
  • Implement data quality checks, monitoring, validation controls, and troubleshooting practices to ensure data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and reliability.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory, privacy, information security, and data governance standards in the design and operation of data pipelines.
  • Provide technical guidance on data engineering design decisions, performance optimization, production support, and operational resiliency.


Relationship Management:

  • Build strong relationships and partnerships with technical team members, clients, vendors, and peers.
  • Lead discussions, listen, and ask questions to ensure problems/issues are identified and resolved.
  • Communicate detailed information in an impactful way, verbally and in writing.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:

  • Collaborates with peers inside and outside the work unit to identify, discuss, and resolve business and technical issues related to data engineering and platform delivery.
  • Interacts regularly with business partners, data owners, technology teams, governance teams, and vendors to clarify requirements, exchange information, and resolve data-related issues.
  • Works closely with internal clients to ensure data pipelines, data products, and supporting processes operate effectively, efficiently, and securely.


COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls.


AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:

As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to data pipelines, data processing patterns, and supporting business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency, data reliability, and effectiveness.


Experience:

  • 5+ years of data engineering experience, including hands-on Databricks experience as a must-have requirement


Who You Are (skills/qualifications):

Must Have Skills:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, Data Integration Developer, or similar role.
  • Must have hands-on experience designing and building enterprise data pipelines using Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, and Delta Lake
  • Strong experience with Spark/PySpark, SQL, Python, ETL development, data ingestion, transformation, and pipeline orchestration.
  • Experience with Azure data services, including Unity Catalog, Azure Data Lake Storage, and cloud-based data integration patterns.
  • Good understanding of data lakehouse concepts, data modelling, data quality controls, metadata management, and secure data handling.
  • Experience with production support, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and operational resiliency for data pipelines.
  • Ability to manage relationships with technology, data governance, and business partners.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain data engineering concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Good to Have:

  • Experience with AutoSys, GitHub, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
  • Banking domain expertise, particularly in risk management

By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: Director, International Controllership
description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. The Director, Record to Report Controllership, will provide end-to-end leadership for the Record-to-Report accounting and controllership activities. This role will be based in Hyderabad and will be responsible for leading a large controllership team, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting, strong balance sheet governance, effective internal controls, and successful delivery of close, reporting, audit support, and compliance requirements. This is a critical leadership role within the Accounting COE and will play a key part in building, transitioning, stabilizing, and scaling controllership activities including transition from other regions. The Director will partner closely with WBD Controllership, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Global Business Services (GBS), and other global and regional stakeholders to deliver high-quality financial outcomes at scale. The role requires a strong controllership mindset, deep technical accounting knowledge, proven people leadership, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed, global environment. The successful candidate will be expected to lead transition of accounting work to WBD’s Hyderabad center, drive operational discipline, process standardization, automation, continuous improvement, and a culture of accountability, quality, and compliance. This role will manage ~ 5 Senior Manager level accounting positions in Hyderabad and will oversee a broader team of ~50 accounting positions, supporting the controllership function. Your normal hours of work are 3:00 p.m IST. to 11:00 p.m IST. Monday to Friday. However, due to business needs, you may be required to work outside these hours and on holidays for the proper performance of your role without any additional pay. Subject to any applicable laws, the Company reserves the right to change your hours of work where this is essential to business needs and upon reasonable notice to you Your Role Accountabilities… Controllership, Close and Reporting Leadership • Lead and oversee RTR accounting and controllership activities • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with applicable accounting and reporting requirements. • Supervise intercompany reconciliations and resolve out-of-balance items with WBD counterparts. • Ensure strong balance sheet governance, account reconciliation quality, variance analysis, management reporting, and timely issue resolution. • Review and analyze financial results against expectations and provide meaningful insights to controllership and business stakeholders. • Review and sign-off monthly and quarterly Balance Sheets, Income Statements, and Cash Flow Statements, including footnotes disclosures and supplemental schedules, ensuring completeness and accuracy. • Ensure accounting implications of business transactions are assessed timely, including coordination with Technical Accounting teams where required. • Responsible for system/manual reconciliations between the Business Unit boundary systems and SAP, ensuring data consistency and accuracy • Continuously identify, design, and implement process improvements and standardizations across areas of responsibility to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. This includes special projects and serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) as needed. Governance, Controls and Audit Readiness • Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure compliance with SOX requirements. • Partner with internal and external auditors to support audit planning, walkthroughs, testing, information requests, and timely closure of audit matters. • Drive discipline around documentation, evidence retention, review controls, issue tracking, and remediation. • Proactively identify financial reporting, compliance, and control risks and ensure appropriate escalation and resolution. Transition and Operating Model Buildout • Lead the transition, stabilization, and scaling of accounting activities being insourced from other regions into the Hyderabad Accounting COE. • Establish clear ownership, process documentation, KPIs, service levels, governance routines, and escalation mechanisms. • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to ensure business continuity, knowledge transfer, and successful transition outcomes. • Build sustainable team capacity and capability to support the future-state controllership operating model. Stakeholder Management and Business Partnership • Act as the key connection point between the Hyderabad Accounting COE and Controllership, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, GBS, and other business stakeholders. • Develop strong relationships with global and regional finance leaders and provide responsive, practical, and technically sound accounting support. • Collaborate with leadership to set department priorities and assist in problem resolution • Understand the business model and operating drivers to provide informed controllership advice and support decision-making. • Ensure effective communication of accounting decisions, process impacts, deadlines, and risks across relevant stakeholder groups. Transformation, Process Excellence and Systems • Drive process standardization, simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across RTR activities. • Identify opportunities to improve close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness, and team productivity. • Support system implementations, ERP-related changes, integrations, reorganizations, and other finance transformation initiatives. • Lead process improvement initiatives in partnership with controllership, technology, GBS, and transformation teams. People Leadership and Talent Development • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Senior Managers and accounting professionals. • Set clear goals, performance expectations, priorities, and accountability standards. • Build strong succession depth and develop controllership capability within the Hyderabad COE. • Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, integrity, continuous improvement, and high-quality execution. • Assess workload, resource requirements, and capacity needs, and recommend changes as required. Qualifications & Experience… Required ● Chartered Accountant, CPA, or equivalent professional accounting qualifications. ● At least 18 years of progressive accounting, controllership, and financial reporting with at least 8 years of supervisory role. ● Strong experience in RTR, close, balance sheet governance, financial reporting, audit support, and internal controls. • Deep understanding of US GAAP, IFRS, and SOX control requirements, including intercompany and foreign currency accounting. ● Proven experience leading large accounting teams, including leaders/managers. ● Prior controllership experience in a multinational, matrixed, global organization. ● Strong stakeholder management experience with the ability to influence senior finance and business leaders. ● Demonstrated ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, deliver against tight deadlines, and manage composure under deadline pressure. ● Strong analytical, problem-solving, present solution, and decision-making skills. ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills with high level transparency ● High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and commitment to quality and compliance. ● Able to work effectively across various time zones. Desired • Experience in media, entertainment, studio, production, distribution, or related industries. • Experience with large-scale insourcing programs. • Experience with SAP or other large ERP platforms. • Experience leading finance transformation, automation, process standardization, or system implementation initiatives. • MBA or master’s degree in accounting, finance, or business preferred. Leadership Attributes • Strong controllership leader with sound judgment and high integrity. • Comfortable building structure in a changing environment. • Able to balance technical accounting depth with practical business partnership. • A leader who can build capability, coach teams, and create accountability. • A transformation-minded leader who can simplify, standardize, and scale processes. • Confident working with senior stakeholders across regions and functions. • Proactive in identifying risks, resolving issues, and driving closure.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:

title: Senior Data Scientist - Product
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Scientist - Product based in United States.

This is an opportunity for a senior data science professional to shape product strategy through rigorous, actionable analysis.
You will partner closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to solve high-impact product questions.
The role combines exploratory analytics, experimentation, statistical modeling, and product performance optimization.
You will help establish reliable analytics foundations that enable confident, data-driven decisions at scale.
Your insights will influence user experience, product adoption, activation, and the evolution of both existing and emerging products.
You may also support early-stage 0-to-1 initiatives by defining success metrics and interpreting initial product signals.
This is a fast-paced, remote environment where strong product judgment, ownership, and analytical thinking can translate directly into measurable business impact.

Accountabilities:

  • Translate business and product needs into rigorous analyses, actionable insights, and recommendations that improve product performance and user experience.
  • Partner with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to identify critical questions, frame analytical approaches, and guide data-informed decisions.
  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analyses, including cohorting, time-series analysis, funnel analysis, experimentation, statistical analysis, and machine learning where appropriate.
  • Build, maintain, and improve scalable analytics infrastructure, ensuring data collection, reporting, and analytical outputs are reliable, accurate, and fit for purpose.
  • Establish and promote best practices for data analysis, measurement, reporting, and interpretation across product teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve activation, engagement, conversion, and other key product outcomes, translating findings into practical initiatives.
  • Support product optimization as well as selected 0-to-1 launches by defining meaningful metrics and analyzing early-stage product performance.
  • Use SQL, Python, R, SAS, and related analytical tools to investigate complex product questions and influence product strategy.
  • Work with product analytics platforms and event data to understand end-to-end user journeys, funnels, and behavioral patterns.
  • Communicate findings clearly through recommendations, presentations, and reports tailored to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Promote a culture of data-driven decision-making, continuous experimentation, and measurable product improvement.
  • Take ownership of analytical projects from problem definition through execution, recommendation, and measurement of impact.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, or another relevant analytical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
    • Strong professional experience in product analytics, data science, or a closely related data-focused role, with demonstrated influence on product strategy and decision-making.
    • Deep hands-on experience with exploratory analysis involving cohorting, time-series analysis, funnel analysis, and product optimization.
    • Expert-level proficiency in SQL, A/B testing, statistical analysis, machine learning, and analytical programming languages such as Python, R, or SAS.
    • Experience building and maintaining dependable analytics infrastructure and ensuring the quality and integrity of data used for decision-making.
    • Experience with product analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Heap, or Mixpanel and the ability to analyze event-level data and end-to-end customer journeys.
    • Strong ability to transform complex quantitative findings into clear, practical recommendations that cross-functional teams can act upon.
    • Experience supporting SaaS or product-led growth environments is highly valuable, particularly around activation metrics, user journeys, and identifying opportunities to improve product adoption.
    • Exposure to 0-to-1 product development and early-stage product measurement is a plus.
    • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business stakeholders.
    • Strong product sense, business judgment, accountability, adaptability, and a continuous-learning mindset.
    • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and analytical decisions may need to be made with imperfect information.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive total cash compensation, with annual base salary and bonus considerations.
      • Tier 1 salary range: $160,000–$200,000 USD for San Francisco, New York City, and Seattle.
      • Tier 2 salary range: $140,000–$176,000 USD for other U.S. locations.
      • Equity opportunities.
      • 401(k) plan.
      • At least 10 paid holidays per year.
      • Flexible paid time off and parental leave.
      • Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
      • FSA/HSA options.
      • Life, AD&D, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance.
      • Employee assistance and wellbeing programs.
      • Global travel coverage.
      • Opportunities for professional growth, autonomy, experimentation, and meaningful product impact.
      • Remote work environment with a strong emphasis on ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and the use of AI and automation to work more effectively.

title: GL Claims Specialist

This fully remote role offers the opportunity to take ownership of a diverse portfolio of General Liability claims from initial report through resolution.
You will apply strong claims expertise to assess coverage, liability, damages, and overall exposure.
The position combines independent decision-making with regular collaboration across customers, agents, attorneys, underwriters, and other partners.
You will investigate complex claim details, establish appropriate reserves, negotiate settlements, and drive timely outcomes.
The role requires sound judgment, strong communication, and a commitment to fair and effective claim resolution.
You will also identify recovery and potential fraud opportunities while maintaining accurate and compliant claim records.
This is an excellent opportunity to deepen your General Liability expertise while making a meaningful impact on customer and business outcomes.

Accountabilities

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of General Liability claims through investigation, evaluation, negotiation, and final resolution.
  • Investigate coverage, liability, and damages by gathering and assessing information from insureds, claimants, witnesses, attorneys, and other relevant parties.
  • Analyze policy provisions and prepare required claim correspondence in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and established guidelines.
  • Evaluate claim exposures, establish and maintain appropriate reserves, and negotiate fair and timely settlements within delegated authority.
  • Coordinate with defense counsel, experts, and external service providers on complex or litigated matters.
  • Identify and pursue appropriate recovery opportunities, including contribution and subrogation.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely claim documentation, payments, and expense approvals within claims management systems.
  • Build effective working relationships with insureds, agents, underwriters, and internal stakeholders to provide a responsive and high-quality claims experience.
  • Recognize potential indicators of fraud and escalate or refer matters according to established procedures.

    • Five or more years of commercial General Liability claims handling experience preferred.
    • Experience evaluating and resolving bodily injury and third-party property damage claims preferred.
    • Experience handling General Liability claims across Southern U.S. jurisdictions is preferred.
    • Strong knowledge of claims investigation, coverage analysis, exposure evaluation, negotiation, and resolution practices.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with customers, attorneys, agents, underwriters, and other business partners.

title: Sr Engineer, Data [T500-28676]
description:
About T-Mobile:

T-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS), headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is America’s supercharged Un-carrier, connecting millions through its strong nationwide network and flagship brands, T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile. Customers benefit from an unmatched combination of value, quality, and exceptional service experience.


About TMUS Global Solutions:

TMUS Global Solutions is a world-class technology powerhouse accelerating the company’s global digital transformation. With a culture built on growth, inclusivity, and global collaboration, the teams here drive innovation at scale, powered by bold thinking.


Sr. Data Engineer

About the Role:

The Data Engineer (Level III) designs, builds, and operates the data pipelines and lakehouse data products that power P&SC intelligence across device supply chain, reverse logistics, procurement, network supply chain, and real-time control tower capabilities. Operating within a squad focused on a specific SC domain or cross-cutting platform function, the Data Engineer is a hands-on technical contributor who builds to production quality, owns pipeline reliability and KTLO, and contributes to the engineering standard of the team.


What You’ll Do:

  • Design and build production-grade data pipelines spanning source ingestion, bronze landing, silver transformation, and gold-layer data product delivery within the squad's domain scope.
  • Own pipeline KTLO (Keep the Lights On) for assigned data products, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and ongoing reliability improvements.
  • Implement data ingestion patterns for assigned source systems including batch file ingestion, API-based ingestion, and event-driven streaming (Kafka, Azure Event Hub) depending on squad scope.
  • Apply medallion architecture (bronze, silver, gold) and Fabric IQ certification standards consistently across all data product builds.
  • Collaborate with System Analysts to implement field-level transformations, business rule logic, and data quality checks as specified in product requirements documentation.
  • Participate in and contribute to pipeline design reviews, ensuring solutions align with the organization's Databricks and Fabric engineering standards.
  • Support the migration and deprecation of legacy platforms including SCOpsBI SQL Server and SAP boundary systems, following the organization's extract, validate, rebuild, cutover, and decommission pattern.
  • Write and maintain comprehensive pipeline documentation including data lineage, transformation logic, SLA definitions, and dependency maps.
  • Contribute to the organization's DevOps and engineering reliability practices including CI/CD pipeline setup, testing frameworks, and incident runbooks.
  • Support and collaborate with junior data engineers within the squad, sharing knowledge and providing guidance on day-to-day engineering tasks.


Must Have Skills:

  • 5-8 years of data engineering experience with a track record delivering production Grade data pipelines in enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience on Python, PySpark, Spark SQL, and T-SQL for pipeline development and transformation logic.
  • Strong Proficiency in Azure Data Factory for building and maintaining ELT/ETL pipelines, including parameterization, triggers, linked services, and error handling
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and workflow orchestration.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt (Data Build Tools) writing models, tests, sources, and documentation within an established project structure
  • Solid SQL skills for data validation, transformation logic, and ad-hoc source system analysis.
  • Expert-level data modelling skills across 3NF, Dimensional (Kimball), and Data Vault 2.0 patterns
  • Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, including implementing checks, alerting on anomalies, and maintaining SLA-compliant pipeline health.
  • Experience with DevOps practices for data pipelines including version control (Git), CI/CD, and automated testing.
  • Agile or Scrum practitioner certification or equivalent
  • Ability to operate with moderate independence on complex technical problems, escalating appropriately and maintaining clear technical documentation.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with real-time streaming technologies including Kafka, Azure Event Hub, Delta Live Tables, or Spark Structured Streaming.
  • Working experience with Snowflake — table design, query performance tuning, views, stored procedures, and data loading patterns (Snow pipe, COPY INTO)
  • Experience with enterprise batch scheduling and orchestration tools such as Control-M or Autosys is a plus.
  • Experience with real-time streaming technologies including Kafka, Azure Event Hub, Delta Live Tables, or Spark Structured Streaming.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Azure Synapse Analytics; familiarity with Fabric IQ and One Lake is a plus.
  • Background in supply chain, reverse logistics, procurement, or network infrastructure data domains
  • Experience working within Agile delivery frameworks — including PI planning, sprint-level technical governance, and cross-squad dependency management
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude, and experience integrating AI/ML-ready data preparation into ETL/ELT pipeline design
  • Working knowledge of SOX and USGCI compliance requirements as they apply to enterprise data platform design and deployment
  • Microsoft Azure certifications — DP-203, AZ-305, DP-900, or the Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
  • Python development skills beyond PySpark, including utility scripting and framework contributions.

title: ESP DIFA Tech
description:
Position Summary

The ESP Reliability / DIFA Engineer supports the DIFA (Dismantle, Inspection, and Failure Analysis) process for Electric Submersible Pump (ESP) systems and is responsible for both the mechanical execution of teardowns and the technical analysis of failures. This role performs equipment dismantling, inspection, documentation, and Root Cause Failure Analysis to identify failure mechanisms, support customer failure reviews, and drive continuous reliability improvements.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Perform dismantling and teardown of returned ESP equipment, including pumps, gas separators, seal sections, motors, sensors, and associated components
  • Follow established DIFA procedures, teardown sequences, and safety practices
  • Maintain proper identification, labeling, and traceability of all equipment and components
  • Preserve failure evidence by avoiding cleaning, alteration, or modification unless instructed
  • Maintain dismantled components and wells in an organized and controlled manner
  • Coordinate and support ESP teardown scheduling
  • Conduct detailed inspections of ESP components to identify damage, wear, corrosion, or abnormal conditions
  • Document teardown and inspection findings through written observations and photographic evidence
  • Develop Dismantle & Inspection (D&I), Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Failure Analysis reports
  • Perform Root Cause Failure Analyses using industry standards and reliability engineering best practices
  • Identify recurring failure modes and contributing operational or environmental factors
  • Provide statistical analysis of ESP performance, including run life, failure trends, and root causes
  • Support the Reliability Manager with investigations, reporting, and technical analysis
  • Assist Sales teams during Customer Failure Reviews with technical findings and reliability conclusions
  • Communicate results clearly and professionally to internal teams and customers
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and reliability improvement strategies

title: Strategic Business Performance, Central Strategy & Operations
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Strategic Business Performance, Central Strategy & Operations based in the United States.

This is a senior, high-impact strategy and operations role at the intersection of data, product, finance, and business performance.
You’ll help create strategic clarity around the organization’s most important in-year goals and performance signals.
The role combines analytical depth with hands-on execution, requiring you to identify critical issues and help drive measurable improvements.
You’ll work across technical and customer-facing teams to turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into structured initiatives and actionable decisions.
Your work will directly influence product strategy, operational priorities, executive decision-making, and business growth.
You’ll partner closely with senior leaders while maintaining a strong connection to data, customer behavior, and product mechanics.
This is an environment for a technically minded strategist-operator who thrives on speed, ambiguity, rigor, and meaningful business impact.

Accountabilities

  • Define and maintain the key metrics that provide a high-signal view of in-year business performance, developing reporting disciplines that encourage rapid action rather than relying solely on traditional dashboards.
  • Lead high-priority deep dives and intervention projects to diagnose risks, identify root causes, unblock critical goals, and remain engaged through execution until performance measurably improves.
  • Translate long-term strategic priorities into actionable operational plans, breaking ambiguous opportunities across product, risk, marketing, and other functions into structured workstreams.
  • Prepare clear, decision-oriented materials for senior executives, synthesizing complex data and unstructured signals into concise diagnoses, recommendations, and business implications.
  • Partner with Product, Corporate Strategy, and other cross-functional teams to challenge assumptions, identify execution gaps, and connect external market dynamics with internal performance.
  • Analyze customer usage patterns, business trends, financial data, and product signals to uncover opportunities and risks that may not be immediately visible.
  • Facilitate senior stakeholder discussions and working sessions that create alignment, accelerate decisions, and drive meaningful action around business performance.
  • Develop creative solutions to complex business problems and influence the roadmaps and priorities of cross-functional teams.
  • Apply AI tools thoughtfully to improve analysis, decision-making, workflows, and operational efficiency while maintaining high standards of rigor and quality.
  • Build strong relationships with senior leaders and stakeholders, acting as a trusted strategic partner on complex and high-visibility business challenges.

    • Requirements

    • 12+ years of experience in product analytics, product strategy, strategic business performance, or similar roles within high-growth technology organizations.
    • Significant experience in Product Strategy, Product Management, GM-style, or business leadership roles where you owned a P&L, key business metric, or defined business outcome.
    • Demonstrated ability to use analytical insights to directly influence business growth, operational performance, or strategic outcomes.
    • Strong understanding of business models, customer behavior, product usage, and data-driven decision-making, with the curiosity to investigate signals and uncover non-obvious insights.
    • Strong product sense and sufficient technical understanding to grasp how software products are built, operated, and scaled.
    • Advanced analytical capabilities, including the ability to independently work with complex datasets using SQL, Python, R, or comparable tools.
    • Experience navigating ambiguous, cross-functional challenges and leading high-stakes initiatives involving senior stakeholders.
    • Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly and translate them into practical recommendations for executive and cross-functional audiences.
    • Proven ability to build trust with senior leaders and facilitate productive conversations that lead to decisions and measurable outcomes.
    • Experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen decision-making without compromising quality.
    • Experience influencing cross-functional roadmaps and developing creative solutions to complex organizational or product challenges.
    • Familiarity with fintech, payments, financial products, or complex financial systems is advantageous but not required.
    • Strong understanding of how product releases, policy changes, and marketing initiatives can affect user experience and downstream operational or support outcomes.
    • Intellectual curiosity, strategic judgment, resilience, and comfort operating in fast-paced environments where problems are complex and priorities evolve.

      • Benefits

      • Annual U.S. base salary range of $212,300–$318,500, with the final range determined based on experience, qualifications, location, and career level.
      • Potential equity compensation and company bonus opportunities.
      • 401(k) retirement plan.
      • Medical, dental, and vision benefits.
      • Wellness stipends and additional programs supporting employee well-being.
      • Flexible working arrangements, with office-assigned employees generally expected to spend at least 50% of their time each month in their local office or with users, depending on team and location.
      • Opportunities to work alongside experienced leaders and highly cross-functional teams on complex, high-impact business challenges.
      • An environment that values diverse perspectives, intellectual rigor, curiosity, integrity, and the willingness to challenge assumptions.
      • Encouragement to apply even when your career path does not perfectly match every listed qualification.

Position Summary: The Member Advisor is a multi-functional role that combines teller, personal banking, and lending responsibilities to deliver comprehensive financial services to our members. This position requires a proactive and friendly individual who can handle a variety of tasks, from processing transactions to offering financial advice and lending solutions. The Member Advisor plays a key role in enhancing member relationships and contributing to the overall success of the credit union.

Opportunity to join our team as a Member Advisor 1, 2, or 3 based on your experience and qualifications. This role offers a base salary plus incentives, as well as the potential for future promotion within the Member Advisor career path.

Location: 6034 Birch Lane , Nampa, ID 83687

Schedule: Average of 36-40 hours within a Monday through Saturday work week.

Monday – Friday 9:00 a.m. – 5:30 p.m.

Saturday 9:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m.

To help support a work-life balance, team members who work a Saturday shift may be scheduled for a full or half weekday off, based on business needs

Travel Requirements: Ability and willingness to travel up to 35 miles to provide coverage and collaborate with regional branches.


Member Service:

  • Proactively interact with members to build relationships of trust.
  • Provide excellent member service by greeting members warmly, identifying their needs, and offering appropriate solutions.
  • Assist members with account inquiries, transaction processing, and problem resolution in a timely and professional manner.
  • Educate members about credit union products and services, helping them make informed financial decisions.

  • Accurately process member transactions, including deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and payments.
  • Properly handle cash and negotiable instruments and maintain accurate records of transactions.
  • Adhere to security and compliance protocols to ensure the safety and confidentiality of member information.

Sales and Referrals:

  • Build strong member relationships by identifying financial needs and uncovering solutions that support members’ long-term financial well-being.
  • Advocate for members by recommending and cross-selling credit union products and services, including loans, credit cards, and savings solutions, that align with their financial goals.
  • Refer members to specialized financial advisors for more complex financial needs to ensure comprehensive financial support.
  • Participate in promotional campaigns, community outreach, and relationship-building opportunities to attract new members and strengthen community connections.
  • Deliver the BLUE Experience by building rapport, learning member needs, uncovering meaningful solutions, and earning member trust through personalized service and financial advocacy.

Account Opening and Maintenance:

  • Open new accounts, including checking, savings, IRA, and Term Certificate accounts.
  • Assist members with account maintenance tasks, including but not limited to updating personal information, setting up online banking, and processing other account service requests.

Lending Responsibility:

  • Guide members through all stages of the consumer lending process, from application through funding and ongoing loan servicing. Assist members with all consumer lending needs by explaining loan terms, conditions, and requirements, and collaborate with the Consumer Lending Department on loan products requiring specialized underwriting.
  • General understanding and ability to explain and sell loan insurance products.
  • Maintain thorough knowledge of lending regulations and compliance requirements.

Problem Resolution:

  • Handle member complaints and issues with patience and professionalism, working to resolve them effectively.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve member questions and discrepancies and to provide effective problem resolution.
  • Escalate complex issues to the appropriate department or supervisor as needed.

Compliance and Risk Management:

  • Ensure all transactions, member interactions, and lending activities comply with Westmark policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Stay informed about changes in banking regulations and industry standards.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
In feite ben je als DevOps Engineer de brug tussen beheer en softwareontwikkeling waarbij de nadruk in deze functie op beheer ligt. Je zorgt dat onze developers schaalbare en betrouwbare applicaties bouwen, met de nieuwste technologieën én een DevOps-aanpak. Daarbij kijk je proactief naar beheer. Wat kun je automatiseren? Beter, veiliger en efficiënter maken? Haal je creativiteit dus maar uit de kast!

Als onderdeel van de Rechtspraak maken we de Nederlandse rechtspraak digitaal toegankelijk. We ontwikkelen belangrijke toepassingen als Rechtspraak.nl, webapplicaties voor digitaal procederen, API’s en S2S-services. Dat doen we in teams, met verschillende soorten engineers en mensen ‘uit de business’.

Security, privacy, CI/CD, normaliseren van de technology stack, machine learning en codekwaliteit. Jij zorgt dat de ontwikkelaars in jouw team het allemaal op de juiste manier toepassen. Ook stem je veel af met bestaande infrastructuur- en platformteams om zorg te dragen voor een hoog kwaliteit software delivery en ontwikkelproces. Spannend? Absoluut! Uitdagend? Ook dat! Want de servicelevels van onze diensten mogen niet in gevaar komen. En daar speel jij een grote rol in. Eenvoudig en simpel: dat zijn de sleutelwoorden bij alles wat je doet. Of het nu gaat om code, systemen of architectuur.

Herken jij je in uitspraken als ‘wisdom of production, ‘operations is a software engineering problem’ of ‘automate everything’? Solliciteren dan!

Dit krijg je ervoor terug

Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij:

  • Contract:een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
  • Salaris:je komt terecht in salarisschaal 11(maximaal € 6.275,94per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur). Inschaling vindt plaats op basis van je werkervaring.
  • Keuzebudget:16,5% van je jaarsalaris (maximaal € 1035 per maand) om je eigen arbeidsvoorwaarden samen te stellen. Zoals het kopen van verlof, het aanschaffen van een fiets of het verduurzamen van je woning.
  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden:je functie zit vol mogelijkheden om je kennis verder uit te breiden en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. En bij onze IVO Academie kun je allerlei trainingen en opleidingen doen.
  • Werk-privébalans:je bent vrij om je werkdagen flexibel in te delen. Zo kun je deels vanuit huis werken. We dragen € 750 bij aan het inrichten van een comfortabele thuiswerkplek.
  • Vakanties en vrije dagen: je hebt 144 vakantie- en 64 keuzebudget-uren op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Dat zijn dus in totaal 26 dagen.
  • Gratis OV:je krijgt van ons een OV-chipkaart voor je woon-werkverkeer.
  • Pensioen:je bouwt je pensioen op bij het ABP, een van de grootste pensioenfondsen van Nederland. Ook dat is dus goed geregeld.

Taitara Mahi - Senior Programme Manager (ERP Transformation)
Fixed-Term / Full-Time

Hastings District Council is delivering a significant enterprise transformation programme that will modernise core business systems, strengthen organisational capability and improve the services we provide to our community.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Programme Manager to lead this high-profile programme through implementation and delivery. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will work closely with executive leaders, business stakeholders, vendors, implementation partners and an established programme team to ensure successful outcomes across technology, people and process change.

This is a rare opportunity to lead one of the most significant transformation programmes in Council's history and help shape how Council operates into the future.

  • Lead the delivery of a large-scale enterprise transformation programme from implementation through to successful adoption, coordinating technical, data, integration, testing, cutover, change and business-readiness activities while maintaining robust plans, governance, reporting and delivery controls throughout.
  • Provide visible leadership across a diverse programme team, delivery partners and business stakeholders.

  • Manage programme scope, budget, schedule, risks and dependencies to achieve successful outcomes.

What will help you succeed

You are a pragmatic and authentic leader who builds trust quickly, communicates clearly and remains focused on outcomes. You can confidently navigate complexity, bring together diverse perspectives and maintain momentum through change.

Most importantly, you understand that successful transformation is not only about technology. It is about people, processes, leadership and creating lasting organisational value.

Why join us?

This significant transformation programme is supported by an experienced programme team, including dedicated change management, business analysis, subject matter expertise and project coordination resources. This allows you to focus on leadership, delivery, navigating complexity and achieving successful outcomes.

If you are motivated by leading meaningful change and leaving a lasting legacy for an organisation and its community, we'd love to hear from you.

Lead one of Council's most significant transformation programmes while enjoying the lifestyle benefits Hawke's Bay is known for, including sunshine, world-class food and wine, outdoor recreation and a strong sense of community.

title: Senior Google Ads Buyer, DTC eCommerce (Remote)
description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

Google is where we are putting our next round of growth. You would own a set of those accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact and there is nobody else to cover it. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly with nobody in between. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. Google is where we are putting our next round of growth, and you would have real influence over how we run it.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

  • Experience prototyping for diverse use cases
  • Cross-functional collaboration with strategists, business leads, and external partners

COMPENSATION

Other forms of variable pay [may/will] be offered for this position. Other components [may/will] include bonus potential, benefits, and/or perks.

title: Platform Engineer - Beam
