title: Clinical Research Engagement Lead - Northeast Region (Washington, D.C.)
description:
The Position

As a Clinical Research Engagement Lead (CREL) at Roche, you will act as the ultimate strategic partner and primary face of Roche Clinical Operations within your market. This is not a traditional coordination role—you are the champion of a "ONE Roche" approach, wielding clinical operational expertise and deep Disease Area (DA) knowledge to build elite, high-trust partnerships with clinical trial sites.

The Opportunity:

You will bridge the gap between strategy and execution across the entire trial lifecycle—from early development to late-stage delivery—ensuring our clinical assets are executed with maximum speed, efficiency, and clinical quality. In this role you will have the opportunity to:

Strategic Planning & Alignment: Develops and executes country-level site engagement strategies aligned with internal priorities, making strategic investment decisions regarding Principal Investigators and clinical sites to support the broader portfolio.(DS) Experience with site budget negotiation, tracking clinical grant payments, and forecasting site-level resource needs

Early Feasibility & Study Set-Up: Conducts early, strategic landscaping and site engagement (in-person or remote) during the protocol concept and study set-up phases to identify optimal sites, evaluate country feasibility, and accelerate recruitment.(DS) Demonstrated ability to drive study start-up metrics, optimize cycle times, and utilize enrollment forecasting tools to ensure site milestones are met on schedule.

Relationship Management & Site Support: Builds deep, multi-stakeholder relationships at strategic sites (including investigators, pharmacists, and administration), acting as a "site champion" and Primary Point of Contact to maintain cross-study consistency and address site needs. Must have and demonstrate exceptional communication skills both oral and written.

Issue Escalation & Performance Oversight: Serves as the local escalation point for study challenges, monitors investigator performance, supports motivational site visits to boost recruitment, and manages sensitive communications during premature site closures. Be able to manage and navigate sensitive and complex situations under unknown or un-clear circumstances.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Reporting: Partners seamlessly with internal teams (e.g., Medical Affairs, Study Start-Up) and CROs to ensure unified site communication, while maintaining meticulous documentation of site visits and interactions in central systems (e.g., Veeva).

Portfolio Oversight & Compliance: Manages assigned local/global clinical studies by overseeing CRO performance, mitigating timeline or operational risks, ensuring eTMF completeness, and maintaining continuous inspection readiness.

(DS) Digital Clinical Trial: Focus on driving adoption of DCT and digital solutions with our sites i.e. eConsent, eSource, Remote Data Entry, etc. Actively pursuing and reviewing digital tools with sites to examine challenges and provide solutions.

Who you are:

  • Degree (MD, PhD, MA / MS, BA / BS) in life sciences or equivalent.

  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant clinical research or clinical operations experience in pharmaceutical, biotech or related industry; Sponsor experience preferred

  • Experience in end-to-end product development and expert understanding of ICH/GCP are both essential.

  • Understanding of end-to-end clinical trial processes, including monitoring, and strong knowledge of clinical trial regulations and guidelines.

  • Proven track record in managing site relationships and overseeing complex clinical trials.

  • Exceptional interpersonal, cross-functional, negotiation, and influencing skills with a proven track record of building high-trust, sustainable relationships with internal stakeholders, CROs, and site personnel.

  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically between 30-50% dependent on business or site needs.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Postgraduate degree or master’s degree will be valued but not required

  • Prior experience working directly with local trial sites and a strong existing network within the regional healthcare ecosystem is a strong plus

  • Highly experienced in early and late phase oncology

  • Highly experienced across multiple disciplines/TAs in non-oncology

This role is regional. Applicants should reside within 30 miles of a major airport and should reside within 50 miles of the Primary Location. Preference will be given to applicants who reside within those parameters.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Washington, D.C. is $108,800 - $202,000. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. title: Senior Full stack .NET Software Engineer
description:
Jij bent allround en levert een grote bijdrage aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe applicaties binnen één van de software development teams in Joure. Je werkt aan producten die ertoe doen!

Comecer Netherlands BV in Joure ontwikkelt, produceert en verkoopt een breed scala innovatieve soft- en hardware producten die wereldwijd worden gebruikt in honderden ziekenhuizen met nucleaire geneeskunde en de (radio)farmaceutische industrie. Comecer Netherlands BV is onderdeel van de Comecer Group en is een bedrijf binnen ATS Corporation.

Als .NET Software Engineer werk je in een SCRUM team aan een nieuw software platform gebaseerd op state-of-the-art technologie. Onze software draait op Windows of Linux en is ontwikkeld in C#, TypeScript en React. Het platform en de applicaties zijn ontworpen om zowel on-premises als in de Cloud te draaien.

Stap voor stap vernieuwen wij onze huidige applicaties naar het nieuwe platform. Bij “applicaties” kun je denken aan software die de complete patiënt/behandel planning regelt in een ziekenhuis voor de nucleaire geneeskunde (planning van PET of SPECT-scan, therapie, van voorbereiding tot injectie). Om de kans op fouten te verminderen en de het de gebruiker makkelijker te maken, heeft de software vele interfaces met ziekenhuis systemen en aangesloten apparatuur van zowel Comecer als derden.

Je ontwikkelt nieuwe en verbetert bestaande applicaties op basis van technisch en functioneel ontwerp en de product backlog. Je werkt nauw samen met jouw directe collega’s zoals de andere Software Ontwikkelaars, Testers, Software Architect, Functioneel Ontwerper en Product Owners. Je draagt bij aan alle aspecten van software engineering (niet alleen softwareontwikkeling maar ook requirements engineering, functioneel ontwerp, verificatie en validatiestrategie, etc.). Je bouwt snel domeinkennis op over onze producten/ toepassingen en helpt zo nu en dan derdelijns ondersteuning aan onze klanten.

Als senior developer ga je ook een belangrijke bijdrage leveren in het opzetten of optimaliseren van onze development toolchain standaardisatie van ons ontwikkelproces. Je begeleid zowel interne als externe ontwikkelteams in het toepassen van de onze architectuur en gebruik van de juiste tooling.

Dit zoeken wij in jou

Je bent proactief en signaleert tijdig verbeteringen of problemen en draagt bij aan de oplossing hiervan. Je hebt ervaring met technische software documentatie (en eventueel kennis van de IEC62304 standaard voor het ontwikkelen van medische software).

Je bent een teamspeler en je bent in staat snel en resultaatgericht te werken op basis van Scrum in een zeer dynamische omgeving.

Daarbij beschik je over:

  • Bachelor of Master in software engineering, of ervaring op gelijkwaardig niveau;
  • goede communicatieve en schriftelijke vaardigheden in het Engels en Nederlands;
  • SQL, Docker, Visual Studio en databasesystemen is een pré;
  • kennis en ervaring van Azure Cloud Services en Azure DevOps is een pré;
  • ervaring bijvoorbeeld GMP, gezondheidszorg, Medical Devices is een pré.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • informele werksfeer in een platte structuur, een gedreven team en veel betrokken collega’s;
  • een marktconform salaris;
  • pensioenregeling volgens de CAO Metaal & Techniek;
  • 25 vrije dagen, 5 ADV dagen en de mogelijkheid om vrije dagen bij te kopen;
  • voldoende mogelijkheid om je te blijven ontwikkelen door het volgen van cursussen en trainingen.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

  • Location: Chennai / Bengaluru
  • Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design and build scalable, cloud-native data platforms that power analytics, reporting, and machine learning. You'll work closely with Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering teams to create reliable data solutions that support business-critical decisions.


What You'll Do

What We're Looking For

title: DEVELOPMENT LIAISON (GRANT WRITER)
description:
Who We Are

Our employees are the heart of our organization, and each person contributes to our mission. We’re looking for motivated, passionate individuals who want to use their skills to support others. We believe people facing mental health or substance use challenges deserve the chance to live meaningful, productive lives. If that mission resonates with you, we encourage you to explore this role and join us in making an impact.


What We Offer

What You'll Do

1. Grant Administration & Proposal Support (30%)

2. Donor Stewardship, CRM & Foundation Support (25%)

  • Coordinate sponsorship fulfillment, pledged contribution follow-up, and delivery or collection of approved materials.

3. Events & Community Engagement Coordination (25%)

  • Maintain event inventories and coordinate requests for materials with the Marketing Design Specialist.
  • Compile participation and follow-up information for Manager review.

4. Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Administrative Support (15%)

  • Serve as the initial administrative point of contact for EAP clients, assisting with inquiries, required paperwork, scheduling, and routine communication.
  • Prepare monthly utilization reports and approved workplace mental health information or resources for EAP employer clients.
  • Coordinate administrative documentation related to EAP onboarding and contract renewals under the direction of the Marketing & Development Manager.
  • Maintain organized EAP records and track outstanding administrative items.
  • Escalate employer relationship, contract, service, or operational concerns to the Marketing & Development Manager or appropriate clinical/operational leader.

5. Department Administration (5%)

  • Schedule meetings, prepare agendas and materials, and document action items as requested.
  • Monitor shared departmental inboxes, inquiry forms, calendars, inventories, and routine requests as assigned.

Other Expectations

  • Work cooperatively with staff across the agency, sharing resources and expertise in pursuit of Pawnee's mission.
  • Adhere to Pawnee policies, procedures, the Employee Handbook, the Code of Conduct, and applicable ethical requirements.
  • Perform other reasonably related duties as assigned.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the Company:

Our client is an AI-native technology and data engineering company focused on building modern data platforms and decision systems that help organizations turn complex data into actionable business outcomes.

The company works across data platforms, cloud modernization, and production AI solutions, with a strong emphasis on building systems that are reliable, transparent, scalable, and easy to understand. Its approach combines engineering expertise with a focus on making data and AI outputs decision-ready, measurable, and trustworthy.

Serving mid-market and enterprise organizations across industries such as financial services, retail, healthcare, and industrial sectors, the company partners closely with clients to solve complex technology challenges and deliver solutions grounded in real-world business impact.


About the Role:

We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to join our delivery team. You will design, build, and own data platforms end to end on client engagements, working within a Medallion architecture pattern using dbt for transformations and Python for ingestion on the client's cloud of choice. You will also contribute to company's internal accelerator programme, reusable components such as our entity resolution engine, ingestion framework, and data quality layer deployed across client projects. This is a hands-on senior role, you write production code, make architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and engage directly with client technical teams. We are looking for someone with 5 to 7 years of hands-on data engineering experience.


What You Will Do:

  • Design and build end-to-end data platforms using the Medallion architecture, Bronze ingestion via Python, Silver staging and canonical models via dbt, Gold reporting and serving layer for BI consumption.
  • Build and own Python-based ingestion pipelines, extracting from SQL databases, Snowflake, REST APIs, and SaaS platforms, with watermark patterns, control tables, and schema drift handling.
  • Write production-grade dbt models for Silver and Gold layers, staging models, canonical entity resolution, SCD Type 2 dimensions, and reporting models shaped for BI tools.
  • Design canonical data models across multiple source systems, resolving the same entity across disparate platforms using surrogate keys, source ID preservation, and conflict resolution logic.
  • Build and contribute to company's accelerator library, entity resolution engine, ingestion framework, data quality profiler, and insights dashboard scaffold.
  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, including dbt test automation, data quality gates, and deployment approval workflows.
  • Engage directly with client technical teams, running architecture discussions and communicating decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Coach and review junior engineers through PR reviews, pair programming, and raising the quality bar across the team.


Must-Have Skills:

Data Engineering Core:

  • Expert-level SQL, complex joins, window functions, CTEs, incremental merge patterns, and performance tuning.
  • Strong Python, production ingestion pipelines, REST API clients, error handling, logging, and retry logic.
  • dbt (any adapter), model structure, incremental materializations, tests, macros, and packages.
  • Medallion architecture, deep understanding of Bronze, Silver, and Gold layer responsibilities and boundaries.
  • Data modelling, canonical modelling, dimensional modelling, star schema, SCD Type 2, and the distinction between integration models and reporting models.

Cloud and Platform:

  • Hands-on delivery experience on at least one major cloud, AWS (S3, Redshift, Glue, Athena), GCP (BigQuery, Dataproc, Cloud Storage), or Azure (Fabric, Synapse, ADLS), with working knowledge of the others.
  • Lakehouse platforms, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or similar, and how data is physically stored, partitioned, and queried.
  • Infrastructure fundamentals, networking, secrets management, managed identity or IAM roles, and container-based compute.

Engineering Practices:

  • Git and GitHub, trunk-based branching, pull requests, code review, and CI/CD automation.
  • Data quality, dbt tests, quarantine patterns, control tables, and schema drift detection.
  • 5 to 7 years of hands-on data engineering experience across ingestion, transformation, modelling, and client delivery.

Desired Skills:

  • Entity resolution, probabilistic or deterministic matching across multiple source systems, surrogate key generation, and lineage preservation.
  • BI and reporting, Power BI, Looker, or Tableau, and the division of logic between SQL preparation and BI-layer calculations.
  • AI and LLM integration, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or AI-assisted workflows built on a structured data layer.
  • Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for cloud resource provisioning.
  • Domain experience in financial services, facility management, automotive, or professional services.


What We Look For Beyond the Tech:

  • You take ownership, if something is wrong you fix it, you do not wait to be asked.
  • You communicate clearly, you can explain an architecture decision to a client CTO and to a junior engineer in the same session.
  • You are rigorous, you write tests, document decisions, and think about what breaks before it breaks.
  • You are curious, the tools change fast and you keep up and bring that forward to the team.


How We Will Support Your Growth:

  • Direct exposure to senior engineers and leadership on real client deliveries, not in a siloed unit.
  • Ownership of accelerator components that go into multiple client engagements and are yours to evolve.
  • Support for cloud and platform certifications, technical writing, and community participation.
  • A culture where commitment matters more than compliance, and intellectual honesty is expected in every conversation.
  • As the team grows, opportunity to move into a practice lead or architecture leadership role.

title: Lead Data Engineer (Fullstack and Palantir)
description:
Job Description: Lead Data Engineer (Palantir Foundry)


Overview:

As a Foundry Platform Engineer (dependent on the name of the role) at Lear, you will own the full lifecycle of data and operational applications within Palantir Foundry, from ingesting and modeling data, to building the Ontology, to delivering the applications and logic that turn data into operational decisions. You will build and maintain robust data pipelines, model real-world business concepts as Ontology objects, implement business logic through Functions and Actions, and deliver end-to-end user applications in Workshop and custom widgets. This is a role for someone who wants to work across the entire stack, data, semantic layer, logic, and applications to drive data-driven decision making across the organization.


Responsibilities:

Manage Execution of Foundry Projects:

  • Lead and participate in projects from conception to root cause analytics and solution deployment.
  • Contribute expert analysis across all programs and product delivery phases.

Data Pipeline Development & Integration:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain efficient, reliable, and scalable data pipelines.
  • Utilize core Foundry tooling, including:
  • Pipeline Builder: Author batch and streaming data pipelines through a visual interface.
  • Code Repositories: Develop transforms in Python for pipeline logic and reusable code.
  • Data Lineage: Visualize and monitor end-to-end data flows.
  • Leverage programmatic health checks to ensure pipeline durability.

Ontology Modeling & Configuration:

  • Design and configure Ontology resources that map Lear’s datasets to real-world business concepts
  • Object types, link types, properties, interfaces, etc.
  • Define and maintain Action Types that govern how users create, edit, and delete objects, including parameters, validation rules, and submission criteria.

Functions & Business Logic:

  • Develop Functions in Python and TypeScript to implement business logic, computed/derived values, and validation.
  • Build function-backed Actions and function-backed columns to power writeback and interactive workflows on the Ontology.

Application Development

  • Build and maintain operational applications in Workshop using the Ontology as the data foundation.
  • Develop custom widgets (React / OSDK) to extend Workshop and deliver tailored user experiences.
  • Partner with business users to translate operational requirements into intuitive, decision-driving applications.

Collaboration and Transparency:

  • Work closely with data scientists, analysts, and operational teams.
  • Provide transparency into pipeline computation, Ontology health, and application performance.

Compliance and data security:

  • Ensure documentation and procedures align with internal practices (ITPM) and Sarbanes Oxley requirements, continuously improving them.
  • Apply foundry’s security model (markings, roles, and granular access policies) to protect sensitive data across pipelines, the Ontology, and applications.

Quality Assurance & Optimization:

  • Optimize data pipelines and their impact on resource utilization of downstream processes.
  • Continuously test and improve data pipeline performance and reliability.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Total 7-11 years' experience as a Data Engineer/Analyst.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience with Palantir Foundry.
  • Proficiency in Python, and familiarity with TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Experience configuring Ontology resources within Palantir Foundry.
  • Experience building Functions and function-backed Actions.
  • Experience building applications in Workshop and familiarity with custom widgets.
  • Familiarity with the AIP toolset (AIP Logic, AIP FDE, etc.) is a plus.
  • HR analytics experience is a plus.

  • Establish a rigorous experimentation operating rhythm, defining hypotheses, metrics, success thresholds, and invalidation signals; analyze results quickly, discontinue ineffective initiatives, and scale successful ones.
  • Use quantitative analysis to diagnose funnel performance, segment cohorts, identify conversion or retention gaps, and translate insights into experiments and product improvements.
  • Shape monetization mechanics, including freemium experiences, credit economics, upgrade triggers, consumption models, pricing decisions, and product-qualified lead signals.
  • Build self-serve journeys that deliver value quickly while intelligently balancing user experience, conversion, expansion, sales engagement, and long-term customer value.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to execute growth initiatives and maintain alignment across the broader product-led growth strategy.
  • Develop and communicate compelling product narratives and recommendations for senior executives, using clear data and business cases to influence investment and prioritization decisions.
  • Establish reliable measurement frameworks and dashboards covering activation, consumption, retention, conversion, pipeline, expansion, and revenue outcomes.
  • Create documentation, retrospectives, experimentation standards, and operating practices that help the broader product organization compound its learning.
  • Mentor, coach, hire, and calibrate senior product managers, raising the quality of experimentation, ownership, strategic thinking, and execution across the growth organization.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging growth and distribution opportunities, including AI-first discovery, LLM-readable experiences, MCP-enabled channels, GEO/AEO, partner-led trials, and other evolving acquisition mechanisms.

    • Requirements

    • 8–12 years of product management experience, including at least 4 years specifically focused on growth, product-led growth, self-serve, monetization, or related product disciplines.
    • Demonstrated direct ownership of a growth loop or portfolio at meaningful business scale, with accountability for measurable revenue or P&L-related outcomes rather than individual feature delivery.
    • Proven experience presenting growth strategies, funnel performance, monetization decisions, or investment recommendations to senior executives, including CEO, CRO, CFO, or board-level stakeholders.
    • Track record of hiring, mentoring, coaching, or calibrating other product managers and establishing a high bar for product craft and execution.
    • Strong full-funnel growth expertise, including activation, time-to-value, retention, conversion, consumption, upgrade triggers, expansion, and PQL quality.
    • Deep understanding of portfolio and channel economics, with the ability to evaluate different acquisition and distribution mechanisms based on unit economics, decay, marginal returns, and compounding potential.
    • Strong experimentation discipline, with hands-on experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, multivariate tests, holdouts, pre/post analyses, and cohort-based experiments.
    • Advanced analytical capabilities, including strong SQL skills and the ability to independently work with data warehouses such as Snowflake without relying heavily on analysts.
    • Experience with consumption-based pricing, credit economics, freemium models, monetization mechanics, and product-qualified lead frameworks.
    • Strong B2B SaaS experience; exposure to data, go-to-market, sales technology, or related software markets is advantageous.
    • Hands-on product-building mindset, with the ability to work directly with engineers and designers, prototype experiences, write or refine product copy, and move ideas rapidly from concept to production.
    • Strong marketing fluency across areas such as SEO, paid acquisition, content, lifecycle marketing, and distribution.
    • Demonstrated understanding of emerging AI-driven discovery and distribution, including LLM-first discovery, agent-readable product experiences, MCP, GEO/AEO, or related concepts.
    • Excellent strategic communication skills, with the ability to translate complex product, funnel, and monetization decisions into compelling business narratives.
    • Strong ownership, curiosity, judgment, and comfort making decisions in ambiguous environments while continuously updating assumptions based on evidence.
    • A collaborative leadership style capable of influencing without formal authority and aligning technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders around measurable outcomes.

      • Benefits

      • Base salary range of $151,900–$238,700 USD.
      • Additional compensation may include bonus, commission, equity, and other benefits, depending on the position and individual circumstances.
      • Fully remote work environment.
      • Comprehensive benefits designed to support employees and their families.
      • Holistic mind, body, and lifestyle programs focused on overall well-being.
      • Opportunities for professional growth, development, and career advancement.
      • An environment that encourages innovation, experimentation, ownership, and rapid execution.
      • Opportunity to work on AI-first, product-led growth initiatives with significant business visibility and impact.

title: 2nd Shift Painter
description:
About the Company:


LEEBOY Inc., part of the FAYAT Group, is a global leader in the production of commercial asphalt pavers and road maintenance equipment. With more than 60 years of industry expertise, we deliver reliable, high-quality machinery that supports road construction professionals worldwide. We value integrity, innovation, and agility, and we recognize our employees as our most important asset. Our commitment to excellence continues to strengthen the trust placed in our products and our brand.


About the Role:


Sprays surface of machines and/or parts, manufactured products, or working area with protective or decorative material such as urethane and/ polyurethane paints.


The hours for this position are Monday - Thursday 3:00 pm to 1:45 am. Fridays will be based on production needs. Occasional Saturdays are possible, depending on production needs.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Must have basic automotive painter knowledge.
  • Basic spray gun operation, basic paint equipment knowledge and repairs, basic spraying techniques.
  • Spray equipment (2KS paint mixing systems, spray guns, pumps, pressure pots, spray gun cleaning station, paint kitchen area, booths ad ovens).
  • Applying paint, mixing paint ratios
  • Taping or masking areas
  • Set up load/unload paint booths and ovens.
  • Touch up equipment, panel painting or blending the area.
  • Basic non-hazardous and hazardous waste training and disposal
  • Must be willing to prep machines and/or parts to be painted.
  • Knowledge of basic operation of the solvent recycler
  • Use a 3-wheel hydraulic cart to move the machines around the paint area.
  • Must be able to climb ladders (up to 12 feet), stoop, bend, reaching, pulling, walking, kneeling, standing, crouching, and crawling.
  • Must be able to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to mix all paint colors by ratio.
  • Must be able to use dry film thickness gauge after the paint has cured.

title: Senior Principal, Compliance  [L7-I] (Infosec & TBA Compliance)
description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

InfoSec & TBA Compliance팀은 안정적이고 신뢰할 수 있는 서비스 운영을 위해 전기통신사업법 및 관련 법령 준수 체계를 구축하고, 서비스 안전성 확보와 통신재난 대응 역량 강화를 주도하는 조직입니다.

Director, TBA Compliance & Information Security Governance는 전기통신사업법(TBA) 및 관련 정보보호 규제에 대한 준수 체계를 총괄하며, 서비스 안정성·보안성 확보를 위한 전략 및 운영 프레임워크를 수립하는 역할입니다. 경영진, 서비스 오너, 보안 조직 및 대외 규제기관과 긴밀하게 협력하여 규제 변화에 선제적으로 대응하고, 컴플라이언스 및 보안 리스크 관리 체계를 지속적으로 고도화하는 데 핵심적인 역할을 수행합니다.

업무 내용

  • 전기통신사업법(TBA) 및 관련 정보보호 규제에 대한 전사 컴플라이언스 전략 및 거버넌스 체계 수립
  • 서비스 안전성 확보 의무와 보안 요구사항에 대한 컴플라이언스 모니터링 프로그램 구축 및 운영 총괄
  • 통신재난관리기본계획 및 서비스 연속성 관련 규제 준수 여부에 대한 감독 및 평가 체계 운영
  • 주요 규제 및 보안 리스크를 식별·평가하고, 비즈니스 및 기술 조직과 협력하여 개선 전략 수립
  • 컴플라이언스 현황 및 주요 리스크를 경영진에게 보고하고 의사결정을 지원
  • 규제기관 대응, 감사 대응 및 주요 대외 점검 활동 리드
  • 데이터 기반 분석과 증적 검토를 통해 통제의 효과성을 검증하고 개선 과제 도출
  • 정보보호 및 컴플라이언스 조직의 역량 강화와 모범 사례(Best Practice) 정착 주도
  • 관련 법령 및 규제 변화에 대한 모니터링을 통해 정책 및 프로세스의 지속적인 개선 추진

자격 요건

  • 정보보호, 컴플라이언스, IT 감사 또는 리스크 관리 분야에서 12년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분
  • 전기통신사업법, 방송통신발전기본법, 정보통신망법, 통신비밀보호법 등 관련 규제에 대한 깊은 이해와 실무 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 클라우드 환경, 대규모 분산 시스템, 네트워크, 데이터베이스 및 보안 아키텍처에 대한 높은 수준의 기술적 이해를 갖추신 분
  • 정보보호 및 규제 준수 프로그램을 설계하고 조직 차원에서 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 다양한 조직 및 경영진 수준의 이해관계자와 효과적으로 소통하고 영향력을 발휘할 수 있는 리더십 역량을 보유하신 분
  • 복잡한 리스크를 분석하고 전략적 해결방안을 제시할 수 있는 뛰어난 문제 해결 능력을 갖추신 분
  • 경영진 보고서 작성 및 Executive-level 프레젠테이션 경험을 보유하신 분

우대 사항

  • 인터넷 플랫폼, 통신사업자, 대규모 온라인 서비스 기업에서 정보보호 컴플라이언스 또는 IT 감사 조직을 리드한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 클라우드 기반 서비스 환경(AWS, Azure, GCP)에서 정보보호 거버넌스 및 리스크 관리 체계를 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 국내외 규제기관 대응, ISMS-P 인증, 내부·외부 감사 대응을 주도한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 글로벌 정보보호 프레임워크(NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 등)에 대한 이해와 적용 경험이 있으신 분
  • 보안 및 IT 리스크 관리 관련 전문 자격증(CISSP, CISA, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, ISMS-P 심사원 등)을 보유하신 분
  • 조직 구축 및 인력 리더십 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 영어를 활용한 문서 작성 및 글로벌 이해관계자와의 협업이 가능하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Senior Social Media Project Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Social Media Project Manager based in South africa.

Join a mission-driven, remote-first organization working across continents and time zones to deliver impactful communications initiatives.
In this role, you’ll help shape and execute social media programs while coordinating high-visibility campaigns and broader communications projects.
You’ll serve as a central project management partner connecting social, content, creative, marketing, PR, analytics, and external collaborators.
Your work will ensure complex initiatives stay organized, aligned with strategic priorities, and delivered on time and within scope.
You’ll have significant influence across distributed teams, building strong collaboration and accountability without relying on direct authority.
The role offers an opportunity to improve workflows, remove bottlenecks, and strengthen how global communications projects are delivered.
This is a one-year remote contract suited to an experienced project manager who thrives in collaborative, multicultural, and fast-changing environments.

Accountabilities

  • Partner with senior social media leadership to plan and deliver evergreen social initiatives, campaigns, strategic programs, and related communications projects.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, defining scope, milestones, timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, and communication plans.
  • Coordinate cross-functional contributors across social media, creators, content, creative, design, video, community, PR, marketing, analytics, and external partners.
  • Lead project kickoffs, status meetings, stakeholder check-ins, retrospectives, and other forums that maintain alignment and momentum.
  • Build and maintain project workflows in Asana, tracking deliverables, dependencies, resources, risks, and shifting priorities across distributed teams.
  • Proactively identify roadblocks, resource constraints, risks, and scope changes, escalating critical issues and helping teams develop practical solutions.
  • Work with leadership and stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, align resources and timelines, and connect project execution to broader communications goals.
  • Coordinate content and campaign workflows from development and review through approval and publication, ensuring delivery remains on schedule and within scope.
  • Develop project documentation, processes, dashboards, and reporting that provide clear visibility into project health, progress, and campaign performance.
  • Establish effective communication practices, decision-making processes, team norms, and expectations across multiple time zones.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Location: Bangalore (HYBRID)

Department: Analytics & Engineering

Team: Quantitative Analytics


About the Company:


Kamakhya Analytics is a technology-driven research and consulting organisation helping leaders, parties, and institutions decode India’s political and policy landscape. We bring together survey science, data analytics, and strategic insight to answer complex questions about public opinion, governance, and performance.From ground-level fieldwork to advanced modelling and interpretation, every project is built for clarity, accuracy, and impact. Our teams manage the complete research cycle design, execution, data engineering, and delivery under a single

framework of discipline, transparency, and speed. Quality and integrity define our work. We apply rigorous controls in sampling and verification, maintain secure and reproducible data systems, and communicate results that withstand scrutiny.


At Kamakhya, our mission is simple: turn evidence into strategy and insight into

action.


Role Summary:

As a Senior Data Engineer (L1) at Kamakhya Analytics, you will build and own reliable, scalable data workflows that power analysis, modelling, reporting, and leadership decision-making. You will integrate data from multiple sources (field, survey, electoral, digital, and internal systems), standardize it into trusted datasets, and ensure teams operate on consistent metric definitions and a clear single source of truth. This is a hands-on role with strong ownership: you will ensure day-to-day pipeline health, implement structured reliability improvements, and set the bar on documentation, review practices, traceability, and governance - especially important given the sensitivity of political and citizen-level data. Youwill also mentor junior engineers and drive operational discipline as the data function scales.


What You'll Do

● Build production-grade data pipelines that support polling, constituency analytics, modelling, dashboards, and reporting.

● Integrate and harmonize data from multiple sources, ensuring clean joins and consistent identifiers.

● Create trusted datasets and curated marts that teams can use repeatedly without rework - reducing manual effort and improving turnaround time.

● Strengthen governance: access controls, secure sharing, auditability, and compliance-aligned handling of sensitive data.

● Raise engineering standards: code reviews, testing discipline, documentation, runbooks, and reproducible workflows.

● Mentor junior engineers through pairing, design reviews, and structured coaching. Key Responsibilities Data Platform & Architecture

● Architect, build, and operate scalable, fault-tolerant data pipelines for structured and unstructured data.

● Drive operational excellence: SLAs, monitoring, incident response, and pipeline performance tuning.

● Design and maintain data lakes/warehouses and ELT/ETL frameworks across cloud and hybrid setups.

● Own and evolve AWS-based data architecture,designing secure, scalable pipelines and storage/compute patterns, optimizing cost and performance, and ensuring reliable deployments through monitoring, alerting, and infrastructure best practices. Governance, Security & Quality

● Establish best practices for data lineage, access controls, secure handling, documentation, and observability.

● Implement automated validation checks, anomaly detection, and runbooks; conduct RCA for recurring issues. Stakeholder Partnership

● Partner closely with analysts, application engineers, and strategy/campaign teams to translate business needs into robust datasets and metrics.

● Ensure consistent metric definitions and prevent multiple versions of the truth.


Must-Have Qualifications

● 5+ years of hands-on Data Engineering experience with a proven track record of building and operating production systems.

● Hands-on experience designing and operating scalable, secure data architectures on AWS, including core services such as S3, IAM, Glue, EMR/EKS/ECS, Lambda, Redshift, CloudWatch, with a strong understanding of VPC networking, security best practices, cost optimization, fault tolerance, and high availability.

● Advanced proficiency in Python, & SQL.

● Strong experience with big-data/distributed systems such as Airflow, Hive, Presto/Trino (or equivalents).

● Hands-on expertise with lake/warehouse architectures: Delta Lake, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift (or similar).

● Strong understanding of ETL/ELT, data modelling (star/snowflake schemas), orchestration patterns, and engineering best practices.

● Exposure to streaming/real-time systems: Kafka/Kinesis/PubSub, Spark Structured Streaming, Flink, etc.

● Experience with CI/CD for data systems, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Docker, Terraform).

● Strong ownership mindset - ability to run systems end-to-end and improve reliability over time. Good-to-Have Qualifications

● Familiarity with PII/consent-sensitive data handling, access governance, and audit logging practices.

● Working knowledge of GIS concepts (admin boundaries, ward/booth mapping, spatial joins) and tools (PostGIS/QGIS).


What Success Looks Like ( First 180 Days)

● Junior engineers are enabled through documentation, templates, and review discipline.

● Review existing codebase and suggest improvements wherever necessary

● Critical pipelines run reliably with clear SLAs, monitoring, and runbooks in place.

● Key datasets are standardized with stable identifiers and consistent metric definitions.

● Data quality issues reduce measurably through automated checks and structured RCA.

● Analysts and stakeholders experience faster turnaround times and fewer reconciliation loops.

title: DevOps Engineer Media & E-depot
description:
Utrecht 32 uur Werk- en denkniveau: Bachelor Tijdelijk

Hogeschool Utrecht

DevOps Engineer Media & E-depot

Bij Hogeschool Utrecht werken we in Team Media & E-depot elke dag aan beter en toegankelijker onderwijs met digitale media. Als DevOps Engineer in Team Media & E-depot zorg jij dat onze applicaties betrouwbaar draaien én doorontwikkeld worden, zodat docenten en studenten optimaal gebruik kunnen maken van media in het onderwijs.

Wat je gaat doen bij Hogeschool Utrecht

Als DevOps Engineer werk je aan het ontwikkelen, beheren en verbeteren van onze applicaties binnen het medialandschap van de HU.

Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden
  • Ontwikkelen en doorontwikkelen van applicaties in Mendix (myMedia, DIAS);
  • Beheren en optimaliseren van de applicaties;
  • Meedenken over architectuur, security, integraties en technische oplossingen;
  • Samenwerken met developers, business analist, scrummaster, product owner en andere collega’s binnen de HU;
  • Contact met eindgebruikers die hulpverzoeken hebben via interne meldingensysteem (Topdesk);
  • Oplossen van incidenten en verbeteren van stabiliteit en performance;
  • Continu verbeteren van de developer experience en deployment processen, o.a. QA op elkaars code, testinstructies schrijven;

Je werkt in een Agile team waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om mee te denken over hoe we dingen slimmer en beter kunnen doen.

Wij bieden jou

Bij ons krijg je de mogelijkheid om te werken aan studentsucces en een voortrekkersrol te pakken bij de aanpak van maatschappelijke opgaven in de regio. Daarnaast bieden wij goede arbeidsvoorwaarden om te komen werken bij de HU:

  • Je krijgt in eerste instantie een jaarcontract (D4) met een omvang van 0.8 – 1.0 fte. Interne sollicitanten behouden hun huidige contractvorm;
  • Afhankelijk van je kennis en vaardigheden zullen je verantwoordelijkheden en takenpakket worden bepaald. Op basis hiervan vindt inschaling plaats in schaal 10, met een maximum salaris van € 5.699,76. bij een voltijd-aanstelling;
  • Daarboven ontvang je een vakantietoeslag van 8% en bovendien een gegarandeerde eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%;
  • Een tegemoetkoming in de eigen bijdrage van de zorgverzekering van € 300,00 bruto per jaar en een internetvergoeding;
  • Uiteraard behoort het tot de mogelijkheden om een deel van je dienstverband thuis te werken, daarvoor krijg je een thuiswerkvergoeding €2,45 netto per dag;
  • Een OV-Kaart van Reisbalans zodat al je OV-reizen (voor werk en privé) kosteloos zijn. Kom je toch liever met de auto of de fiets? Dan krijg je een uitstekende kilometervergoeding;
  • Wij bieden je uitstekende studie en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden via het eigen HU Ontwikkelportaal, gericht op ontplooiing als onderzoeker en als docent;
  • Bij een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur heb je ca 53 dagen verlof, waaronder de feestdagen en verplichte vrije dagen, Daarnaast krijg je ieder jaar 45 duurzame inzetbaarheidsuren.

Natuurlijk krijg je van ons ook een laptop en een smartphone in bruikleen om locatie-ongebonden te kunnen werken. en bieden wij je ook de mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van leuke extra's zoals ons fietsplan, kortingen bij verzekeringen, software en fitness. Samen met de sociale partners streven we naar afspraken die echt werken en uitgaan van goed werkgeverschap en goed werknemerschap.

Jouw profiel

Wij willen natuurlijk graag dat jij bij ons succesvol wordt in jouw nieuwe baan. We ontvangen van jou graag jouw motivatie en een overzicht van je ervaring. In jouw cv lezen we in ieder geval dat jij:

  • Minimaal beschikt over een bachelor diploma of ervaring waaruit jouw ICT-expertise (ontwikkeling en technisch beheer) blijkt;
  • In staat bent om complexe IT-processen, ketens en integraties te doorgronden en eventuele verstoringen te analyseren;
  • Minimaal 1 jaar ervaring hebt met Mendix, Intermediate Developer certificaat in bezit of bezig deze te behalen;
  • Kennis van Javascript, CSS, open standaarden en protocollen is een pré;
  • Je affiniteit hebt met (Media) Asset Management en video (bewerking);
  • De Nederlandse taal goed beheerst.

Tot slot, mocht je uit bovenstaande lijst niet alles bieden maar wel denken over het juiste DNA te beschikken dan verkennen we graag of dit gat te dichten is.

Naast de kennis en ervaring die je in huis hebt, vinden wij het minstens zo belangrijk wie je bent. Als wij met elkaar in gesprek gaan, dan wordt ons uit jouw voorbeelden duidelijk dat jij de volgende competenties meebrengt:

  • Je bent kritisch, overziet gevolgen van veranderingen in een complexe omgeving;
  • Je zoekt automatisch de samenwerking op met collega's en leveranciers. En staat open om te sparren;
  • Je gaat mee in de technologische ontwikkelingen en weet de impact daarvan op de business inzichtelijk te maken.
Jouw ontwikkelingsperspectief

Bij Hogeschool Utrecht zijn er heel veel mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij helpen je bij jouw ontwikkeling; of dit nu gaat om kennisuitbreiding, coaching of om de volgende stap in je carrière. Bij ons kun je jezelf blijven ontwikkelen in een uitdagende en maatschappelijk georiënteerde omgeving waarbij plezier centraal staat. Kansen zijn er altijd. Het is aan jou om deze kansen te pakken.

Jij komt werken bij Hogeschool Utrecht

Hogeschool Utrecht (HU) is een grote gemeenschap van bijna 40.000 studenten en ruim 4.000 medewerkers. Samen werken we intensief met de beroepspraktijk en met elkaar aan oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van nu.

De HU is gevestigd op het Utrecht Science Park en in Amersfoort en biedt onderwijs op associate degree-, bachelor- en masterniveau. Onlangs is daar het professional doctorate aan toegevoegd. Met onderzoek hebben we (regionale) impact en leiden we studenten op tot innovatieve professionals.

Je wordt lid van een gemeenschap waarin we elkaar binnen en buiten het werk ontmoeten op allerlei verschillende plekken en manieren. Bijvoorbeeld bij de community van de HU Alumni , de HU Gender and Sexuality Alliance (HU GSA) , of het Netwerk Diversiteit & Inclusie.

De HU-gemeenschap is open, rechtvaardig en duurzaam en zo geven we vorm aan de beroepspraktijk, de maatschappij en de professionals van de toekomst.

title: Storskadetaksator til Property Erhverv
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Storskadetaksator til Property Erhverv

Vil du arbejde med de store og komplekse erhvervsskader – i et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden?

Vil du arbejde med nogle af de mest komplekse og spændende erhvervsskader på markedet? Motiveres du af at skabe overblik, finde løsninger og guide kunder gennem omfattende skadeforløb? Så kan du blive en del af vores Property Erhverv-team, hvor høj faglighed, samarbejde og kundeoplevelsen går hånd i hånd.

Hos Sedgwick bliver du en del af vores Property Erhverv-team, hvor vi håndterer nogle af markedets mest komplekse skader.

Vi er et team på seks erfarne specialister med baggrund som arkitekter, ingeniører og bygningskonstruktører. Vi har en uformel og hjælpsom kultur, hvor sparring og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Ingen ved alt, men sammen kan vi meget.

Teamet er primært placeret i Ballerup med én kollega i Aarhus, og du har fleksibilitet til både at arbejde hjemmefra og benytte kontoret (Aarhus eller Ballerup) efter behov.

En rolle med både ansvar og variation

Som storskadetaksator bliver du ansvarlig for at håndtere større og mere komplekse erhvervsskader fra første besigtigelse til endelig opgørelse og afslutning.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Større bygningsskader
  • Entrepriseskader
  • Ansvarsskader

Men også kunne håndtere større og komplekse:

  • Byggeskader
  • Ejerskifteskader

Du vil være den centrale rådgiver for både kunder, forsikringsselskaber og øvrige interessenter gennem hele skadeforløbet. Ingen sager er ens, og du får stor mulighed for at anvende både din tekniske indsigt, din erfaring og din dømmekraft. Stillingen dækker kunder i hele landet.

En hverdag tæt på kunderne

En stor del af arbejdet foregår ude hos kunderne, hvor du besigtiger skader, vurderer omfanget og rådgiver om den videre proces.

Vi arbejder for mange forskellige forsikringsselskaber med forskellige produkter og vilkår. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan navigere professionelt mellem forskellige samarbejdspartnere og samtidig skabe tillid hos kunder, der ofte står i en vanskelig situation.

Som storskadetaksator er du ofte den person, kunden husker bedst fra skadeforløbet. Derfor værdsætter vi både høj faglighed og evnen til at møde mennesker med ro, nærvær og forståelse.

Og hvem er du så?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har minimum 5 års erfaring med opgørelse af større bygningsskader, samt erfaring med ejerskifte- og byggeskader
  • Har solid erfaring som taksator inden for erhvervsområdet
  • Har kørekort og egen bil
  • Har erfaring med at håndtere skader for flere forskellige forsikringsselskaber
  • Kommunikerer professionelt på alle niveauer

Fagligheden er vigtig, men det er din måde at arbejde på også. Du skaber tryghed for kunderne i situationer, der ofte er både omfattende og krævende. Du er rolig, professionel og løsningsorienteret, tager ansvar for dine sager og er samtidig en holdspiller, der bidrager til det gode samarbejde med både kolleger, kunder og forsikringsselskaber.

title: Site Reliability Engineer, Vehicle Software
description:
Site Reliability Engineer - Vehicle Software

The role

As a Site Reliability Engineer at Wayve, you will work across the full reliability stack for our vehicle software: observability, incident management, operator tooling, and the automation that lets engineering and operations teams detect, triage, and resolve issues faster. You will work closely with software engineers, field engineers, and operations, debugging real systems, improving real processes, and having direct impact on how our vehicles perform in production.

Wayve is scaling its autonomous vehicle programs with partners, and you will help shape the SRE approach for vehicle-centric systems as that happens. This is not a role where reliability sits on top of the real work, it is central to it.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and improve tooling, automation, observability, and incident-management processes for vehicle software reliability.

  • Work closely with field engineers, software teams, and operations to diagnose reliability issues and improve system performance.

  • Own hands-on debugging across Linux, low-level systems, logs, metrics, traces, and vehicle and production data.

  • Develop reliability improvements that reduce manual intervention and make issue detection, triage, and recovery faster.

  • Support vehicle-centric operations, including safety-operator tools and the reliability needs of our customer and partner programs.

About you

Essential skills

  • You will write production-quality code every day in Python, C++, or Rust. This is a software engineering role as much as a reliability role, and coding is central to the work.

  • Comfortable debugging at the Linux and systems level, reading logs, tracing failures, and finding root cause in complex environments.

  • Experience with CI/CD, containerization, networking, distributed systems, databases, and observability and incident-management tooling, including DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Splunk, or Humio.

  • Experience diagnosing complex production or operational systems, not just escalating, but seeing problems through to resolution.

  • The communication skills to work effectively across engineering, operations, and field teams, and the judgment to know when to bring others in.

  • Based in Sunnyvale and able to be onsite at least three days a week to work alongside the field teams you will support.

Desirable skills

  • Experience with autonomous vehicles, robotics, embedded systems, or safety-critical environments. We know this is rare, and it is not a barrier to applying.

  • Experience with large-scale telemetry or high-volume data pipelines.

  • Familiarity with vehicle-centric or on-device software systems.

This is a full-time role based in our office in Sunnyvale. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home. The reasonably estimated salary for this role ranges from $209,700 to $266,800, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Azure Databricks
description:
Salary: Excellent Salary and benefits package.

Take ownership of an established Azure Databricks platform and lead its next stage of evolution.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer – Azure Databricks to join a large, established New Zealand organisation undergoing significant investment in its data capability.

The foundations of the data platform are already in place. Your focus will be on extending, hardening and scaling the environment – introducing new capability, improving engineering practices and strengthening governance as the platform matures.

This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll combine technical delivery with leadership of a small team of Data Engineers. You’ll set technical direction and engineering standards while working closely with analytics, BI and business stakeholders.

Proven production experience with Azure Databricks is essential.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the continued evolution of an Azure Databricks lakehouse, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog and medallion architecture.
  • Design and build robust, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL and Python.
  • Extend platform capability across Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Key Vault and other Azure services.
  • Mature CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and DevOps practices.
  • Strengthen data governance, quality, lineage, access control and security.
  • Improve platform performance, reliability, monitoring and observability.
  • Design and maintain data models supporting analytics and reporting.
  • Lead, coach and mentor Data Engineers and establish strong engineering standards.
  • Partner with analytics, BI and business teams to translate data requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Contribute to the organisation’s broader data strategy and roadmap.

What we’re looking for

You’ll be an experienced Data Engineer who has worked extensively with Azure Databricks in a production environment and is comfortable taking technical ownership of an evolving data platform.

You’ll bring:

  • Strong commercial Azure Databricks experience, including Delta Lake and Unity Catalog.
  • Strong experience across the Azure data ecosystem, particularly Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2 and Azure Key Vault.
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong Python capability for data engineering.
  • Experience with dimensional and/or medallion data modelling.
  • CI/CD experience using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions.
  • Infrastructure-as-code experience using Terraform, Bicep or ARM.
  • Experience implementing data governance, quality and access-control frameworks.
  • Experience improving or re-architecting an existing data platform for greater scalability, governance and reliability.
  • Previous experience leading, coaching or mentoring Data Engineers.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Experience with Power BI, streaming or near-real-time ingestion technologies such as Event Hubs or Kafka, and relevant Databricks or Microsoft Azure certifications would be advantageous.

Why consider this opportunity?

This is an opportunity to step into an environment where the foundations have already been built but there is still plenty of scope to make your mark.

You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Influence the technical direction of a growing data platform.
  • Lead and develop a small engineering team.
  • Work on a modern Azure Databricks environment.
  • Introduce better engineering, governance and DevOps practices.
  • Work closely with senior technical and business stakeholders.
  • Help shape the organisation’s longer-term data capability.

The role is Auckland based with a hybrid working model of three days in the office and two days working from home.

Benefits include subsidised medical insurance, enhanced employer retirement contributions, additional leave benefits and dedicated paid learning and development time.

If you’re an experienced Azure Databricks Data Engineer looking for a role combining hands-on engineering, technical ownership and team leadership, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply now or contact JOYN for a confidential discussion.

title: Marketingkoordinator
description:
Vil du være en del af en kreativ og værdidrevet virksomhed, hvor du er tæt på beslutningerne og kan gøre en mærkbar forskel? Til vores kontor i Herning søger vi en struktureret og alsidig kollega, der kan koordinere marketingaktiviteter på tværs af hele vores brandportefølje. Jobbet er en kombination af content, kampagnestøtte, praktisk koordinering og tæt samarbejde med salg, på tværs af både Living og Kids.

Hos DDI Group er vi midt i en spændende vækstrejse. Vi styrker nu vores marketingafdeling og leder efter en ny kollega til vores kontor i Herning, der kan tage ejerskab over den daglige koordinering af marketingopgaver på tværs af vores brands, såsom OYOY Living Design, ReCollector, bObles, Gejst mfl. Du bliver en støtte i dagligdagen til de enkelte brandejere og bindeled til salg, B2B-webshop og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Du får en rolle med stor variation, hvor ingen dage er ens.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en vigtig del af vores marketingteam, med en bred koordinatorrolle der spænder over content, data, produktlanceringer, kampagner, direct-to-consumer markedsføring og trade marketing. Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med salgsteamet og brandansvarlige for at sikre, at marketingmaterialer, kampagner og produktdata er opdaterede og performer bedst muligt på tværs af markederne. Du vil have arbejdsplads på vores kontor i Herning. Din reference vil være til vores e-commerce manager.

Det kommer du til at arbejde med:

  • Koordinering af marketingmaterialer og kampagner på tværs af brands og markeder

  • Vedligeholdelse og opdatering af produktdata og marketingassets

  • Support til contentproduktion, blandt andet til SoMe annoncering og egne webshops

  • Assistance med e-mail marketing (bl.a. i Klaviyo) – opsætning, segmentering og udsendelser

  • Tæt samarbejde med salgsteamet om lokale og internationale markedsaktiviteter

  • Administrativ og praktisk support til marketing- og produktafdelingen

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Gerne har 1-3 års erfaring fra en koordinerende eller udførende marketingrolle

  • Har en relevant uddannelse inden for marketing, kommunikation eller lignende

  • Er struktureret, nysgerrig og god til at holde overblik, når mange opgaver kører parallelt

  • Har teknisk forståelse og gerne erfaring med platforme som Shopify, Klaviyo eller lignende marketing- og e-commerce-tools

  • Er nysgerrig på at lave AI orienterede løsninger

  • Er proaktiv, samarbejdsorienteret og trives i en dynamisk organisation med mange brands og interessenter

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk og engelsk, skriftligt og mundtligt

Vi tilbyder:

  • En hverdag i en spændende og værdidrevet virksomhed i vækst

  • En bred og udviklende rolle med stor kontaktflade til hele organisationen

  • Muligheden for at arbejde med et varieret brandportefølje inden for både Living og Kids

  • Uformel arbejdskultur med højt tempo og godt humør

  • Fedt arbejdsmiljø, med gode kolleger og sociale arrangementer

  • Oplæring i systemer og arbejdsprocesser

Om os

DDI Group er hovedselskabet bag en række ambitiøse danske bolig- og børnebrands, som forener den skandinaviske designtradition med innovation. Vores brands og produkter spænder fra moderne møbler, belysning og boliginteriør til gennemtænkte produkter til børn.

Vores brandportefølje består af flere stærke brands, herunder OYOY Living, GEJST, ReCollector, Plauborg, bObles, FILIBABBA, OYOY Mini, Scandinavian Baby Products, samt distribuerede brands som Bright Starts, Baby Einstein, Oball, Ingenuity og Connetix.

Sådan søger du:

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, og har du lyst til at blive en del af vores team med base på vores kontor i Herning? Så send din ansøgning snarest muligt til CMO Jacob Loburski på jlo@ddigroup.com og E-commerce Manager Anders Lading på ala@ddigroup.com. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte CMO Jacob Loburski på mail jlo@ddigroup.com eller E-commerce Manager Anders Lading på ala@ddigroup.com

Opstart: Snarest muligt. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Jobbet kan søges via enten e-mail eller LinkedIN.

Unsolicited application - Warehouse employee (part time)

We are not currently looking for warehouse employees, but you are very welcome to send us an unsolicited application.

Can you perform in a busy environment, do you have experience from packing or from a warehouse and do you have a good physique?

About the job
As a warehouse employee you are an important part of the business. You will pack products for our customers from refrigerated, dry, green and frost areas. We use pick-by-voice, and you will be walking around the warehouse, picking and packing orders throughout your entire shift. This requires that you have a good physique.

The packing department consists of more than 40 different nationalities and since it is a multicultural area it requires that you speak and understand English.

Work hours
Nemlig operates 365 days a year and you should be able to work in rotation, also during the afternoon, evenings and weekends. It is important that you are able to work in all our different timeslot rotations, which depends on seasons and order flows.
Your shifts can start in the morning 6:00 AM, midday or afternoon 06:00 PM the latest. Please feel free to specify in your application which exact times that would work best for you.
We are offering a flexible part-time contract, so your average working hours will be between 15 and 25 hours per week, calculated over a planned period of at least 4 weeks. Usually, you will be scheduled for 15 hours per week, spread across 3–5 working days, depending on which department you work in. During busy periods, we may change your work schedule one month in advance, increasing your working hours by up to 25 hours per week. It is therefore important that you are flexible during busy periods. There will be work every other weekend.

Our expectations
We hire responsible employees who thrive in a performance environment and who are willing to go the extra mile.

title: Senior Staff Embedded Software Engineer - SATCOM
description:
Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
The Skylark product line is focused on the rapid design, build, and test of cutting-edge active phased array antennas (AESA) for terrestrial and airborne applications. Current programs span high-power, large-scale ground terminals for missile defense to commercial airline and helicopter connectivity solutions.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Staff Embedded Software Engineer to join our software team. In this position, you will be responsible for low-level and high-level software in Cesium’s products through all phases of the development process. Key projects will include Linux-based single-board computers and high-reliability microcontroller systems. Cesium’s goal is to create an out-of-the-box hardware and software experience which enhances our customers’ ability to rapidly integrate our products into their systems.
As a Cesium software team member, you will be responsible for software designs from concept through production, including product roadmaps, block diagrams, detailed design and coding, analysis, test, qualification, and in-orbit support. The ideal candidate will have development experience at nearly every level of the software stack, including microcontrollers, low-level drivers, board support packages (BSP), end-use applications, and user interfaces. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience in software testing and high-reliability qualification, as well as software engineering and software project management practices.
The successful candidate will present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and implement software for embedded devices and systems, from requirements to production and commercial deployment.
  • Design, develop, code, test, debug and document system software.
  • Review code and system designs.
  • Analyze code for efficiency, stability and scalability.
  • Integrate and validate new product designs.
  • Support software quality assurance and optimize I/O performance.
  • Provide post-production/in-orbit customer support.
  • Interface with hardware design and development engineers.
  • Assess third party and open source software.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
  • Minimum of 12 years of industry experience in software development.
  • Experience in hands-on development and troubleshooting of embedded hardware. API design for interfacing with FPGAs.
  • Extensive programming experience in C and an object oriented programming language, preferably C++.
  • Experience in embedded systems design with preemptive, multitasking real-time operating systems (experience with real-time Linux is desirable).
  • Familiarity with software configuration management tools, defect tracking tools, and peer review.
  • Excellent knowledge of real-time system coding techniques, IP protocols, interfaces, and hardware subsystems.
  • Excellent understanding of multi-threaded applications and resource management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with products for aerospace applications.
  • Adequate knowledge of reading electronics schematics and component data sheets.
  • Experience with ARM processors and fully-featured microcontrollers.
  • Experience in design and development of a Software Development Kit (SDK).
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.
CesiumAstro is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Business Analytics Specialist
description:
About PayJoy
PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success. Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system. Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life. PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.
This role

We are looking for a Business Analytics Specialist to serve as a key technical authority within the Global Metrics team and help define the architecture, standards, and analytical foundations that support Customer Support operations globally.

The professional will be responsible for defining and evolving the end-to-end data architecture across the Global Customer Support ecosystem, including data ingestion patterns, Medallion Architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold), dimensional modeling, semantic layers, KPI frameworks, data governance, and analytical standards.

The role requires strong hands-on experience with Databricks and dbt, as well as experience working with large-scale datasets, high-volume data ingestion, and scalable data pipelines.

Experience with AI-oriented data architectures and data modeling for MLOps is highly desirable but not mandatory.

Key Responsabilities

Data Architecture

  • Own and evolve the Bronze / Silver / Gold data architecture for the Global Metrics ecosystem.

  • Define scalable architectural patterns for integrating new Customer Support platforms and data sources.

  • Design dimensional, relational, and analytical data models.

  • Define standards for data ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption.

  • Design integration patterns across APIs, cloud storage, SaaS platforms, and enterprise data platforms.

  • Establish architecture principles for data quality, traceability, lineage, scalability, and maintainability.

  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to translate architectural designs into production-ready implementations.

  • Review technical solutions and ensure alignment with Global Metrics architectural standards.

Data Pipelines & Large-Scale Processing

  • Design scalable data pipelines using Databricks and dbt.

  • Work with large-scale datasets and high-volume data ingestion workloads.

  • Define transformation patterns and data-processing strategies for distributed environments.

  • Optimize data models and processing pipelines for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost.

  • Support ingestion strategies using platforms such as Fivetran, APIs, file-based integrations, and cloud object storage.

  • Define reusable patterns for batch and incremental data processing.

  • Ensure pipelines are designed with appropriate monitoring, recoverability, and data-quality controls.

Analytics & Semantic Architecture

  • Own the design and evolution of the analytics semantic layer.

  • Define scalable frameworks for KPIs, business metrics, dimensions, and analytical entities.

  • Translate business concepts into standardized analytical definitions and data models.

  • Design and govern the Gold analytical layer used by dashboards, analytics, AI, and reporting.

  • Define dimensional and OLAP models optimized for analytical consumption.

  • Establish reusable semantic models to reduce duplicated business logic across dashboards and datasets.

  • Partner with Business Analysts and stakeholders to ensure metrics accurately represent business processes and operational reality.

Metrics Governance & Business Rules

  • Define and maintain standards for KPI definitions, calculations, dimensions, and business rules.

  • Maintain and evolve the business glossary and data dictionary.

  • Establish governance processes to prevent conflicting or duplicated metric definitions.

  • Define global naming conventions, taxonomies, tags, classifications, and analytical standards across Customer Support platforms.

  • Ensure business definitions are consistently translated into technical implementations.

  • Support the definition of global analytical entities such as customers, contacts, interactions, tickets, agents, queues, channels, and support journeys.

System & Data Integration Architecture

  • Define how new systems and vendors are integrated into the Global Metrics data ecosystem.

  • Evaluate integration alternatives such as APIs, event streams, file exports, object storage, managed ingestion platforms, and direct database connections.

  • Define source-of-truth strategies and relationships across multiple operational systems.

  • Design data models that enable end-to-end traceability across Customer Support interactions and platforms.

  • Participate in architecture discussions with internal Data, Engineering, Security, and Platform teams.

  • Work with vendors and technical stakeholders to assess data availability, integration capabilities, and architectural constraints.

  • AI & Advanced Analytics Architecture — Preferred

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Statistics, or a related technical field.

  • Equivalent professional experience may be considered in place of formal education.

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Data Architecture, Business Intelligence Architecture, or similar roles.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing scalable analytical data solutions.

  • Strong hands-on experience with:

  • Databricks

  • dbt

  • Advanced SQL

  • Dimensional data modeling

  • Data warehouse / lakehouse architectures

  • Medallion Architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold)

  • Semantic layers and analytical data models

  • Data integration patterns

  • Experience working with large-scale datasets and high-volume data ingestion is required.

  • Experience designing and optimizing scalable data pipelines.

  • Experience with Fivetran or equivalent managed ingestion platforms is preferred.

  • Experience with Spark and distributed data processing is strongly preferred.

  • Experience designing analytics solutions consumed by BI platforms such as Hex, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Mode, or equivalent tools.

Familiarity with:

  • LLM-based analytics

  • Context engineering

  • NLP / text analytics

  • AI data pipelines

  • Data-Centric AI principles

  • AI / Advanced Data Experience — Nice to Have

Benefits

  • 100% Company-funded Health for employees and immediate family members
  • Life Insurance
  • Indefinite-term contract
  • 20 days of vacations, unlimited sick leave
  • $2,000 USD annual Co-working Travel perk
  • $2,000 USD annual Professional Development perk
  • Phone finance, headphone benefit, home office equipment allowance and wellness perks
  • Catered lunches

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Finance for the next billion * Ownership * Break Through Walls * Live Communication * Transparency & Directness * Focus on Scale * Work-Life Balance * Embrace Diversity * Speed * Active Listening

title: College Football Quality Reviewer - Independent Contractor
description:

At CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the disruptive potential of AI for the world. By combining advanced technology with a global network of talented experts, we make unusable data usable and inference reliable and trustworthy, driving real-world business value at scale.

More than just a workplace, we're a global community founded on strong relationships and the belief that meaningful work transforms lives. Our commitment to earning, learning, and serving fuels everything we do, as we strive to connect one million people to meaningful work and build leaders worth following.
