title: Library Advisor - Riverside County Library System
description:
The Library Advisor is a non-supervisory professional Librarian who serves as a system-wide advisor, implementation leader, and professional resource for the Riverside County Library System (RCLS).


Reporting to the Assistant Executive Director, the Library Advisor works collaboratively with Executive leadership, Branch Managers, Library Management Office staff, and other organizational partners to support consistent, high-quality public library services across RCLS. The position provides professional consultation, coaching, training, and implementation support.


The Library Advisor does not supervise Branch Managers or serve as an intermediary between branches and Executive leadership.

Instead, the role focuses on strengthening organizational effectiveness by sharing professional expertise, supporting implementation of Executive priorities, promoting best practices, facilitating collaboration, and helping branches successfully navigate organizational initiatives.


The Library Advisor serves as a professional consultant, organizational resource, and implementation partner, not as a supervisory position. Success is measured by strengthening Branch Managers, improving organizational consistency, supporting successful implementation of executive priorities, and promoting operational excellence through collaboration, coaching, and professional expertise.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Support and Consultation

  • Provides support to Branch Managers regarding public library operations, programming, collections, customer service, community engagement, and professional library practices.
  • Serves as a professional resource by offering guidance, coaching, recommendations, and implementation assistance.
  • Advises on operational incidents and recommend appropriate responses; matters requiring executive action are elevated appropriately.

Organizational Implementation

  • Supports implementation of executive priorities and organizational initiatives.
  • Assist Branch Managers with implementation plans translating organizational priorities into measurable local actions.
  • Identifies implementation challenges and collaborates on solutions.
  • Participates in cross-functional projects that advance operational excellence.

Professional Development

  • Supports orientation and onboarding of new Branch Managers and management staff.
  • Identifies training needs and coordinates learning opportunities.
  • Assists in facilitating leadership forums, peer-learning sessions, workshops, and collaborative problem-solving.
  • Serves as a mentor and professional resource.

Operational Excellence

  • Visits branchs to support implementation efforts on behalf of executive Leadership direction, organizational initiatives, operational assessments, and continuous improvement.
  • Use LibraryIQ and other approved tools to analyze operational trends and provide recommendations.
  • Maintain awareness of current library trends and emerging practices.

Collaboration

  • Partners with Collection Management, Literacy Services, Business Operations, Marketing, Facilities, Information Technology, HR, and other departments.
  • Encourages Branch Managers to work directly with designated subject-matter experts.
  • Supports partnerships, Friends of the Library, programming initiatives, and community engagement.

Organizational Support

  • May help to assist in the temporary operational support during leadership vacancies or major organizational initiatives as assigned.
  • Routes matters requiring executive involvement through appropriate leadership channels.
  • Promotes a collaborative, inclusive, customer-focused culture.

title: Senior Software Project Engineer
description:
Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior Software Project Engineer to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing software for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.
The CesiumAstro software team designs complex firmware and software for state-of-the-art aerospace systems. As a member of the software engineering team, you will help facilitate and improve the execution of the software development lifecycle at CesiumAstro. You will collaborate with software engineers, program managers, customers, and other stakeholders to plan and manage execution in a fast-paced engineering environment.
Activities include maintaining backlog health, holding software standups, and communicating project status to diverse stakeholders. The ideal candidate has experience managing embedded system firmware development in high-reliability systems. Experience with both agile and traditional design methodologies is desirable, including agile and v-model flows. Further, the ideal candidate has some first-hand embedded system software development experience.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create software development plans subject to cost and schedule constraints.
  • Lead periodic planning meetings, retrospectives, and daily standups.
  • Communicate project status to a wide variety of technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Represent the software engineering team to programmatic stakeholders.
  • Maintain software issue tracking systems and projects such as Jira.
  • Prioritize feature development based on varied and sometimes conflicting stakeholder inputs.
  • Interface to external parties including customers and vendors.
  • Ensure consistent and correct software development lifecycle execution.
  • Continuously improve software project execution processes.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience required including at least 1 year of embedded software development experience and at least 3 years of software project management experience.
  • Excellent communication skills, especially in tailoring to a target audience.
  • Familiarity with board-level hardware design processes as they pertain to software development.
  • Knowledgeable on multiple software product lifecycle and management approaches including Agile and V-model.
  • Competency with software lifecycle management tools such issue tracking (Jira preferred), requirements management, configuration management, etc.
  • Experience project managing firmware development.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience designing products for deployment into aerospace systems.
  • Experience with government contract program management.
  • Experience with requirements-driven engineering processes.
  • Experience with DO-178C Software Certification.
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.
CesiumAstro is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary


The Global Data Engineering Lead (GDEL/Senior Engineer) – Data & Analytics, will work to lead multiple initiatives, solutions, and teams within Eisai’s Global Data & Analytics technology organization within our GDASC. Reporting directly to the Global Data & Analytics Technology Lead, this role contributes to the overall mission of establishing future-proof data and solution architectures supporting data engineering, data science, analytics, business intelligence, and AI globally.


The GDEL will work collaboratively with global GDBT leaders and peers, business stakeholders, consultants, technology vendors, and managed service providers to deliver successful technical projects that meet complex business requirements providing a cohesive and unified data strategy and implementation.


They are responsible for the co-creation, architecture, design, development, and implementation of data analytics, AI architecture, and reference frameworks supporting Eisai’s global businesses. They will lead and be responsible for participating in the strategic planning and hands-on engineering of solutions and cloud environments that support advanced analytics, data science, AI, and other data platform initiatives. This will include supporting commercial, R&D, and corporate analysis initiatives as well as the associated personas such as enterprise users, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and AI engineers.


Deep experience required with Eisai’s Data Foundational Platforms which are Databricks, Informatica and Tableau.


Essential Functions

  • Inspires, leads, and directs the GDASC technical data & analytics teams to promote the capabilities and adoption of business intelligence, analytics, and AI solutions supporting Eisai globally.
  • Should have the ability to perform “hands-on” work participating in the build of data & analytics solutions within Eisai’s ecosystem of tools.
  • Manages, advises, and coaches team members within the GDASC.
  • Works with Global D&A leadership to support enterprise operating models for data and analytics for both global and federated capabilities and how they interact. The goal is an effective, efficient, scalable, and agile model driving value from standardization and reuse of advanced capabilities while supporting regionally relevant flexibility and delivery autonomy.
  • Coaches and mentors operational support teams on technical concepts, designs, and system functionality to support ongoing projects as well as projects in production.
  • As a technology strategist, they contribute to the Data and Analytics business strategy.
  • Works collaboratively across the global organization to build the data ingestion, storage and/or virtualization structures needed to support our next generation of data products, self-service analytics, and data democratization initiatives.
  • Should enable operational efficiency and effectiveness providing governed data democratization as an output.


Requirements


Work Experience and Education

  • An undergraduate or postgraduate degree in computer science, information science, management information systems, a related field, or equivalent experience relevant to this position.
  • 10+ years experience working with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
  • 10+ years IT domain experience in pharmaceutical industry preferred but not required.
  • 8+ years experience designing and implementing data solutions on Amazon Web Services (AWS), incorporating product offerings such as:

Athena

Lambda Functions

DynamoDB

Managed Airflow (MWAA)

EC2

Managed Kafka (MSK)

Elastic MapReduce (EMR)

Neptune

ElastiCache

RDS – Aurora PostgreSQL

Glue

Redshift

Kinesis

S3 Standard, Glacier, etc.

  • 5+ years experience using data management and analysis tools including Databricks, Informatica, RStudio/Posit, and Immuta.
  • Strong knowledge of data wrangling, preparation, and ETL for use in advanced analytics, machine learning and AI.
  • Deeply passionate about learning and innovating using leading edge and next generation solutions in big data engineering, cloud, and open source.
  • Strong data architecture, warehousing, modeling and wrangling skills demonstrating an understanding of various data architecture patterns and when to use them. Examples include: ETL/ELT, data vault and data warehousing techniques, normalization/de-normalization, key-value, in-memory, wide column, columnar, graph, text-indexing, vector, partitioning, streaming, and message queuing
  • Experienced with medallion architecture providing progressive data cleansing, deduplication, and applied data quality through bronze, silver, and gold layers.
  • Strong software engineering and object-oriented programming skills with expertise in SQL, Python, Scala, R, and Java; including open-source frameworks/libraries, such as Spark, Airflow and streaming services.
  • Working knowledge of traditional big data systems, such as Hadoop, Impala, Sqoop, Oozie, Cassandra, Redshift, Oracle, MS SQL Server, and PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with varying file and table data formats such as ORC, Parquet, Delta, and Iceberg.
  • Hands-on experience with various Business Intelligence tools such as Tableau and PowerBI


Leadership and Teamwork

  • Strong track record of effective cross-functional team collaboration and execution
  • Experience working in multi-cultural and international environments
  • Ready to think, behave, and act in an innovative consulting manner to drive the GDBT Technology Strategy.
  • Effective leadership skills. These include team building, consensus building, the ability to balance team and individual responsibilities and achieving goals through others not directly under the leader's supervision, by working ethically and with integrity.
  • Communication, Organization, and Issue Resolution Skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Influential networker with a collaborative mindset and strong customer-centric focus.
  • Ability to plan, organize, prioritize, and work effectively in a fast paced and dynamic environment.
  • Proven problem solver who takes ownership and is driven by a strong sense of urgency, timely resolution, and keen attention to detail to execute successfully under time and resource demands.
  • Information Technology Planning, Analysis, Design, Architecture and Management
  • Strong business analysis skills and experience, which include issues resolution and business needs solutioning.
  • Familiarity with information management practices, system development life cycle (SDLC) management, IT services management, agile and lean methodologies, infrastructure and operations, Enterprise Architecture (EA), and Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) frameworks.
  • Experience in managing application / system changes in accordance with computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11 and GxP regulations.


Domain Knowledge

  • Experience in enabling product development through the use of big data analytics and data science solutions and familiarity of pharma functions and processes.
  • Strong technical knowledge of life science production systems that will help weigh trade-offs and evaluate risks when designing for future states.

Eisai Core Values

  • Embodies and consistently demonstrates Eisai’s core company values: Quality, Teamwork, Respect, Integrity, and Professionalism.

title: Senior Product Development Chemist (Tires)
description:
Senior Product Development Chemist (Tire Materials)

Arclin has an immediate, full time opening for a Senior Product Development Chemist (Tires) at their Cleveland, Ohio location. This is an on-site role.

About Arclin:

You can find Arclin everywhere. Our technologies make homes and transportation safer, help crops flourish, keep water clean, protect first responders and members of the military, and preserve the purity of essential pharmaceuticals. These vital, everyday products can't fail, and we’re here to give the world an extra layer of performance and peace of mind.

With ~4,000 team members across more than 30 global manufacturing facilities, we operate with the scale to make a global impact and the agility to solve complex challenges at the molecular level. Rooted in scientific discovery and innovation, Arclin’s materials redefine performance across industries - from Firepoint®’s patented intumescent technology that helps stall flames and save lives to the iconic Kevlar® and Nomex® brands trusted to protect those who serve, strengthen aerospace and industrial systems, and perform where reliability and safety are top of mind.

As we expand our mission‑critical materials portfolio and shape the next era of performance technologies, we’re looking for people who want to grow, lead, and solve the challenges others can’t. Together, we’ll advance the innovations that keep the world moving. Because at Arclin, our people are truly Vital Beyond Measure.

Sr. Product Development Chemist Responsibilities:

  • Assists the Business and/or Technical Directors with the development, implementation and deployment of an approved technology strategy for each market segment
  • Identifies and recommends optimum resource deployment, including lab activity, in support of the respective strategy
  • Integrates the innovative thinking of direct reports, peers, project team members into decisions which benefit project outcomes, while building the capabilities of team members
  • Creates a team environment conducive to innovation; sustains team members’ focus on time/cost/quality outcomes while delivering innovative solutions
  • Ensures that project work occurs in compliance with all Arclin policies and procedures including HSE and regulatory requirements
  • Achieves project or defined sub-set of departmental objectives within agreed time, cost, and quality parameters.
  • Gains credibility with peers by delivering results which accelerate Arclin’s progress towards strategic goals, while being consistent with Arclin’s values
  • Communicates with internal and external customers to ensure project plans and work in progress will meet desired outcomes
  • Interfaces with Customer personnel to determine current and future technology needs and recommend appropriate action plans to the Business Region Management
  • Solicits feedback from key stakeholders at regular intervals to ensure quality, cost and response time continue to meet with customer expectations
  • Using expert knowledge, develops the technical know-how and capability of the Arclin R&T organization in the areas of advanced tire materials characterization, process and manufacturing simulation, tire/vehicle performance modeling, and tire digital twin development.
  • Devises and carries out projects that target defined, strategic scientific objectives in a timely, cost-efficient, and safe manner.
  • Uses structure/property relationship thinking to develop, evaluate, and refine formulations.
  • Conducts rubber formulating, mixing and testing, material optimizations, and material characterization using a variety of chemical, physical, or mechanical techniques common to the field of rubber science.

Senior Product Development Chemist Requirements:

  • Bachelors’ degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Polymer Engineering or related field is required
  • Minimum five (5) years job related experience (Prefer 10yrs+)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Ability to coordinate activities both on site and between sites
  • Strong technical knowledge of:
  • Tire rubber materials, compounding, formulating, and manufacturing including EV passenger tread compounding, approaches targeting wet traction, treadwear, and fuel economy; truck/bus tread compounding for treadwear and fuel economy.
  • Rubber property relationships to tire performance and compound property influence on tire design parameters.
  • Advanced tire materials testing and characterization methods
  • Digital simulation of rubber and tire manufacturing processes, tire/vehicle performance modelling, and digital twin development.
  • Preferred: Hands-on experience using rubber laboratory equipment including Moving Die Rheometer (MDR), Rubber Process Analyzer (RPA), Mooney Viscometer, Universal Testing Machine (i.e., Tensile Tester), Dynamic Mechanical Analyzer (DMA), laboratory rubber mixers (Banbury and Brabender), and Two-Roll Mill

title: Restaurant Server
description:

Hook It Up Fish & Chips brings a fresh take on a classic favorite to the heart of Santa Fe. Located just steps from the historic Santa Fe Plaza, Hook It Up serves up crispy fried fish, succulent shrimp, golden chicken and perfectly paired chips in a casual, energetic setting.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer II

  • Provision and manage clusters, monitor alerts, and oversee the health and configuration of cloud environments.

description:
Vil du rådgive erhvervskunder om valuta, risikostyring og finansiel afdækning – og skabe løsninger, der styrker kundernes økonomiske tryghed og handlekraft?

Så er du måske vores nye valutarådgiver/specialist i Finansiel Afdækning, som er en del af Transaction Banking i Jyske Bank Erhverv.

Du skal søge jobbet, hvis du vil kombinere høj faglighed med kundeværdi

I Transaction Banking arbejder vi tæt på virksomhedernes drift og pengestrømme. Finansiel Afdækning rådgiver erhvervskunder om valuta- og renterisici og hjælper dem med overblik, strategi og gennemfører relevante afdækningsforretninger.

Som valutarådgiver/specialist bliver du en vigtig del af kundeteamet omkring større erhvervskunder. Du bringer specialistviden i spil sammen med erhvervspartnere, øvrige specialister og Jyske Markets, så kunden oplever rådgivning, der er stærk, relevant og let at handle på.

Du får stor fleksibilitet, indflydelse på din hverdag og et tydeligt ansvar for at omsætte markedsindsigt og kundekendskab til løsninger, der skaber værdi for kunder, kollegaer og banken.

Dine vigtigste opgaver

  • Rådgive erhvervskunder om valutarisici, valutastrategi og afdækningsløsninger.
  • Skabe overblik over kundens valutaeksponering og omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til klare anbefalinger
  • Indgå i kundeteams sammen med erhvervspartnere og specialister på tværs af banken
  • Identificere forretningsmuligheder og deltage i kundemøder, kanvasarbejde og kundearrangementer
  • Bidrage til udvikling, videndeling, faglig sparring og anvendelse af digitale rådgivningsværktøjer på valutaområdet

Vi lægger vægt på forberedelse, stærkt kundekendskab og modet til at udfordre kundernes status quo, når det skaber bedre beslutninger.

Dit markedsområde bliver primært København og Sjælland. Din arbejdsplads bliver som udgangspunkt i Glaskuben på Kalvebod Brygge i København, og du bliver del af et landsdækkende fagligt miljø i Finansiel Afdækning.

Du lykkes i jobbet, når du omsætter rollen til kundeværdi

  • Du er engageret og gør rådgivningen konkret, enkel og handlingsorienteret.
  • Du arbejder proaktivt med kundemøder, kanvas, pipeline og videndeling, så valuta bliver en naturlig del af den samlede erhvervsrådgivningen
  • Du udarbejder relevant kundevendt materiale af høj kvalitet.
  • Du tager ansvar for at udvikle og fastholde stærke kunderelationer på valutaområdet
  • Du bringer specialistviden aktivt ind i kundeteamet og styrker samspillet med erhvervspartnere, specialister og Jyske Markets.
  • Du bidrager til Jyske Banks strategi gennem rådgivning og løsninger, der styrker kundetilfredsheden.

Din profil

Vi forventer, at du har solid erfaring med valutarådgivning og handel i relation til erhvervsvirksomheder, f.eks. fra en lignende stilling i et pengeinstitut eller en finansafdeling.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har høj faglighed og kendskab til finansielle markeder, risikostyring og erhvervskundernes forretning
  • Skaber tillid gennem viden, nysgerrighed, tydelig kommunikation og fokus på kundernes behov
  • Trives med at arbejde tæt sammen med erhvervspartnere om både nye og eksisterende kunder
  • Kan gøre komplekse finansielle emner konkrete, relevante og værdiskabende for kunden.
  • Arbejder struktureret, vedholdende og tager ansvar for orden i eget hus
  • Arbejder selvstændigt, men bidrager aktivt til fællesskabet og udvikling af teamet
  • Motiveres af fastsatte mål for resultater, adfærd og udvikling.

Om Finansiel Afdækning

Finansiel Afdækning er en del af Transaction Banking i Jyske Bank Erhverv. Vi rådgiver om valuta- og renterisici, finansielle strategier og afdækningsprodukter med udgangspunkt i kundens situation, ønsker og behov.

Vi er et landsdækkende team med høj faglighed, stærkt samarbejde og et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med højt til loftet og plads til et godt grin.

Hos os er initiativ, kundefokus og viljen til udvikling en selvfølge. Vi vil være en af bankens mest værdsatte specialistafdelinger ved at levere relevant, ansvarlig og værdiskabende rådgivning.

Finansiel Afdækning tæller pt. 12 medarbejdere fordelt på 6 fysiske placeringer. Se dine kommende kolleger.

Diversitet, inklusion og ligestilling

I Jyske Bank mener vi, at diversitet skaber bedre beslutninger, relationer og arbejdsmiljø. Vi arbejder for inklusion og lige muligheder for alle.

Vi opfordrer alle til at søge, uanset køn, alder og religion. Vi styrkes af hinandens forskelligheder – kom og vær med.

Hør mere om jobbet

Hvis du er interesseret i jobbet, eller har spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer
description:
About This Vacancy

Als Fullstack Software Engineer werk je aan de volledige keten van softwareontwikkeling: van gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces tot robuuste backendlogica en cloudintegraties. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende technologieën en werkt samen met collega’s en klanten aan innovatieve oplossingen die impact maken. Denk aan:

  • Ontwerpen en bouwen van webapplicaties met moderne front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue).
  • Ontwikkelen van schaalbare backendservices in bijvoorbeeld Java, C#, Node.js of Python.
  • Integreren van databases, APIs en cloudservices (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Waarborgen van kwaliteit en performance via CI/CD, testautomatisering en DevOps-principes.
  • Samenwerken met UX-designers, data-engineers en domeinexperts om complete oplossingen te realiseren.
  • 3 tot 8 jaar ervaring met fullstack softwareontwikkeling in hightech of enterprise-omgevingen.
  • Een afgeronde Bachelor-, bij voorkeur Masteropleiding in een technisch vakgebied (bijvoorbeeld informatica, software engineering of wiskunde).
  • Kennis van en ervaring met softwaredesign en ontwikkelprincipes (OOP, TDD, SOLID, Clean Code).
  • Ervaring met cloudplatforms (Azure, AWS of GCP) en containertechnologie (Docker, Kubernetes) is een plus.
  • Ervaring met Scrum, Agile of SAFe methodieken.
  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
  • Een analytische, pragmatische en gestructureerde manier van werken.
  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd, zodat je stabiliteit hebt in een dynamische omgeving.
  • Een uitgebreide individuele winstdeling.
  • Een individueel opleidingsbudget van €2.200 per jaar, zodat je jezelf continu kunt blijven ontwikkelen.
  • De kans om samen te groeien met onze ervaren professionals in onze kleinschalige, hechte business-cel.
  • Toegang tot ons TMC Entrepreneurial Lab, waar je je eigen ideeën en projecten tot leven kunt brengen.
  • Een omgeving waar jouw stem telt en waar jouw dromen werkelijkheid kunnen worden.

What We Expect From You

  • 3 tot 8 jaar ervaring met fullstack softwareontwikkeling in hightech of enterprise-omgevingen.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met zowel front-end (React, Angular of Vue) als back-end (Java, C#, Node.js, Python).
  • Een afgeronde Bachelor-, bij voorkeur Masteropleiding in een technisch vakgebied (bijvoorbeeld informatica, software engineering of wiskunde).
  • Kennis van en ervaring met softwaredesign en ontwikkelprincipes (OOP, TDD, SOLID, Clean Code).
  • Ervaring met cloudplatforms (Azure, AWS of GCP) en containertechnologie (Docker, Kubernetes) is een plus.
  • Ervaring met Scrum, Agile of SAFe methodieken.

title: Roof Loader Crewmember - Building Materials
description:
With all your career options, why not choose a company where you can own part of the business? MacArthur Co. is 100% Employee-Owned and offers an outstanding suite of employee benefits. What began in 1913 as a small manufacturer of pipe insulation has grown into a national distributor of building materials. At our MacArthur Co., you will receive an ownership stake in the value our combined honest efforts create.


As a Roof Loader Crewmember, you will execute operations stocking & preparing orders of building materials for distribution to a network of customers.   • Regular, reliable, predictable attendance

  • Substantial Stock Ownership Program
  • Competitive Compensation Packages
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) & 8 Paid Holidays Each Year
  • Employer Sponsored Family Dental Insurance

title: Global Solution Owner - Wärtsilä Oyj
description:
We are always on the lookout for a talent with a growth mindset – are you the one?

We are looking for a Global Solution Owner with a main responsibility in Field Service and Workshops (FSWS) process area. The preferred location for this position is in Finland either in Helsinki, Vaasa or Turku but also other Wärtsilä locations are negotiable. We offer the possibility of hybrid work.

Your role and responsibilities

As a Global Solution Owner, you are driving the solution agenda for Field Service and Workshop processes: standardisation, digitalisation and fit-for-purpose IT enablement. The tasks can also be adjusted based on your individual skills and interests. You’ll be working closely with other Global Solution Owners, IT organisation and Global Process Owner of FSWS.

Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

  • Acting as the solution-facing requirements authority: capture needs/pain points, define requirements, and own the requirements backlog.

  • Leading demand management: structure intake, shape demand, and drive prioritisation proposals with FSWS business stakeholders.

  • Ensuring holistic end-to-end process design: safeguard that cross-process and cross-system impacts are considered, not just local optimisations.

  • Ensuring data/integration/reporting/analytics coverage in solutions: that required data flows, integrations, and insight needs are included in designs and deliveries.

  • Driving process & IT innovation: benchmark performance, identify gaps, explore new tech (e.g., AI/analytics/process mining), and lead early feasibility/discovery.

  • Working in SAP S/4HANA Service implementation.

  • Acting as a change leader for solution impact.

To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

  • Strong background in Field Services and Workshops

  • Excellent understanding of SAP S/4HANA Service module

  • Capability to work with different stakeholders, from business VP to a technical specialist

  • University degree and background from similar position

  • Good communication and presentation skills

Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership and taking responsibility of our work. We support each other’s growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe in that by being your own true self you can accomplish so much more. We don’t always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for.

Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.

Nawia IT & Tech will help Wärtsilä in this recruitment. We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

title: Account Director - Promotional Medical Education
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Account Director - Promotional Medical Education based in United States.

This is a senior account leadership opportunity within a science-driven medical communications environment supporting pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device clients.
You will oversee the strategic and day-to-day management of assigned accounts while guiding teams responsible for delivering high-quality medical education programs.
The role combines client leadership, people management, financial oversight, business development, and cross-functional collaboration.
You will build trusted relationships with clients, key faculty, medical associations, and other healthcare stakeholders while translating scientific and business objectives into effective programs.
You will have the opportunity to shape new initiatives, identify growth opportunities, and contribute innovative ideas that strengthen existing client partnerships.
The position offers significant autonomy, visibility with senior leadership, and the chance to mentor account professionals at different stages of their careers.
A flexible, predominantly remote environment supports collaboration, work-life balance, and high-quality delivery across geographically distributed teams.

Accountabilities

  • Manage the day-to-day activities and strategic priorities for an assigned portfolio of client business, ensuring programs are delivered effectively and aligned with client objectives.
  • Establish and maintain strong, trusted relationships with clients, key stakeholders, faculty, medical associations, and relevant healthcare institutions.
  • Maintain consistent written and verbal communication with clients and internal account teams, proactively addressing concerns, resolving issues, and ensuring expectations are met or exceeded.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of client organizations, products, disease states, scientific landscapes, and marketing objectives to provide informed strategic guidance.
  • Oversee project budgets, financial monitoring, reconciliations, forecasts, and other financial aspects of assigned accounts.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities for organic account growth by developing proposals, creating new business presentations, presenting innovative concepts, and participating in client meetings.
  • Lead brainstorming sessions and support the development and launch of new programs and initiatives.
  • Hire, train, coach, and mentor account management professionals while establishing individualized development plans, providing ongoing feedback, and conducting performance evaluations.
  • Assign and manage team workloads, ensuring appropriate staffing, prioritization, and resource allocation across projects.
  • Partner with department leaders to identify, coordinate, and manage internal and external resources required for successful program execution.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments and resolve conflicts involving teams, projects, or individual contributors.
  • Prepare and communicate updates to senior leadership regarding account activity, business development opportunities, financial performance, forecasts, and potential risks.
  • Participate in or lead internal team meetings, ensuring alignment on priorities, responsibilities, timelines, and client commitments.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree required; an advanced degree in science, business, or a related discipline is preferred.
    • 7+ years of relevant professional experience, including management responsibilities and involvement in interdisciplinary teams within scientific marketing, communications, healthcare, or a related environment.
    • Demonstrated experience managing and developing teams, with the ability to provide clear direction, constructive feedback, coaching, and career development support.
    • Experience in promotional medical education, medical communications, medical affairs, healthcare advertising, or a comparable scientific communications environment is highly relevant.
    • Experience within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, managed care, hospital, medical communications agency, or healthcare advertising setting is preferred.
    • Strong ability to quickly understand, retain, and communicate complex scientific and technical concepts.
    • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to build credibility and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders and subject-matter experts.
    • Proven business development capabilities, including proposal development, presentation creation, opportunity identification, and expansion of existing client relationships.
    • Strong financial and organizational skills, including experience overseeing budgets, project resources, workloads, and competing priorities.
    • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, internet-based tools, and other standard business applications.
    • Strong problem-solving, conflict-resolution, prioritization, and decision-making abilities.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively across departments while also working independently in a flexible, remote environment.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible, predominantly remote work environment designed to support work-life balance.
      • Opportunity to work with pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations on science-based medical communications and education programs.
      • Career development and mentorship opportunities within a multidisciplinary environment.
      • Opportunity to lead and develop account management professionals and contribute to their long-term career growth.
      • High-visibility role with exposure to clients, healthcare stakeholders, senior leadership, and new business initiatives.
      • Collaborative environment bringing together professionals with diverse scientific, medical, communications, and business expertise.
      • Opportunity to contribute to innovative, evidence-based programs with clinical and scientific relevance.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Pyspark & AWS
description:
Senior Data Engineer - Pyspark & AWS

Experience: 5-7 Years

Location: Koregoan Park, Pune

Work Mode: Work from Office (5 days working)


Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced and leadership-minded Senior Data Engineer - Pyspark & AWS to drive the reliability, scaling, and operation of our enterprise data infrastructure. In this role, you will balance core development with production support and operational excellence, ensuring high availability through proactive monitoring and debugging of cloud data streams.

As a senior member of the data team, you will take full ownership of the data ecosystem, troubleshoot complex live incidents, and actively mentor and upskill junior engineers.


Key Responsibilities:

Data Engineering & Pipeline Design:

Orchestration: Program complex workflow dependencies and multi-stage DAGs within Apache Airflow.

ETL Architecture: Construct serverless data preparation workflows using AWS Glue and PySpark.

Compute Processing: Deploy targeted, cost-optimized scripts via AWS Lambda for event-driven backend tasks.

Storage Management: Structure secure Amazon S3 data lakes with clear landing, raw, and gold curation tiers.


Leadership & Mentorship:

Technical Ownership: Accept end-to-end accountability for platform health, security compliance, and architecture updates.

Team Mentorship: Guide junior developers through systematic code reviews, architectural advice, and pair programming sessions.

Process Standards: Establish baseline engineering documentation, testing frameworks, and on-call rotation protocols.


Technical Skills:

Primary Skills (Required)

AWS Production Environment: Background supporting enterprise-scale cloud infrastructures under tight data freshness targets.

Observability & Triage: Hands-on triage using AWS CloudWatch, CloudTrail, X-Ray, or third-party log collectors.

Serverless Ingestion: Advanced setup of AWS Glue (Crawlers, Catalogs, Jobs) and event-driven AWS Lambda components.

Data Lakes & Orchestration: Deep mastery of Amazon S3 object storage policies and workflow automation with Apache Airflow.

Apache Spark: Processing large-scale datasets using distributed computing engines via PySpark or Spark SQL.

Python Programming: Advanced scripting for data automation, API bindings, custom transformations, and object mutation.

Database Foundations: Ability to query and locate performance degradation points inside Amazon Redshift, Athena, or RDS systems.


Production Support & Operations:

Production Support: Provide Tier 3 technical support for live cloud datasets, maintaining strict platform uptime SLAs.

System Monitoring: Build dashboards using AWS CloudWatch to track resource consumption and data flow metrics.

Issue Debugging: Inspect execution logs, trace data failures, and resolve runtime bottlenecks across active microservices.

Incident Management: Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) activities for data dropouts, pipeline breaks, or structural data quality shifts.


Qualifications & Experience:

Experience: 5+ years of dedicated data engineering or platform support experience, with strong Pyspark programming skills and at least 3 years directly focused on AWS ecosystems.


Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.

Soft Skills: Highly analytical communicator capable of translating business roadblocks into immediate technical fixes.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Job Title :: Lead Data Engineer

Location :: Pune (Remote)

Minimum relevant years of experience :: 10+ Years


Must have skills:

  • Oracle Golden Gate
  • Change Data Capture (CDC)
  • Cloud experience (Azure/AWS/OCI)
  • Heterogenous Architecture


Job Description:

  • The Lead Data Engineer (Oracle GoldenGate) is the senior technical authority responsible for leading engineering teams in the implementation of Oracle GoldenGate solutions to replicate authoritative operational databases hosted on-premise and in AWS into Microsoft Azure Fabric (OneLake).
  • The role ensures that replication is delivered with accuracy, performance, resilience, and operational robustness, producing stable, production-grade GoldenGate implementations while safeguarding technical integrity. The Lead Data Engineer acts as the primary escalation point for complex replication challenges.
  • This is a hands-on engineering leadership position focused on GoldenGate expertise, implementation excellence, and consistent, standardized execution.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical implementation of Oracle GoldenGate replication solutions from development through production release, ensuring full alignment with approved solution designs.
  • Provide hands-on engineering leadership, working closely with Architecture, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver secure, scalable, and production-ready GoldenGate implementations.
  • Translate architectural designs into robust, resilient solutions, enforcing reusable standards and consistent implementation patterns.
  • Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex replication, performance, and data integrity issues.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks related to database design, performance, networking, and legacy environments, partnering with the Agile Technical Project Manager to manage dependencies and maintain alignment with the agreed delivery plan.
  • Define and implement validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and operational readiness standards for replication environments.
  • Mentor engineers and champion disciplined, standardized GoldenGate engineering practices.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience leading Data Engineering projects
  • Strong working knowledge of database replication and Change Data Capture (CDC) using Oracle GoldenGate
  • Strong background in data engineering in cloud data platforms and DevOps practices
  • Strong leadership, communication, and ownership mindset


Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Working knowledge of Azure Data Services, including Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, storage, and security

Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

The Sourcing Coordinator is responsible for supporting the Sourcing team's effectiveness by coordinating stewardship activities for donors, maintaining donor and prospect information, and ensuring that donor communications and follow-up actions are completed consistently and on schedule. This role helps ensure new and existing donors receive a positive experience through accurate tracking, timely recognition, and proactive stewardship while supporting the team's sourcing efforts. By providing structure, organization, and accountability across key stewardship and sourcing processes, the Sourcing Coordinator enables Sourcing Managers to focus on relationship building and donor growth.


Adhere to PACT values. (Purpose: Using our strengths passionately to contribute to our mission. Accountability: Choosing to rise above one’s circumstances and demonstrating ownership to achieve results. See It. Own It. Solve It. Do It. Courage: Standing up for what’s right and acting. Transparency: Doing things openly and honestly).


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Donor Stewardship

  1. Owns execution of the Donor Stewardship Playbook, ensuring all weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual stewardship activities are completed accurately and on schedule.
  2. Maintains the donor recognition program by tracking donor data, recognition levels, mailings, gifts, and annual recognition activities.
  3. Researches and prospects potential donors through online research, phone calls, and other outreach methods to identify opportunities and gather information needed to establish new donor relationships.
  4. Oversees donor appreciation efforts, including handwritten thank you letters, stewardship campaigns, social media/blog writings, and other donor recognition activities.
  5. Maintains and updates donor-facing communication materials, including newsletters, campaign updates, impact reports, donor handouts, and related stewardship resources.

Operational Support

  1. Responds to donor inquiries while Sourcing Managers are in the field and provides essential information to Sourcing Managers after, to ensure timely follow-up.
  2. Serves as a resource for operational questions, ensuring necessary information is documented and up-to-date, and helping maintain established processes.

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

title: Privatrådgiver
description:
Brænder du for tiltrækning og rådgivning af privatkunder? Vil du have ansvaret for en attraktiv kundeportefølje? Vil du være en del af succesen hos en stærk lokalbank, som lever i mødet med kunden?

Kunderådgiver med ansvar for egen kundeportefølje
Du får ansvaret for en mindre portefølje af attraktive privatkunder. Du er på forkant og yder en personlig rådgivning, hvor du holder møder med dine kunder og tilbyder individuelle og fleksible løsninger, der matcher deres behov. Du holder også møder med de mange nye kunder, der ønsker at skifte til Djurslands Bank, ligesom du deltager i de opsøgende aktiviteter, vi iværksætter sammen i teamet.

Medarbejder i en stærk lokalbank
Du tilbydes en rådgiverstilling, hvor du kan tage selvstændige beslutninger, hvor du får rig mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og personligt, og hvor du er tæt på dine kunder og kan yde en individuel rådgivning. Har du erfaring med eller interesse for at arbejde med kunder i segmentet "Lokal erhverv"? Så er der mulighed for, at det også kan indgå i stillingen.

Privatdirektør Martin Schultz Bürger udtaler: ”Jeg er netop startet i Djurslands Bank, hvor jeg er blevet taget rigtig godt imod som ny kollega i banken. Jeg ser frem til at lære banken endnu bedre at kende og til at stå i spidsen for privatteamet i Randers. Allerede nu har jeg fået indtryk af et team, som brænder for at give gode kundeoplevelse til både nuværende og potentielle kunder, og som har et stærkt socialt fællesskab. Jeg glæder mig til at høre fra netop dig, som vil være med til at være på forkant overfor vores bestående kunder og arbejde med tiltrækning af nye kunder.”

I Randers er vi områdekontor for bankens afdelinger på Djursland og i Randers. Vi har et privatteam, et erhvervsteam og et supportteam, ligesom områdets formuekonsulent og forsikringskonsulent er tilknyttet områdekontoret.

I banken lægger vi vægt på ordentlighed, menneskelige værdier, trivsel og arbejdsglæde. Vi er et bundsolidt pengeinstitut med gode nøgletal, en høj kundetilfredshed og vækst af nye kunder.
Her er frie rammer og korte beslutningsveje, og som lokalbank i Østjylland er alle kolleger og interne ”livliner” funderet i det østjyske – tæt på dig og dine kunder.

Erfaring med rådgivning af privatkunder
Vi forventer, at du er uddannet og fagligt velfunderet som privatrådgiver. Du matcher både førstegangskøberne, de mere komplekse familiekunder samt de modne kunder. Du brænder for rådgivning af privatkunder, du er ambitiøs, og du sætter en høj standard for dine møder.

Hvis du herudover kan nikke ja til følgende, er det måske dig, vi søger:

  • Du er bosat i Randers eller har et godt kendskab til Randers-området
  • Du motiveres af arbejdet med at tiltrække nye kunder
  • Du har flair for opsøgende aktiviteter
  • Du kan bedst lide at opnå gode resultater sammen med dit team

Interesseret?
Du kan høre mere om stillingen ved at kontakte privatdirektør Martin Schultz Bürger på mobil 2327 2370.

Hvis Martin ikke lige tager telefonen ved første kald, så læg en besked eller smid en sms, så vender jeg snarest muligt retur.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning – der naturligvis behandles fortroligt – snarest muligt.

Er du ikke en haj til at skrive ansøgninger? Så nøjes du bare med at sende os dit CV – resten tager vi mundtligt over en kop kaffe.

title: Data & AI Consultant
description:
About ASI Solutions

ASI Solutions is an Australian-owned technology partner focused on making lives easier through agile, reliable technology at scale. For nearly 40 years, ASI has supported education, government, and commercial organisations as technology environments have grown more complex and more critical to performance. Our approach is practical and outcomes-led. We take the time to understand what matters to each organisation before designing and delivering right-sized, de-risked solutions across managed services, cloud, security, data and AI, and digital skills. With national capability and local delivery teams, ASI helps customers move forward with clarity and confidence.

About the Role

We have an e opportunity for a Data & AI Consultant to join our growing Data & AI practice. In this role, success looks like solutions that get adopted, not shelved: reports that are actually used, business stakeholders who trust the numbers because you explained them clearly, and delivery patterns that lift the whole team. You'll design, build and support analytics solutions across Microsoft Fabric and Power BI for customers in education, government and commercial sectors — with exposure to Copilot, Azure OpenAI and agent-based solutions as we extend into Generative AI.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and optimise end-to-end analytics solutions in Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and Warehouse design, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, notebooks and the medallion (bronze/silver/gold) pattern
  • Build and tune Power BI semantic models and reports, including star schema modelling, DAX, Power Query (M), incremental refresh, row-level security and performance tuning
  • Run discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews, mapping business processes and KPIs into requirements the business can sign off on
  • Turn ambiguous business questions into a defensible data model, metric definitions and delivery plan
  • Deliver supporting automation using Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse where relevant
  • Apply governance and security good practice across workspaces, source control, access models and data quality controls
  • Produce clear solution documentation, handover material and customer enablement/training
  • Support pre-sales activity, including scoping, effort estimation and demonstrations
  • Mentor junior consultants and contribute reusable assets back into the practice
  • Own delivery quality on your engagements, managing scope, timeline and stakeholder communication

A Bit About You

You measure your own success by whether your solutions get used. You're analytically sharp, but it's your soft skills that set you apart — you can sit with a business stakeholder, understand what they actually need, and explain a technical trade-off in language that builds confidence rather than confusion. title: Staff RF Engineer
description:
Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Staff RF Engineer to our team. The ideal candidate has experience in board-level RF electronics design. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge RF hardware for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.
In this position, you will be responsible for RF circuits and systems through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will be proficient in board-level schematic design and PCB layout of RF circuits, and system-level communications concepts such as link budgets and modulation schemes. The work will include many aspects of phased array communication systems, including RF front-ends, frequency converters and synthesizers, filters, beamformers, power dividers, and phased array antennas.
As a CesiumAstro hardware team member, you will be responsible for RF hardware designs from initial concept through requirements definition, part selection, detailed design, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support of Cesium's products. Hardware design tasks will include block diagrams, detailed schematics, PCB layout and routing, simulations, and test design.
The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • A Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Electrical Engineering (EE) from an accredited university or institution.
  • 8 years of industry experience in design and analysis of RF electronics design, analysis, test, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with professional simulation tools such as CST and ADS, as well as EDA tools such Altium.
  • Hands-on experience with lab instruments such as vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with MATLAB or other programming languages.
  • Experience in aerospace electronics design, development, and qualification.
  • Knowledge of worst-case circuit analysis, failure method and criticality analyses, and reliability analysis.
  • Experience with antenna design.
  • Knowledge of EMI/EMC design and mitigation techniques.
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.
CesiumAstro is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Our Consumer Experience and Analytics organization, within CVS Health's Data, Digital, Analytics, and Technology (DDAT) organization, is seeking a hands-on, passionate, and people-focused Principal Software Development Engineer to join our high-energy, growing team. In this role, you will help shape the future of healthcare technology by building innovative applications and products at the forefront of cloud, data, and AI-driven solutions. Leveraging your deep technical expertise, you will join a high-performing architecture team responsible for developing a cloud-native platform designed to transform healthcare experiences and improve the lives of hundreds of millions of consumers.

As a Principal Software Development Engineer, you will operate within a large-scale product, engineering, and architecture ecosystem, leading strategic technical initiatives across one or more value streams, Agile Release Trains (ARTs), or enterprise platforms. Exceptional systems thinker who can seamlessly navigate between high-level architectural strategy and detailed technical implementation.

Experience designing and implementing modern software architectures, including microservices and micro-frontend patterns, while driving large-scale solutions across multiple applications and teams.

Broad technical expertise spanning cloud platforms, enterprise applications, microsevices, APIs, data analytics, networking, and large-scale systems.

Good understanding of ADA and other regulatory compliances including PCI, PII, and PHI.

Excellent collaboration, influencing, negotiation, coaching, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build strong coalitions across teams and organizations.

Outstanding communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to effectively evangelize technical vision and drive alignment among diverse stakeholders.

Passionate about technology, innovation, and continuous learning, with a high degree of technical curiosity and aptitude.

Working closely with Product Managers/Owners, Application Architects and Engineering Leads to provide guidance on implementation of reference architecture solutions that demonstrate best in class user experiences.

Evaluating emerging technologies, leading proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives, and developing architectural recommendations that validate technical approaches and accelerate innovation.

Developing solutions that are well engineered, flexible, resilient, operable, maintainable, and can be delivered on schedule, while ensuring a balance between tactical and strategic technology solutions.

Aurthor white papers, guides, how-to's, and other technical documentation that clearly explains architectural guidelines, vision, technical direction, and serves as a reference for the internal developer community.

Excellent collaboration, influencing, evangelization, negotiation, coaching, mentoring, and coalition-building skills, with the ability to work with across all levels (e.g. jr. to VP) and job functions (e.g. product, platform, developers, DevOps).

Champion a user-centric approach to product development, ensuring accessibility, privacy, and security are embedded into every solution. Ensure the secure handling of PII and PHI data and that architectural designs address potential security threats and vulnerabilities.

Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) oversight and development support on future application updates and maintenance.

Mentor and coach architects and engineers, fostering technical excellence, continuous learning, and a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

Define and validate Non-Functional Requirements, including performance, scalability, availability, resiliency, disaster recovery, security, and observability, ensuring solutions meet enterprise standards.

Analyze current architecture and develop opportunities for improvements in alignment with industry best practices.

Work with internal and external stakeholders to arrive at optimal business and technology solutions.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of Software Industry experience.

7+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale solution design and technical architecture initiatives across multiple value streams.

7+ years’ hands-on experience with modern technologies and frameworks, including Java, Python, Node.js, Angular, and ReactJS.

7+ years of experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including data modeling, normalization/denormalization, sharding, and other scalable data architecture patterns.

7+ years of experience designing cloud-native, microservices-based solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

5+ years of experience designing modern APIs and RESTful services that enhance user experience and simplify systems integration.

title: SDM
description:

This is a rare opportunity to join a growing Tier 2 AV/ICT integration business at exactly the right time.

The business has a clear trajectory to become a national AV/ICT integrator over the next 4–5 years, and they're looking for a technically strong professional to help build the service function as the company scales.

One minute you could be jumping in the car for a reactive client call-out, fault-finding a Crestron/Q-SYS/DSP/network issue, getting into the rack and working through the problem with the client.

What's more important is that you're technically strong, customer-focused and ready for greater responsibility.

Why this opportunity?

Because you're getting in early.

You're not joining an established corporate service department where your role is already defined and your progression is limited.

You're joining a business that is growing - and you can grow with it.
The successful person will have the opportunity to influence how service is delivered, how technical resources operate, how customers are supported and how the function scales nationally.

As the business expands, so will the opportunity for technical leadership, people leadership and broader service management responsibility.
For the right person, this can become a long-term leadership career, not simply another technical role.

If you're thinking:

Sydney | Permanent

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Title : Senior Data Engineer

Experience: 6+ Years

Location: Chennai, Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad

Contract: 6 Months

Notice Period : Immediate Joiners


Job Overview


We are seeking a hands-on Data Engineer to develop, optimize, and maintain automated data pipelines supporting data governance and analytics initiatives. This role will focus on building production-ready workflows for ingestion, transformation, quality checks, lineage capture, access auditing, cost usage analysis, retention tracking, and metadata integration, primarily using Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake, and Microsoft Purview.


Key Responsibilities


  • Pipeline Development – Design, build, and deploy robust ETL/ELT pipelines in Databricks (PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake) to ingest, transform, and curate governance and operational metadata from multiple sources landed in Databricks.
  • Granular Data Quality Capture – Implement profiling logic to capture issue-level metadata (source table, column, timestamp, severity, rule type) to support drill-down from dashboards into specific records and enable targeted remediation.
  • Governance Metrics Automation – Develop data pipelines to generate metrics for dashboards covering data quality, lineage, job monitoring, access & permissions, query cost, usage & consumption, retention & lifecycle, policy enforcement, sensitive data mapping, and governance KPIs.
  • Microsoft Purview Integration – Automate asset onboarding, metadata enrichment, classification tagging, and lineage extraction for integration into governance reporting.
  • Data Retention & Policy Enforcement – Implement logic for retention tracking and policy compliance monitoring (masking, RLS, exceptions).
  • Job & Query Monitoring – Build pipelines to track job performance, SLA adherence, and query costs for cost and performance optimization.
  • Metadata Storage & Optimization – Maintain curated Delta tables for governance metrics, structured for efficient dashboard consumption.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting – Monitor pipeline execution, optimize performance, and resolve issues quickly.
  • Collaboration – Work closely with the lead engineer, QA, and reporting teams to validate metrics and resolve data quality issues.
  • Security & Compliance – Ensure all pipelines meet organizational governance, privacy, and security standards.


Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
  • 6+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, with Azure Databricks and Azure Data Lake
  • Proficiency in PySpark, SQL, and ETL/ELT pipeline design
  • Demonstrated experience building granular data quality checks and integrating governance logic into pipelines
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Purview for metadata management, lineage capture, and classification
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory or equivalent orchestration tools
  • Understanding of data modeling, metadata structures, and data cataloging concepts
  • Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to document pipeline logic and collaborate with cross-functional teams

title: Director of Materials Management
description:
The Director of Materials Management is responsible for leading the end-to-end materials management function for manufacturing of high-end indoor and outdoor cooking appliances. The Director owns demand planning, translation and timely loading of the approved forecast into the ERP/MRP system, supply planning, purchasing execution, inventory performance, and material availability. This leader establishes a disciplined demand-to-supply operating cadence; maintains direct, proactive communication with suppliers; and partners closely with manufacturing to identify, escalate, and resolve potential shortages before production is affected. The Director leads and develops a team of 5-7 buyers, planners, and materials professionals in an engaged continuous improvement environment while collaborating with Strategic Sourcing on contracts, pricing, supplier strategy, and new product introductions.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESULTS

  • Provide strategic and operational leadership for demand planning, supply planning, purchasing execution, inventory control, and material availability across the manufacturing operation.
  • Own the demand planning process and operating cadence, integrating commercial forecasts, customer demand, production plans, promotions, service requirements, and new product introductions into one approved demand plan.
  • Ensure the approved forecast is accurately and timely loaded into the ERP/MRP system; govern planning parameters, lead times, safety stocks, order policies, and master data so system-generated demand signals are reliable and actionable.
  • Chair regular demand and supply reviews, identify material and capacity gaps, reconcile constraints, document decisions, and communicate risks, options, and required actions to executive and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Maintain direct and proactive supplier communication regarding forecasts, purchase requirements, capacity, commitments, past-due orders, expedites, recovery plans, and emerging risks.
  • Establish supplier operating rhythms and performance reviews; drive corrective actions and sustainable recovery for delivery, quality, responsiveness, and capacity issues.
  • Stay closely connected to manufacturing through daily shortage and production-readiness reviews; anticipate constraints, prioritize actions, and escalate potential line-impacting shortages with clear owners and recovery dates.
  • Lead cross-functional shortage mitigation with manufacturing, quality, engineering, logistics, and Strategic Sourcing, including alternate supply, substitutions, schedule adjustments, premium freight decisions, and supplier recovery plans.
  • Optimize inventory investment and working capital by balancing service and production continuity with inventory turns, excess and obsolete exposure, safety stock, lot sizes, and supplier lead times.
  • Set functional strategy, policies, standard work, controls, and decision rights for planning, buying, shortage management, inventory governance, and supplier follow-up.
  • Partner with Strategic Sourcing on supplier transitions, resourcing, negotiations, cost-reduction initiatives, risk management, and new product introductions while ensuring execution readiness and continuity of supply.
  • Partner with Quality and Engineering to resolve supplier non-conformance, disposition constrained material, and ensure corrective actions protect future production requirements.
  • Build meaningful dashboards and analytics that provide forward-looking visibility to demand changes, forecast accuracy, supplier performance, shortages, inventory health, and production risk.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 5-7 buyers, planners, and materials professionals; set clear goals, provide timely feedback, build succession capability, and hold the team accountable for results.
  • Create an engaged continuous improvement culture using structured problem solving, root-cause analysis, standard work, visual management, and employee-led improvement initiatives.
  • Develop team capability in ERP/MRP discipline, data analysis, supplier communication, business acumen, and cross-functional influence; ensure appropriate workload balance and coverage.
  • Communicate supply risks, operational tradeoffs, and performance trends clearly across all levels of the organization and translate business priorities into aligned materials actions.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS:

  • Demand plan and system discipline - forecast accuracy and bias by product family; approved forecast loaded into ERP/MRP accurately and on schedule; planning parameter and master-data accuracy.
  • Material availability and production continuity - material availability to schedule; shortage aging and closure rate; production disruptions or schedule misses attributable to material shortages.
  • Supplier delivery and responsiveness - supplier on-time delivery, past-due purchase orders, commit-date adherence, corrective-action closure, and recovery-plan effectiveness.
  • Inventory and working capital - inventory turns or days on hand; excess and obsolete inventory; safety-stock adherence; inventory record accuracy; progress against annual working-capital plan.
  • Planning and purchasing execution - MRP exception closure, purchase-order placement timeliness, reschedule-message action rate, and premium freight or expedite cost attributable to planning or supplier performance.
  • Cross-functional operating cadence - on-time completion of demand, supply, shortage, and supplier reviews; timely escalation of material risks with documented owners, actions, and recovery dates.
  • Continuous improvement - measurable improvements delivered against the annual CI roadmap, including lead-time reduction, process adherence, waste elimination, and sustained corrective actions.
  • People leadership and engagement - achievement of team objectives, development-plan completion, retention, succession coverage, cross-training, engagement, and closure of employee-led improvement actions.
  • Financial performance - materials-related cost, inventory, premium freight, and productivity performance versus the annual operating plan.

title: Klinikchef til Hejmdal Privathospital i Odense
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for en psykiatrisk klinik og sætte retning for mennesker, kvalitet og udvikling i en organisation med høje ambitioner?

Hejmdal Privathospital søger en klinikchef til vores afdeling i Odense. Vi søger en erfaren leder med solid erfaring fra psykiatrien, som motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem andre, udvikle stærke faglige miljøer og omsætte ambitioner til konkrete forandringer, der skaber værdi for både patienter og medarbejdere.

Ledelse, drift og udvikling

Som klinikchef har du det overordnede ansvar for klinikkens drift, kvalitet, udvikling og trivsel.

Du er nærmeste leder for klinikkens teamledere og spiller en central rolle i udviklingen af både ledelseslaget og de faglige miljøer. Sammen med teamlederne skaber du retning for klinikken og sikrer, at medarbejderne har de rette rammer for at levere udredning og behandling af høj faglig kvalitet.

Som klinikchef bringer du din psykiatrifaglige erfaring i spil i arbejdet med at udvikle klinikken, sikre høj behandlingskvalitet og understøtte stærke faglige miljøer på tværs af faggrupper. Du balancerer sikker drift med fortsat udvikling af klinikken og trives med at omsætte strategiske beslutninger til konkrete forandringer i hverdagen.

Du trives i en organisation i udvikling og motiveres af at skabe forbedringer. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du har erfaring med at drive forandringer og formår at omsætte idéer og strategiske beslutninger til konkrete løsninger, som skaber værdi for både patienter og medarbejdere.

Du får blandt andet ansvar for

  • Klinikkens samlede drift, kvalitet, aktivitet og resultater, herunder kapacitetsstyring, prioritering, ressourceplanlægning og økonomi
  • Ledelse, udvikling og rekruttering af klinikkens medarbejdere samt understøttelse af trivsel og organisationsudvikling
  • At drive, implementere og forankre udviklings- og forandringsinitiativer samt skabe følgeskab omkring nye strategier, processer og måder at arbejde på
  • Tværgående samarbejde på tværs af Hejmdals klinikker og stabsfunktioner

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har en relevant sundhedsfaglig uddannelse som psykiater, psykolog eller sygeplejerske
  • Har solid erfaring fra psykiatrien samt dokumenterede resultater fra ledelsesroller
  • Skaber resultater gennem ledere, nøglepersoner og medarbejdere
  • Har erfaring med at drive og implementere forandringer og kan skabe følgeskab, engagement og varige resultater
  • Er en synlig og relationsstærk leder med fokus på udvikling af mennesker, faglighed og organisation
  • Har et stærkt organisatorisk blik og kan balancere drift, kvalitet og udvikling

Et stærkt lederfællesskab

Hos Hejmdal tror vi på, at gode resultater skabes gennem stærke relationer, høj faglighed og fælles retning.

Som klinikchef bliver du en del af Hejmdals samlede ledergruppe og indgår samtidig i et stærkt lederfællesskab med de øvrige klinikchefer. Du får et tæt samarbejde med direktionen samt kolleger i HR, Økonomi, Projektkontoret og øvrige centrale funktioner. Samarbejde, sparring og fælles udvikling er en vigtig del af hverdagen.

Hos Hejmdal går høje faglige ambitioner hånd i hånd med arbejdsglæde, ordentlighed og fællesskab, fordi vi tror på, at det er fundamentet for bæredygtige resultater.

Hjertet af Hejmdal

Hejmdal Privathospital er Danmarks største psykiatriske privathospital med afdelinger i Aalborg, Aarhus, Odense og på Frederiksberg.

Vi er et tværfagligt fællesskab af speciallæger, psykologer, sygeplejersker, læger og administrative medarbejdere, som hver dag arbejder for at hjælpe børn, unge og voksne med psykiatriske lidelser gennem udredning og behandling af høj faglig kvalitet.

Hos os går faglighed, omsorg og ambitioner hånd i hånd. Vi tager ansvar, bruger vores handlerum og arbejder hver dag for at hjælpe flest muligt bedst muligt.

Praktiske oplysninger

  • Arbejdssted: Hejmdal Odense, Rytterkasernen 21, 5000 Odense C
  • Ansøgningsfrist: Vi vurderer og indkalder løbende til samtale

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, som du ikke kan finde svar på i opslaget eller på vores hjemmeside, er du velkommen til at kontakte Administrerende direktør Katja Damborg Laut på kdl@hejmdal.dk.

  • Ability to stand for extended periods.
