title: Senior Communication Systems Engineer - Spacecraft
description:
Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are designing, building, and launching 8 new satellites in the next four years. They are BIG and super capable RF payload rideshare SmallSats. Our launches are already secured. Our in-house test facilities are built. If you want to own critical communications for these LEO communications satellites and then have the chance to iterate and improve your design at a rapidly growing tech company, this is your chance.
We’re looking for builders, problem-solvers, and system thinkers. As a Senior Communication Systems Engineer, you will own the design, configuration, and operation of the satellite’s space-to-ground communication links. You will define how the satellite communicates with the ground in both nominal and off-nominal conditions, ensuring reliable command, telemetry, and fault recovery.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, expertise with both space-based communication payloads and ground terminals, and proven ability to coordinate activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Model, analyze and maintain the satellite’s link budget, modulation and coding, ensuring reliable communications from space to ground for all RF links.
  • Architect hardware-based crypto solutions for flight hardware, manage pass-throughs and end points for users and operations.
  • Strong understanding of ground station and network operations with the ability to troubleshoot issues with commercial providers and on-site terminals.
  • Define how the radios are used in different mission phases, including contingency operations and emergency recovery.
  • Contribute to the RF link test campaign and work with flight software and ground teams to validate end-to-end communication link performance, from antenna to command center.
  • Optimize low-SWaP communications, mitigate interference, and ensure robust, fail-safe links.

WHAT A SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE LOOKS LIKE

  • You understand how to design, analyze, and operate spaceborne communication links.
  • You can balance power, bandwidth, protocols and noise to ensure reliable space-to-ground connectivity. You can answer “what’s the link budget” with thorough analysis, EbN0, EsN0, or effective data rate given a variety of conditions.
  • Extensive and practical experience with crypto—From COMSEC plan development, key management to system trouble shooting you have applied, on the ground experience.
  • You know how comms fit into the broader mission, from flight software integration to ground operations
  • You are comfortable identifying problems and using your expertise to find solutions.
  • You can prototype, test, and iterate quickly, focusing on what’s needed to get a mission off the ground.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related field
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience with emphasis on satellite communications, RF system engineering, or related fields
  • Experience in design, verification, and operation of satellite communication links
  • Strong understanding of link budget analysis, modulation schemes, and ground station interfaces
  • Hands-on experience configuring and testing ground station equipment and space-qualified radios and antennas
  • Practical understanding of how space links fail, why, and how to fix them before they break
  • Ability to define and implement communication system CONOPS for nominal and emergency operations
  • Experience with satellite communication link licensing and regulatory compliance (ITU/FCC)

title: Sr Revenue Assurance Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr Revenue Assurance Analyst based in the United States.

This role is focused on protecting revenue integrity through detailed financial analysis, account investigation, and risk identification.
You will evaluate customer claims, disputes, contracts, pricing, and financial obligations to ensure accurate outcomes.
With approximately 80% of the role dedicated to Revenue Assurance and 20% to Billing Operations support, you will have broad operational visibility.
Your analysis will help uncover revenue leakage, financial exposure, process gaps, and opportunities for recovery and improvement.
You will work closely with Finance, Billing Operations, Sales, Customer Success, and Legal or Contract Administration teams.
The role combines investigative problem-solving, data analysis, reporting, and process improvement in a remote or hybrid environment.
It is an opportunity to directly influence financial accuracy, customer outcomes, operational controls, and sustainable revenue performance.

Accountabilities

  • Evaluate customer claims, disputes, and account concerns, validating contractual terms, pricing, and financial obligations.
  • Investigate disputed charges, account discrepancies, and complex customer financial issues to determine appropriate resolutions and amounts due.
  • Assess and recommend customer adjustments when warranted, preparing supporting documentation for management review and approval.
  • Analyze customer account activity to identify revenue leakage, financial risk exposures, process deficiencies, and control gaps.
  • Conduct detailed account research and root-cause analysis to resolve recurring issues and improve revenue integrity.
  • Develop and maintain reporting and analytics covering customer disputes, account adjustments, revenue recovery opportunities, revenue risk trends, and operational performance.
  • Partner with Finance and other business stakeholders to support revenue validation, financial controls, and revenue assurance activities.
  • Collaborate with Billing Operations on customer investigations, escalations, billing discrepancies, and complex account issues.
  • Support operational reporting, process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives within billing operations.
  • Maintain working knowledge of billing, provisioning, and order-to-cash processes to support operational continuity.
  • Assist with implementing and enhancing billing controls, policies, and procedures.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives affecting billing operations and customer financial outcomes.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Mathematics, Data Analytics, Accounting, or a related discipline.
    • 3–7 years of experience in Revenue Assurance, Revenue Operations, Customer Financial Operations, Financial Analysis, Contract Administration, Audit, Billing Operations, Business Analysis, or a related field is preferred.
    • Strong analytical, investigative, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to research complex account activity and financial discrepancies.
    • Demonstrated ability to interpret contracts, pricing schedules, amendments, and customer agreements and translate them into financial conclusions.

    • Experience in data center, colocation, managed services, cloud services, SaaS, technology services, or other recurring-revenue environments is preferred.
    • Knowledge of customer account lifecycle management and revenue management principles is a plus.

title: VP of Autonomy
description:
Mission

TAR’s mission is to power intelligence for the world. We are building the world’s first off-grid power plant for data centers powered by renewable technologies.

We firmly believe AI should be built in the US for the benefit of all people. For that, power must be fast, clean and scalable. We are singularly focused on delivering GW-scale power faster than anyone has ever done, by rethinking every layer of the stack.

We vertically integrate to solve every bottleneck, from racking systems to power electronics to dispatch algorithms to on-site construction.

Leave your mark on the future of civilization-scale energy infrastructure.

Company

TAR is both a hardware and software company, we are building out massive, critical, physical infrastructure. TAR is working directly with one of the largest compute providers to scale and deploy 5GWs by 2028.

We operate on…

  • High ownership. High Agency. Own project end-to-end. Great people don’t need to be managed.

  • Speed. We achieve great things on incredible timelines. We push ourselves to go faster.

  • First principles. No ego. No hierarchy. Challenge every assumption.

  • Passion. Solving the energy problem is one of the largest challenges that faces the world now and in the future.

About the role

TAR builds its own construction robots to install a proprietary solar racking system at the scale and pace gigawatt campuses demand. The robots and the hardware they run are engineered together, and the autonomy software that drives them has to hold up in the dust, heat, and vibration of a live construction site in West Texas. As VP of Autonomy, you own the autonomy software organization: perception, planning, and controls for TAR's robotics systems. You take autonomy from early development through field deployment across a growing robot fleet, set the technical direction and system architecture, and hire and lead the engineers and managers who ship it. This is a leadership-team seat based at our San Francisco robotics facility, with real time in the field at our West Texas site.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the autonomy software strategy and technical roadmap for TAR's robotics systems, tying engineering priorities to a hard construction schedule and the company's energy-infrastructure mission.

  • Build and lead the autonomy software organization, hiring, structuring, and developing individual contributors and engineering managers as the scope grows from one robot to a fleet.

  • Own system architecture across autonomy, perception, planning, and controls, making design choices that hold up under real operating conditions in the field, not only in simulation.

  • Drive the software development lifecycle end to end, from roadmap and prioritization through release, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner directly with hardware and manufacturing leadership so autonomy software is co-developed with the robots it runs on rather than bolted on afterward.

  • Serve as the senior autonomy voice on the leadership team, shaping investment decisions, roadmap trade-offs, and deployment timing alongside engineering, product, and executive leadership.

  • Represent autonomy externally with customers, partners, and investors when technical credibility in robotics software is what earns trust.

  • Establish field-feedback loops so lessons from deployed robots feed directly back into the software roadmap and architecture.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading a software organization at the Director, Head of, or VP level.

  • Hands-on track record building and scaling a software team from an early stage, setting technical direction, engineering process, and hiring.

  • Demonstrated ownership of software or autonomy for a robotics system in production or field deployment, from early development through real-world operation.

  • Deep expertise in autonomous systems software: perception, planning, controls, or a closely related discipline.

  • Strong communication skills, comfortable representing autonomy and software decisions to executive leadership, customers, and investors.

Nice to have

  • Experience with autonomy for energy, industrial, or infrastructure robotics, such as Anduril, Built Robotics, or Tesla, rather than consumer robotics.

  • A track record partnering closely with hardware teams on tightly coupled hardware, software, and autonomy systems.

  • Background in a high-growth, venture-backed robotics or hardware startup.

  • Experience standing up an autonomy software organization from zero to one, building it before you scale it.

Salary and Benefits

  • Up to $15K relocation bonus

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance

  • $1K monthly stipend for meals

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:

title: Solutions Architect - Data Engineering
description:
Solutions Architect - Data Engineering


What are we looking for

real solver?

Solver? Absolutely. But not the usual kind. We're searching for the architects of the audacious & the pioneers of the possible. If you're the type to dismantle assumptions, re-engineer ‘best practices,’ and build solutions that make the future possible NOW, then you're speaking our language.

  • Improver. Solver. Futurist.
  • Great sense of humor.
  • ‘Possible. It is.’ Mindset.
  • Compassionate collaborator. Bold experimenter. Tireless iterator.
  • Natural creativity that doesn’t just challenge the norm, but solves to design what’s better.
  • Thinks in systems. Solves at scale.


This Isn’t for Everyone. But if you’re the kind who questions why things are done a certain way— and then identifies 3 better ways to do it — we’d love to chat with you.


Your Responsibilities

what you will wake up to solve.


You are not just a Solutions Architect; you are a futurifier of our data universe and the primary enabler of our AI ambitions. With a deep-seated passion for data engineering, you will architect and build the foundational data infrastructure that powers the customers entire data intelligence ecosystem.

As the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for our enterprise-grade data platforms, you own the outcome, end-to-end. You are the definitive solver for our customer's most complex data challenges, leveraging a powerful tech stack including Snowflake, Databricks, etc. and core GCP & AWS services (BigQuery, Spanner, Airflow, Kafka). This is a hands-on-keys role where you won't just design solutions—you'll build them, break them, and perfect them.


  • Solution Design & Pre-sales Excellence:Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, engineering, and operations, to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Design Core Data Engineering: Master data modeling, architecting high-performance data ingestion pipelines and ensuring data quality and governance throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Enable Cloud & AI: Design and implement solutions utilizing core GCP data services, building foundational data platforms that efficiently support advanced analytics and AI/ML initiatives.
  • Optimize Performance & Cost: Continuously optimize data architectures and implementations for performance, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness within the cloud environment.
  • Bridge Business & Tech: Translate complex business requirements into clear technical designs, providing technical leadership and guidance to data engineering teams.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Continuously research and evaluate new data technologies, architectural patterns, and industry trends to keep our data platforms at the cutting edge.


The DNA of a ‘Searcian’

superpowers we value.

The ‘happier’ core

  • happier-at-heart: humble, adaptable, positive, passionate, innovative, excellence-minded, responsible.
  • happier-in-action: Not just a poster on the wall; It's how we make decisions, treat each other, show up for clients & hire or promote people.
  • Thinks like a founder. Acts like an owner.
  • Always in Beta: Relentless curiosity. Openness to learn, un-learn, and re-learn.
  • Real Optimist: Views all setbacks as opportunities.
  • Believes in truth over comfort. Ideas over titles. Learning over knowing.
  • Embraces chaos with calm. Evolves faster than the market.


Functional Skills:


  • Enterprise Data Architecture Design: Expert ability to design holistic, scalable, and resilient data architectures for complex enterprise environments.
  • Cloud Data Platform Strategy: Proven capability to strategize, design, and implement cloud-native data platforms.
  • Pre-Sales & Technical Storyteller: Crafts compelling, client-ready proposals, architectural decks, and technical demonstrations. Doesn't just present; shapes the strategic technical narrative behind every proposed solution.
  • Advanced Data Modelling: Mastery in designing various data models for analytical, operational, and transactional use cases.
  • Data Ingestion & Pipeline Orchestration: Strong expertise in designing and optimizing robust data ingestion and transformation pipelines.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Exceptional skills in articulating complex technical concepts and architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Performance & Cost Optimization: Adept at optimizing data solutions for performance, efficiency, and cost within a cloud environment.


Tech Superpowers:


  • Cloud Data Mastery: You're a wizard at leveraging public cloud data services, with deep expertise in GCP (BigQuery, Spanner, etc.) and expert proficiency in modern data warehouse solutions like Snowflake.
  • Data Engineering Core: Highly skilled in designing, implementing, and managing data workflows using tools like Apache Airflow and Apache Kafka. You're also an authority on advanced data modeling and ETL/ELT patterns.
  • AI/ML Data Foundation: You instinctively design data pipelines and structures that efficiently feed and empower Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence applications.
  • Programming for Data: You have a strong command over key programming languages (Python, SQL) for scripting, automation, and building data processing applications.


Experience & Relevance:


  • Architectural Leadership (8+ Years): You bring extensive experience (8+ years) specifically in a Solutions Architect role, focused on data engineering and platform building.
  • Cloud Data Expertise: You have a proven track record of designing and implementing production-grade data solutions leveraging major public cloud platforms, with significant experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Data Warehousing & Data Platform: Demonstrated hands-on experience in the end-to-end design, implementation, and optimization of modern data warehouses and comprehensive data platforms.
  • Databricks & BigQuery Mastery: You possess significant practical experience with Databricks as a core data warehouse and GCP BigQuery for analytical workloads.
  • Data Ingestion & Orchestration: Proven experience designing and implementing complex data ingestion pipelines and workflow orchestration using tools like Airflow and real-time streaming technologies like Kafka.
  • AI/ML Data Enablement: Experience in building data foundations specifically geared towards supporting Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence initiatives.


Join the ‘real solvers’

ready to futurify?

If you are excited by the possibilities of what an AI-native engineering-led, modern tech consultancy can do to futurify businesses, apply here and experience the ‘Art of the possible’.


Don’t Just Send a Resume. Send a Statement.

description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

About the team

As the engineering organization matures, the infrastructure teams are key to Airwallex’s ability to build a globally distributed platform, increase engineer productivity, and ensure effective use of resources.

Our team works to provide the best possible experience for our developers and customers while providing a safe and secure environment to ensure that our financial solutions are always available.

  • Experience using and understanding of other cloud infrastructure (Aliyun, azure, etc.)

title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer
description:

Solve by Talent is partnering with the University of Sydney to recruit an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer to support the delivery of key Information and Communications Technology (ICT) initiatives that help shape the future of education, research, and innovation.

Why join the University of Sydney?

Join one of Australia’s leading universities at a pivotal point of change, where technology is evolving to better support student learning, empower teaching excellence, and enable research delivery at global scale.

ICT is central to delivering the University’s academic mission. Working across faculties, disciplines, and research communities, you will shape the platforms, services, and partnerships that enable student success, strengthen teaching, and accelerate research impact.

With strong investment and clear direction, you’ll operate in a large and complex environment where your contribution has visible, meaningful impact across the University.

The opportunity

This role offers the opportunity to play a key part in operating and evolving the University’s enterprise AI environment, ensuring AI-enabled systems and generative AI tools are secure, reliable and responsibly managed.

You’ll work across the full engineering lifecycle of AI-enabled systems, from understanding business needs and shaping technical solutions through to development, deployment, monitoring, support and ongoing optimisation.

This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong focus on operational reliability, model assurance and responsible AI, oppose to building AI models from scratch.

What you’ll do
  • Design, develop, deploy and operationalise scalable AI-enabled platforms, solutions and tools.
  • Administer, monitor and maintain AI-enabled platforms, services and generative AI tools in cloud environments.
  • Monitor and support the observability of AI platforms and services, responding to incidents, conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventative improvements.
  • Plan and deliver software upgrades, security patches, performance tuning and maintenance activities to keep AI services secure, reliable and efficient.
  • Validate and monitor AI model performance, identify technical and operational risks, and ensure outcomes remain accurate, explainable and aligned with assurance standards.
  • Support the infrastructure, data pipelines and data management practices underpinning AI systems.
  • Partner with architects, engineers, product teams, governance functions and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.

What we’re looking for
  • Extensive commercial experience across cloud, software, platform or integration engineering, including hands-on experience delivering and supporting AI-enabled platforms within a large, complex organisation.
  • Strong coding capability in Python, SQL or similar languages, with experience in version control, testing and automation.
  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, intelligent agents and other LLM-based services.
  • Strong data management and engineering capability, including troubleshooting AI systems and improving performance, reliability and scalability.
  • Demonstrated understanding of secure and responsible enterprise AI practices, including privacy, data protection, access controls, AI risk assessment, assurance, monitoring and governance in a complex organisational environment.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in Computer Science, ICT or a related discipline, or equivalent training and experience.

What’s in it for you?

At the University of Sydney, we support our staff with a range of benefits designed to enhance your career, wellbeing and work-life balance, including:
  • 17% superannuation to support your financial future
  • Generous parental leave entitlements
  • Salary packaging options
  • Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
  • Career development and learning opportunities
  • Health and wellbeing programs, including Fitness Passport
  • Access to a vibrant, globally recognised university community
Accessibility and inclusion

University of Sydney is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience for all candidates.

If you require any adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please let us know. This may include changes to the interview format, additional time, breaks, accessible interview locations, materials in advance, or other practical support to help you participate comfortably.

Pre-employment checks

Any offer of employment will be subject to the successful completion of required pre-employment and background checks. Ongoing employment may also require you to maintain relevant clearances or checks required for the role.

To meet the University’s obligations under the National Higher Education Code to Prevent and Eliminate Gender-Based Violence, you may also be asked to declare whether you have been investigated for, or found to have engaged in, sexual harm or gender-based violence during previous employment or through a legal process.

Sponsorship / work rights for Australia

To be eligible for this role, you must have unrestricted work rights in Australia for the duration of the appointment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

How to apply

If you’re looking to contribute to meaningful work in a world-class university environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now to join the University of Sydney.

title: Level Designer, Missions
description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Avalanche is a Warner Bros. Games studio located in downtown Salt Lake City nestled against the backdrop of the beautiful Wasatch Mountains. We’ve been in the video game business since 1995, creating interactive experiences for fans of the world’s largest franchises. Join the team behind the blockbuster open world, action RPG Hogwarts Legacy as we create what’s next!

Avalanche, a division of WB Games Inc., is seeking a Mission Level Designer to join our team of talented industry veterans. In this role, you will guide the creative vision and execution of missions, owning the player experience from concept through final implementation. As both a mission implementer and player-focused storyteller, you will shape gameplay, pacing, and spatial design while collaborating across disciplines to deliver cohesive, immersive experiences. The ideal candidate brings a passion for game design and The Wizarding World.


What part will you play?

  • Mission Ownership, Structure & Player Experience:
    Collaborate on the design and deliver compelling missions from concept through final implementation. Define mission structure, pacing, and gameplay flow across combat, exploration, and narrative beats, ensuring the player experience is intuitive, engaging, and aligned with the game’s creative vision. Communicate objectives and progression through level design, using spatial layout, encounter design, and environmental storytelling rather than relying on explicit instruction.
  • Implementation & Scripting:
    Implement missions using visual scripting tools, establishing core logic, progression, triggers, and integration with game systems. Deliver functional, stable content that is consistently ready for QA, internal reviews, and playtests.
  • Iteration, Feedback & Quality Refinement:
    Champion an iterative development process by proactively gathering feedback through reviews, cross-disciplinary input, and playtesting. Translate feedback and insights into actionable improvements, continuously refining mission flow, difficulty, readability, and emotional impact.
  • Creative Input:
    Serve as a key creative contributor in defining each mission’s purpose, tone, emotional arc, and learning opportunities. Ensure missions not only succeed on their own terms, but also support progression goals, reinforce the broader player journey, and contribute meaningfully to the overall game experience.
  • Cross-Disciplinary Leadership & Communication:
    Act as the mission’s point of ownership and alignment across disciplines, driving communication with design, art, audio, narrative, engineering, and other partners as needed. Anticipate dependencies, surface risks early, and maintain momentum by identifying opportunities, proposing solutions, and guiding the mission forward through initiative and ownership.
  • Mentorship & Design Stewardship:
    Uphold design standards, share best practices and support the growth of other designers through feedback, collaboration and by example. Help elevate the craft of mission design across the project through thoughtful critique and a strong understanding of the player experience.

What do we need from you?

  • Industry experience as a Level Designer, with a track record of owning missions from concept to final implementation.
  • Solid experience in Unreal Engine 5, including level creation workflows, tools, and best practices in a production environment.
  • Proficient in Blueprints (UE5), including the ability to implement and troubleshoot gameplay logic, mission flow, and scripted events with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Strong understanding of mission flow, spatial composition, gameplay pacing, and player guidance across combat, exploration, and narrative-driven moments.
  • Proven cross-disciplinary leadership, with experience collaborating closely with art, narrative, engineering, and design to align contributors around a shared creative vision.
  • Excellent communication and feedback skills, with the ability to both receive direction thoughtfully and provide clear, constructive feedback to others.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, with the ability to take ownership, anticipate development needs, and continuously drive work forward.
  • Solid creative judgment and design sensibility, with the ability to contribute original ideas while balancing player experience, production constraints, and overall game goals.
  • A passion for games, level design, and crafting exceptional player experiences.

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

title: Charter Broker (Helicopter & Private Jet)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Charter Broker (Helicopter & Private Jet) based in India.

This is a freelance commercial role focused on growing private aviation charter business across Bengaluru and the wider Indian market.
You will identify, qualify, negotiate, and close high-value helicopter and private jet charter opportunities for discerning clients.
The role combines business development, aviation broking, supplier management, and end-to-end charter coordination.
You will leverage established relationships with operators, clients, luxury travel partners, corporate organizations, production houses, and event planners.
Success will depend on your ability to source competitive aircraft solutions, negotiate effectively, and deliver a highly responsive client experience.
You will work with a strong degree of autonomy while collaborating with operational teams to ensure smooth execution of bookings.
This opportunity is particularly suited to an aviation professional with a strong network, commercial drive, and a proven record of closing premium charter deals.

Accountabilities

  • Identify and develop new charter opportunities through existing networks, corporate outreach, luxury travel partners, production companies, event planners, and other relevant channels.
  • Manage the complete charter sales cycle, from lead generation and client qualification through aircraft sourcing, routing, pricing, negotiation, and contract finalization.
  • Source suitable helicopters and private jets by maintaining and expanding a reliable network of aircraft operators and FBOs.
  • Negotiate competitive aircraft availability and pricing while balancing client requirements, commercial objectives, and operational feasibility.
  • Prepare tailored quotations, flight itineraries, and proposals that meet client expectations and applicable aviation, safety, and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate with operations teams on confirmed bookings, passenger manifests, ground handling, special requests, and other logistical requirements.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, track pipeline activity, monitor opportunities, and provide revenue forecasts.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with high-net-worth individuals, corporate executives, travel professionals, production teams, and other key stakeholders.
  • Represent the business professionally at industry events, client meetings, and relevant commercial networking opportunities.
  • Provide market intelligence and contribute insights that can support commercial strategy and expansion within the Indian private aviation market.
  • Protect client confidentiality and demonstrate discretion while consistently delivering a premium, personalized service experience.

    • Requirements

    • 3+ years of relevant experience in aircraft charter sales, aviation broking, private aviation operations, or a closely related commercial aviation role.
    • Demonstrated expertise in helicopter and/or private jet charter, with a strong understanding of the private aviation sales cycle.
    • An established network of clients, aircraft operators, brokers, FBOs, or other industry contacts within the Indian private aviation market; Bengaluru connections are highly desirable.
    • Proven ability to generate business, negotiate high-value contracts, manage commercial relationships, and consistently close sales.
    • Strong commercial judgment and an entrepreneurial, proactive approach to business development.
    • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; knowledge of additional regional languages is an advantage.
    • Strong client-management and relationship-building skills, particularly when working with high-net-worth and corporate customers.
    • Excellent organization and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-value enquiries and negotiations simultaneously.
    • Comfortable working independently in a freelance, commission-based environment with flexibility to travel for client meetings when required.
    • Proficiency with CRM systems, quoting platforms, Microsoft Office, and other relevant sales tools.
    • Knowledge of aviation regulations, aircraft operating requirements, and operator safety standards is advantageous.
    • A high level of discretion, professionalism, responsiveness, and commitment to premium customer service.

      • Benefits

      • Commission-based compensation with the commission structure to be discussed, offering significant earning potential based on performance.
      • Flexible freelance arrangement with autonomy over schedule, business development activity, and pipeline management.
      • Opportunity to work with a premium aviation business serving high-net-worth individuals and corporate clients.
      • Access to support from internal sales and operations teams for logistics, booking coordination, and contract execution.
      • Opportunity to expand your professional network across the private aviation and luxury travel sectors.
      • Potential for long-term collaboration and increased territory or responsibilities based on commercial performance.
      • Remote and flexible working structure, with local presence in Bengaluru for relevant client meetings and business development activities.
